Our key insight is that interaction naturally enables trajectory-dependent adaptive computation: retrieved spatial memory can be discarded during novel exploration, temporal context can be adjusted according to local latent dynamics, and early-step model outputs can be reused when the camera revisits familiar regions. Based on this insight, Light Interaction combines adaptive context management, denoising cache acceleration, and hardware-software co-designed 3D block sparse attention with fused Triton kernels. Evaluated on HY-WorldPlay and Matrix-Game-3.0, Light Interaction achieves up to 2.59x speedup without model retraining while maintaining competitive visual quality.

</details>


### [311] [Diffusion Image Generation with Explicit Modeling of Data Manifold Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00094)
*Duoduo Xue,Zhiyu Zhu,Junhui Hou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MIND，一种融合离散补丁标记化与连续扩散模型的数据流形感知图像扩散模型，通过软top-k聚合、双分支高频特征嵌入和多阶段过渡采样策略，在ImageNet 256×256上大幅超越DiT和SiT基线，以130M参数达到FID 2.06，超越3.1B参数的LlamaGen-3B。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像生成模型需要从底层数据流形中采样，但现有方法（纯离散标记化或纯连续扩散）难以同时兼顾结构量化能力和并行生成灵活性，且Transformer骨干在低维输入上存在频谱偏差问题。

Method: 1) 将离散补丁标记化集成到连续扩散模型的得分函数中，显式建模流形几何；2) 提出软top-k聚合机制实现端到端可微训练；3) 设计双分支高频特征嵌入层缓解Transformer的频谱偏差；4) 提出多阶段过渡采样方案，根据时间步动态调整采样策略。

Result: ImageNet 256×256上，80轮训练后MIND-B无引导FID 22.73（DiT-B/2为43.47）；平均比DiT和SiT分别降低FID 15.95和9.06；有引导下MIND-B（130M参数）FID 2.06，超越LlamaGen-3B（3.1B参数）的FID；MIND-XL（715M参数）FID降至1.95。

Conclusion: MIND通过融合离散标记化与连续扩散，为扩散生成模型提供了新视角，在效率和效果上均取得显著提升，代码将开源。

Abstract: Image generative models aim to sample data points from the underlying data manifold, a task that requires learning and decoding a dense, low-dimensional, and compact parameterization space. To achieve this, we propose the Data Manifold-aware Image diffusioN moDel (MIND), a novel framework that explicitly models manifold geometry by integrating discrete patch tokenization into the score function of a continuous diffusion model. This approach successfully leverages both the structural quantification capabilities of discrete tokens and the parallel generation flexibility of continuous diffusion. Moreover, we enable end-to-end differentiable training via a novel soft top-$k$ aggregation mechanism and introduce dual-branch high-frequency feature embedding layers to alleviate the spectral bias of transformer backbones on low-dimensional inputs. Furthermore, for inference, we design a multi-stage transition sampling scheme that dynamically adjusts the sampling scheme based on timestep. Extensive experiments on ImageNet 256$\times$256 demonstrate the effectiveness of MIND. After 80-epoch training, our base model achieves an FID of 22.73 without guidance, nearly halving the 43.47 FID of the vanilla DiT-B/2 baseline. The proposed method reduces FID by 15.95 and 9.06 on average compared with the baselines DiT and SiT, respectively. For image generation on ImageNet-256$\times$256 with guidance, the proposed MIND-B with only 130M parameters achieves an FID of 2.06, superpassing the LlamaGen-3B with 3.1B parameters. The proposed MIND-XL with 715M parameters further reduces the FID to 1.95. Our MIND introduces a fresh perspective on diffusion-based image generation, paving the way for future research and innovation in this community. The code will be publicly available.

</details>


### [312] [CR-JEPA: Cross-Modal Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for Remote Sensing Image Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00706)
*Md Aminur Hossain,Ayush V. Patel,Nitant Dube,Biplab Banerjee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CR-JEPA是一种跨模态遥感图像检索框架，采用联合嵌入预测架构和素描各向同性高斯正则化，在BEN-14K等数据集上显著提升了跨模态检索性能（S1→S2从61.23%到75.82%），同时保持同模态检索竞争力且参数更少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨模态遥感图像检索面临成像物理、空间分辨率、光谱配置和视觉外观的显著差异，且单一投影目标难以同时支持跨模态语义对齐和同模态邻域保持。

Method: 提出CR-JEPA，包含模态特定stem、共享Transformer主干和JEPA风格预测目标；应用素描各向同性高斯正则化稳定嵌入；采用解耦头设计，分别处理同模态和跨模态检索。

Result: 在BEN-14K上，S1→S2检索从61.23%提升至75.82%，S2→S1从63.73%提升至75.40%，显著优于X-JEPA，且同模态检索具有竞争力。

Conclusion: CR-JEPA有效解决了跨模态遥感检索中语义对齐和嵌入稳定性的挑战，在多个基准上取得最优性能。

Abstract: Cross-modal remote sensing image retrieval aims to retrieve semantically related scenes across heterogeneous sensing modalities. This remains challenging because paired observations may differ substantially in imaging physics, spatial resolution, spectral configuration, and visual appearance. Moreover, a single retrieval projection trained with one objective may be insufficient to jointly support cross-modal semantic alignment and same-modal neighbourhood preservation. We propose CR-JEPA, a Cross-modal Retrieval Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for dual-modality remote sensing retrieval. The model uses modality-specific stems, a shared transformer trunk, and JEPA-style predictive objectives to estimate masked latent target features within and across modalities. Inspired by LeJEPA, we apply Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization to raw retrieval projections to stabilize embeddings and mitigate collapse. CR-JEPA further employs a decoupled-head design with a unified retrieval head for same-modal retrieval and a cross-modal retrieval head for cross-modal search. We evaluate CR-JEPA on BEN-14K, CBRSIR_VS, and DSRSID. On BEN-14K, CR-JEPA improves S1 to S2 retrieval from 61.23% to 75.82% and S2 to S1 retrieval from 63.73% to 75.40% over X-JEPA, while also achieving competitive same-modal retrieval with fewer parameters.

</details>


### [313] [MBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark on Memory Capability for Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00793)
*Shengjun Zhang,Zhang Zhang,Simin Huang,Zhenyu Tang,Hanyang Wang,Chensheng Dai,Min Chen,Yifan Li,Yuxin Li,Yingjie Chen,Hao Liu,Chen Li,Jing Lyu,Yueqi Duan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对视频世界模型在长期记忆保持能力上的缺失，本文提出MBench基准，从实体一致性、环境一致性和因果一致性三个维度（12个子维度）系统评估模型的长时状态维持能力，揭示了现有主流模型在长期状态保留方面的系统性局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型评估基准主要关注视觉质量、运动连贯性和文本-视频对齐，忽略了世界模型的核心能力——记忆（即在长时间跨度和复杂交互中保持一致性）。需要专门的基准来量化评估视频世界模型的记忆能力。

Method: 将记忆能力分解为三个层次互补的核心维度（实体一致性、环境一致性、因果一致性），进一步细化为12个可量化子维度；基于严格筛选的真实长视频构建基准；采用基于规则的量化矩阵和视觉语言模型进行客观综合评估。

Result: 对主流视频世界模型的广泛评估揭示了现有方法在长期状态保留方面存在关键的系统性局限。

Conclusion: MBench为视频世界模型的记忆能力评估提供了标准化基准，明确了未来的研究方向，有助于推动该领域从视觉上合理的视频生成向真正具备世界模型功能的方向发展。

Abstract: Recent advancements in video-based world models have demonstrated an unprecedented ability to synthesize high-fidelity visual sequences. However, a fundamental gap persists between visually plausible video generation and the functional requirements of a world model, particularly in maintaining a stable and reasonable internal state over extended temporal horizons. While existing benchmarks primarily emphasize visual quality, motion coherence, and text-video alignment, they largely overlook memory, the core capability of a world model to preserve consistency across long-term horizons and complex interactions. To address this gap, we present \textbf{MBench}, a comprehensive benchmark dedicated to quantifying and evaluating the memory capability of video world models. We systematically decompose the memory capability of video world models into three hierarchical and complementary core dimensions: entity consistency, environment consistency, and causal consistency, which are further refined into 12 quantifiable sub-dimensions for comprehensive characterization of long-term memory. Our benchmark is built upon rigorously curated real-captured long videos, and evaluated by rule-based quantitative matrices and VLM to enable objective and comprehensive consistency assessment. Extensive evaluations of mainstream state-of-the-art video world models reveal critical systemic limitations of existing methods in long-term state retention, providing a standardized benchmark and clear research direction to advance the field.

</details>


### [314] [MedSyn2: Flexible Control of 3D CT Generation via Text and Semantically-Defined Segmentation Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00967)
*Weicheng Dai,Chenyu Wang,Binxu Li,Shantanu Ghosh,Afrooz Zandifar,Christina LeBedis,Kayhan Batmanghelich*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种灵活的多模态框架，支持从放射学报告和分割提示（均为可选）进行可控体积医学图像生成。该框架允许用户仅对特定解剖结构或异常区域进行分割，并通过文本描述指定其语义含义，无需完整器官标注。基于改进的扩散Transformer和门控注意力机制，实现了高分辨率、解剖一致的CT体积生成，在FID等指标上提升24%，并通过放射科医师评估验证了与真实图像的高度一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可控体积医学图像生成方法存在两难：文本提示灵活但空间控制弱（无法精确控制异常的位置、形状和边界）；基于分割的方法空间指导精确但需要完整器官标注，限制性强。亟需一种既灵活又具有精确空间控制能力的生成框架。

Method: 1) 提出灵活的多模态框架，同时支持放射学报告和分割提示作为输入（均为可选）；2) 允许用户仅对特定解剖结构或异常进行部分分割，通过文本描述指定分割掩码的语义含义；3) 基于改进的扩散Transformer架构，联合处理图像和分割token；4) 引入门控注意力机制有效处理长放射学报告。

Result: 1) 在感知和语义指标上达到SOTA，平均FID提升24%；2) 生成高分辨率、解剖一致的CT体积；3) 用于数据增强时提高数据效率；4) 放射科医师评估确认生成图像与真实医学图像高度一致。

Conclusion: 所提出的灵活多模态框架成功解决了可控体积医学图像生成中灵活性与精确空间控制之间的矛盾，提供了一种高度可扩展的条件机制，在生成质量和实用性方面均优于现有方法。

Abstract: Generative models for volumetric medical images have found many applications in medical imaging, ranging from data augmentation to serving as priors for inverse problems. For these applications, generating high-resolution 3D images with strong controllability is essential but remains highly challenging. Existing approaches typically control generation either through radiology reports used as text prompts or through full image segmentation. While text-based prompting is flexible, it provides limited spatial control over the location, shape, and boundary of abnormalities. In contrast, segmentation-based methods receive precise spatial guidance but are restrictive in requiring full-organ annotations. In this work, we propose a flexible multimodal framework for controllable volumetric image generation that supports input from radiology reports and segmentation prompts (both optional). Our approach allows users to provide segmentation of a specific anatomy or abnormality without requiring full-organ annotations. The semantic meaning of the segmentation mask is specified through an accompanying text description, resulting in a highly flexible and scalable conditioning mechanism. We develop a memory-efficient architecture based on a modified diffusion transformer that jointly processes image and segmentation tokens. The model further incorporates gated attention to effectively attend to long radiology reports. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art perceptual and semantic scores (e.g., 24% relative improvement in mean FID), generates high-resolution anatomically consistent CT volumes, and improves data efficiency when used for data augmentation. Radiologists' evaluation further confirms strong alignment between generated and real medical images.

</details>


### [315] [An Empirical Study of Data Scale, Model Complexity, and Input Modalities in Visual Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04409)
*Yidi Zhouluo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究通过控制数据规模、模型复杂度和输入模态三个变量，实证分析了它们对深度神经网络视觉泛化性能的影响。实验发现：增加数据规模始终能提升泛化性能，而模型复杂度变化不能带来稳定增益；去除颜色信息会降低模型性能，梯度、边缘、小波等显式先验特征在不同架构下效果不一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代深度神经网络在计算机视觉中表现优异，但其泛化性能的来源难以用传统统计学习理论解释，因此需要实证探究影响视觉泛化的关键可控因素。

Method: 先在一维非线性函数上进行初步实验，通过改变训练样本数量和多项式次数观察数据规模与模型复杂度的影响；然后在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上进行主实验，比较不同训练数据规模、模型架构和输入模态下的模型性能。

Result: 增加训练数据规模始终提升泛化性能；模型复杂度变化无法提供稳定增益；去除颜色信息降低模型性能；梯度、边缘、小波等先验特征在不同模型架构下效果不一致。

Conclusion: 数据规模是提升视觉泛化性能的可靠因素，而模型复杂度和输入模态的影响具有不稳定性，需要根据具体架构和任务进行权衡。

Abstract: Modern deep neural networks usually have large parameter scales and nonlinear hierarchical structures, and they have achieved strong performance in computer vision. However, the source of their generalization performance remains difficult to explain using traditional statistical learning theory. Among the factors that may affect visual generalization, data scale, model complexity, and input modalities are fundamental and controllable variables. This study empirically analyzes how these three factors influence model generalization performance. Specifically, in a preliminary experiment, we construct a one-dimensional nonlinear function and vary the number of training samples and the polynomial degree to observe the effects of data scale and model complexity on model performance. In the main experiments, we compare model performance on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 under different training data scales, model architectures, and input modalities. The experimental results show that increasing the training data scale consistently improves generalization performance, whereas changes in model complexity do not provide stable gains. In addition, removing color information degrades model performance, while explicit prior features such as gradients, edges, and wavelets have inconsistent effects across different model architectures. Overall, this study provides an empirical analysis of the relationships among data scale, model complexity, input modalities, and visual generalization performance. Code and experimental logs are available at: https://github.com/YidiZhouluo/DeepLearning-Empirical-Studies/tree/main/Exp_01.

</details>


### [316] [Would you still call this Dax? Novel Visual References in VLMs and Humans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05409)
*Ada Defne Tür,Gaurav Kamath,Joyce Chai,Siva Reddy,Benno Krojer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了新颖视觉参考数据集(NVRD)，包含19,176张覆盖90个视觉概念及其扰动版本的图像，用于研究视觉语言模型在上下文学习中如何习得与先验知识矛盾的新视觉概念。实验发现模型在矛盾情境下习得困难，且与人类相比存在显著的过度泛化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在遇到与预训练先验知识相矛盾的新视觉概念时，其如何将新颖视觉参考映射到语言的过程尚不明确，现有工作缺乏对此类情境的系统研究。

Method: 构建NVRD数据集（19,176张图像，90个视觉概念，每个概念含最多20个扰动版本）；对比评估3个开源和2个闭源模型与2,400个人类判断；分析模型在上下文学习中的新概念习得能力及泛化行为。

Result: (i) 当新概念与先验知识矛盾时，模型在上下文中习得新概念的能力较差；(ii) 模型与人类对视觉扰动的敏感性呈相关性，但模型显著过度泛化，将学习到的标签扩展到人类拒绝的刺激上。

Conclusion: NVRD可作为人类与机器视觉概念学习研究的语料库和基准，揭示了当前VLM在矛盾情境下概念学习的局限性及与人类认知的差异。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs), like human learners, are frequently exposed to new visual concepts, but how they map novel visual references to language after exposure remains largely underexplored, particularly when those references contradict prior knowledge from pre-training. To study this, we present the Novel Visual References Dataset (NVRD): 19,176 images spanning 90 visual concepts across different levels of visual novelty, each with up to 20 increasingly perturbed versions of the original object to probe generalization. Unlike prior work on visual augmentations of familiar concepts, NVRD comprises entirely novel, open-ended stimuli constructed from scratch, mirroring how humans encounter genuinely new concepts. We evaluate 3 open- and 2 closed-source models alongside 2,400 human judgments for direct human-model comparison, and find that (i) models struggle to acquire novel concepts in-context when they contradict prior knowledge, and (ii) while models and humans show correlated sensitivity to visual perturbations, models significantly overgeneralize, extending learned labels to stimuli that humans reject. We contribute NVRD as a corpus and benchmark for research on visual concept learning in both humans and machines.

</details>


### [317] [Emotion-Aware Image Generation from Korean Diary Text via LLM-based Prompt Translation and LoRA Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05816)
*Jihun Cho,Soo-Yeon Jeong,Sun-Young Ihm*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种情感感知的文本到图像生成管道，利用Qwen3-8B识别短韩语日记中的隐含情感，并通过LoRA微调Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium生成儿童手绘风格图像，同时探讨了情感触发词对生成图像的影响及CLIP Score作为评估指标的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有T2I模型主要关注视觉对象相关模式，缺乏对上下文情感理解的能力，无法有效捕捉包括日记在内的多种文本类型中的情感。

Method: 提出情感感知文本到图像生成管道：使用Qwen3-8B进行短日记隐含情感识别，采用LoRA微调Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium在儿童绘画图像上训练，并引入基于情感触发词的图像生成策略。

Result: 通过实验检验了情感触发词对生成图像的影响，并揭示了CLIP Score在评估情感感知图像生成任务中的局限性。

Conclusion: 该管道能够从短韩语日记中生成带有情感的儿童手绘风格图像，但现有评估指标（如CLIP Score）不足以有效衡量情感感知图像生成的质量。

Abstract: T2I models cannot effectively capture sentiment from various types of text, including diaries, as they primarily focus on visual object-related patterns rather than contextual emotional understanding. This paper proposes an emotion-aware text-to-image pipeline that generates children's hand drawing style images from short Korean diary entries. The proposed pipeline employs Qwen3-8B for recognising implicit sentiment from short diaries, and Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium fine-tuned with LoRA on children's drawing images with emotion-based trigger words for image generation. Additionally, this paper presents experiments examining the effect of emotion trigger words on generated images and discusses the limitations of CLIP Score as an evaluation metric for emotion-aware image generation.

</details>


### [318] [A Vision-language Framework for Comparative Reasoning in Radiology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06407)
*Tengfei Zhang,Ziheng Zhao,Xiaoman Zhang,Lisong Dai,Pengcheng Qiu,Ya Zhang,Yanfeng Wang,Weidi Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MedReCo框架，将放射学比较形式化为实体感知的跨图像推理问题，支持参考病例检索和时间序列比较解读。基于来自8个机构、4个国家、7种模态的69万+图像构建MedReCo-DB数据集，开发MedReCo（实体感知编码器用于可控检索）和MedReCo-VLM（视觉语言模型用于间隔变化生成式解读）。实验表明，该方法在内部检索所有12个设置中Recall@1最高，外部检索平均提升6.0个百分点，在胸片和CT上纵向随访准确性分别提升14.5-46.5和13.0-27.9个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学影像AI在孤立图像解读方面表现优异，但与放射学临床实践严重脱节——诊断和随访依赖于跨既往研究和相似参考病例的比较。现有方法缺乏这种实体感知的跨图像比较推理能力。

Method: (1) 构建MedReCo-DB大规模比较影像资源，将报告分解为解剖结构、异常发现和病理条件；(2) 开发MedReCo实体感知视觉编码器，支持基于实体条件的可控临床类比病例检索；(3) 开发MedReCo-VLM视觉语言模型扩展，用于间隔变化的生成式比较解读。

Result: MedReCo在内部检索所有12个设置中Recall@1最高，外部检索平均提升6.0个百分点，在临床易混淆的鉴别诊断组中持续优于最强基线。MedReCo-VLM在所有比较生成评估中取得最佳性能，胸片纵向随访准确性提升14.5-46.5个百分点，CT提升13.0-27.9个百分点。

Conclusion: 实体感知的比较推理可以从常规临床数据中大规模学习，为医学影像AI提供更符合临床实践的基础。该方法有效弥合了AI孤立图像解读与放射学实践之间长期存在的差距。

Abstract: Medical imaging artificial intelligence has achieved strong performance in isolated image interpretation, but remains poorly aligned with radiological practice, where diagnosis and follow-up rely on comparison across prior studies and analogous reference cases. Here we formulate radiological comparison as an entity-aware cross-image reasoning problem and introduce a framework that supports both reference-case retrieval and temporal comparative interpretation. We construct MedReCo-DB, a large-scale comparative imaging resource derived from routine image-report pairs, comprising more than 690,000 images from over 160,000 patients across eight institutions, four countries and seven imaging modalities. Reports are decomposed into anatomical structures, abnormal findings and pathological conditions to provide supervision for entity-conditioned retrieval and comparative visual question answering. Using this resource, we develop MedReCo, an entity-aware visual encoder for controllable retrieval of clinically analogous cases, and MedReCo-VLM, a vision--language extension for generative interpretation of interval change. Across internal, external and cross-center evaluations, MedReCo achieved the highest Recall@1 in all 12 internal retrieval settings and improved external retrieval by a mean of 6.0 percentage points. In clinically confusable differential groups, it consistently outperformed the strongest baselines. MedReCo-VLM achieved the best performance across all comparative generation evaluations and improved longitudinal follow-up accuracy by 14.5-46.5 percentage points on chest radiographs and 13.0-27.9 percentage points on CT. These findings suggest that entity-aware comparative reasoning can be learned from routine clinical data at scale and may provide a more clinically aligned foundation for medical imaging AI.

</details>


### [319] [DisPOSE: Projected Polystochastic Diffusion for Self-Supervised Multi-View 3D Human Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07419)
*Tony Danjun Wang,Tolga Birdal,Nassir Navab,Lennart Bastian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DisPOSE是一个自监督框架，通过将多视角多人3D姿态估计中的分配问题建模为扩散生成过程，结合可微Sinkhorn投影和超图卷积解码器，实现了无需标注的高效人体定位与骨架重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自监督方法依赖合成3D姿态目录，在真实场景中因分布偏移导致泛化能力差；多视角多人场景下的个体分配问题本质上是离散的，缺乏有效的可微求解方案。

Method: 1) 将多视角人员分配建模为多随机张量空间上的扩散生成过程；2) 去噪过程中使用可微Sinkhorn投影引导解向有效分配；3) 通过超图卷积解码器从多视图回归完整3D骨架，显式建模关节间的关系统一结构。

Result: 在标准数据集上超越现有自监督方法；在新提出的手术室高遮挡场景基准上表现强劲；仅用10%伪标签即可保留99%性能，展现出高标签效率；对不同相机布局几乎无关。

Conclusion: 将分配与根回归组件解耦并保持可微性，使DisPOSE对不同相机排列几乎无关，为多视角多人3D姿态估计提供了高效、泛化性强的自监督方案。

Abstract: Recovering 3D human poses for multiple individuals from different camera views is a fundamental bottleneck for analyzing interacting behaviors. Existing self-supervised approaches leverage synthetic catalogues of 3D poses; however, this leads to poor generalization in real-world scenarios due to distribution shifts. We therefore introduce DisPOSE, a self-supervised framework that approximates the inherently discrete multi-view person-assignment problem as a generative diffusion process over the space of polystochastic tensors. By employing differentiable Sinkhorn projections during denoising, our model learns to guide solutions toward valid and feasible assignments based on 2D image priors. The complete 3D skeletons of localized individuals are then regressed using a Hypergraph-Convolutional Decoder that explicitly models relational structures and articulated joints across multiple views. The proposed approach outperforms current state-of-the-art self-supervised methods on standard datasets and demonstrates strong performance on a newly proposed benchmark featuring highly occluded scenes from surgical operating rooms. Our diffusion-based localization demonstrates high label efficiency, retaining 99% of its performance with only 10% of the pseudo-labels. Notably, disentangling the assignment and root regression components while maintaining differentiability makes DisPOSE nearly agnostic to different camera arrangements.

</details>


### [320] [OpenGlass: Ultra-Low-Power On-Device AI Eyewear with Event-based Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07431)
*Pietro Bonazzi,Julian Moosmann,Ahmet Celik,Philipp Mayer,Michele Magno*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种开源智能眼镜平台，采用模块化FPC转接板设计支持事件相机和帧相机，通过nRF5340协调器与GAP9 RISC-V SoC协同的硬件-软件协同电源管理系统，实现200mAh电池下连续ML推理最长11.5小时。在LynX数据集上基于Prophesee GENX320事件相机的手势识别中，R(2+1)D模型达到83.94%的交叉验证准确率，GAP9上端到端推理延迟78.3ms。全部设计开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能眼镜受限于功耗、内存和计算资源，且支持事件视觉和嵌入式ML的开源硬件平台极其稀少，亟需一个模块化、可快速原型验证的新型传感器和算法的开放平台。

Method: 采用灵活FPC转接板实现模块化设计，支持事件相机和帧相机切换而无须重制PCB；硬件-软件协同电源管理系统结合可配置PMIC和nRF5340事件驱动唤醒，使GAP9 SoC在推理间隔完全断电；使用极性分离事件直方图处理Prophesee GENX320事件相机数据，采用R(2+1)D模型进行自中心手势识别。

Result: 200mAh电池下实现11.5小时连续ML推理；R(2+1)D在LynX数据集上留二交叉验证达到83.94%准确率（宏F1=0.781），GAP9上端到端延迟78.3ms；时间增强和模糊类移除带来最大性能提升（+8.9个百分点）。

Conclusion: 该开源平台证明了在紧凑功耗预算下实现长时间、低延迟的嵌入式ML推理的可行性，为智能眼镜领域的事件视觉和边缘AI研究提供了可复现的硬件-软件协同设计基准。

Abstract: Smart eyewear enables unobtrusive, context-aware interaction through multimodal sensors and on-device intelligence, but is severely limited by power, memory, and compute constraints in a compact form factor. Open-hardware platforms supporting event-based vision and embedded ML at this scale are rare. This work introduces an open-source smart glasses platform for rapid prototyping of novel sensors and algorithms. Its modular design uses a flexible FPC interposer to support both event-based and frame-based cameras without full PCB redesign. A hardware-software co-designed power management system combines a configurable PMIC with event-driven wake-up via an nRF5340 coordinator, keeping the GAP9 RISC-V SoC powered down between inferences. The prototype achieves up to 11.5 hours of continuous on-device ML from a 200 mAh battery. As a demonstration, an egocentric hand gesture recognition pipeline was evaluated on the LynX dataset using polarity-separated event histograms from a Prophesee GENX320 camera. R(2+1)D achieved the best cross-subject accuracy of 83.94\% (macro F1 = 0.781) under leave-two-subjects-out validation, with 78.3 ms end-to-end inference latency on the GAP9. Temporal augmentation and removal of ambiguous classes provided the largest gains (+8.9 pp). All hardware designs, firmware, and models are released open source.

</details>


### [321] [The Lipreading Gap: Do VSR Models Perceive Visual Speech Like Human Lipreaders?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07435)
*Rishabh Jain,Naomi Harte*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过对比三种视觉语音识别（VSR）系统与人类基线在MaFI数据集上的表现，发现尽管VSR模型在整体准确率上超越人类，但其成功/失败的模式与人类不同，模型主要依赖训练数据中的语言线索而非视觉感知，未能将视觉特征绑定为有意义的词汇。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究当前高性能视觉语音识别（VSR）模型是否真正具备了类人的视觉语音感知能力，而不仅仅是表面上的准确率提升。

Method: 在MaFI唇读数据集上，从词级、字符级、音素级和视位级四个粒度，将三种VSR系统与人类基线进行系统对比；同时引入文本n-gram基线（仅给定少量初始音素）与人类唇读能力对比；分析训练词频与视觉信息量对模型错误的影响；计算视位准确率、混淆矩阵及人-模型相关性。

Result: VSR模型整体准确率高于人类，但成功和失败的模式与人类不同；仅给定少量初始音素的文本n-gram基线即可媲美人类唇读能力；模型词级错误更受训练词频影响而非视觉信息量；模型在人类认为最难的视位上提升最大，对视觉清晰度的依赖远弱于人类。

Conclusion: 当前VSR系统主要依赖训练数据中的语言先验而非真实的视觉感知，未能实现视觉特征与词汇意义的有效绑定，与人类的视觉语音感知机制存在本质差异。

Abstract: Visual speech recognition (VSR) models now surpass human lipreaders on benchmarks, but do such gains establish human-like visual speech perception? To explore this, we compare three VSR systems with human baselines on the MaFI word-level lipreading dataset using word, character, phoneme, and viseme-level metrics. Although models achieve higher overall accuracy, they succeed and fail on different words than humans. A text-only n-gram baseline given only a few initial phonemes rivals human lipreading. VSR word-level errors are consistently better explained by training word frequency than by the visual informativeness of words. Viseme accuracies, confusion matrices and human-model correlations further show that models gain most on visemes humans find hardest, and show much weaker dependence on visual clarity. Our work demonstrates that VSR systems rely primarily on language cues from training data rather than visual perception, failing to bind visual features into meaningful words.

</details>


<div id='cs.CY'></div>

# cs.CY [[Back]](#toc)

### [322] [Beware of GeeksBearing Gifts: Building True EU Frontier AI Sovereignty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07536)
*Nick Moës,Toni Lorente,Amin Oueslati,Jonathan Smith,Robin Staes-Polet,Radina Kraeva*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一框架，将欧洲主权五大支柱与前沿AI价值链的五层26组件29子组件相连接，用于识别欧盟政策中的关键缺口、冗余和跨支柱权衡，并通过AI Gigafactory倡议等案例展示该框架如何揭示被狭义经济框架所掩盖的战略冲突，为欧盟在92项现有倡议基础上设计、评估和优先排序前沿AI干预措施提供结构化基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 欧盟在前沿AI领域处于结构性依赖地位（前沿模型几乎全部来自美中、AI超算能力仅为美国的约1/16、全球超大规模数据中心仅15%在欧盟境内），现有政策碎片化且缺乏贯穿前沿AI全价值链的战略自主统一愿景，亟需一个系统性框架来识别政策漏洞与权衡。

Method: 构建一个连接五大主权支柱（经济竞争力、韧性、安全与国防、欧洲价值观、对外关系）与前沿AI堆栈分解（五层、26组件、29子组件）的统一框架，并应用于分析欧盟AI Gigafactory倡议及四大委员会通信中的92项倡议。

Result: 该框架能够系统性地识别欧盟现有政策中的关键缺口、冗余和跨支柱权衡，展示了以主权为中心的视角如何揭示被狭义经济框架所掩盖的冲突，为欧盟前沿AI干预措施的设计、评估和优先级排序提供了结构化方法。

Conclusion: 欧盟需要采用这一主权中心框架来弥补现有碎片化政策的不足，以实现前沿AI全价值链上的战略自主，而不仅仅局限于经济竞争力的狭义考量。

Abstract: Frontier artificial intelligence is reshaping all aspects of society, from economic output or military capability to democratic institutions. The EU is entering this transformation from a position of structural dependence: frontier models originate almost exclusively from the United States or China, the US holds approximately sixteen times the EU's AI supercomputing capacity, and only 15% of global hyperscale data centre capacity resides within EU borders. Although the European Commission has accelerated its policy response, existing initiatives remain fragmented and lack a cohesive vision for securing strategic autonomy across the full frontier AI value chain. Here we propose a unified framework connecting five sovereignty pillars (economic competitiveness, resilience, security and defence, European values, and foreign relations) to a decomposition of the frontier AI stack comprising five layers, 26 components, and 29 sub-components. This framework allows the identification of critical gaps, redundancies, and inter-pillar trade-offs that current EU policy leaves implicit. Our analysis of the AI Gigafactory Initiative illustrates how a sovereignty-centred lens reveals conflicts that narrowly economic framings obscure. Moreover, this framework offers policymakers a structured basis for designing, evaluating, and prioritising frontier AI interventions across multiple dimensions of European strategic autonomy across the 92 initiatives from four major Commission communications we. identify, and beyond.

</details>


### [323] [Prompt Governance? On Governing Technologies Governed by Natural Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07539)
*Anna Neumann,Holli Sargeant,Jatinder Singh*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了通过自然语言指令（提示词）治理生成式AI的可行性。研究发现，学术界对系统级指令的功能存在矛盾性主张，而政策制定者将其视为稳定的行为控制机制，这种错位使得提示词治理路径具有不确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管政策制定者将系统级指令（如系统提示词）视为AI治理的可及干预点，假设其能可靠、可预测地控制模型行为，但这种假设在不同上下文中的有效性尚未得到充分检验。

Method: (i) 系统梳理文献中关于系统级指令的讨论与主张，构建主张类型学；(ii) 分析两个政策框架（美国《防止觉醒AI》行政令、欧盟通用AI实践准则）如何将系统级指令定位为治理对象；(iii) 识别学术观点与政策假设之间的错位。

Result: 发现文献中关于系统级指令能实现何种目标存在分散且矛盾的主张；政策方法将其视为稳定、可解释的控制机制，而学术证据不支持这一假设；这种错位对提示词治理路径构成挑战。

Conclusion: 鉴于学术与政策视角之间的错位，必须谨慎对待通过自然语言进行AI治理的方法。该发现不仅影响LLM政策语境，亦对技术系统中使用自然语言作为控制机制具有广泛启示。

Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is increasingly operated by natural language instructions (prompts). Across the pipeline, stakeholders designate various forms, e.g. end-user guidelines, developer specifications, or system prompts, as prompt governance instruments. These textual artifacts are intended to shape model behaviour by specifying constraints, priorities, and compliance rules. Policymakers and regulators have begun to treat system-level instructions as accessible prompt-based GenAI intervention points, assuming they function (directly or indirectly) as behavioural control. Yet whether these instructions operate reliably and predictably enough across contexts to support such governance frameworks remains underexplored. Towards this, we systematically evaluate (i) how researchers discuss and treat system-level instructions in the literature, focusing on large language models (LLMs) as they isolate language effects; (ii) how policymakers position system-level instructions as governance objects, incorporating analysis of two policy frameworks (US Exec. Order on Preventing Woke AI, and EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice); and (iii) whether misalignments between these perspectives warrant closer inspection of the viability of governing AI through natural language. We identify a fragmented literature advancing varying and contradictory claims about what goals system-level instructions can achieve, which we distil into a typology of claims. Further, we show how divergent claims complicate policy approaches that treat system-level instructions as stable, interpretable control mechanisms. We argue that given such misalignments, careful consideration must be given to prompt governance approaches. Our findings have broad implications, extending from a LLM policy context to the use of natural language as control mechanism in technical systems more generally.

</details>


### [324] [DIYHealth Suite: Dataset, Model, and Benchmark for Health Management at Home](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07542)
*Changshuo Liu,Junran Wu,Zhongle Xie,Wenqiao Zhang,Kaiping Zheng,Jiaqi Zhu,Qingpeng Cai,Ooi Gene Anne,Marcus Chun Jin Tan,Jianwei Yin,James Wei Luen Yip,Beng Chin Ooi*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出DIYHealth Suite框架，包含大规模多模态数据集DIYHealth-900K、自适应基础模型DIYHealthGPT（采用混合超低秩自适应技术）以及首个家庭护理任务基准DIYHealthBench，在11项家庭健康管理任务上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式AI在医疗领域依赖医院级设备，限制了其在家庭健康管理中的应用。家庭DIY诊疗面临数据异构、模型需适应可变任务和个体条件、缺乏统一基准等挑战。

Method: 构建DIYHealth-900K多模态数据集；提出DIYHealthGPT模型，核心创新为Hybrid Hyper Low-Rank Adaptation（混合超低秩自适应）技术；建立DIYHealthBench评估基准。

Result: 在11项家庭护理任务上，DIYHealthGPT在开放问答和封闭问答两种设定下均优于通用基线和医学专用基线，达到SOTA性能。

Conclusion: DIYHealth Suite为下一代个性化家庭健康管理奠定了基础，推动了生成式AI从临床向居家场景的拓展。

Abstract: Generative AI is reshaping healthcare, yet most existing advances rely on hospital-grade devices, which limits their accessibility and potential for health management outside clinical settings. With the proliferation of portable devices and telemedicine, healthcare is shifting toward home-based Diagnosis-It-Yourself (DIY) care. Despite this promise, several distinctive challenges remain: (i) home-collected data are heterogeneous, exacerbated by the absence of standardized large-scale datasets; (ii) models require adaptation to variable task demands and evolving individual conditions; (iii) the broad spectrum of home care tasks lacks a unified benchmark for systematic evaluation. In this paper, we present DIYHealth Suite, a comprehensive framework designed to address these challenges through a tailored dataset, model, and benchmark. We first curate DIYHealth-900K, a large-scale multimodal dataset capturing diverse real-world home care scenarios. Building on this, we propose DIYHealthGPT, an adaptive foundation model for home-based health management, powered by the novel Hybrid Hyper Low-Rank Adaptation technique. Finally, we establish DIYHealthBench, the first benchmark to evaluate foundation models on home care tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DIYHealthGPT delivers state-of-the-art performance over both general-purpose and medical-specific baselines on 11 home care tasks in both open-QA and closed-QA settings, laying the groundwork for the next generation of personalized health management at home.

</details>


### [325] [Concerns and Strategic Responses of Older Workers Navigating Generative AI in Bridge Employment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07543)
*Aditya Nayak,Aakash Gautam,Rama Adithya Varanasi*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 通过对21名专业人士的深度访谈，研究探讨了老年工作者（OWs）在生成式AI（GenAI）冲击下如何应对桥梁就业（退休前过渡性就业）决策过程的变化。研究发现GenAI带来了时间性和结构性干扰，OWs通过不同形式的边界工作重构任务以恢复稳定性与连续性，这种行为被概念化为"AI韧性"，使桥梁就业决策演变为持续的协商与适应过程。最后提出通过平衡个人、中观和宏观层面的策略来减少OWs的职业倦怠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI正在快速改变工作场所，对弱势群体（包括通过桥梁就业重返职场的老年工作者）影响尤为显著，但已有研究对这一群体如何应对GenAI驱动的职业中断缺乏深入理解。

Method: 采用质性研究方法，对21名专业人士进行半结构化深度访谈，分析老年工作者在桥梁就业过程中如何应对GenAI带来的挑战。

Result: 老年工作者在桥梁就业决策的所有阶段均经历了GenAI带来的时间性和结构性双重干扰；他们通过多种形式的边界工作（boundary work）重新配置任务以恢复稳定性和连续性。

Conclusion: 将老年工作者的应对行为概念化为"AI韧性"，这一韧性使桥梁就业决策从一次性决定转变为持续的协商适应过程；建议通过平衡个人层面的AI韧性策略、中观层面的AI韧性集体以及宏观层面的对抗性和可争议的AI中介组织结构来减少老年工作者的职业倦怠。

Abstract: Generative AI (GenAI) is transforming workplaces at a rapid pace. This disproportionately affects vulnerable communities, including older workers (OWs) who re-enter the workforce through bridge employment prior to final retirement. Through in-depth semi-structured interviews with 21 professionals, we examine how OWs navigate GenAI-driven disruptions while pursuing bridge roles, focusing on their concerns about GenAI integration and their responses to these changes. Our findings show that OWs experienced both temporal and structural disruptions across all stages of the bridge employment decision-making process due to GenAI. In response, they reconfigured their tasks through different forms of boundary work aimed at restoring stability and continuity. We conceptualize these responses as AI resilience, which reshaped OWs' bridge employment decision-making into an ongoing process of negotiation and adaptation. We conclude by offering recommendations to reduce burnout among OWs by balancing individual-level AI resilience strategies with meso-level AI resilience collectives and macro-level adversarial and contestable AI-mediated organizational structures.

</details>


### [326] [AI-Integrated Learning Management System for Middle School: A Longitudinal Study of Learning Outcomes Through High School and Beyond](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07544)
*Misan Paul Etchie,Taiwo Olutosin*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种集成AI的学习管理系统（LMS），专为中学教育设计，通过在学生的日常课业中提供策略受限的AI辅助（形成性反馈、提示、间隔复习、自适应练习）和教师仪表盘，旨在解决传统LMS仅作为工作流工具、反馈滞后导致学生错误概念固化的问题，并计划通过纵向研究评估其对从初中到高中乃至毕业后的长期学习轨迹的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中学是构建核心学业技能和学习习惯的关键期，但现有LMS更多作为工作流工具而非教学支持，导致学生带着困惑持续练习，教师被动救火，反馈到来时错误概念已固化，亟需一种能提供及时、持续AI辅助的解决方案。

Method: 提出一个AI集成的LMS平台，包含：（1）策略门控的AI辅助，提供形成性反馈和提示；（2）基于掌握程度的间隔复习与自适应练习推荐；（3）面向教师的仪表盘，汇总错误模式并标记持续困难。同时设计纵向研究，追踪细粒度学习行为数据（尝试、修改、求助、节奏），关联制度性结果以分离工具采纳效应与长期学习轨迹变化。

Result: 论文处于提案阶段，尚未给出实证结果，但描述了平台的隐私优先设计（数据最小化、角色访问控制、年龄适切响应约束、可审计AI交互日志）和评估框架。

Conclusion: 该AI集成LMS有望将反馈窗口前移，在错误固化前进行干预，长期可能改变学生的学习轨迹，而隐私保护设计确保了对未成年人的合规使用。

Abstract: Middle school is a key window for building core academic skills and the learning routines students carry into later grades, yet many students still fall behind because help is often limited and comes too late, after they have already been stuck for a while. Learning Management Systems (LMSs) are now standard infrastructure for distributing materials, collecting work, assessing students' tasks, and recording grades, but in most deployments they still behave more like workflow tools than instructional supports. The result is the usual bottleneck: students keep practicing through confusion, teachers triage questions, and feedback that could have corrected the misunderstanding arrives after the misconception has already hardened. To address this gap, we propose an AI-integrated LMS for middle school instruction, paired with a longitudinal study design to test whether sustained, bounded AI support changes outcomes through high school and into post-high school pathways. The proposed platform adds policy-gated AI assistance to everyday coursework, delivering formative feedback and hinting, recommending spaced review and adaptive practice based on mastery, and providing teacher-facing dashboards that summarize misconception patterns and flag sustained struggle. Because the platform is intended for minors, the design is privacy-first, using data minimization, role-based access control, age-appropriate response constraints, and auditable logs of AI interactions. Beyond short-term performance, the evaluation plan links fine-grained learning traces (attempts, revisions, help-seeking, and pacing) to institutional outcomes where feasible, so we can separate tool adoption effects from longer-run changes in learning trajectories.

</details>


### [327] [Reshaping Undergraduate Computer Science Education in the Generative AI Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07545)
*Yi-Chieh Lee,Nattapat Boonprakong,Yugin Tan,Harold Soh,Alex Potanin,Viraj Kumar,Anoop K. Sinha,Chen Qian,Paul Denny,Mennatallah El-Assady,Ian Oakley,Jake Renzella,Amy Zhang,Jat Singh,Wee Sun Lee,Hsuan-Tien Lin,Jane L. E,Anthony Tang,Margaret M. Burnett,Sowmya Somanath,Renwen Zhang,Vicky Charisi,Alexandra I. Cristea*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文基于两次国际NUS-Google研讨会的发现，提出由于生成式AI自动化了许多传统编程任务，计算机科学本科教育应从侧重实现级编程转向强调系统设计、抽象和批判性评估，并提出了课程改革的五条路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI的快速发展使得传统CS教育中强调的编程、调试、测试等技能被自动化，现有课程框架难以为继，亟需重新思考CS教育的核心目标与内容。

Method: 通过在新加坡举办的两次国际NUS-Google研讨会，召集教职员工、行业从业者和学生，收集多方观点并进行定性分析，识别应保留和弱化的技能，提出"面包屑"式渐进改革策略。

Result: 识别出关键技能的变化趋势，提出课程应围绕系统设计、抽象和批判性评估重新组织，并通过"面包crumbs"在当前课程中嵌入新技能的练习。

Conclusion: CS教育应从实施级编程转向培养AI原生能力，包括重新聚焦基础、增强高阶路径、采用新教学法和调整制度支持，以培养能与AI协同创作的毕业生。

Abstract: Generative AI represents a turning point for Computer Science (CS) education. In recent decades, post-secondary CS education has largely focused on what has been seen as practical software engineering skills: implementation-level programming, debugging, testing, and software design, analysis, and documentation. However, this framing is becoming less tenable as generative AI automates many of these tasks, challenging their centrality in CS education.
  To keep pace with advances in AI technology, CS curricula should consider a shift toward understanding and verifying AI-generated artifacts. This white paper outlines the findings of two international NUS-Google Workshops in Singapore, where we convened faculty members, industry practitioners, and students, and proposes a strategic response to reshape how CS should be taught at the undergraduate level. Based on the findings, we identify critical skills that must be preserved and those that are becoming less important. By incorporating these skills as "breadcrumbs," we can provide helpful nudges and engaging exercises within the current curriculum, enhancing learning experiences for everyone.
  We believe that to effectively prepare future computer science graduates, capable of creating, solving problems, and managing, as well as co-creating, artifacts with AI. It is important to consider a shift in curricula. Emphasizing system design, abstraction, and critical evaluation could greatly enhance their education and readiness for the challenges ahead. We propose prerequisites for solutions to reform CS education by fostering AI-native competencies, re-centering fundamental education, enhancing advanced pathways, embracing new pedagogies, and shifting institutional support.

</details>


### [328] [Human-Centred Risk Mitigation for AI-Mediated Information Manipulation: A SOCMINT Framework Based on Information Manipulation Sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09754)
*Antonio Scala*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出基于信息操纵集（IMS）的SOCMINT框架，作为连接单个事件与战略归因之间的中间分析单元，用于应对社会性网络攻击中的信息操纵，并通过桌面推演评估协议验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有防御方法在事件级分析（碎片化弱信号）与归因优先分析（延迟缓解）之间摇摆，缺乏适中的操作单元来连贯地理解信息操纵的全过程。

Method: 基于VIGINUM/EEAS的IMS实践，构建SOCMINT框架，将操纵视为包含叙事、账号、基础设施、时间模式、跨平台迁移、合成放大和认知目标定位的连贯过程；流程包括信号检测、诊断分诊、IMS假设构建、置信度/严重性评估、缓解选择与迭代更新；并提出桌面推演评估协议。

Result: 通过紧凑场景示例展示了IMS分析能捕捉到内容级和归因优先分析遗漏的信息；桌面推演协议可用于评估决策质量、置信度校准和缓解措施的比例性。

Conclusion: 以人为中心的风险缓解不仅需要更好的检测能力，还需要在不确定性下进行结构化推理、可审计的决策过程，以及防止对合法异议过度安全化的保障措施。

Abstract: AI-mediated information manipulation increasingly takes the form of social cyber attacks that target trust, attention, credibility, reputation, and decision-making rather than only technical infrastructures or isolated false contents. Existing defensive approaches often oscillate between incident-level analysis, which fragments campaigns into weak signals, and attribution-first analysis, which may delay mitigation until responsibility is established. This paper proposes a SOCMINT framework based on Information Manipulation Sets (IMS) as an intermediate operational unit between individual incidents and strategic attribution. Building on the VIGINUM/EEAS use of IMS in counter-FIMI analysis, the framework treats manipulation as a coherent process involving narratives, accounts, infrastructures, temporal patterns, cross-platform migration, synthetic amplification, and cognitive targeting. The proposed pipeline moves from signal detection and diagnostic triage to IMS hypothesis construction, confidence/severity assessment, mitigation selection, and iterative update. A compact scenario illustrates how IMS-based analysis captures what content-level and attribution-first approaches miss. The paper also proposes a tabletop evaluation protocol to assess decision quality, confidence calibration, and mitigation proportionality. The main implication is that human-centred risk mitigation requires not only better detection, but also structured reasoning under uncertainty, auditable decision-making, and safeguards against over-securitising legitimate dissent.

</details>


### [329] [Astro, I'm Home! Investigating Factors that Influence the Acceptance of Home Robots Using Supervised Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07551)
*Katrin Fischer,Essence Wilson,Steffie Kim,Dmitri Williams*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究运用正则化技术（Lasso和Ridge回归）探索社交机器人技术接受模型。在原始UTAUT2框架中，绩效期望、社会影响和享乐动机是使用意向的最强预测因子，同时可用性、信任和能力也被识别为有前景的变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着社交机器人在家庭环境中的使用日益增加，需要识别和验证影响用户接受度的关键变量，以建立更准确的技术接受模型。

Method: 采用探索性研究设计，运用正则化技术（Lasso回归和Ridge回归）对变量进行分析和筛选，在UTAUT2框架基础上识别新的技术接受模型。

Result: 绩效期望、社会影响和享乐动机是UTAUT2框架中最强且最一致的预测因子；可用性、信任和能力被识别为预测使用意向的有前景的新变量。

Conclusion: 正则化技术有效识别了社交机器人技术接受的关键预测变量，为扩展UTAUT2模型提供了实证支持，特别是可用性、信任和能力等因素值得后续研究关注。

Abstract: The use of social robots in home environments is on the rise. This exploratory study applies regularization techniques (e.g., Lasso and Ridge regression) to investigate variables and identify new models of technology acceptance in the context of social robots. Within the original UTAUT2 framework, performance expectancy, social influence, and hedonic motivation emerged as the strongest and most consistent predictors of intention to use the technology. In addition, usability, trust, and competence were identified as promising variables in a model predicting intention to use.

</details>


### [330] [Position: Anthropomorphic Misalignment Research Needs Stronger Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07612)
*Vansh Gupta,Peter Nutter,Samuel Stante,Andreas Krause,Florian Tramèr,Lukas Fluri,Xin Chen,Anna Hedström*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文指出许多拟人化对齐偏差研究（AMR）缺乏强有力的证据，难以支撑模型部署和监管等关键安全决策。作者通过评估欺骗、新兴对齐偏差和谄媚等不同概念下的失败模式，展示了概念模糊性、非鲁棒数据集、实验设计和因果干预不足如何导致对模型行为的过度解读。文章提出了证据等级框架和诊断清单，旨在提升AMR的方法论严谨性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前拟人化对齐偏差研究（AMR）的证据基础薄弱，可能导致基于这些研究做出的关键安全决策（如模型部署和监管）存在风险。作者希望提高AMR领域的方法论严谨性，确保关于AI风险的主张建立在坚实的实证基础之上。

Method: 本文为一篇立场论文（position paper），通过分析不同对齐偏差概念（欺骗、新兴对齐偏差、谄媚）中的失败模式，评估概念模糊性、数据集非鲁棒性、实验设计缺陷和因果干预不足等问题。提出了证据等级框架和诊断清单作为改进工具。

Result: 识别了AMR研究中概念模糊性、非鲁棒数据集、实验设计缺陷和因果干预不足等导致模型行为过度解读的关键问题。提出了证据等级框架和诊断清单以提升研究严谨性。

Conclusion: AMR研究需要更强有力的证据基础才能支撑关键安全决策。作者提出的证据框架和诊断清单有助于在该领域建立共享标准，促进更富有成效的科学讨论，确保AI风险主张建立在可靠实证基础上。

Abstract: We argue that many Anthropomorphic Misalignment Research (AMR) studies need stronger evidence to ensure that they can provide a robust foundation for critical safety decisions, such as model deployment and regulation. By evaluating failure modes across different misalignment concepts, such as deception, emergent misalignment, and sycophancy, we show how conceptual ambiguity, non-robust datasets, experimental design, and insufficient causal interventions can lead to overinterpretation of model behaviors. This position paper aims to offer guidance on evidentiary considerations that can help improve methodological rigor in AMR. To achieve this, we provide a clear call to action through a proposed framework of evidence levels and a diagnostic checklist. These shared standards will enable more productive scientific discourse and ensure that claims about AI risks rest on solid empirical foundations.

</details>


### [331] [Frankenstein in the Pipeline: Computational Epistemicide in Facial Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07628)
*Nina da Hora*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文以玛丽·雪莱的《弗兰肯斯坦》作为方法论诊断框架，批判性地分析了基于嵌入的人脸识别技术如何通过检测/裁剪、关键点定位、对齐/正面化、嵌入等流水线操作，实施“计算性认识论灭绝”——将人脸这一活生生的关系性表面摧毁为数值代理，并最终通过向量化完成弗兰肯斯坦式的“缝合”，主张废除主义作为规范性立场。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究虽然记录了计算机视觉的优生学根源，但较少关注暴力在流水线层面的具体操作机制。本文旨在填补这一空白，揭示嵌入人脸识别如何通过技术流程本身实施认识论层面的暴力。

Method: 采用玛丽·雪莱的《弗兰肯斯坦》作为方法论诊断框架（拆解、重构及通过程序主张合法性的造物），提出“计算性认识论灭绝”概念，并逐阶段分析人脸识别流水线（检测/裁剪→关键点定位→对齐/正面化→嵌入→向量化→距离相似度与阈值化）。

Result: 揭示了人脸识别流水线如何将人脸逐步窄化为可数据化的内容，产生“规范人脸”作为可读性条件，并催生对应的“形式-主体”作为识别条件；距离相似度和阈值化将“足够接近”规范操作化，使识别与标准化不可分割，改革性“伦理AI”优化在结构上不足。

Conclusion: 主张废除主义作为规范性立场：拒绝将向量化身份作为权利和准入的合法基础，并拆除通过可拆解数据点治理人类生命的制度冲动。

Abstract: While the eugenic roots of computer vision are well-documented in critical technology studies, less attention has been paid to the operational mechanisms through which this violence is enacted at the level of the pipeline. This paper employs Mary Shelley's Frankenstein not as a metaphor for unintended consequences, but as a diagnostic framework for method: disassembly, reconstruction, and the production of a creature whose legitimacy is asserted by the procedure that made it.
  I argue that embedding-based facial recognition enacts what I call computational epistemicide, an extension of Sueli Carneiro's concept of epistemicide to the computational domain - by destroying the face as a living, relational surface and authorizing a numerical proxy as the privileged site of identity. Across detection/cropping, landmarking, alignment/frontalization, and embedding, the face is progressively narrowed to what can be stabilized as data, producing a canonical face as the condition of legibility and a corresponding form-subject as the condition of recognition. Vectorization completes the Frankensteinian "stitching": the dissected face is reassembled into a fixed-dimensional artifact designed to circulate across databases and institutions. I then show how distance-based similarity and thresholding operationalize a norm of "close enough," making recognition inseparable from standardization and rendering reformist "ethical AI" optimization structurally insufficient. The paper concludes by arguing for abolition as a normative stance: refusing vectorized identity as a legitimate basis for rights and access, and dismantling the institutional impulse to govern human life through dissectible data points.

</details>


### [332] [Reimagining Open Source and Openness in AI: Co-Creating Responsible Technological Futures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07764)
*Genevieve Smith,Hiral Patel,Steven Luo,Monica G. Bobra,Judy Brewer,Cathryn Carson,Isadora Cruxen,Shachee Doshi,Maximilian Gahntz,Nicholas Garcia,Natalia Luka,Meredith M. Lee,Min Kyung Lee,Woohyeuk Lee,Jarrod Millman,Ricardo Miron Torres,Chinasa T. Okolo,Cailean Osborne,Derek Slater,Katie Steen-James,Nikko Stevens,Jennifer Tridgell,David Gray Widder*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过多部门参与式工作坊，运用未来思维和参与式设计方法，探讨了不同利益相关者如何共同理解和协商AI中的负责任开放性问题。研究产出了共同构想的未来愿景、行动路径和研究路线图，识别了围绕开放性目的、范围、运行方式等方面的四组核心张力，表明负责任开放性是一个需要协商的社会技术项目，而非单一技术解决方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关于AI中开源与开放性的争论日益激烈，但鲜有实证研究考察多元利益相关者如何集体理解和协商负责任的开放性，特别是超越行业主导定义和框架的参与式过程。

Method: 采用多部门参与式工作坊，结合未来思维（futures thinking）和参与式设计方法（participatory design methods），通过共同创造的方式生成愿景、行动路径和研究路线图。

Result: 识别出四组核心张力：开放性作为目的还是手段（purpose）、扩张还是有意义获取（scope）、强制性还是条件性（operation）、充分性还是依赖于治理和使用（operation），揭示了不同利益相关者对开放性的冲突性解读。

Conclusion: 负责任开放性并非单一技术解决方案，而是一个由价值观、立场和优先级共同塑造的、需要协商的社会技术项目。参与式未来方法能够在AI治理中揭示超越主流企业叙事的多元愿景、行动和研究优先事项。

Abstract: Debates over open source and openness in artificial intelligence have intensified as policymakers, researchers, and practitioners grapple with how foundation models should be developed and governed to balance innovation, accountability, and public interest. However, there has been limited empirical work examining how diverse stakeholders collectively understand and negotiate responsible openness in AI, particularly through participatory processes that extend beyond industry-led definitions and frameworks. This paper presents findings from a multi-sectoral workshop grounded in futures thinking and participatory design methods. The workshop generated co-created visions of desirable futures and the role of AI, alongside a set of action pathways and a research roadmap focused on responsible open source and openness in AI. This paper makes three key contributions. First, it empirically documents the co-created visions, actions, and research priorities. Second, it identifies four core tensions that emerged as participants translated high-level aspirations into concrete actions, revealing conflicting interpretations of openness regarding its purpose (as an end or a means), its scope (expansion versus meaningful access), and its operation (mandatory versus conditional, sufficient versus dependent on governance and use). These tensions illustrate that responsible openness is not a singular technical solution, but a negotiated sociotechnical project shaped by values, positionalities, and priorities. Third, the paper advances methodological approaches in AI governance by demonstrating how participatory futures methods can surface plural visions, actions, and research priorities that extend beyond dominant, largely corporate, narratives, offering empirical insight into how openness, power, and accountability are negotiated in practice.

</details>


### [333] [Memetic Capture: A Pluralistic Policy Framework for Governing AI-Driven Cultural Disempowerment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07802)
*Subramanyam Sahoo*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出“文化捕获”（memetic capture）概念，指出AI通过文化维度渐进式剥夺人类自主性，并构建了“文化多元治理框架”（CPGF），包含四层政策架构：量化文化影响力指标、民主价值集会、多元部署标准及跨国协调机制。作者强调多元主义不仅是伦理要求，更是治理的结构性必要条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI治理框架存在关键盲区：将文化影响视为次于经济与安全问题的次要议题。然而文化是AI渐进式剥夺人类权力的最隐蔽载体——它直接侵蚀人类用以识别和抵抗权力丧失的偏好与价值观本身。

Method: 提出“文化捕获”（memetic capture）统一概念；构建四层文化多元治理框架（CPGF）：(1) 量化文化影响力指标；(2) 民主价值集会；(3) 多元部署标准；(4) 跨国协调机制。

Result: 识别出具体政策杠杆，讨论了实施中的张力问题，并勾勒出多元对齐与文化AI治理交叉领域的研究议程。

Conclusion: 多元主义不是治理的可选伦理附加项，而是结构性必需——单文化的AI治理反而会加速其声称要防止的权力剥夺进程。

Abstract: Culture is the most insidious vector of gradual human disempowerment by AI: unlike economic or political displacement, cultural displacement attacks the very preferences and values through which humans recognise and resist disempowerment itself. We argue that existing AI governance frameworks suffer from a critical blind spot by treating cultural impact as secondary to economic and safety concerns. This paper develops \emph{memetic capture} as a unifying concept for AI-driven cultural disempowerment, and proposes the \textbf{Cultural Pluralistic Governance Framework (CPGF)}, a four-tier policy architecture combining quantitative cultural influence metrics, democratic value assemblies, pluralistic deployment standards, and transnational coordination mechanisms. We argue that pluralism is not merely an ethical requirement for such governance but a structural necessity: monocultural AI governance accelerates the very disempowerment it claims to prevent. We identify concrete policy levers, discuss implementation tensions, and outline a research agenda at the intersection of pluralistic alignment and cultural AI governance.

</details>


### [334] [Stable Geometry, Reversing Poles: The Bipolar Structure of AI Occupational Substitutability and Its Decade-Scale Inversion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07939)
*Shuyao Gao,Minghao Huang*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究将1,961个O*NET详细工作活动分解为15,817个微观动作，构建了一个7维宏观语义类型学下的职业自动化指数。发现工具介导的物理活动与规划设计活动构成一个双极结构（Cohen's d=2.41），该几何结构在多种压力测试下保持稳健，但其内容在过去十年中发生了极性反转：Frey-Osborne时代的高风险类别在LLM时代变为低风险，反之亦然。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究（自Frey & Osborne 2017以来）在评估AI对劳动力市场影响时普遍采用连续梯度表示法，即对每个职业赋予[0,1]区间的自动化暴露分数。但这种连续性假设很少被明确阐述，也未在微观动作层面得到检验。本文旨在填补这一空白，在更细粒度的微观动作层面检验自动化风险的几何结构。

Method: 使用多智能体LLM流水线（含31名专家的人工校准），将1,961个O*NET详细工作活动分解为15,817个微观动作，并将先前工作中的职业自动化指数投射到7维宏观语义类型学上。通过三种独立压力测试验证稳健性：分辨率变化（K=7到K=15）、编码器替换为BGE、以及使用Eloundou的GPT-4任务评分进行交叉验证。

Result: 发现自动化风险呈现双极结构：工具介导的物理活动（M2，平均OAI=0.054）与规划与设计活动（M7，平均OAI=0.499）构成两极，Cohen's d=2.41（H=172.88, p=6.21e-34）。三种压力测试均验证了该几何结构的稳健性。中间六类宏观活动形成低对比度带（TOST检验仅1/15对等价）。但该结构的极性内容已发生反转：Frey-Osborne时代的排序与LLM时代完全相反（Spearman rho=-0.750, p=0.020）。

Conclusion: 自动化风险的几何结构（双极结构）是稳健的，但其内容（哪一极风险高）取决于时代的主导能力前沿。这一发现表明，研究者应关注结构本身而非其表面极性，因为技术变迁可能引发极性反转。

Abstract: Empirical research on the labor-market impact of artificial intelligence has converged, since Frey and Osborne (2017), on a continuous-gradient representation in which each occupation is assigned a real-valued exposure score on [0,1] obtained by linear aggregation across capability dimensions. This continuity is rarely articulated as an assumption and has not been tested at the micro-action level where substitution actually occurs. We decompose 1,961 O*NET Detailed Work Activities into 15,817 micro-actions using a multi-agent LLM pipeline with 31-expert HITL calibration, then project the DWA-level Occupational Automation Index from our prior work onto a 7-macro semantic typology. The result is a bipolar structure. Tool-Mediated Physical (M2, mean OAI = 0.054) and Planning & Design (M7, mean OAI = 0.499) form two extremes separated by Cohen's d = 2.41 (H = 172.88, p = 6.21e-34). The geometry is robust under three independent stress tests: resolution (K=7 to K=15, polar gap widens from 0.45 to 0.57), encoder swap to BGE (LLM-class OAI lead replicates at 3.37x), and Eloundou's GPT-4 task ratings (DWA-level rho = 0.635). The six middle macros form a low-contrast band between the poles (TOST at d=0.2 admits only 1/15 pairs as equivalent), not a flat plain. The geometry's stability does not, however, extend to its content. Across a decade, the polarity has inverted. Frey-Osborne (2013) placed Tool-Mediated Physical near the highest computerisation risk and Planning & Design near the lowest; our LLM-era OAI reverses that order, with macro-level FO-Eloundou Spearman rho = -0.750, p = 0.020, against the original Oxford Martin appendix. Which pole is high is therefore contingent on the era's dominant capability frontier, while the stable geometry itself is the structurally robust object.

</details>


### [335] [Contemporary AI lacks the imagination to diverge or negate in science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08251)
*Honglin Bao,Siyang Wu,Xiao Liu,Sida Li,Shiyun Cao,James A. Evans*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 通过对121,640篇预印本作者的大规模调研（6,749名科学家提供25,139组评分），系统评估了LLM在科学假设生成中的表现。发现：非推理LLM产生同质化想法，推理模型探索空间更大但缺乏零假设提出能力；科学家偏好与自己相似的想法，看重概率而非新颖性，且社会科学领域LLM表现最差；现有自动评估器与专家判断一致性弱，而基于人类评分微调的Qwen3-14B奖励模型将差距缩小至接近同行评审者间一致性水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前关于AI加速科学发现的论断缺乏大规模、科学家参与的真实场景验证，需要系统评估LLM在实际科研工作流中的能力与局限。

Method: 邀请121,640篇近期预印本作者对其论文对应的LLM生成后续想法进行评分（新颖性、实证可行性、真实概率、采纳倾向），收集6,749名科学家的25,139组评分，并对比多种自动评估器与专家判断的一致性。

Result: 非推理LLM产生同质化"蜂群思维"；推理模型探索更广但缺乏零假设；科学家偏好相似想法且重概率轻新颖性；社会科学家容忍更高风险但最苛刻；现有自动评估器与专家一致性弱；Qwen3-14B奖励模型经微调后提升显著（比SOTA高27%），接近同行评审一致性。

Conclusion: 当前科学AI仍是一个需要人类grounding的协作者，其想象力、输出和判断均需人类引导才能发挥价值。

Abstract: Bold projections that artificial intelligence will accelerate scientific discovery have raced ahead of evidence from working scientists, and the field still lacks large-scale, scientist-in-the-loop tests of these claims. Here we mount the largest such evaluation to date and map what AI cannot yet do for science. We invited authors of 121,640 recent preprints across biology, medicine, chemistry, and the social sciences to judge follow-up ideas that large language models (LLMs) generated from the context and puzzles of their own papers. 6,749 scientists returned 25,139 sets of ratings on novelty, empirical feasibility, probability of being true, and favorability of adoption. Three patterns emerge. First, non-reasoning LLMs collapse into a narrow "hivemind" of similar ideas; reasoning models roam a wider hypothesis space, yet no model class spontaneously proposes null hypotheses -- a move humans make more freely. Second, scientists reward ideas that resemble their own and prize probability over novelty, though social scientists tolerate risk more readily than life scientists. Senior social scientists are the harshest critics, and their skepticism is well-earned: LLMs falter most in pluralistic fields like the social sciences that demand context-aware interpretation and evolving theories. Third, automated evaluators on which the community currently relies -- LLM-as-a-judge, artificial metrics, and even state-of-the-art (SOTA) models -- agree weakly with expert judgment, and retrieval augmentation and scientist persona prompting yield only marginal gains. A Qwen3-14B reward model we post-trained on human ratings captures field taste nuances, beats SOTA models by up to 27%, and closes the gap to the inter-rater consistency of independent peer reviewers. For all the hype, today's scientific AI still represents a collaborator whose imagination, outputs and judgment benefit from human grounding.

</details>


### [336] [Risk-Aware Planning for Transit Desert Remediation Under Demand Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08371)
*Polina Khoroshevskaya,Ashish Kumar Perukari*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）与条件风险价值（CVaR）约束的风险感知框架，用于在缺乏实际客流数据的情况下规划交通荒漠治理。模型利用人口、土地利用和就业数据对潜在需求进行先验估计，并通过新服务部署后的客流观测更新先验。在25个城市的实验中，该规划器在5年内平均修复了53.6%的交通荒漠区域，相比静态优化平均提升5.0个百分点，在中等预算下提升最大（+9.9个百分点），且在需求先验偏差50%时仍保持稳健。人口密度和现有交通密度是修复成本的最强结构预测因子（R²=0.41）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交通荒漠（transit deserts）区域存在明显的出行需求但公共交通服务不足，影响美洲数千万居民。由于这些区域在服务开通前无法观测到实际客流数据，传统的基于客流量信号的规划方法失效，亟需一种能在不确定条件下进行风险感知决策的规划方法。

Method: 将交通荒漠治理建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），并引入条件风险价值（CVaR）约束以控制财务尾部风险。模型利用人口统计、土地利用和就业数据构建潜在需求的先验分布，随后通过实际部署服务后观测到的客流数据更新后验信念。采用myopic belief-aware规划策略，在25个城市上使用统一的财务模型（运营成本、资本支出、票价收入和净补贴）进行实验评估。

Result: 经过5年规划，中位数修复了53.6%的交通荒漠区域；相比静态优化平均提升5.0个百分点，在25个城市中的16个获得改善；在中等预算下提升最大（+9.9个百分点）；在需求先验偏差50%时仍保持有效性。人口密度和现有交通密度是修复成本的最强结构预测因子（R²=0.41）。

Conclusion: 所提出的风险感知POMDP框架能有效在需求不确定条件下规划交通荒漠治理，显著优于静态优化方法，且对先验偏差具有鲁棒性。该研究为缺乏客流数据的交通规划问题提供了可行的决策支持工具。

Abstract: Transit deserts are areas where public transportation is inadequate despite evidence of travel demand, a condition that affects tens of millions of residents across the Americas. Planning for these areas is difficult because the usual demand signal is missing: ridership cannot be observed before service exists. To address that setting, we formulate risk-aware transit desert remediation as a partially observable Markov decision process with Conditional Value-at-Risk constraints for financial tail risk. The model uses demographic, land-use, and employment data to set a prior over latent demand, then updates that prior as new service deployments produce ridership observations. A myopic belief-aware planner is evaluated on 25 cities using a unified financial model for operating cost, capital expenditure, fare revenue, and net subsidy. After five years, the planner remediates a median of 53.6% of transit-desert tracts and improves on static optimization by 5.0 percentage points on average, with gains in 16 of 25 cities. Gains are largest at moderate budgets (+9.9 points at baseline) and persist under 50% prior-demand miscalibration, while population density and existing transit density are the strongest structural predictors of remediation cost ($R^2\!=\!0.41$ on per-tract cost)

</details>


### [337] [Beyond Prediction: Longitudinal Reasoning in EHR-Integrated Clinical AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08413)
*Irene Yi,Grace Brown,Sufian Aldogom,Nathan Roll,Eric J. Basile,Pamela M. Resnikoff,Isaac Gutterman,Oscar Schiff,Keira Salata,Benjamin Mujkic,Ammar Ahmed*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文系统分析了当代临床AI系统如何整合电子健康记录（EHR）数据及其支持纵向临床推理的程度。研究发现，尽管许多系统整合了EHR数据，但主要基于单次就诊或聚合表示，缺乏对患者历史跨时间推理的明确支持。推理相关结构表示不一致，评估范式仍聚焦预测性能而非纵向可解释性。作者提出未来系统应更好地与临床实践的时间性和解释性结构对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前临床AI系统在整合EHR数据时，大多将其视为静态输入而非持续临床推理的载体，缺乏对纵向时间推理的支持，这与临床实践的时间性和解释性本质不符。现有评估也偏重预测性能而忽略纵向可解释性。

Method: 基于临床NLP和EHR整合系统的精选语料库，构建了一个编码框架，涵盖技术整合策略和推理相关的表示特征（如轨迹建模、跨就诊综合、纵向分析、缺失推理）。同时收集了三名医生在其机构EHR系统中的使用体验。

Result: 多数系统使用基于单次就诊或聚合的表示；明确的时间推理支持有限；推理相关结构表示不一致；评估以预测性能为中心而非纵向可解释性。

Conclusion: 当前方法将EHR数据视为静态输入而非临床推理的基石。本文提出了一个框架，指导未来系统更有效地与临床实践的时间性和解释性结构对齐。

Abstract: We present a structured analysis of how contemporary clinical AI systems integrate electronic health record (EHR) data and the extent to which they support longitudinal clinical reasoning. Drawing on a curated corpus of clinical natural language processing (NLP) and EHR-integrated systems, we develop a coding framework that captures both technical integration strategies and reasoning-relevant representational features, such as trajectory modeling, cross-encounter synthesis, longitudinal analysis, and absence reasoning. We also elicited the experiences of three physicians in their EHR use, including what strengths and weaknesses they found with their institution's current EHR system(s). Our analysis shows that while many systems incorporate EHR data, they predominantly operate on encounter-level or aggregated representations, with limited support for explicit temporal reasoning across patient histories. Reasoning-relevant structures are inconsistently represented, and evaluation paradigms remain largely focused on predictive performance instead of longitudinal interpretability. We argue that current approaches treat EHR data as a static input rather than a substrate for ongoing clinical reasoning, and we outline a framework for understanding how future systems might more effectively align with the temporal and interpretive structure of clinical practice.

</details>


### [338] [Clinical Reasoning in the Age of AI: Longitudinal Cognition and Human-AI Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08442)
*Irene Yi,Grace Brown,Sufian Aldogom,Nathan Roll,Eric J. Basile,Pamela M. Resnikoff,Bianca Sanchez,Chirag Lodha,Isaac Gutterman,Oscar Schiff,Keira Salata,Benjamin Mujkic,Ammar Ahmed*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究通过混合方法（定性访谈+结构化调查）揭示了AI辅助医疗系统中，现有AI系统主要应用于文档记录和总结等任务，与医生临床推理过程存在结构性错位——AI生成的表征常忽略临床决策中的时间性和解释性结构，而核心推理仍依赖医生隐性驱动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医生在追求速度和医疗质量的双重需求下转向AI系统，但面临AI的幻觉和谄媚问题。理解医生在真实环境中的临床推理过程对设计有效的AI推理系统至关重要，而现有研究过度关注性能基准和诊断准确性，忽视了临床推理随时间展开的结构性过程。

Method: 采用混合方法设计，结合定性访谈与结构化调查数据，对临床推理及其与当前AI辅助工作流程的关系进行实证研究。

Result: 当前AI系统主要用于单次诊疗任务（如文档记录和总结），仅部分对齐医生的推理过程；AI生成的表征常遗漏临床决策中的时间性或解释性结构；核心推理（尤其跨多次诊疗的推理）仍隐含且由医生驱动。

Conclusion: 研究提供了理解临床推理作为情境敏感、时间延展过程的统一框架，识别了临床医生认知与当前AI设计之间的关键错位，为开发更好对齐和增强真实临床推理的AI系统提供了具体方向。

Abstract: As physicians turn to AI-powered systems to help meet the dual demands of speed and care quality, they are met with hallucinations and sycophancy. Understanding how doctors reason through clinical problems in real-world settings is critical for design of effective AI reasoning systems. While recent advances in medical AI have emphasized performance benchmarks and diagnostic accuracy, comparatively little attention has been paid to the structure of clinicians' reasoning processes as they unfold over time, e.g., how they interact with electronic health records and operate under conditions of uncertainty and constraint. This study provides a comprehensive, empirically-grounded account of clinical reasoning and its relationship to current AI-mediated workflows through a mixed-methods design that combines qualitative interviews with structured survey data.
  Findings indicate that current AI systems are primarily deployed for encounter-level tasks such as documentation and summarization, and only partially align with physicians' underlying reasoning processes. In particular, AI-generated representations often omit temporal or interpretive structures central to clinical decision-making, while core aspects of reasoning, especially those spanning multiple encounters, remain largely implicit and physician-driven. By integrating fine-grained qualitative insights with broader quantitative patterns, this study offers a unified framework for understanding clinical reasoning as a context-sensitive, temporally extended process and identifies key mismatches between clinician cognition and current AI design. These results provide concrete directions for the development of AI systems that more effectively align with and augment real-world clinical reasoning.

</details>


### [339] [Friend or Foe? Language as an ideological switch in open-weight LLMs under Russian disinformation stress](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08512)
*Anna Małgorzata Kamińska,Tetiana Klynina*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过对四个共享基础模型但针对不同语言社区微调的开源LLM进行受控审计，系统性地否定了“文化对齐微调会自动编码目标社区政治取向”的假设。研究发现“微调悖论”：乌克兰导向模型在使用俄语时对俄罗斯虚假信息的抵抗力最弱，而俄罗斯导向模型反而表现出最强的抵制。语料构成、语言覆盖和提示格式比名义文化来源更具决定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 政策与行业话语普遍假设文化对齐的LLM微调会编码目标社区的政治取向（乌克兰模型抵制俄叙事，俄罗斯模型强化俄叙事），本文旨在通过实证检验这一未经测试的假设。

Method: 对四个共享基础模型但针对不同语言社区微调的开源LLM进行受控审计，分别使用乌克兰语、俄语和英语查询十个有争议的战时叙事（克里米亚、“去纳粹化”、“一个民族”论、布查和马里的波尔暴行否认等）。

Result: 发现“微调悖论”：乌克兰导向模型在使用俄语时对俄罗斯虚假信息的抵抗力最弱，俄罗斯导向模型反而表现出最强的抵制。语料构成、语言覆盖和提示格式比名义文化来源更具决定性。

Conclusion: 区域信息主权的主要威胁并非来自对抗性微调，而是来自“文化对齐保证韧性”这一未经测试的假设。研究结果对混合战争、数字主权和后帝国信息秩序相关辩论具有重要意义。

Abstract: As Russia's war against Ukraine extends into generative AI, large language models (LLMs) adapted for local post-Soviet languages are deployed in contested information environments. Policy and industry discourse assumes that culturally aligned adaptation encodes the political orientation of the target community: a Ukrainian-oriented model will resist Russian narratives, a Russian-oriented one will reinforce them. Does it? This article systematically disconfirms that assumption. We run a controlled audit of four openly available LLMs sharing a common base model but fine-tuned for different linguistic communities, querying them in Ukrainian, Russian and English across ten contested wartime narratives: Crimea, "denazification", the "one people" thesis, and atrocity denial at Bucha and Mariupol. The result is a Fine-Tuning Paradox: the Ukrainian-oriented model shows the weakest resistance to Russian disinformation in Russian, while the Russian-oriented one exhibits the strongest rejection. Corpus composition, language coverage and prompt format prove more decisive than nominal cultural provenance. We situate these findings within debates on hybrid warfare, digital sovereignty and post-imperial information orders, arguing that the principal threat to regional information sovereignty is not adversarial fine-tuning but the untested assumption that cultural alignment guarantees resilience.

</details>


### [340] [Regulating the AI Tutor: Intentions, Help-Seeking, and Self-Regulated Learning in Adolescent GenAI Use](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08568)
*Rania Abdelghani,Peter Kaiser,Kou Murayama*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 对98名九年级学生在AI数学辅导中的对话数据（1616轮次）进行分析，发现尽管学生倾向于选择有支架支持的学习方式，但互动中充斥着工具性请求，缺乏监控与评估，导致后测成绩显著低于前测，且外在认知负荷越高成绩越低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 青少年在真实学习任务中使用生成式AI工具时的自我调节学习和高层次求助行为尚不明确，现有研究多聚焦总体学习结果而非过程性互动。

Method: 收集98名九年级学生与Mistral-Large数学辅导系统的对话日志（808次学生轮次）、前后测知识、学习需求及认知负荷自我报告，提出结合SRL/HS理论与两个LLM特定归纳编码（对AI的主动性、认知警觉性）的轮级编码本，并报告初步AI编码结果。

Result: 学生互动以工具性请求为主，几乎无显式监控或评估；后测成绩显著低于前测；外在认知负荷越高，控制先验知识后后测成绩越低。

Conclusion: 这些模式可用于支持人机混合分析互动模式，并指导设计促进更具主动性和认知警觉性的GenAI使用的支架。

Abstract: Generative AI (GenAI) tools are now common learning companions for adolescents, yet how they regulate their use during authentic learning tasks remains poorly understood. Self-regulated learning (SRL) and high-level help-seeking (HS) are commonly proposed as safeguards against passive or shortcut-oriented use, but most empirical studies focus on aggregate learning outcomes rather than these moment-to-moment processes during AI-supported learning.
  This work-in-progress examines open-ended conversational data from 98 Grade-9 students across three German Gymnasium schools, who used a web-based Mistral-Large tutor to prepare a curriculum-aligned mathematics skill before an exam. Alongside chat logs (1,616 turns; 808 student turns), we collected pre-post domain knowledge, pre-chat learning needs, and self-reported cognitive load. We propose a turn-level codebook combining theory-driven SRL and HS constructs with two LLM-specific inductive codes (agency over the AI; epistemic vigilance), and report preliminary AI-coded results.
  Although students overwhelmingly selected scaffolded support before the chat, their interactions were dominated by instrumental requests with almost no explicit monitoring or evaluation. Post-test performance was significantly lower than pre-test, and higher extraneous cognitive load predicted lower post-test scores after controlling for prior knowledge. We discuss how these patterns can support hybrid human-AI analysis of interaction patterns and inform scaffolds for more agentic and epistemically proactive GenAI use.

</details>


### [341] [A Classroom Study of LLM-Generated Feedback Intervention in Introductory Programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08807)
*Hasnain Heickal,Andrew Lan*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过大规模课堂实验，比较了三种AI反馈形式（自然语言提示、失败测试用例、无反馈）在Python入门编程课程中的效果，发现自然语言反馈显著提高完成率和收敛速度，而测试用例反馈的效果取决于其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM被越来越多地用于编程课程的自动反馈，但来自真实课堂环境、比较不同反馈模态的实证证据仍然有限。

Method: 在入门Python编程课程中开展大规模课堂研究，通过随机协议部署AI生成反馈，设置三种条件：自然语言提示、AI生成的失败测试用例、无AI反馈；收集了来自215名学生的6,693份提交数据（ProgFeed数据集），分析学习轨迹、反馈质量和重复尝试行为。

Result: 自然语言反馈显著关联更高的完成率和更快的正确解法收敛速度；测试用例反馈的效果异质性强，关键取决于反馈的有效性。

Conclusion: AI生成反馈的形式很重要，评估反馈质量（而不仅仅是其存在与否）对于理解其教学影响至关重要。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to provide automated feedback in introductory programming courses, yet empirical evidence from authentic classroom deployments comparing different feedback modalities remains limited. In this work, we present a large-scale classroom study in which AI-generated feedback was deployed through a randomized protocol in an introductory Python programming course. Students received one of three feedback conditions on incorrect submissions: natural language hints, AI-generated failing test cases, or no AI feedback. We release the resulting dataset, ProgFeed, which captures 6,693 submissions from 215 consenting students across 17 labs, including feedback conditions, execution-based performance measures, and fine-grained temporal information. Using this data, we analyze learning trajectories, feedback quality, and submission behavior over repeated attempts. We find that natural language feedback is significantly associated with higher completion rates and faster convergence to correct solutions. Test case feedback, by contrast, exhibits heterogeneous effects that depend critically on feedback validity. Our results suggest that the form of AI-generated feedback matters, and that evaluating feedback quality -- not just its presence -- is essential for understanding its pedagogical impact.

</details>


### [342] [Culturally-Aware AI for Cross-Boundary Community Learning: Undergraduate Innovation at the Intersection of Computation and Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09041)
*Jiaojiao Zhao,Weisheng Zhang,Jiawen Cai,Haibin Gao,Luyao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文报告了一项跨边界社区学习项目，其中本科生开发AI驱动的解决方案用于文化遗产保护与可持续发展，并提出了一个融合教育、技术和文化三个维度的协作框架，以推动具有文化意识的AIED发展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AIED研究缺乏人本导向和对文化背景的充分关注，且基于社区的学习（Community-Based Learning）这一源自社会工作的教学法在AIED研究中代表性不足，尤其在亚太地区。

Method: 通过跨边界社区学习项目，让本科生开发AI解决方案用于文化遗产保护与可持续发展，考察社区参与式计算如何在教育、技术、文化三个维度上实现人本AIED。

Result: 提出了一个面向文化意识的AIED协作框架，支持多利益相关方协作，并通过打破社会工作与计算科学之间的学科壁垒来扩大参与。

Conclusion: 社区参与式计算能够有效实现人本AIED，该框架有助于在亚太等地区推广具有文化敏感性的AI教育实践。

Abstract: Research on artificial intelligence in education (AIED) is rapidly expanding, yet technical progress often lacks human-centered grounding and adequate attention to cultural context. Community-Based Learning, a pedagogy rooted in social work, remains underrepresented in AIED research, particularly within Asia-Pacific contexts. This paper reports on cross-boundary Community-Based Learning where undergraduate students develop AI-enabled solutions for cultural heritage preservation and sustainable development. We examine how community-engaged computing operationalizes human-centered AIED across three dimensions: education, technology, and culture. We contribute a collaborative framework for culturally-aware AIED that fosters multi-stakeholder collaboration while widening participation by dissolving disciplinary silos between social work and computational science.

</details>


### [343] [Can Data Work be Reparative?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09408)
*Srravya Chandhiramowuli,Ding Wang,Alex Taylor*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过民族志研究，考察了一个以女性主义视角构建在线安全数据集的公民科技项目，分析了其如何将数据工作重新定位为修复与补偿的场所，并探讨了在推进数据工作公平报酬和AI数据集集体治理过程中遇到的挑战与张力。作者基于STS的修复正义视角，认为修复数据工作（及AI）的根本在于重置问责关系，呼吁将受数据生产忽视、排斥和伤害最深的群体置于中心位置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI安全评估和红队测试等责任机制高度关注技术改进，但忽视了数据工作者与AI系统之间深层次的责任关系。作者希望从女性主义和修复正义视角出发，探索一种替代性的数据工作模式，以回应在线安全领域的伦理困境。

Method: 采用民族志研究方法，对一个公民科技项目进行深入田野调查。该项目的特色是以女性主义视角、协作方式构建用于训练和基准测试在线安全系统的数据集。分析框架结合了STS领域的修复正义与修复理论。

Result: 揭示了该替代方案在实践中面临的两大核心张力：一是数据工作公平报酬的推进困难，二是AI数据集集体治理的挑战。研究指出，修复数据工作的根本在于重置问责关系——不是对AI或数据集负责，而是对受数据生产模式伤害最深的群体负责。

Conclusion: 修复正义视角要求中断当前数据生产的规范，将受数据生产忽视、排斥和伤害最深的群体置于中心位置，而非AI或数据集本身。这为构建数据与AI实践的替代性未来提供了批判性议程和一种大胆的责任愿景。

Abstract: We present an ethnographic study of an alternative approach to data work, developed by a civic-tech initiative that builds datasets for training and benchmarking online safety systems. They aim to respond to online safety concerns from a feminist perspective, by building safety datasets collaboratively with those most impacted by online harms. In this paper, we examine how this approach aims to reorient data work as a site for repair and redress, and trace the struggles they encounter in the process. Specifically, we draw attention to the challenges and tensions involved in advancing just reward for data work and collective governance of AI datasets. Examining these challenges through an STS-informed lens of reparative justice and repair, we argue that the work of repairing data work (and AI) lies, fundamentally, in resetting the ties of accountability. At a time heightened emphasis on efforts like safety evaluations and red teaming to make AI more responsible, we highlight the need to confront foundational questions about how the humans involved in these efforts relate to the datasets and systems they help produce. A reparative lens demands that we interrupt prevailing norms of data work and place at their centre, not AI or datasets, but those most harmed by the neglect, oversight and exclusion animated in the current modes of dataset production. This, we argue, offers a bold vision for responsibility and contributes towards a critical agenda for building alternative futures of data and AI practice.

</details>


### [344] [Interpretable Crisis Behavior Analysis Using Mobility and Social Media Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09532)
*Muhammad Hamza Arshad Majeed,Sidahmed Benabderrahmane,Talal Rahwan*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出一个可解释的统一分析框架，融合移动性数据与社交媒体数据，利用形式概念分析（FCA）和关联规则挖掘，识别危机情境下的跨领域行为模式。通过2025年洛杉矶 wildfires（33天）和阿联酋 COVID-19（671天）两个案例验证，结果表明该方法能生成高置信度、可操作的政策简报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 危机期间，人口移动模式与在线情绪话语会同时发生变化，但现有研究通常将二者孤立分析，缺乏统一的跨领域行为模式识别方法。

Method: 构建可解释流水线：对齐异构日级信号 → 转化为二元行为状态 → 应用形式概念分析（FCA）提取共现结构 → 挖掘关联规则 → 通过时序留出法验证规则稳定性 → 通过结构化政策翻译层将稳健规则转化为操作简报（含触发条件、前置时间和行动预案）。

Result: Wildfire案例中，交通压力、恐惧/愤怒情绪与治理话语在33天窗口内紧密耦合，规则置信度达100%，Lift值达2.5；COVID案例中，获得8条稳定同日规则（88%留出通过率）和40条干净预测规则（2-7天前置时间）。

Conclusion: 可解释的多模态融合方法能够产出既具有科学可信度又具有政策可操作性的危机情报。

Abstract: Crises alter both how people move and how they communicate. During emergencies such as wildfires and pandemics, changes in mobility patterns and online emotional discourse evolve jointly, yet they are typically studied in isolation. This paper presents a unified and interpretable pipeline that integrates mobility and social media data to identify cross-domain behavioral patterns in crisis settings. The framework is evaluated through two case studies: a short-horizon analysis of the January 2025 Los Angeles wildfires (prototype case) and a longitudinal analysis of UAE COVID-19 behavior from March 2020 to December 2021 (primary case, 671 days). The pipeline aligns heterogeneous daily signals, transforms them into binary behavioral states, applies Formal Concept Analysis (FCA) to extract co-occurrence structure, mines association rules, and validates rule stability through chronological holdout testing. A structured policy-translation layer renders robust rules as operational briefs specifying triggers, lead times, and action playbooks. Results reveal clear cross-domain behavioral structure in both crises. In the wildfire case, traffic stress, fear/anger sentiment, and governance discourse are tightly coupled within a 33-day window, with key rules reaching 100\% confidence and lift scores up to 2.5. In the COVID case, repeated mobility adaptation and sentiment volatility yield 8 stable same-day rules (88\% holdout pass rate) and 40 clean predictive rules with 2--7 day lead horizons. The work demonstrates that interpretable multimodal fusion can produce both scientifically credible and policy-actionable crisis intelligence.

</details>


### [345] [I Was Scrolling and Then I Saw a Pregnant Strawberry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09589)
*Piera Riccio*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文探讨了AI迷你剧（水果剧）这一新兴社交媒体现象，指出这些看似无害的生成式AI视频系列实际上再现有害的性别叙事结构——将女性角色系统性地与道德越轨、性背叛和生殖能力关联，并蕴含种族化逻辑。文章认为，生成式AI的"柔软、圆润、视觉可爱"美学作为一种"美学洗白"机制，中和了这些叙事的意识形态重量，使其能够规避内容审核系统广泛传播。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 揭示AI迷你剧这一看似无害的流行文化现象背后隐藏的性别歧视和种族化叙事结构，以及生成式AI美学如何成为这些有害叙事的"洗白"机制，从而提醒计算创意领域关注这一文化后果。
