Method: 采用个人观察与细读法（close reading），结合女性主义电影理论、批判种族理论和平台研究，对AI迷你剧的叙事内容和美学特征进行分析。

Result: 发现AI迷你剧（1）女性角色被系统性地与道德越轨、性背叛和生殖能力关联；（2）部分情节编码了种族化逻辑——即身体可见差异被赋予道德含义；（3）生成式AI的柔软、圆润、可爱美学起到了"美学洗白"作用，使这些叙事得以规避内容审核系统广泛传播。

Conclusion: 生成式AI的美学特征并非中性，而是具有意识形态功能的，它使原本可能被审查的有害叙事得以流通，这对计算创意领域具有重要的文化影响，需要警惕技术美学背后的权力结构。

Abstract: AI minidramas (also known as fruit dramas) are short, algorithmically distributed generative AI video series featuring anthropomorphized characters that have recently emerged as a widespread phenomenon on social media platforms. This paper argues that despite their seemingly innocuous aesthetic, these videos reproduce deeply gendered narrative structures in which female characters are systematically associated with moral transgression, sexual betrayal, and reproductive capacity, and that several plots also encode the logic of racialization, i.e., the process by which visible bodily difference is morally loaded. Drawing on feminist film theory, critical race theory, and platform studies, it further argues that the generative AI aesthetic of these videos, characterized by softness, roundness, and visual cuteness, functions as a mechanism of aesthetic laundering, neutralizing the ideological weight of these narratives and enabling their circulation despite content moderation systems. This paper approaches these questions through personal observation and close reading, reflecting on the specific affordances of generative AI that make this phenomenon both possible and culturally consequential for the field of computational creativity.

</details>


### [346] [Awareness of Technological Isomorphism: Integrating AI into Elementary Mathematics Teaching on Data and Prediction,A Case Study of the Compound Line Graph](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09598)
*Li Li,Yu Cao*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出"技术同构意识"核心概念，定义为学生元认知层面意识到自身数学认知操作与AI技术操作共享底层逻辑结构，基于迁移学习与元认知理论，构建"感知-理解-创造"三阶段教学路径及评估量规，并通过五年级"复式折线统计图"案例实证验证，为学科教学与AI素养教育深度融合提供可操作框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人工智能深入融入小学数学教育，亟需一种能够解释学生从学科知识向AI理解进行认知过渡的概念工具。现有"计算思维"概念难以精准描述这一跨领域认知迁移过程，因此需要提出新概念来填补理论空白。

Method: 基于迁移学习与元认知理论，提出"技术同构意识"核心概念，阐明其与"计算思维"的本质区别；构建"感知-理解-创造"三阶段教学路径及配套评估量规；通过中国五年级数学教材"复式折线统计图"课例进行案例研究实证验证。

Result: 该框架能够阐明学生从数学到AI的认知跃迁机制，指导教师识别学科课程中的"同构接口"；通过五年级"复式折线统计图"课例提供了高度可复制的操作框架，实证验证了该框架的有效性。

Conclusion: "技术同构意识"为学科教学与AI素养教育的深度融合提供了新的理论视角和实践路径，具有高度的可复制性和推广价值。

Abstract: The deep integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into elementary mathematics education necessitates a conceptual tool capable of explaining students' cognitive transition from disciplinary knowledge to AI understanding. This study proposes a novel core concept, "Awareness of Technological Isomorphism, " defined as a student's metacognitive realization that their own mathematical cognitive operations (e.g., observing trends, inducing patterns, and making predictions) share an underlying logical structure with AI technical operations (e.g., pattern recognition and predictive modeling). This awareness, in turn, facilitates cognitive transfer from disciplinary mathematics to AI comprehension. Underpinned by transfer learning and metacognitive theories, this study clarifies the distinct essence of this concept from traditional "computational thinking." We demonstrate the explanatory power of this framework in two ways: elucidating the mechanism of students' cognitive leap from mathematics to AI, and guiding instructors to identify "isomorphic interfaces" within disciplinary curricula. On this basis, a three-stage pedagogical pathway--spanning "Perception, Comprehension, and Creation"--is constructed alongside a corresponding evaluation rubric. This framework is empirically validated through a case study based on the "Compound Line Graph" lesson from a fifth-grade mathematics textbook in China, offering a highly replicable operational framework for the deep convergence of disciplinary instruction and AI literacy education.

</details>


### [347] [Principled Uncertainty in Clinical AI: End-to-End Bayesian Modelling and Algorithmic Equity Auditing Across Multimodal Patient Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09789)
*Oladimeji Anthonio,Dimeji Abdulsobur Olawuyi,Oloruntoba Ajayi,Temiloluwa Aderemi,Joseph Odamo*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向多模态临床数据的端到端贝叶斯不确定性建模框架，通过概率深度学习架构（包括模态特定变分编码器、精度加权融合机制和分解不确定性输出头）量化预测的不确定性。实验表明，该框架不仅实现了良好的校准性能（ECE=0.096），更重要的是，其认知不确定性能够系统性地识别医疗资源不足的亚群（如基层/农村患者不确定性公平差距达15.3%，p<0.001），将校准后的不确定性确立为一种可操作的临床公平性信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有临床AI系统通常在不进行原则性不确定性量化的情况下产生预测，限制了其在高风险医疗环境中的可信度；同时，缺乏将不确定性作为公平性度量的形式化方法。

Method: 构建概率深度学习架构：模态特定变分编码器 + 精度加权晚期融合机制 + 分解不确定性输出头（分离任意不确定性和认知不确定性）。训练使用复合贝叶斯损失函数（二元交叉熵 + KL散度正则化 + 不确定性校准惩罚）。

Result: 模型ECE=0.096。亚群公平审计显示：基层/农村患者认知不确定性公平差距15.3%（p<0.001，效应量0.698），低社会经济地位患者6.8%（p<0.001），老年患者3.9%（p<0.001），未发现性别差异。

Conclusion: 校准后的不确定性不仅是概率模型的技术属性，更构成了一种具有直接临床相关性的可操作公平性信号，能够系统性地识别未被充分服务的患者群体。

Abstract: Clinical artificial intelligence (AI) systems routinely produce predictions without principled quantification of uncertainty, limiting their trustworthiness in high-stakes medical environments. This paper presents an integrated research programme addressing two interconnected problems: (1) the development of a fully end-to-end Bayesian uncertainty modelling framework for multimodal clinical data, and (2) the application of calibrated uncertainty estimates as a formal measure of algorithmic equity across patient subgroups. We construct a probabilistic deep learning architecture comprising modality-specific variational encoders, a precision-weighted late fusion mechanism, and a decomposed uncertainty output head that separates aleatoric from epistemic uncertainty. The system is trained with a composite Bayesian loss incorporating binary cross-entropy, Kullback-Leibler divergence regularisation, and an uncertainty calibration penalty. We evaluate model calibration using Expected Calibration Error (ECE = 0.096) and conduct a subgroup equity audit across facility type, socioeconomic status, age group, and biological sex on a dataset of 1,000 simulated patients. Results demonstrate that epistemic uncertainty systematically identifies underserved populations: primary/rural facility patients show a 15.3% uncertainty equity gap (p < 0.001, effect size = 0.698), low socioeconomic status patients exhibit a 6.8% gap (p < 0.001), and elderly patients show a 3.9% gap (p < 0.001), whilst no significant sex-based disparity is detected. These findings establish that calibrated uncertainty is not merely a technical property of probabilistic models but constitutes an actionable equity signal with direct clinical relevance.

</details>


### [348] [Strategic Integration of Artificial Intelligence in the C-Suite: The Role of the Chief AI Officer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.10247)
*Marc Schmitt*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出角色设计理论，解释组织如何通过设立首席AI官（CAIO）、混合角色或联邦结构来应对AI治理挑战，并建立了CAIO框架链接AI的三大特性与高管设计问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有C-level角色无法充分治理和整合AI，组织应对方式各异（设立CAIO、混合角色、联邦结构），需要一个理论来解释这种差异。

Method: 理论构建：识别AI的三大特性（分布式判断问责、上游治理、非平稳性），归纳三种配置（集中扩展、分布式扩展、角色创建），提出CAIO框架及四项命题。

Result: 提出CAIO框架，将AI特性链接到高管设计问题及角色所需功能与能力；提出四项命题说明CAIO何时出现、组织形式、有效性条件及配置演进。

Conclusion: 通过理论驱动的高管层面战略整合分析，为高管领导力、组织设计和数字治理研究做出贡献。

Abstract: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into corporate strategy has become critical for organizations seeking to maintain competitive advantage in the digital age. Although organizations increasingly rely on AI as a strategic and organizational resource, existing C-suite roles remain only partially equipped to govern, integrate, and leverage it coherently at the enterprise level. Organizations vary in their responses. Some create a dedicated Chief AI Officer (CAIO), others extend existing mandates into hybrid roles, and still others coordinate AI through federated structures. This paper develops a role-design theory to explain this variation. I identify three properties that distinguish AI from earlier cross-cutting enterprise technologies - distributed accountability for judgment, upstream governance, and non-stationarity - and three configurations through which organizations respond: concentrated extension, distributed extension, and role creation. The CAIO Framework links these properties to the executive design problems they generate and to the functions and capabilities required of the dedicated role. Four propositions specify when a dedicated CAIO emerges, what form an organization's response takes, when the dedicated role is effective, and how configurations evolve over time. This paper contributes to research on executive leadership, organizational design, and digital governance by offering a theory-driven account of the strategic integration of AI at the executive level.

</details>


### [349] [Data Want to be Free: An Innovation Resistance Theory Model for Identifying Barriers to Government Data Sharing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.10883)
*Anastasija Nikiforova,Antoine Clarinval,Anneke Zuiderwijk,Daniel Rudmark,Petar Milic,Charalampos Alexopoulos,Katrin Rajamäe-Soosaar*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究基于创新抵抗理论（IRT），构建了专用于政府数据共享的IRT4DS模型，识别出5大类39项组织抵抗障碍及23项应对措施，并通过对21个欧洲公共组织的访谈验证，为理解公共数据开放中的组织抵抗提供了理论框架和实践指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管数据共享对数字政府和数据驱动创新日益重要，但许多公共组织仍不愿开放数据。已有研究多关注开放数据采纳的影响因素，但缺乏理论性工作来解释为什么公共机构内部持续存在抵抗行为。

Method: 从文献中推导初始模型，再通过对来自6个欧洲国家的21个公共组织的访谈进行精炼，最终形成IRT4DS模型。

Result: IRT4DS模型识别出39项障碍（涵盖使用、价值、风险、传统和形象五个维度）以及23项应对措施，这些措施针对最关键障碍及负责应对的行动主体进行了映射。

Conclusion: 将IRT扩展到政府数据共享情境，推进了关于公共数据为何通常保持封闭状态的理论理解，并为政策制定者设计支持性数据生态系统、减少开放政府数据（OGD）采纳中的结构性及文化性障碍提供了可操作指导。

Abstract: Data sharing is increasingly essential for digital government and data-driven innovation, yet many public organizations remain reluctant to make their data openly available. While prior research has examined factors influencing open data adoption, little theoretical work explores why resistance persists within public agencies. This study develops an Innovation Resistance Theory (IRT) model tailored to government data sharing to identify predictors of organizational resistance. An initial model was derived from literature and refined through interviews with 21 public organizations across six European countries. The resulting IRT4DS model identifies 39 barriers spanning usage, value, risk, tradition, and image dimensions, and 23 countermeasures mapped to the most critical barriers and the actors responsible for addressing them. By extending IRT into the context of governmental data sharing, the study advances theoretical understanding of why public data often remains closed and provides actionable guidance for policymakers seeking to design enabling data ecosystems and reduce structural and cultural barriers to OGD adoption.

</details>


### [350] [Health-Informed Computing: Estimating and Addressing the Public Health Impact of Data Centers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.06288)
*Yuelin Han,Zhifeng Wu,Pengfei Li,Adam Wierman,Shaolei Ren*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种原则性方法来模拟数据中心的空气污染物排放并评估公众健康影响。研究显示，到2028年，美国数据中心的年度公众健康负担预计将超过200亿美元，且健康成本分布不均——受影响最严重县的每户健康负担可达全国平均水平的约7倍。作者进一步提出了健康感知计算框架，将公众健康影响纳入数据中心资源管理的时空优化，并建议扩展能源报告以包含公众健康影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI需求的激增导致高能耗数据中心快速扩张，其排放的常规空气污染物对公众健康造成影响，但这一议题在可持续性评估中受到的关注相对有限。现有研究缺乏系统性的方法来量化数据中心的空气污染物排放及其健康影响。

Method: 提出了模拟数据中心空气污染物排放的原则性方法，并据此评估公众健康影响。在此基础上构建了健康感知计算框架，将公众健康成本显式纳入数据中心资源管理的时空优化决策。

Result: 预计到2028年，美国数据中心的年度公众健康负担将超过200亿美元；虽然全国层面的影响尚属温和，但健康成本在地理上高度不均，受影响最严重县的每户健康负担可达全国平均水平的约7倍。

Conclusion: 建议扩展能源报告体系以包含数据中心的公众健康影响，并呼吁关注所有受影响社区。健康感知计算框架能够在支持环境可持续性的同时减轻公众健康成本。

Abstract: The surging demand for artificial intelligence (AI) has led to a rapid expansion of energy-intensive data centers, contributing to criteria air pollutant emissions and raising public health concerns that have received comparatively limited attention in sustainability assessments. This paper introduces a principled methodology to model air pollutant emissions for data centers and estimate the public health impacts. Our findings reveal that the growing demand for AI and computing technologies is projected to push the total annual public health burden of U.S. data centers up to more than $20 billion in 2028. Although national-level impacts remain modest, data center health costs are unevenly distributed: in the most affected counties, the estimated per-household health burden can reach about seven times the national average. Next, we propose a health-informed computing framework that explicitly incorporates public health impacts into data center resource management across space and time, mitigating public health costs while supporting environmental sustainability. More broadly, we recommend extended energy reporting to include public health impact of data centers and paying attention to all impacted communities.

</details>


### [351] [Uncovering Intervention Opportunities for Suicide Prevention with Language Model Assistants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.18541)
*Jaspreet Ranjit,Hyundong J. Cho,Claire J. Smerdon,Yoonsoo Nam,Myles Phung,Jonathan May,John R. Blosnich,Swabha Swayamdipta*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文研究了语言模型作为美国国家暴力死亡报告系统（NVDRS）中自杀数据标注和专家指南制定的辅助工具的效用。实验表明，LM在50个变量上的预测与现有标注一致性达85%，并在38%的差异案例中发现标注错误。此外，提出了一种人在回路算法，帮助专家高效构建新变量的标注指南，并在真实案例中验证了其与人工方法相当的标注质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NVDRS数据包含大量自由文本叙述，人工从死亡调查记录中提取结构化信息耗时费力，且标注指南的制定需要专家大量投入。因此，研究者希望探索语言模型作为高效助手来辅助数据标注和专家指南制定的可能性，以支持自杀干预措施的开发。

Method: 使用语言模型对NVDRS中50个变量进行预测，与现有标注进行一致性比较；对不一致案例进行专家审查；提出一种人在回路（human-in-the-loop）算法，使专家仅需对LM错误预测提供反馈即可高效构建和完善新变量的标注指南，并在一个关于受害者与律师互动的新变量案例中进行了验证。

Result: LM预测与现有标注的一致性约为85%；在LM与标注不一致的案例中，专家审查发现38%的情况下存在标注问题；提出的算法在实际新变量标注任务中达到了与劳动密集型人工方法相当的标注质量。

Conclusion: 语言模型能够作为处理敏感数据的公共卫生研究人员的有效助手，可以在高风险的场景下提升数据标注和指南制定的效率。

Abstract: Warning: This paper discusses topics of suicide and suicidal ideation, which may be distressing to some readers.
  The National Violent Death Reporting System (NVDRS) documents information about suicides in the United States, including free text narratives (e.g., circumstances surrounding a suicide). In a demanding public health data pipeline, annotators manually extract structured information from death investigation records following extensive guidelines developed painstakingly by experts. In this work, we facilitate data-driven insights from the NVDRS data to support the development of novel suicide interventions by investigating the value of language models (LMs) as efficient assistants to these (a) data annotators and (b) experts. We find that LM predictions match existing data annotations about 85% of the time across 50 NVDRS variables. In the cases where the LM disagrees with existing annotations, expert review reveals that LM assistants can surface annotation discrepancies 38% of the time. Finally, we introduce a human-in-the-loop algorithm to assist experts in efficiently building and refining guidelines for annotating new variables by allowing them to focus only on providing feedback for incorrect LM predictions. We apply our algorithm to a real-world case study for a new variable that characterizes victim interactions with lawyers and demonstrate that it achieves comparable annotation quality with a laborious manual approach. Our findings provide evidence that LMs can serve as effective assistants to public health researchers who handle sensitive data in high-stakes scenarios.

</details>


### [352] [AI Self-preferencing in Algorithmic Hiring: Empirical Evidence and Insights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.00462)
*Jiannan Xu,Gujie Li,Jane Yi Jiang*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过大规模简历匹配实验发现，LLM在筛选简历时存在显著的自我偏好偏差（67%-82%），即更倾向选择由自己生成的简历；模拟24个职业的招聘流程显示，使用与评估者相同LLM的候选人被短列表的概率比提交人工简历的候选人高23%-60%，商业领域（如销售、会计）影响最大；通过干预LLM的自我识别能力可将偏差降低50%以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM被广泛应用于招聘等决策过程的两端（求职者用LLM优化简历，雇主用LLM筛选简历），需要探究LLM是否会系统性偏好自己生成的内容，以及这种自我偏好偏差在现实场景中的影响。

Method: 采用大规模受控简历对应实验，控制内容质量后比较LLM对自身生成、人类撰写及其他模型生成简历的偏好；并在24个职业中模拟真实招聘流程，量化偏差对候选人短列表概率的影响。

Result: LLM的自我偏好偏差范围为67%-82%；使用相同LLM的候选人比提交人工简历的候选人被短列表概率高23%-60%，商业领域影响最大；通过干预自我识别能力可降低偏差50%以上。

Conclusion: AI辅助决策中存在因自我偏好偏差导致的AI-AI交互偏见，需扩展AI公平性框架以涵盖此类偏差，而不仅限于传统的人口统计学差异。

Abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) tools become widely adopted, large language models (LLMs) are increasingly involved on both sides of decision-making processes, ranging from hiring to content moderation. This dual adoption raises a critical question: do LLMs systematically favor content that resembles their own outputs? Prior research in computer science has identified self-preference bias -- the tendency of LLMs to favor their own generated content -- but its real-world implications have not been empirically evaluated. We focus on the hiring context, where job applicants often rely on LLMs to refine resumes, while employers deploy them to screen those same resumes. Using a large-scale controlled resume correspondence experiment, we find that LLMs consistently prefer resumes generated by themselves over those written by humans or produced by alternative models, even when content quality is controlled. The bias against human-written resumes is particularly substantial, with self-preference bias ranging from 67% to 82% across major commercial and open-source models. To assess labor market impact, we simulate realistic hiring pipelines across 24 occupations. These simulations show that candidates using the same LLM as the evaluator are 23% to 60% more likely to be shortlisted than equally qualified applicants submitting human-written resumes, with the largest disadvantages observed in business-related fields such as sales and accounting. We further demonstrate that this bias can be reduced by more than 50% through simple interventions targeting LLMs' self-recognition capabilities. These findings highlight an emerging but previously overlooked risk in AI-assisted decision making and call for expanded frameworks of AI fairness that address not only demographic-based disparities, but also biases in AI-AI interactions.

</details>


### [353] [Bathtubs, Boundaries, and Sandboxes: AI Regulatory Learning under Legal Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.04094)
*Tom Deckenbrunnen,Alessio Buscemi,Marco Almada,Alfredo Capozucca,German Castignani*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文以《AI法案》为例，利用Coleman's bathtub分析AI治理中的监管学习空间，论证法律不确定性无法完全事前消除，且在合理范围内对监管学习是必要的。通过边界对象和边界协商人工制品，论文解释了法律要求向操作实践的转化，并识别了技术沙盒框架中作为边界协商人工制品所需的具体属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI的快速发展及其融入社会各层面带来了监管挑战，各国政策制定者依赖高层级原则和抽象法律要求来保持法规的灵活性，但这导致下游开发者、企业和审计人员在将抽象要求转化为可验证技术标准时面临法律不确定性。

Method: 以《AI法案》为案例，运用Coleman's bathtub分析框架研究AI治理中的监管学习空间，结合边界对象和边界协商人工制品的概念，分析技术沙盒框架的具体属性。

Result: 法律不确定性不能完全事前消除，且在合理范围内是监管学习所必需的；边界对象和边界协商人工制品有助于解释法律要求向操作实践的转化；技术沙盒框架需具备特定属性才能有效作为边界协商人工制品用于AI评估。

Conclusion: 法律确定性是长期目标，但过早封闭监管工具会破坏适应性治理所需的学习过程。

Abstract: Effective regulation of AI is a defining policy challenge, driven by their integration into all aspects of society. To remain responsive to their rapid development and emergent properties, policymakers across the globe rely on high-level principles and abstract legal requirements. Yet, while this flexibility supports future-proofing human-centred regulations and aligning them with socio-ethical values, it also causes legal uncertainty downstream as developers, companies, and auditors struggle with translating these abstract requirements into verifiable technical requirements. Using the AI Act as an example, this paper draws on Coleman's bathtub to analyse the regulatory learning space in AI governance. It argues that legal uncertainty cannot be fully reduced ex ante and that, within reasonable bounds, it is also necessary for regulatory learning because it creates the space in which boundary negotiation over socio-technical meaning can occur. Building on this analysis, the paper shows how boundary objects and boundary negotiating artifacts help explain the translation of legal requirements into operational practice. By examining technical sandbox frameworks, it further identifies concrete properties that technical infrastructures must possess to function effectively as boundary negotiation artifacts in AI assessment. The paper concludes that legal certainty remains the long-term aim, but that premature closure of regulatory instruments risks undermining the learning processes needed for adaptive governance.

</details>


### [354] [How Hyper-Datafication Impacts the Sustainability Costs in Frontier AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.00056)
*Sophia N. Wilson,Sebastian Mair,Mophat Okinyi,Erik B. Dam,Janin Koch,Raghavendra Selvan*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过可持续性视角审视了AI领域中大规模数据的环境、社会和经济成本，提出了"超数据化"（hyper-datafication）概念，分析了Hugging Face Hub约55万个数据集，并结合肯尼亚数据工人的定性调研，揭示了数据增长带来的环境成本、劳动风险向全球南方的系统性转移，最后提出了Data PROOFS建议以缓解这些成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前前沿AI的成功高度依赖大规模数据，但这些数据的获取、存储和管理所带来的环境、社会和经济成本往往被忽视。本文旨在揭示这些隐性成本，引发学界和业界对数据可持续性的关注与讨论。

Method: 对Hugging Face Hub上约55万个数据集进行定量分析（涵盖数据集增长趋势、存储能耗与碳足迹、语言数据的社会表征），结合对肯尼亚数据工人的定性访谈，并利用外部数据中心基础设施数据佐证全球分布不均衡。

Result: 超数据化导致显著且持续增长的环境成本；劳动风险与表征性伤害系统性向全球南方转移；全球数据中心基础设施分布存在严重不平衡。

Conclusion: 提出Data PROOFS建议（涵盖溯源、资源意识、所有权、开放性、简约性和标准化），以缓解大规模数据带来的可持续性成本，呼吁研究社区关注数据层面被忽视的代价。

Abstract: Large-scale data has fuelled the success of frontier artificial intelligence (AI) models over the past decade. This expansion has relied on sustained efforts by large technology corporations to aggregate and curate internet-scale datasets. In this work, we examine the environmental, social, and economic costs of large-scale data in AI through a sustainability lens. We argue that the field is shifting from building models from data to actively creating data for building models. We characterise this transition as hyper-datafication, which marks a critical juncture for the future of frontier AI and its societal impacts. To quantify and contextualise data-related costs, we analyse approximately 550,000 datasets from the Hugging Face Hub, focusing on dataset growth, storage-related energy consumption and carbon footprint, and societal representation using language data. We complement this analysis with qualitative responses from data workers in Kenya to examine the labour involved, including direct employment by big tech corporations and exposure to graphic content. We further draw on external data sources to substantiate our findings by illustrating the global disparity in data centre infrastructure. Our analyses reveal that hyper-datafication drives substantial and growing environmental costs while systematically redistributing labour risks and representational harms toward the Global South. Thus, we propose Data PROOFS recommendations spanning provenance, resource awareness, ownership, openness, frugality, and standards to mitigate these costs. Our work aims to make visible the often-overlooked costs of data that underpin frontier AI and to stimulate broader debate within the research community and beyond.

</details>


### [355] [Empirical Modeling of Therapist-Client Dynamics in Psychotherapy Using LLM-Based Assessments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.12450)
*Angela Chen,Siwei Jin,Canwen Wang,Holly Swartz,Tongshuang Wu,Robert E Kraut,Haiyi Zhu*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文利用大语言模型（LLMs）对约2000小时的心理治疗对话进行自动化编码，衡量治疗师行为（共情、探索）、关系质量（融洽关系）和来访者反应（自我表露、情绪表达），并结合结构方程模型分析各变量间的动态关系。研究发现，治疗师的共情和探索直接促进来访者的自我表露和情绪变化，而融洽关系则作为调节变量影响治疗师行为与来访者情感之间的关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心理治疗过程研究传统上依赖人工编码，难以大规模开展。本文旨在构建一个基于LLMs的计算框架，实现对治疗师-来访者互动的自动化、可扩展测量，从而揭示治疗过程的核心动态机制。

Method: 使用LLMs对治疗师行为（共情、探索）、关系质量（融洽关系）和来访者结果（自我表露、自我指向及外向指向的负性情绪）进行自动化评分；通过与人工作标注的ICC验证（0.45-0.81）；将模型应用于Alexander Street语料库中约2000小时的转录文本；采用结构方程模型（SEM）估计治疗师行为、融洽关系与来访者反应之间的时刻间关系，并控制来访者先前状态和上下文。

Result: 共情和探索直接预测来访者自我表露的增加和情绪表达的转变；共情与自我指向的负性情绪关联更强（而非外向指向的负性情绪），表明其促进对内在痛苦的认知；探索则增加表露和情绪细化。融洽关系不直接放大表露或情绪强度，而是调节治疗师行为与来访者情感之间的关系，可能有助于减少内在痛苦。

Conclusion: 基于LLM的测量结合结构建模能够大规模捕捉核心治疗过程：共情和探索发挥直接作用，融洽关系作为语境调节因素。这为心理治疗的精确建模、可扩展的治疗师培训及AI辅助临床教育奠定了基础。

Abstract: Psychotherapy is a primary treatment for many mental health conditions, yet the interplay among therapist behaviors, client responses, and the therapeutic relationship is difficult to study at scale, as process research has relied on labor-intensive human coding. We develop and validate a computational framework for modeling therapist-client interaction, using large language models (LLMs) to measure therapist behaviors (empathy, exploration), relational quality (rapport), and client outcomes (self-disclosure, self-directed and outward-directed negative emotion). After validating model-generated scores against human annotations (ICC = 0.45-0.81; rapport 0.81, self-disclosure 0.78), we apply these measures to roughly 2,000 hours of transcripts from the Alexander Street corpus and use Structural Equation Modeling to estimate moment-to-moment relationships among therapist behaviors, rapport, and subsequent client responses, controlling for prior client state and context. Therapist empathy and exploration directly predict increased client disclosure and shifts in emotional expression; empathy is more strongly associated with self-directed than outward-directed negative emotion, suggesting greater acknowledgment of internal distress, while exploration increases disclosure and emotional elaboration. Rapport does not directly amplify disclosure or emotional intensity but instead moderates the associations between therapist behaviors and client affect, potentially contributing to reductions in internal distress. These results show that LLM-based measurement combined with structural modeling can capture core therapeutic processes at scale, with empathy and exploration acting directly and rapport as a contextual moderator, providing a foundation for precision modeling of psychotherapy and for scalable therapist training and AI-supported clinical education.

</details>


### [356] [Cognitive Comparability and the Limits of Governance: Evaluating Authority Under Radical Capability Asymmetry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.02720)
*Tony Rost*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出一个六维治理评估框架（合法性、问责性、可纠正性、非支配性、辅助性、制度韧性），检验当治理者与被治理者之间存在认知不对称时治理理论的前提假设。在边界超级智能权威的极端不对称场景下，六个维度中有四个出现结构性失败，其中两个可通过制度设计缓解，另两个（公共理性问题和永久能力不对称下的非支配问题）需要新的规范性理论而非制度设计。此外，原本独立的监督维度在极端不对称下会协同退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有治理理论隐含假定治理者与被治理者之间存在粗略的认知可比性，但这个假设从未被明确检验。随着人工智能系统能力不断提升，未来可能出现治理者（超级智能）与被治理者（人类）之间认知不对称极端化的情形，这一假设可能不再成立，需要预先审视其有效性。

Method: 从政治合法性理论、委托-代理模型、共和主义理论和AI对齐文献中提取六个评估维度（合法性、问责性、可纠正性、非支配性、辅助性、制度韧性），先在现有非多数主义机构（认知不对称有限但有边界）上进行演示验证，再应用于边界超级智能权威（认知不对称极端）的前瞻性案例。

Result: 在极端认知不对称下：1）六个维度中有四个出现结构性失败；2）其中两个（辅助性的范围限制、制度韧性）可通过制度设计解决；3）另外两个（认知不可理解下的公共理性问题、永久能力不对称下的非支配问题）需要新的规范性理论；4）原本作为独立检查的维度在极端不对称下开始协同退化，因为它们依赖相同的监督能力。

Conclusion: 治理理论中那些使各检查维度保持独立的隐含假设，正是因为它们一直成立而从未被检视。当认知不对称达到极端程度时，这些假设失效，需要发展新的规范性理论来应对公共理性和非支配问题，而非仅仅改进制度设计。

Abstract: Governance theory presupposes a rough cognitive comparability between governors and governed. This paper makes that assumption explicit and testable through a six-dimension evaluation framework covering legitimacy, accountability, corrigibility, non-domination, subsidiarity, and institutional resilience, drawn from political legitimacy theory, principal-agent models, republican theory, and the AI alignment literature. The framework is first demonstrated on existing non-majoritarian institutions, where capability asymmetry is real but bounded, and then applied to a prospective case of bounded superintelligent authority, where the asymmetry is radical. Four of six dimensions show structural failures. Two of the four appear tractable to institutional design (subsidiarity scope limitation and institutional resilience). The other two, the public reason problem under cognitive incomprehensibility and the non-domination problem under permanent capability asymmetry, call for new normative theory rather than better institutional design. The analysis also finds that dimensions which operate as independent checks under bounded asymmetry begin to degrade together under radical asymmetry, because each depends on the same oversight capacity. The assumptions that allowed these checks to remain independent have gone unexamined so far because they have always held.

</details>


### [357] [Bounded by Risk, Not Capability: Quantifying AI Occupational Substitution Rates via a Tech-Risk Dual-Factor Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04464)
*Shuyao Gao,Minghao Huang*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种技术-业务风险双因素模型，通过将923个职业分解为2,087个详细工作活动(DWA)，利用多智能体LLM集成评估技术可行性与业务风险，发现传统算法概率无法捕捉专家责任约束下的"制度溢价"，计算了美国劳动力市场的相对职业自动化指数(OAI)，挑战了传统RBTC假说：非例行的符号操纵型认知角色(如数据科学家)面临前所未有的自动化风险(OAI≈0.70)，而非结构化的体力劳动和高风险照护角色展现出绝对韧性，揭示了深刻的"认知风险不对称性"，并假设了"合规溢价"的涌现必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有任务级评估主要衡量对AI能力的理论"暴露度"，忽略了现实商业采纳中的关键摩擦：责任、合规和物理安全。职业并非瞬间被消灭，而是通过原子化行动逐步被侵蚀，需要一个能够同时考量技术可行性与业务风险的综合评估框架。

Method: 将923个职业分解为2,087个详细工作活动(DWA)，使用多智能体LLM集成对每项DWA同时评分技术可行性与业务风险；通过基于方差的人类在环(HITL)验证与专家小组校准；采用数学瓶颈聚合计算相对职业自动化指数(OAI)。

Result: 非例行认知角色如数据科学家OAI≈0.70，面临前所未有的暴露；非结构化体力劳动与高风险照护角色展现出绝对韧性。发现算法概率与专家评估之间存在深刻的"认知鸿沟"——专家受责任约束产生的"制度溢价"无法被纯算法模型捕获。

Conclusion: 挑战传统RBTC假说，揭示"认知风险不对称性"；提出"合规溢价"假设——工资韧性日益与风险吸收能力挂钩；本研究作为系统性脆弱性的横截面诊断，为后续可计算一般均衡(CGE)计量建模奠定基础。

Abstract: The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) has ignited concerns about technological unemployment. Existing task-based evaluations predominantly measure theoretical "exposure" to AI capabilities, ignoring critical frictions of real-world commercial adoption: liability, compliance, and physical safety. We argue occupations are not eradicated instantaneously, but gradually encroached upon via atomic actions. We introduce a Tech-Risk Dual-Factor Model to re-evaluate this. By deconstructing 923 occupations into 2,087 Detailed Work Activities (DWAs), we utilize a multi-agent LLM ensemble to score both technical feasibility and business risk. Through variance-based Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) validation with an expert panel, we demonstrate a profound cognitive gap: isolated algorithmic probabilities fail to encapsulate the "institutional premium" imposed by experts bounded by professional liability. Applying a strictly algorithmic baseline via mathematical bottleneck aggregation, we calculate Relative Occupational Automation Indices ($OAI$) for the U.S. labor market. Our findings challenge the traditional Routine-Biased Technological Change (RBTC) hypothesis. Non-routine cognitive roles highly dependent on symbolic manipulation (e.g., Data Scientists) face unprecedented exposure ($OAI \approx 0.70$). Conversely, unstructured physical trades and high-stakes caretaking roles exhibit absolute resilience, quantifying a profound "Cognitive Risk Asymmetry." We hypothesize the emergent necessity of a "Compliance Premium," indicating wage resilience increasingly tied to risk-absorption capacity. We frame these findings as a cross-sectional diagnostic of systemic vulnerability, establishing a foundation for subsequent Computable General Equilibrium (CGE) econometric modeling involving dynamic wage elasticity and structural labor reallocation.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [358] [Offline Reinforcement Learning for Plasma Control in Nuclear Fusion: Codebase and Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07550)
*Yang Fu,Haomin Bao,Rohit Sonker,Xiaoyan Hu,Aravind Venugopal,Jeff Schneider,Jiayu Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RL4F是一个面向核聚变等离子体控制的离线强化学习基准，基于DIII-D托卡马克历史数据构建评估环境，包含旋转、密度、温度和压力四类完整廓线跟踪任务。实验表明离线模型基RL方法平均表现最佳，但无单一方法主导所有任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线强化学习为利用历史托卡马克数据开发等离子体控制器提供了可行途径，但缺乏标准化的基准来评估多执行器、长时域等离子体控制问题，导致进展难以衡量。

Method: 基于DIII-D托卡马克历史放电数据构建动力学函数的闭环评估环境，设计旋转、密度、温度和压力四类完整廓线跟踪任务，在统一协议下评估多种模仿学习和离线强化学习基线方法。

Result: 离线模型基RL方法在多数目标上获得最佳平均性能，但无单一方法在所有任务中占优，突显了动力学建模在复杂长时域等离子体控制任务中的重要性。

Conclusion: RL4F不仅为核聚变社区提供了标准化的离线RL基准，也为更广泛的离线RL算法开发提供了平台。

Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising route for developing plasma controllers from historical tokamak data, since online trial-and-error on real devices is costly and risky. However, progress in this direction remains difficult to measure due to the lack of a standardized offline RL benchmark for realistic multi-actuator, long-horizon plasma control problems in nuclear fusion. We introduce RL4F, an Offline Reinforcement Learning Benchmark for Plasma Control in Nuclear Fusion, providing closed-loop evaluation environments and baseline comparisons across four full-profile tracking tasks: rotation, density, temperature, and pressure. The dynamics function underlying the evaluation environment is built from historical discharge data from DIII-D, a real-world Tokamak. We evaluate a broad set of imitation learning and offline RL baselines under a unified protocol. We find that offline model-based RL methods obtain the best average performance on most objectives, although no single method dominates all tasks, highlighting the importance of dynamics modeling in complex, long-horizon plasma control tasks. To foster further research, we open-source the codebase, datasets, and evaluation framework, providing a benchmark not only for the fusion community but also for algorithm development in offline RL.

</details>


### [359] [MedicalRec: Medical recommender system for image classification without retraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07553)
*Roghayeh Taghavi,Aysa Hasanazde Bashkandi,Amir Ali Bengari,Mohammad Amin Raji,Mohammad Salahi Ardekani,Parisa Mardukhian,Parvaneh Rezaei,Ramin Mousa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于Transformer的医学图像分类模型推荐系统MedicalRec，并构建了包含5000余条记录的数据集MedicalRec-Bench，在多种特征设置下最高HitRate@100达到75.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习在医疗领域广泛应用，但选择合适模型常需试错，消耗大量计算资源和能源。现有研究缺乏系统性的模型推荐方法，导致资源浪费和碳排放问题。

Method: 从3000篇医学图像分类论文中收集数据构建MedicalRec-Bench数据集（含5000+记录，覆盖皮肤癌、肿瘤、伤口、乳腺癌、MRI等分类任务），设计四种不同特征数量的评估模式（MedicalRec I-IV，5-18个特征），采用Transformer架构构建推荐模型MedicalRec。

Result: MedicalRec在数据集评估及12个基模型对比中表现优异，最大HitRate@100达到75.5%。数据集和代码已开源。

Conclusion: 基于Transformer的推荐系统能有效为医学图像分类任务推荐合适模型，减少试错带来的能源浪费，同时数据集存在大量缺失值问题（因作者未报告）是未来可改进方向。

Abstract: The emergence of machine learning and deep learning has revolutionized the efficiency of diagnostic, therapeutic, and administrative systems in healthcare. However, this rapid adoption has come at the cost of requiring significant computing power and energy consumption, as well as e-waste disposal and carbon emissions. One of the challenges of these models is choosing the right model for classification tasks. To this end, researchers attempt to identify the optimal model using their data through trial and error, which involves energy consumption and waste. The goal of this study is to develop a model-based recommender system for medical image classification. For this purpose, a data set was collected from 3,000 articles in the field of medical image classification. This dataset, publicly available under the name MedicalRec-Bench, contains over 5,000 records of models tested in various tasks, including Skin Cancer Classification, Tumour Classification, Wound Classification, Breast Cancer, and MRI classification. The dataset was evaluated in four different modes, depending on the number of features: MedicalRec I (5 features), MedicalRec II (9 features), MedicalRec III (11 features), and MedicalRec IV (18 features). Collecting all values for the features is challenging due to non-reporting by the authors; hence, the dataset contains significant amounts of missing values. The Medical Recommender System (MedicalRec) is a transformer-based model used for item recommendations in this study. This model achieved remarkable results in the evaluation on the dataset and in the evaluation with 12 base models. This model achieved a maximum HitRate@100 of 75.5%. The dataset and implementations are available through the GitHub link: https://github.com/Ramin1Mousa/MedicalRec

</details>


### [360] [SPIN: Decentralized Swarm Control via Tensorized Policy Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07557)
*Zhaowen Fan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SPIN框架，通过将联合策略张量分解为矩阵乘积态（MPS）链，将多智能体 swarm 协调的计算复杂度从指数级 O(n^m) 降至线性级 O(m·n·χ²)，并结合离线预训练的神经编码器与Radon-Nikodým导数零样本重加权滤波器，实现低功耗边缘平台上的实时分布式协同控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化多智能体swarm在资源受限的边缘平台上运行时，面临联合动作空间指数级增长和高延迟通信开销两大根本性瓶颈，现有方法难以在计算可负担性和实时性之间取得平衡。

Method: 1) 将局部多智能体团的联合策略张量分解为MPS链，复杂度降至线性；2) 采用解耦的混合神经符号控制管线：离线预训练多层神经网络作为结构协调编码器，将手工几何描述符映射为环境目标度量；3) 运行时通过Radon-Nikodým导数作为零样本重要性重加权滤波器实现即时行为适应。

Result: 在离散时间多智能体仿真沙箱中，针对跟踪、分散覆盖和多目标协调等任务，验证了框架能够实现稳定的目标导向运动、抗坍塌的空间扩散以及结构化子群形成。

Conclusion: SPIN提供了一条数学上严谨的、实现低功耗边缘swarm智能的可计算路径，有效解决了边缘平台上多智能体协调的可扩展性问题。

Abstract: Decentralized multi-agent swarm coordination on resource-constrained edge platforms remains fundamentally bottlenecked by the exponential scaling of joint action spaces and high-latency communication overhead. This paper introduces the Swarm Policy Interference Network (SPIN) framework, an architectural paradigm that bypasses these limitations by modeling swarm topologies as a compressed tensor network. We factorize the joint policy tensors of local multi-agent cliques into Matrix Product State (MPS) chains, reducing the computational complexity of evaluation from an exponential $O(n^m)$ wall to a strictly linear $O(m \cdot n \cdot χ^2)$ constraint. To bridge local continuous spatial geometry with this discrete algebraic backend without requiring power-intensive online training loops, we introduce a decoupled, hybrid neuro-symbolic control pipeline. Local multi-layered neural networks operate as structural coordination encoders, pre-trained offline to nonlinearly map hand-engineered geometric descriptors into abstract environmental target measures. At runtime, edge agents execute instantaneous behavioral adaptations by applying the Radon-Nikodým derivative directly as a zero-shot importance-reweighting filter. We validate the framework within a discrete-time multi-agent simulation sandbox spanning tracking, decentralized dispersion/area coverage, and multi-goal coordination regimes. Qualitative telemetry demonstrates that the integrated pipeline achieves stable target-directed motion, anti-collapse spatial spreading under decentralized constraints, and structured subgroup formation across multiple targets, providing a mathematically grounded route to tractable, low-power edge swarm intelligence.

</details>


### [361] [Boundary Variance Inflation Causes Acquisition Bias in Gaussian Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07561)
*Maria Bånkestad,Sanna Jarl,Jens Sjölund*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了有界域上平稳高斯过程在边界处后验方差膨胀的根本原因——核相关邻域在边界处的截断，并展示了这种几何扭曲如何导致三种采集函数（方差最大化、负积分后验方差、期望预测信息增益）产生不同的边界偏好模式，最后提出了一种与目标函数无关的采集轮廓诊断方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有界域上平稳高斯过程的边界效应长期以来被认知（如地质统计学中的伪影、贝叶斯优化中的过度探索），但其根本成因和影响机制尚未被充分研究。

Method: 通过几何分析追溯边界效应的根源——核相关邻域在边界处的截断；在三种采集函数类别（方差最大化、负积分后验方差、期望预测信息增益）上展示该扭曲的表现；提出一种与目标函数无关的采集轮廓诊断方法。

Result: 边界核截断产生与观测无关的扭曲，且随维度增加而恶化；方差最大化将选择集中在角点，而负积分后验方差和期望预测信息增益将选择推向轴对齐的内部壳层；采集行为可能被核几何主导而非期望的任务特定不确定性。

Conclusion: 边界核截断是边界效应的根本机制，提出了一种无需目标函数的通用诊断工具用于任意采集函数、核函数和有界域几何。

Abstract: Gaussian processes with stationary kernels on bounded domains exhibit inflated posterior variance near the boundary. Despite being a long-recognized artifact in geostatistics and a source of over-exploration in Bayesian optimization, the causes and effects of boundary-induced acquisition bias are underexplored. We trace the root cause to a simple geometric mechanism: the truncation of the kernel correlation neighborhood at the domain boundary creates an observation-independent distortion that worsens with dimensionality. We show how this distortion manifests across three acquisition classes: variance maximization concentrates selections at the corners, whereas negative integrated posterior variance and expected predictive information gain move selections inward to axis-aligned interior shells. These patterns arise without reference to any objective function, meaning that acquisition behavior can be dominated by kernel geometry rather than the desired task-specific uncertainty. To quantify this, we introduce a function-free selection-profile diagnostic for arbitrary acquisitions, kernels, and bounded-domain geometries.

</details>


### [362] [Emergence via Phase Transitions: Mechanism Landscapes and Universal Convergence Across Complex Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07563)
*Truong Xuan Khanh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出层级涌现框架(HEF)，将涌现建模为机制景观中的相变过程，通过热力学和信息论约束证明其收敛到唯一不动点，并在111个模算术Transformer实验中发现"grokking"现象的实证指纹（权重范数峰值、tanh扭结曲线、收敛精度一致），验证了框架的可检验性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习、生物学和物理学中独立演化的系统常常趋同于相似的高层结构（如grokking电路、代谢解、重正化流固定点），但目前缺乏统一的数学框架来解释这种跨领域的收敛普适性现象。

Method: 提出层级涌现框架(HEF)，将涌现定义为受热力学和信息论约束的机制景观中的相变。引入临界能量阈值Ec区分探索机制与收敛机制。在结构假设下证明物理可行性、严格度量收缩和唯一不动点收敛。通过有效信息(Effective Information)和机制竞争熵将收敛结构与因果涌现关联。

Result: 在111个模算术Transformer实验中：92%的运行中权重范数在grokking前系统性达到峰值；归一化精度曲线坍缩为tanh扭结曲线(R²=0.93)，符合Landau-Ginzburg普适类；所有grokked模型收敛到0.9745±0.014，不受初始化、权重衰减或训练比例影响(ANOVA p>0.13)。

Conclusion: HEF不能作为涌现的普适理论，但可作为跨复杂系统收敛现象的可证伪数学框架。

Abstract: Across machine learning, biology, and physics, independently evolving systems often converge toward strikingly similar high-level structures despite radically different microscopic details. Grokking circuits converge across random seeds, evolutionary lineages rediscover similar metabolic solutions, and renormalization flows approach common fixed points. We propose the Hierarchical Emergence Framework (HEF) as a candidate universality framework for such convergence phenomena. HEF models emergence as a phase transition in a mechanism landscape constrained by thermodynamic and information-theoretic laws. The framework introduces a critical energy threshold Ec separating an exploration regime with competing mechanisms from a convergence regime governed by a unique minimum-cost mechanism. Under structural assumptions, we prove physical feasibility, derive strict metric contraction, and establish convergence toward a unique fixed-point representation independent of initial conditions. We further connect this convergence structure to causal emergence through Effective Information and mechanism competition entropy. To test the framework, we study delayed generalization ("grokking") in modular arithmetic transformers across 111 experiments. We identify a reproducible empirical fingerprint of the Ec transition: the weight norm peaks systematically before grokking in 92% of runs. Normalized accuracy curves collapse onto a tanh kink (R^2=0.93) consistent with a Landau-Ginzburg universality class, and all grokked models converge to 0.9745+/-0.014 regardless of initialization, weight decay, or training fraction (ANOVA p>0.13). HEF is not presented as a universal theory of emergence, but as a falsifiable mathematical scaffold for studying convergence phenomena across complex systems.

</details>


### [363] [Towards Graph Foundation Models for Dynamics in Complex Networked Systems: Lessons from Super-Spreader Identification in Multilayer Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08306)
*Michał Czuba,Mateusz Stolarski,Adam Piróg,Piotr Bielak,Piotr Bródka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出网络动力学（如传播、影响力最大化、流行病建模）需要从单网络归纳泛化到跨网络，并设计了四个属性目标。作为概念验证，ts-net在合成多层网络上训练后，能零样本泛化到真实多层网络，在四项指标中三项优于传统方法。最后指出了构建网络动力学图基础模型的五大挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有网络动力学研究局限于转导范式（在单个网络上训练，无法直接应用于未见过的网络），缺乏跨网络归纳泛化能力，而这恰是构建图基础模型（GFMs）的必要前提。

Method: 提出了四个设计属性以实现跨网络归纳泛化；作为概念验证，构建了ts-net（TopSpreadersNetwork），仅在合成多层网络上训练，在真实多层网络上进行零样本测试。

Result: ts-net在零样本泛化到不同规模和层数的真实多层网络时，在四项评估指标中有三项优于经典启发式算法和转导基线方法。

Conclusion: ts-net证明了跨网络归纳泛化的可行性，但距离真正的图基础模型仍有五大挑战：规模扩展、多层泛化、自监督预训练、跨任务迁移及节点属性融合。

Abstract: Network dynamics - including spreading, influence maximisation, and epidemic modelling - remain largely confined to the transductive paradigm, where models are trained on a single network and cannot be reused on unseen graphs without retraining. We argue that inductive cross-network generalisation is a necessary prerequisite for Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) in this domain and propose four design properties towards this goal. As a proof of concept, ts-net (TopSpreadersNetwork), trained solely on synthetic multilayer networks (MLNs), demonstrates zero-shot generalisation to real-world MLNs of varying size and layer count, outperforming classical heuristics and transductive baselines on three of four metrics. Based on ts-net's performance, we further outline five open challenges towards building GFMs for network dynamics: scale, many-layer generalisation, self-supervised pretraining, cross-task transfer, and node-attribute integration.

</details>


### [364] [STARIXNet: Multivariate and Multi-attribute Deep Learning Approach to Real-Time Resource Allocation in Cloud Platforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07565)
*Ahmed Abdulaal,Maruf Aytekin,Thilaga kumaran Srinivasan,Tomer Lancewicki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: STARIXNet是一种轻量级神经网络，通过多变量空间中的时空关系建模来智能缩放云平台微服务，在沃尔玛生产环境中实现了10%-50%的成本节省，并优先保障服务稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有微服务缩放方案局限于单变量空间（通常仅依赖CPU使用率），且仅作为纯预测任务处理，忽视低估风险与系统响应延迟问题；替代方案计算复杂，难以大规模实时部署。

Method: STARIXNet通过捕获多个系统指标间的时空关系，建模季节性(S)、时间性(T)、自回归综合(A)和外生(X)模式，实现多变量空间中的资源分配决策，并采用聚合策略优先保障服务稳定性，其次考虑成本效率。

Result: 在真实世界环境中，STARIXNet在沃尔玛关键生产微服务中实现10%至50%的可量化成本节省，以及通过改善服务稳定性和客户体验带来的无形收益。

Conclusion: STARIXNet证明了多变量时空建模在微服务智能缩放中的有效性，优于现有单变量预测方案，可在保证服务稳定性的前提下实现显著成本节约。

Abstract: Intelligent scaling of microservices in cloud platforms is crucial for mitigating escalating compute costs while avoiding service disruptions. Current solutions are limited to the univariate space, typically focusing on CPU usage alone to drive scaling decisions. Moreover, they address the problem as a purely forecasting task, focusing on prediction precision while neglecting the greater risks of underestimation and delays in system responsiveness. Alternative solutions are computationally complex, making them impractical for large-scale, real-time deployments. To address these challenges, we present STARIXNet, a lightweight neural network that guides resource allocation decisions in the multivariate space by capturing spatio-temporal relationships among multiple system metrics. STARIXNet models multiple quasi-dependent attributes, in particular the (S)easonal, (T)emporal, (A)uto-(R)egressive (I)ntegrated, and e(X)ogenous patterns, then implements an aggregation policy to finalize scaling decisions, prioritizing service stability, followed by cost-efficiency, over raw forecast accuracy. We empirically demonstrate the performance of STARIXNet by benchmarking against existing solutions in real-world settings. STARIXNet is deployed for critical production microservices at Walmart achieving tangible savings ranging from 10\% to 50\%, in addition to intangible benefits through improved service stability and customer experience.

</details>


### [365] [TriHead-GAN: A Generative Adversarial Network with Triple-Head Discriminator for Carbon Emission Time Series Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07569)
*Zesen Wang,Lijuan Lan,Yonggang Li,Chunhua Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TriHead-GAN提出了一种基于Transformer的三头判别器对抗框架，通过联合监督分布真实性、跨变量依赖性和步态时间平滑性，有效生成高质量的城市级碳排放时序数据，并在多个数据集上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市级高频碳排放监测数据极度稀缺，限制了深度学习模型的应用。现有生成模型（GAN、扩散模型）在保留碳排放数据的领域结构（如跨变量相关性和一阶差分统计特性）方面表现不足。

Method: 提出TriHead-GAN框架，包含Transformer生成器（全局自注意力+局部时序卷积+逐步噪声注入+抗平滑损失）和三头判别器：Wasserstein评论家监督分布真实性、无泄漏回归监督跨变量依赖性、相邻差分预测监督步态时间平滑性。

Result: 在自收集的长沙碳排放数据集、两个公开碳排放数据集（中国、美国）以及ETTh1基准上，TriHead-GAN在绝大多数设置下优于主流基线方法，且生成的合成窗口能够提升低资源碳排放监测场景下的下游预测精度。

Conclusion: TriHead-GAN通过多维度联合监督有效解决了碳排放时序生成中分布匹配与结构保真之间的权衡问题，为碳监测数据稀缺场景提供了可行的数据增强方案。

Abstract: Accurate carbon emission monitoring is critical for climate policy and emerging regulatory mechanisms such as the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism, yet city-level high-frequency monitoring data remain extremely scarce, severely limiting data-hungry deep learning models. Time series generation is a natural remedy, but existing GAN and diffusion-based generators often provide limited explicit supervision for the domain structure of carbon emission data: they may match marginal distributional statistics while insufficiently preserving cross-variable correlations between CO$_2$ and co-emitted pollutants and meteorological factors, and tend to collapse the first-difference statistics of atmospheric measurements, producing sequences that are smooth on average but lack the realistic step-wise variability of the underlying signals. We propose TriHead-GAN, a Transformer-based adversarial framework whose triple-head discriminator jointly supervises three complementary aspects of the joint distribution: distributional authenticity via a Wasserstein critic, cross-variable dependency via leakage-free regression of the target variable, and step-wise temporal smoothness via adjacent-difference prediction. The generator combines global self-attention with local temporal convolution, per-step noise injection, and an anti-smoothing loss that matches first-difference statistics. Experiments on the self-collected Changsha Carbon dataset, two public carbon datasets (China, US), and the ETTh1 benchmark show that TriHead-GAN achieves favorable performance over mainstream baselines on the vast majority of settings, and that the resulting synthetic windows improve downstream forecasting accuracy in low-resource carbon monitoring scenarios.

</details>


### [366] [Enabling KV Caching of Shared Prefix for Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07571)
*Younghun Go,Jaehoon Han,Changyong Shin,Chuk Yoo,Gyeongsik Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对扩散语言模型（DLM）中双向注意力导致传统KV缓存失效的问题，本文提出双向前缀缓存（BiCache），通过动态识别安全层深度复用共享前缀KV，在保持模型精度（仅0-1.8%差异）的同时提升服务吞吐量36.3%-98.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM的KV缓存技术假设KV一旦计算即保持不变，但DLM的双向注意力机制下更新任意token会动态改变整个上下文及其对应KV，直接应用现有缓存技术会导致模型精度近乎崩溃（接近零），亟需专为DLM设计的共享前缀KV缓存方案。

Method: BiCache基于关键观察设计：共享前缀KV在浅层保持稳定可复用，而浅层层数取决于每个请求中共享前缀token的比例。该方法动态识别安全层深度，在该深度以下复用共享前缀KV，消除冗余计算。

Result: 与现有技术相比，BiCache将服务吞吐量提升36.3%-98.3%，且无精度崩溃（精度差异仅为0-1.8%）。

Conclusion: BiCache是首个面向DLM共享前缀的KV缓存技术，通过动态层深度识别有效解决了双向注意力带来的缓存失效问题，实现了高性能DLM服务。

Abstract: Key-value (KV) caching for shared prefixes is essential for high-throughput large language model (LLM) serving, but it faces critical challenges in emerging diffusion language models (DLMs). In DLMs, bidirectional attention means that updating any token dynamically alters the entire context and its corresponding KVs. Thus, existing caching techniques developed for LLMs, which assume that KVs remain invariant once computed, corrupt the shared prefix KVs. Our experiments show that applying these techniques to DLMs causes model accuracy to collapse to near zero.
  To unlock high-throughput DLM serving, we propose bidirectional prefix caching, bicache, the first KV caching technique for shared prefixes in DLMs. bicache is designed based on key observations from our comprehensive analysis: shared prefix KVs remain stable and reusable in shallow layers, while the depth of shallow layers depends on the fraction of shared prefix tokens in each request. Thus, bicache dynamically identifies a safe layer depth for reusing shared prefix KVs and eliminates redundant computation. Evaluations demonstrate that bicache significantly improves serving throughput by 36.3%-98.3% compared to existing techniques without accuracy collapse (only 0-1.8% difference).

</details>


### [367] [When Should an AI Scientist Stop? Verifiable Experiment Steering and Refusal for Autonomous Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07576)
*Neel Tushar Shah,Manglam Kartik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CARTOGRAPH是一个面向AI科学家的验证层，通过未解析子空间实验引导（select）、显式模糊性闭合（resolve）和基于残差的库不充分性检测（refuse）三个机制，实现对科学实验设计的验证与可靠性评估。在多个测试平台上，CARTOGRAPH-A在性能上显著优于原始投影方法，并能有效识别库外机制和标记不可靠的结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI科学家系统中，实验设计缺乏对未解析子空间和模糊性的显式处理，且无法有效检测模型库不充分性导致的不可靠结论，亟需一个统一的验证层来提升AI驱动科学发现的可靠性。

Method: 提出CARTOGRAPH验证层，包含三个核心模块：1) select：基于未解析子空间的实验引导（未解析Fisher信息量迹）；2) resolve：显式模糊性闭合（CA-RTOGRAPH-A为精确未解析A-最优规则）；3) refuse：基于残差的库不充分性检测。在局部线性-高斯桥接假设下推导了闭式EIG和Box-Hill作为局部比较器。

Result: 1）在5个测试平台上，d=8时CARTOGRAPH-A以129W/0T/15L显著优于原始投影（p<10^-21）；2）框架初步识别出3个库外药代动力学机制，随后因残差暴露结构失配而撤销识别，而1个扰动的库内对照始终保持识别；3）低维药代动力学和过滤EPA设置中，观察到与理论预测一致的近平局；4）在A-Lab自主材料系统40个正向声明的回顾审计中，拒绝守卫标记了人工再分析后判定为不确定的全部4个声明，同时通过了32/36个确认声明。

Conclusion: CARTOGRAPH为AI科学家提供了有效的验证层，能够在实验设计中主动处理模糊性、检测模型库不充分性，并显著提升AI驱动科学发现的可靠性和可审计性。

Abstract: We present CARTOGRAPH, a verification layer for AI scientists that couples unresolved-subspace experiment steering (select), explicit ambiguity closure (resolve), and residual-based library inadequacy detection (refuse). Under a local linear-Gaussian bridge, raw unresolved projection is the isotropic unresolved Fisher-information trace, while CARTOGRAPH-A is the exact unresolved A-optimal rule; closed-form EIG and Box-Hill arise as local comparators rather than global equivalents. Across five testbeds, CARTOGRAPH-A beats raw projection 129W/0T/15L at d = 8 (p < 10^-21) in a replicated structured cascade. More distinctively, the framework tentatively identifies three out-of-library pharmacokinetic mechanisms and then revokes those identifications as residuals expose structural misfit, while one perturbed in-library control stays identified throughout. In low-dimensional pharmacokinetic and filtered EPA settings, near-ties against disagreement are predicted by theory and observed. Finally, in a retrospective audit of 40 positive claims from the published A-Lab autonomous materials system, the refuse guard flags all 4 claims later marked inconclusive under manual reanalysis while passing 32/36 confirmed claims. Code is available at https://github.com/ai4science-boed/cartograph.git

</details>


### [368] [MST-Direct at Scale: Multivariate and Conditional Geostatistical Simulation via Sinkhorn Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07578)
*Tcharlies Bachmann Schmitz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文扩展了基于Sinkhorn最优传输的MST-Direct方法，从原始双变量、无条件、小网格设置推广到多变量、条件化、大网格场景，通过稀疏候选限制Sinkhorn匹配器、多变量元组匹配和克里金条件化解决了可扩展性、多变量扩展和硬数据约束三大问题，在六变量异方差非线性参考分布上验证了零直方图误差、精确硬数据忠实和准确空间相关性再现，优于PPMT方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 克服原始MST-Direct方法在双变量、无条件、小网格设置上的三大局限性：大规模网格的可扩展性、多变量扩展能力、硬数据条件化处理。

Method: 提出稀疏候选限制Sinkhorn匹配器（O(nC)内存复杂度），通过匹配目标值元组到独立FFT-MA高斯骨干上，利用克里金方法条件化骨干以固定观测数据元组，保持传输计划为目标元组的排列以精确保留多元联合分布。

Result: 在六变量异方差强非线性参考分布上，无条件（200x200）和条件化（100x100，200硬数据样本）场景下，MST-Direct实现零直方图误差、精确忠实硬数据、准确再现指定空间相关结构，而PPMT仅为近似。

Conclusion: MST-Direct成功扩展至多变量、条件化、大规模网格场景，在联合分布保持、硬数据忠实性和空间相关性再现方面均达到精确匹配，显著优于近似方法PPMT。

Abstract: This paper extends MST-Direct, a Matching-via-Sinkhorn-Transport approach for multivariate geostatistical simulation, from the original bivariate, unconditional, small-grid formulation to multivariate, conditional, and large-grid settings. We address the three main limitations identified in the original work: (i) scalability beyond a few thousand nodes through a sparse, candidate-restricted Sinkhorn matcher with O(nC) memory complexity; (ii) extension to multiple variables by matching target value tuples onto an independent FFT-MA Gaussian backbone that reproduces a prescribed variogram; and (iii) hard-data conditioning by fixing observed data tuples at their spatial locations while conditioning the backbone through kriging. Because the transport plan remains a permutation of the target tuples, the multivariate joint distribution is preserved exactly.
  The method is validated using the same six-variate, heteroscedastic, strongly nonlinear reference distribution employed in Direct Multivariate Simulation (DMS), under both unconditional (200x200) and conditional (100x100, 200 hard-data samples) scenarios, and is benchmarked against the Projection Pursuit Multivariate Transform (PPMT). Results show that MST-Direct reproduces the joint distribution with zero histogram error, exactly honours hard data, and accurately reproduces the prescribed spatial correlation structure, whereas PPMT remains an approximation.
  Index Terms-Optimal transport, Sinkhorn algorithm, geostatistical simulation, multivariate simulation.

</details>


### [369] [Training-Inference Kernel Contracts: Bounding Divergence in Post-Training and Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07581)
*Bruce Changlong Xu,Lan Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"核契约"(kernel contracts)框架，用于规范训练核与推理核之间因数值精度差异导致的策略分布偏差，并给出了从logit漂移到策略梯度偏差的理论界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代后训练管线中，同一策略权重在训练核(优化自动梯度)和推理核(优化低精度、融合、动态批处理)上运行时会因有限精度产生不同分布，且偏差集中在基准测试未充分覆盖的切片上，缺乏统一的偏差容忍度规范框架。

Method: 提出契约C=(N,S,R,O,Pi)框架，包含数值、统计、运行时和可观测性子句以及违规升级策略；推导了从logit漂移到总变差距离再到有界奖励漂移的界链，并针对RL后训练场景给出了基于per-token重要性比率漂移的策略梯度偏差上界。

Result: 建立了从底层数值偏差到上层策略梯度偏差的理论链式界，设计了四阶段推广管线、在线路由循环和YAML DSL契约工件，但本文为框架与词汇论文，未报告生产级实证验证。

Conclusion: 核契约为训练-推理数值一致性提供了形式化规范框架，为未来在RL后训练等场景中系统化管理核间偏差奠定了基础。

Abstract: A modern post-training pipeline often writes one symbol for its policy, pi_theta, while evaluating it through two different programs: a training kernel optimized for autograd and an inference kernel optimized for low-precision, fused, dynamically batched serving. In finite precision, these kernels can induce different distributions at identical weights, with the gap concentrated on slices that aggregate benchmarks under-represent. This paper proposes kernel contracts: a contract-first framework for specifying acceptable divergence between K_train and K_inf. A contract C = (N, S, R, O, Pi) combines numerical, statistical, runtime, and observability clauses with an escalation policy from violations to routing actions. We derive a chain of bounds from logit drift to total-variation distance to bounded reward drift, and specialize it to RL post-training, where per-token importance-ratio drift yields a bound on policy-gradient bias under explicit support and norm assumptions. We also describe a four-stage promotion pipeline, online routing loop, and minimal YAML DSL for contract artifacts. This is a framework and vocabulary paper; we do not report production-scale empirical validation.

</details>


### [370] [Customer Churn Prediction on Structured Data Using FT-Transformer and Stacking Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07582)
*Joyjit Roy,Samaresh Kumar Singh,Laxmi Shaw*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种融合FT-Transformer与XGBoost的校准感知堆叠混合架构，用于客户流失预测。在公开银行流失数据集上，该混合模型在5x5交叉验证下达到62.10% F1、0.861 AUC-ROC和0.647 PR-AUC，优于MLP基线，并通过消融实验验证了Transformer组件和堆叠策略的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化数据集上的客户流失预测面临类别不平衡、非线性特征交互和异构特征类型等挑战。现有研究在统计验证、概率校准和可重复性方面存在不足，需要一种可复现且可扩展的参考架构。

Method: 提出混合架构：FT-Transformer利用自注意力机制捕获高阶特征交互，XGBoost捕获梯度提升决策边界。采用类别加权损失函数处理类别不平衡，避免合成过采样。通过基于逻辑回归元学习器的袋外(OOF)堆叠进行集成，校准过自信的基模型输出并学习最优组合权重。

Result: 在公开银行流失数据集上，5x5交叉验证下混合模型达到62.10% F1、0.861 AUC-ROC和0.647 PR-AUC，较MLP基线提升3.37 F1点和0.027 AUC。同时报告了95%置信区间。消融实验证实Transformer组件和堆叠策略均有实质性贡献。

Conclusion: 提出的校准感知堆叠混合架构为结构化表格数据上的流失预测提供了可复现且可扩展的参考方案，有效解决了统计验证和概率校准方面的不足。

Abstract: Customer churn prediction is essential across data-driven industries such as insurance, digital banking, eCommerce, and subscription platforms, where retaining existing customers is typically more cost-effective than acquiring new ones. Predicting churn on structured datasets remains challenging due to class imbalance, nonlinear feature interactions, and heterogeneous feature types. Tree-based ensemble methods consistently demonstrate strong performance in these contexts, often outperforming conventional neural networks. This study introduces a validated hybrid architecture that integrates feature-tokenized transformers (FT-Transformer) with gradient-boosted trees through calibration-aware stacking. The proposed framework addresses persistent gaps in statistical validation, probability calibration, and reproducibility found in prior research. The FT-Transformer captures higher-order feature interactions using self-attention, while XGBoost captures gradient-boosted decision boundaries with complementary inductive biases. Class imbalance is handled using class-weighted loss functions, thereby avoiding synthetic oversampling and preserving minority-class distributions. The models are ensembled using out-of-fold (OOF) stacking with a logistic regression meta-learner, which recalibrates overconfident base model outputs and learns optimal combination weights. On a public bank churn dataset, the hybrid model achieves 62.10% F1, 0.861 AUC-ROC, and 0.647 PR-AUC, outperforming the Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) baseline by 3.37 F1 points and 0.027 AUC under 5x5 cross-validation with 95% confidence intervals reported. Ablation studies demonstrate that both the transformer component and stacking strategy contribute materially to performance. The proposed methodology offers a reproducible and extensible reference architecture for contemporary churn prediction on structured tabular data.

</details>


### [371] [Outage Detection in Self-Healing Smart Grids Using Reinforcement Learning with Spectral Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07583)
*Lihui Liu,Mucun Sun,Caisheng Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于谱图强化学习的配电网自愈框架，利用谱图神经网络学习最优供电恢复策略，在三个IEEE测试系统上实现了接近最优的实时性能和良好的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统机器学习方法响应慢、计算成本高，且现有基于GNN的方法在空间域操作，无法捕获电力网络中频域的重要全局结构模式和系统级交互关系。

Method: 提出谱图强化学习框架，使用谱图神经网络（Spectral GNN）建模控制策略，学习最优供电恢复策略。

Result: 在IEEE 13-bus、34-bus和123-bus三个改进测试系统上进行评估，达到接近最优的实时性能，并在多种故障场景下具有良好的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 频域信息对电力网络的全局结构建模至关重要，谱图强化学习能有效提升配电网故障管理的实时性和韧性。

Abstract: Self-healing smart grids can quickly adjust their network configuration during outages to minimize power disruptions. During an outage, several actions can be taken, such as network reconfiguration through switching operations and emergency load shedding. However, traditional machine learning methods for outage mitigation are not well suited for smart grids due to their slow response time and high computational cost. To address these challenges, recent studies have explored reinforcement learning to automatically perform network reconfiguration. In these approaches, the control policy is typically modeled using a graph neural network (GNN). However, conventional GNNs operate in the spatial domain and may fail to capture important relationships in the frequency domain. Frequency-domain information is particularly useful for modeling global structural patterns and system-wide interactions in power networks. In this paper, we propose a spectral graph reinforcement learning framework for outage management in distribution networks to enhance system resilience. Our model learns the optimal power restoration policy using a spectral graph neural network. We evaluate the proposed method on three modified IEEE test systems: the 13-bus, 34-bus, and 123-bus networks. Experimental results show that our approach achieves near-optimal performance in real time and generalizes well across a wide range of outage scenarios.

</details>


### [372] [From Human Guidance to Autonomy: Agent Skill System for End-to-End LLM Deployment on Spatial NPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07586)
*Jiajie Li,Erwei Wang,Zhiru Zhang,Samuel Bayliss*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种两阶段方法论，在AMD XDNA 2 NPU上实现了从人工引导到智能体自主的端到端LLM部署。第一阶段人工引导下部署Llama-3.2-1B，相比手工优化基线实现2.2倍预填充加速和4.0倍解码加速；第二阶段将经验蒸馏为包含八个阶段、强制数值正确性的智能体技能系统，自主部署了8个额外的仅解码器LLM（0.5-4小时/个，几乎无需人工干预），且3个模型的持续性能达到或超过参考部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要集中在单核优化而非在资源受限的空间NPU上进行端到端LLM部署，且缺乏自动化方法。作者希望降低在空间NPU上部署LLM的劳动密集度，实现从人工驱动到智能体自主的转变。

Method: 两阶段方法论：第一阶段，通过人工引导的智能体辅助开发Llama-3.2-1B的参考部署，记录优化轨迹；第二阶段，将文档蒸馏为智能体技能系统（8个阶段），编排优化和调试技能集，每阶段强制数值正确性，然后自主部署其他LLM。

Result: 第一阶段：Llama-3.2-1B实现预填充2.2倍、解码4.0倍加速。第二阶段：8个LLM（0.5B-4B参数）在0.5-4小时内自主部署完成，均通过数值正确性门控，其中3个模型性能达到或超过参考部署水平。这些模型此前从未通过开源软件栈部署在AMD NPU上。

Conclusion: 本文证明了两阶段方法论能够有效实现从人工引导到智能体自主的LLM部署迁移，所提出的智能体技能系统具有良好的功能泛化能力，能够自主部署未见过的LLM并达到有竞争力的性能，显著降低了空间NPU上端到端LLM部署的人工成本。

Abstract: Spatial neural processing units (NPUs) provide an energy-efficient platform for edge LLM inference, but efficiently deploying an LLM end-to-end on such hardware remains labor-intensive. Although AI coding agents have begun to lower this cost, existing studies have largely focused on single-kernel optimization rather than end-to-end LLM deployment on resource-constrained spatial NPUs.
  We present a two-stage methodology, instantiated on the AMD XDNA 2 NPU, that progresses from human-guided development to agent autonomy. In the first stage, we develop a reference deployment of Llama-3.2-1B through human-guided agent assistance. The resulting implementation achieves a speedup of 2.2x on prefill and 4.0x on decode over the hand-optimized baseline, with the optimization trajectory and its lessons recorded as structured documentation throughout. In the second stage, we distill the documentation into an agent skill system consisting of eight phases, orchestrating the optimization and debugging skill sets, with numerical correctness strictly enforced at each phase.
  Using our agent skill system, we autonomously deploy eight additional decoder-only LLMs (Llama-3.2-3B, SmolLM2-1.7B, Qwen2.5-{0.5B, 1.5B, 3B}, Qwen3-{0.6B, 1.7B, 4B}) end-to-end on the AMD XDNA 2 NPU using the open-source compiler stack. To our knowledge, these models have not previously been deployed on AMD NPUs via any open-source software stack. Each deployment completes in 0.5-4 hours of agent wall time with almost no human guidance, and passes the numerical-correctness gates, demonstrating functional generalization to previously unencountered LLMs. Three of the eight match or exceed the sustained performance of our Llama-3.2-1B reference deployment, suggesting that the resulting implementations can be competitive without additional model-specific human engineering.

</details>


### [373] [The Routing Plateau: Understanding and Breaking the Accuracy Limits of LLM Routers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07587)
*Yifan Lu,Qiyue Zhang,Shenrun Zhang,Zhibo Yu,Zhuang Wang,Hanjie Chen,Jiarong Xing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过系统性研究21种路由方法在5个基准测试上的表现，发现了一个被称为"路由高原"的普遍现象：包括kNN在内的许多方法准确率非常接近，收敛到狭窄的性能范围，远低于oracle路由器的上限。研究表明这一高原主要由可预测性瓶颈导致——当前路由器主要学习全局平均模型性能趋势而非细粒度的查询特定路由信号。突破高原需要更大的训练数据集、更强的编码器和端到端微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM路由已成为一种通过为每个查询动态选择模型来改进成本-质量权衡的流行方法，但其性能极限和限制因素尚不明确，需要系统性研究来理解当前路由方法的共同局限并提供改进方向。

Method: 对21种路由方法（包括基于聚类的路由器、学习分类器、成对排名和基于置信度的方法）在5个基准测试上进行广泛研究，分析其性能表现和收敛模式，并进一步探索突破性能高原的策略（更大训练数据集、更强编码器、端到端微调）。

Result: 发现了"路由高原"现象：多种方法（包括kNN）性能非常接近，收敛到远低于oracle路由器的狭窄性能范围。该高原主要由可预测性瓶颈引起——路由器学习的是全局平均模型性能趋势而非细粒度查询特定信号，导致能解决重叠的简单查询但共同在需要实例级路由决策的困难查询上失败。

Conclusion: 当前路由方法存在共同限制，突破路由高原需要更大的训练数据集、更强的编码器和端到端微调。这些发现为构建更有效的路由系统提供了见解和可行方向。

Abstract: LLM routing has become a popular approach to improve the cost-quality trade-off of LLM services by dynamically selecting a model for each query. Recent work has explored a broad range of routing methods, including clustering-based routers, learned classifiers, pairwise ranking, and confidence-based approaches. Our extensive study of 21 routing methods across five benchmarks reveals a consistent phenomenon that we call the routing plateau: many methods, including kNN, achieve very similar accuracy and converge to a narrow performance range that remains far below the oracle router. Our investigation shows that the plateau is largely caused by a predictability bottleneck: current routers mainly learn global averaged model-performance trends rather than fine-grained query-specific routing signals. As a result, they solve overlapping easy queries but collectively fail on hard queries that require instance-specific routing decisions. We further study how to move beyond the plateau and find that larger training datasets, stronger encoders, and end-to-end fine-tuning can further improve routing accuracy. These findings characterize the common limits of current routing methods and provide insights and actionable directions for the community to build more effective routing systems.

</details>


### [374] [Optimality of Sequential Filtering Under Independent Cost and Selectivity Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07589)
*Hrishikesh Paranjape,Abhishek Mandal,Xian Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文形式化了序列过滤问题，证明在独立模型下按成本/拒绝概率升序排列过滤器可最小化期望总成本，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟证明了该最优排序策略在期望和全分布上均优于常见启发式方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 序列过滤管道是大规模系统中的常见设计模式，但过滤器排序通常依赖缺乏形式化保证的启发式方法，需要理论上的最优排序策略。

Method: 形式化定义序列过滤的期望成本目标，在独立性假设下推导最优排序条件（成本/拒绝概率升序），并通过蒙特卡洛模拟进行验证。

Result: 最优排序（按成本/拒绝概率升序）在期望值和全分布上均严格优于常见启发式方法。

Conclusion: 为序列过滤问题提供了有理论保证的最优排序策略，可应用于排名系统、级联推理、欺诈检测等场景。

Abstract: Sequential filtering pipelines are a common design pattern in large-scale systems, where a large population of items is progressively reduced by a sequence of stages that each incur cost. Despite their prevalence in ranking systems, cascaded machine learning inference, and fraud detection, filter ordering is often determined by heuristics without formal guarantees. We formalize sequential filtering under an expected-cost objective and prove that, under an independence model, ordering filters by increasing ratio of cost to rejection probability minimizes expected total cost. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations show that the optimal ordering strictly dominates common heuristics across all runs, both in expectation and across the full distribution of outcomes.

</details>


### [375] [ResearchClawBench: A Benchmark for End-to-End Autonomous Scientific Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07591)
*Wanghan Xu,Shuo Li,Tianlin Ye,Qinglong Cao,Yixin Chen,Hengjian Gao,Yiheng Wang,Qi Li,Kun Li,Sheng Xu,Shengdu Chai,Fangchen Yu,Xiangyu Zhao,Zhangrui Zhao,Weijie Ma,Zijie Guo,Haoyu Zhou,Haoxiang Yin,Lixue Cheng,Chaofan Hu,Haoxuan Li,Lu Mi,Xuxuan Xie,Yifan Zhou,Ruizhe Chen,Zhiwang Zhou,Xingjian Guo,Yuhao Zhou,Xuming He,Shengyuan Xu,Xinyu Gu,Jiamin Wu,Mianxin Liu,Chunfeng Song,Fenghua Ling,Dongzhan Zhou,Shixiang Tang,Yuqiang Li,Mao Su,Peng Ye,Siqi Sun,Bin Wang,Xue Yang,Zhenfei Yin,Tianfan Fu,Guangtao Zhai,Wanli Ouyang,Bo Zhang,Lei Bai,Wenlong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ResearchClawBench是一个包含40个跨领域科学任务的基准测试，用于评估AI智能体自主科研能力。最强自主智能体Claude Code平均得分21.5，最强LLM为26.5，当前系统距离可靠的科学发现仍有较大差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI编码智能体越来越多地用于科学工作，但其端到端自主研究能力难以验证，缺乏标准化的评估基准。

Method: 构建40个源自真实发表论文的跨学科任务，提供相关文献和原始数据，隐藏目标论文。专家设计多模态评分标准，将目标科学成果分解为加权标准进行评估。采用统一协议评估7个自主研究智能体，并通过ResearchHarness评估17个原生LLM。

Result: 最强自主智能体Claude Code平均得分21.5，最强LLM Claude-Opus-4.7平均得分20.7，LLM前沿均值仅26.5。错误集中在实验协议不匹配、证据不匹配和缺失科学核心。

Conclusion: ResearchClawBench为衡量自主科学研究的进展提供了可复现的评估基准，当前系统远未达到可靠的再发现水平。

Abstract: AI coding agents are increasingly used for scientific work, but their end-to-end autonomous research capability remains difficult to verify. We present ResearchClawBench, a benchmark for evaluating autonomous scientific research across 40 tasks from 10 scientific domains. Each task is grounded in a real published paper, provides related literature and raw data, and hides the target paper during evaluation. Expert-curated multimodal rubrics decompose the target scientific artifacts into weighted criteria, enabling evaluation of target-paper-level re-discovery while leaving room for new discovery. We evaluate seven autonomous research (auto-research) agents under a unified protocol and seventeen native LLMs through the lightweight ResearchHarness. Current systems remain far from reliable re-discovery: the strongest autonomous agent, Claude Code, averages 21.5, and the strongest ResearchHarness LLM, Claude-Opus-4.7, averages 20.7, with an LLM frontier mean of only 26.5. Error analysis shows that failures concentrate in experimental protocol mismatch, evidence mismatch, and missing scientific core. ResearchClawBench provides a reproducible evaluation frontier for measuring progress toward autonomous scientific research.

</details>


### [376] [UNIQ: Conformal Calibration for Adaptive Conservatism in Offline Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07592)
*Aditya Upadhyay*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: UNIQ是一种基于不确定性感知分位数的离线强化学习方法，通过融合共形预测的不确定性估计实现状态自适应的保守性调节，在保持接近IQL的低内存开销（~250MB，较EDAC降低约10倍）的同时，在D4RL MuJoCo基准上持续提升IQL性能，尤其擅长Walker2d和replay-heavy任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有离线强化学习方法对所有状态施加统一保守性惩罚，忽略了局部数据覆盖程度的差异，导致在数据充足的区域过度保守或在数据稀疏区域保守性不足。

Method: 基于Implicit Q-Learning (IQL)框架，训练多分位点值集成；利用分割共形预测计算无分布假设的不确定性估计；将不确定性信号映射为状态依赖的分位点，在数据覆盖好的区域放松保守性，在数据边界附近的不确定区域加强保守性。

Result: 在D4RL MuJoCo基准上持续超越IQL，Walker2d和replay-heavy任务提升最大；峰值VRAM约250MB，相比EDAC降低约10倍。

Conclusion: UNIQ作为一种实用的机制贡献，通过状态自适应的保守性策略改善了离线强化学习中性能与效率的权衡，而非追求全面最优的绝对性能。

Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning requires careful conservatism to mitigate distribution shift, yet most existing methods apply a fixed penalty uniformly across all states regardless of local data coverage. We present UNIQ (Uncertainty-Informed Quantile), an offline RL method that introduces state-adaptive conservatism through conformally calibrated uncertainty estimation. Built on the Implicit Q-Learning (IQL) backbone, UNIQ trains a multi-expectile value ensemble, computes distribution-free uncertainty estimates using split conformal prediction, and maps the resulting signal to a state-dependent expectile that relaxes conservatism in well-covered regions while strengthening it in uncertain regions near the data frontier. On D4RL MuJoCo benchmarks, UNIQ consistently improves over IQL, with the largest gains observed on Walker2d and replay-heavy tasks. At the same time, UNIQ operates at near-IQL memory cost (approximately 250 MB peak VRAM), providing roughly a 10x reduction compared to EDAC. Rather than pursuing overall state-of-the-art performance, we position UNIQ as a practical mechanism contribution that improves the performance-efficiency trade-off in offline reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [377] [Shortcuts in the Tail: Debiasing via Post-Hoc Spectral Compression of Fine-Tuning Updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07596)
*Edward Sun,Dmitrii Troitskii*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种简单的后处理干预方法——截断ΔW (微调权重与基础权重的差值) 的SVD尾部奇异值，无需重训练、组标签或反事实数据，即可减少微调模型对虚假相关性的依赖。实验表明，该方法在多个指令微调模型和分类基准上显著降低虚假相关组间差距，且精度损失极小（<2pp）。作者认为该方法的有效性源于虚假相关响应集中在ΔW的奇异值尾部。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微调常引入虚假相关性，导致模型在代表性不足的群体上系统性失败。现有缓解方法需要重训练、组标签或精心构建的反事实数据，成本高昂且不实用。

Method: 对微调权重与基础权重的差值 ΔW = W_ft - W_base 进行SVD分解，截断其尾部奇异值（即top-k截断），仅保留前k个最大奇异值对应的分量。

Result: 在三个指令微调模型（0.5B-7B）和四个分类基准上，top-k截断在所有单元上均降低了虚假相关组间差距，精度损失小于2个百分点，在CivilComments数据集上组间差距最多降低5倍。对比实验（bottom-k、random-k截断以及匹配秩的LoRA）排除了低秩近似或秩约束训练作为解释的可能性。

Conclusion: ΔW的奇异基是研究微调学习内容的有效坐标系；虚假相关响应倾向于集中在ΔW的奇异值尾部，而非头部主成分，这一行为特性而非原始奇异值的分布是截断有效的关键。

Abstract: Fine-tuning often introduces spurious correlations alongside task knowledge, causing systematic failures on underrepresented groups. Existing mitigations require retraining, group labels, or curated counterfactual data. We show a simple post-hoc intervention reduces shortcut reliance without any of these: truncating the tail of the SVD of $ΔW = W_\mathrm{ft} - W_\mathrm{base}$ reduces the spurious-group gap while preserving task accuracy. Across three instruction-tuned models ($0.5$B--$7$B) and four classification benchmarks, top-$k$ truncation reduces the gap on every cell at $<2$ pp accuracy loss, by up to $5\times$ on CivilComments. We propose this works because the shortcut response sits in the tail of the singular ordering of $ΔW$, a claim about how truncation behaves rather than about the raw singular values, which are broadly distributed and look the same across all four datasets. A controlled boundary case in which fine-tuning has only a shortcut to learn shows the predicted FT-to-base collapse, and bottom-/random-$k$ and matched-rank LoRA controls rule out generic low-rank approximation and rank-constrained training as the explanation. We read this as preliminary evidence that the singular basis of $ΔW$ is a useful coordinate system for studying what fine-tuning has learned.

</details>


### [378] [Repetition Mismatch: Why Data Mixture Experiments Don't Scale and How to Fix Them](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07597)
*Kevin Zhou,Lisa Alazraki,Kris Cao,Marek Rei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了预训练数据混合优化中高重复率导致小规模实验外推失败的根本原因——重复率失配，并提出了一种通过子采样匹配目标重复率的控制方法，仅需少量token即可准确估计最优混合比例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高质量数据稀缺需重复使用时，小规模实验外推到目标训练预算常失败，但失败根源未被分离。

Method: 通过子采样程序匹配目标重复率来控制重复率效应，在二源和三源数据设置下进行重复控制实验。

Result: 二源场景下单次重复控制实验（1/16目标token）误差0.05，无控制误差0.75；三源场景下两次重复控制实验即可恢复最优混合。

Conclusion: 重复动力学而非规模单独决定了小规模混合实验的可推广性，数据重复应作为混合优化的第一类变量对待。

Abstract: Pre-training data mixtures are commonly tuned by running small-scale experiments and extrapolating to the target training budget. When high-quality data is scarce and must be repeated, this extrapolation frequently fails, but the source of the failure has not been isolated. We show that a primary culprit is a repetition mismatch: because high-quality datasets are small, their repetition rate changes as the training budget grows, shifting the optimal mixture in ways that small-scale proxy experiments do not anticipate. A subsampling procedure that matches the target repetition rate controls for this effect. In a two-source setting combining limited high-quality data with web crawl, a single repetition-controlled experiment using only 1/16 of the target tokens recovers a mixture within 0.05 of the optimum for a 757M parameter model, compared to an error of 0.75 without repetition control. Achieving comparable accuracy without repetition control requires three to four horizons, consuming 44 to 94% of the target token budget. With three data sources, the larger mixture space requires more than a single experiment to constrain, but the approach remains effective: at the 757M scale, just two repetition-controlled horizons recover the optimal mixture, outperforming baselines that instead require the full two-source experiments to construct. Our results reveal that repetition dynamics, not scale alone, shape whether small-scale mixture experiments generalize. More broadly, they suggest that data repetition deserves treatment as a first-class variable in mixture optimization, rather than an inconvenient side effect of limited data.

</details>


### [379] [A Topological Characterization of Graph Neural Networks via Stochastic Block Model Embeddings on the n-Sphere](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07598)
*Gopal Anantharaman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种拓扑框架，通过将训练好的图神经网络（GNN）在随机块模型（SBM）上的映射压缩到单位n-球面上，生成问题无关的低维"指纹"，用于模型比较和迁移学习候选检索，无需重新训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法缺乏统一的、可比较的框架来量化不同训练好的GNN之间的相似性，导致迁移学习时需要大量重训练，缺乏高效的模型库检索手段。

Method: 基于三个理论基础：割距离图空间(W_0, δ_□)的紧致性、Frieze–Kannan弱正则引理及其图-信号扩展、MPNN在割距离下的Lipschitz连续性。构造了一个保测度映射Ψ_n: [0,1]→S^{n-1}，将SBM区域放置在不相交的球冠上，生成低维指纹。

Result: 对于任意精度ε>0，足够大图上的训练MPNN可以(在ε误差内)通过有界复杂度的阶梯图-信号分解，并映射到球面指纹，支持可视化和最近邻搜索，实现无需重训练的迁移学习候选检索。同时讨论了高维浓度测度的障碍。

Conclusion: 提出了五个未来方向：双曲和Grassmannian替代模型、Gromov–Wasserstein距离、信息几何(Fisher)重表述、层嵌入云的持续同调指纹、基于图征分解的谱距离基线。

Abstract: We propose a topological framework for comparing trained Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) by mapping the Stochastic Block Models (SBMs) induced on the graphon-signal space of a Message Passing Neural Network (MPNN) onto the unit $n$-sphere $\sphere^{n-1}\subset\R^n$. The construction rests on three classical pillars: the \emph{compactness} of the cut-distance graphon space $(\Wo,\cutdist)$ \citep{lovasz2006limits,lovasz2012large}, the Frieze--Kannan \emph{weak regularity lemma} together with its graphon-signal extension due to \citet{levie2023graphon}, and the Lipschitz continuity of MPNNs with respect to the cut-distance.
