### [633] [The Mirrored Influence Hypothesis: Efficient Data Influence Estimation by Harnessing Forward Passes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.08922)
*Myeongseob Ko,Feiyang Kang,Weiyan Shi,Ming Jin,Zhou Yu,Ruoxi Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出镜像影响假说（Mirrored Influence Hypothesis），揭示训练数据与测试数据之间的影响具有互反性，并据此开发了一种高效的影响力估计方法，仅需计算测试样本的梯度和训练样本的前向传播，在训练数据远多于测试样本的场景下显著提升效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有影响力估计方法（如计算每个训练点的梯度或重复训练不同子集）在扩展到大型数据集和模型时面临巨大的计算挑战，亟需更高效的方法。

Method: 提出镜像影响假说，将训练数据对测试预测的影响重新表述为逆问题：评估如果模型在特定测试样本上训练，训练样本的预测会如何改变。基于此，新方法仅需计算特定测试样本的梯度，并对每个训练点进行一次前向传播。

Result: 在扩散模型的数据归因、数据泄露检测、记忆化分析、错误标签检测及语言模型行为追踪等多个场景中验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 镜像影响假说具有广泛适用性，所提方法在测试样本数远小于训练集规模时，相比现有方法在效率上有显著提升。

Abstract: Large-scale black-box models have become ubiquitous across numerous applications. Understanding the influence of individual training data sources on predictions made by these models is crucial for improving their trustworthiness. Current influence estimation techniques involve computing gradients for every training point or repeated training on different subsets. These approaches face obvious computational challenges when scaled up to large datasets and models.
  In this paper, we introduce and explore the Mirrored Influence Hypothesis, highlighting a reciprocal nature of influence between training and test data. Specifically, it suggests that evaluating the influence of training data on test predictions can be reformulated as an equivalent, yet inverse problem: assessing how the predictions for training samples would be altered if the model were trained on specific test samples. Through both empirical and theoretical validations, we demonstrate the wide applicability of our hypothesis. Inspired by this, we introduce a new method for estimating the influence of training data, which requires calculating gradients for specific test samples, paired with a forward pass for each training point. This approach can capitalize on the common asymmetry in scenarios where the number of test samples under concurrent examination is much smaller than the scale of the training dataset, thus gaining a significant improvement in efficiency compared to existing approaches.
  We demonstrate the applicability of our method across a range of scenarios, including data attribution in diffusion models, data leakage detection, analysis of memorization, mislabeled data detection, and tracing behavior in language models. Our code will be made available at https://github.com/ruoxi-jia-group/Forward-INF.

</details>


### [634] [Investigating the Histogram Loss in Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.13425)
*Ehsan Imani,Kai Luedemann,Sam Scholnick-Hughes,Esraa Elelimy,Martha White*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了回归任务中使用Histogram Loss学习条件分布带来的性能提升原因，发现主要源于优化改进而非额外信息建模，并在无需超参数调优的情况下验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 回归任务中即使仅需预测均值，训练建模完整分布的神经网络也常带来性能提升，但其背后的原因尚不完全清楚。本文旨在探究这一现象的根本原因。

Method: 通过理论与实证分析，系统研究Histogram Loss的各个组件对性能的贡献，区分优化改进与额外信息建模两种可能的原因。

Result: 学习分布带来的性能收益主要源于优化改进（如梯度特性、损失景观等），而非建模了额外的信息。

Conclusion: Histogram Loss在常见深度学习应用中具有可行性，且无需昂贵的超参数调优即可取得良好效果。

Abstract: It is becoming increasingly common in regression to train neural networks that model the entire distribution even if only the mean is required for prediction. This additional modeling often comes with performance gain and the reasons behind the improvement are not fully known. This paper investigates a recent approach to regression, the Histogram Loss, which involves learning the conditional distribution of the target variable by minimizing the cross-entropy between a target distribution and a flexible histogram prediction. We design theoretical and empirical analyses to determine why and when this performance gain appears, and how different components of the loss contribute to it. Our results suggest that the benefits of learning distributions in this setup come from improvements in optimization rather than modelling extra information. We then demonstrate the viability of the Histogram Loss in common deep learning applications without a need for costly hyperparameter tuning.

</details>


### [635] [Are Classification Robustness and Explanation Robustness Really Strongly Correlated? An Analysis Through Input Loss Landscape](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.06013)
*Tiejin Chen,Wenwang Huang,Linsey Pang,Dongsheng Luo,Hua Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文挑战了分类鲁棒性与解释鲁棒性之间存在内在关联的传统观点，通过聚类评估方法和新型训练方法证明两者并无强相关性，且调整解释损失景观不影响分类鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挑战深度学习鲁棒性研究中一个普遍假设：图像分类系统的分类鲁棒性与解释鲁棒性是内在相关的。作者试图验证这一假设是否成立。

Method: 1）提出一种基于聚类的评估方法，用于高效评估解释鲁棒性；2）设计了一种新型训练方法，专门用于调整关于解释损失的损失景观。

Result: 1）增强解释鲁棒性并不会使输入损失景观（相对于解释损失）变得平坦——这与分类鲁棒性中平坦损失景观对应更好鲁棒性的结论相反；2）调整解释损失景观可以影响解释鲁棒性，但对分类鲁棒性无影响。

Conclusion: 分类鲁棒性与解释鲁棒性之间并不存在强相关性，这一发现挑战了领域内的主流假设，并为理解损失景观与解释损失之间的关系开辟了新方向。

Abstract: This paper delves into the critical area of deep learning robustness, challenging the conventional belief that classification robustness and explanation robustness in image classification systems are inherently correlated. Through a novel evaluation approach leveraging clustering for efficient assessment of explanation robustness, we demonstrate that enhancing explanation robustness does not necessarily flatten the input loss landscape with respect to explanation loss - contrary to flattened loss landscapes indicating better classification robustness. To deeply investigate this contradiction, a groundbreaking training method designed to adjust the loss landscape with respect to explanation loss is proposed. Through the new training method, we uncover that although such adjustments can impact the robustness of explanations, they do not have an influence on the robustness of classification. These findings not only challenge the prevailing assumption of a strong correlation between the two forms of robustness but also pave new pathways for understanding relationship between loss landscape and explanation loss.

</details>


### [636] [Mean Teacher based SSL Framework for Indoor Localization Using Wi-Fi RSSI Fingerprinting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.13303)
*Sihao Li,Zhe Tang,Kyeong Soo Kim,Jeremy S. Smith*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Mean Teacher的半监督学习（SSL）框架，用于大规模室内定位，通过集成接入点选择、模型预训练/克隆和批量级噪声注入，有效利用混合标记/未标记数据进行静态训练和在线连续重训练，在UJIIndoorLoc和XJTLU动态数据库上分别将3D定位误差降低7.4%-7.7%和2D定位误差最大降低49.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于Wi-Fi RSSI指纹的室内定位面临三大挑战：1）标记数据采集耗时费力；2）监督学习模型无法利用未标记数据，泛化能力有限；3）动态环境下模型性能退化。为解决这些问题，需要一种能高效利用混合标记/未标记数据且适应动态场景的定位框架。

Method: 提出基于Mean Teacher的半监督学习框架，包含三个关键组件：接入点选择、模型预训练/克隆、批量级噪声注入。在离线阶段利用混合数据库进行静态训练，在线阶段利用用户未标记指纹进行连续重训练。Mean Teacher通过模型权重的指数移动平均生成更稳定的目标标签，兼顾性能与计算复杂度。

Result: 在UJIIndoorLoc数据库上，相比传统监督学习，CNNLoc和SIMO-DNN模型的平均3D误差分别降低7.403%和7.748%；在XJTLU动态数据库上，动态训练场景下平均2D误差最大降低49.227%。

Conclusion: 所提出的SSL框架在大规模室内定位中能显著提升模型性能，尤其在动态场景下效果突出，有效解决了传统方法在标记数据稀缺和动态环境中的局限性。

Abstract: Conventional large-scale indoor localization based on Wi-Fi RSSI fingerprinting faces issues of time-consuming and labor-intensive labeled data collection, limited generalization of a model trained under a supervised learning (SL) framework due to its inability to leverage unlabeled data, and model performance degradation in dynamic scenarios with environmental variations. To address those challenging issues, we propose a comprehensive semi-supervised learning (SSL) framework for a deep neural network (DNN) localization model based on the Mean Teacher, which incorporates access point selection, model pre-training/cloning, and batch-level noise injection. The proposed SSL framework can not only efficiently use hybrid labeled/unlabeled databases for static training of a model during the offline phase, but also exploit unlabeled fingerprints from users of the indoor localization system deployed in the field for continuous retraining of the model during the online phase. We base the proposed SSL framework on the Mean Teacher because it can generate more stable target labels through an exponential moving average of model weights without incurring the high computational complexity of the Pi-Model and with better scalability for online learning than Temporal Ensembling, making it an optimal choice that strikes the right balance between performance and computational complexity in large-scale indoor localization. With the UJIIndoorLoc database, the proposed SSL framework reduces the mean 3D errors of the CNNLoc and SIMO-DNN models by 7.403% and 7.748%, respectively, compared with those under the conventional SL framework; with the XJTLU dynamic database, the maximum reduction in mean 2D error reaches up to 49.227% under a dynamic training scenario, demonstrating the substantial performance improvement achieved by the proposed SSL framework.

</details>


### [637] [Federated Large Language Models: Current Progress and Future Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.15723)
*Yuhang Yao,Jianyi Zhang,Junda Wu,Chengkai Huang,Yu Xia,Tong Yu,Ruiyi Zhang,Sungchul Kim,Ryan Rossi,Ang Li,Lina Yao,Julian McAuley,Yiran Chen,Carlee Joe-Wong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了联邦学习与大语言模型结合（FedLLM）的最新进展，重点涵盖联邦微调、联邦提示学习、联邦预训练及联邦智能体等方向，分析了效率、个性化与安全等挑战的现有解决方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型训练依赖集中式数据收集，存在严重的隐私和治理问题。联邦学习提供去中心化训练方案，但将FL与LLM结合面临数据异质性、收敛不稳定、通信开销和计算约束等新挑战，亟需系统性综述来梳理现有方法与未来方向。

Method: 本文采用系统性综述方法，对FedLLM领域的最新研究进行梳理，重点分析联邦微调和联邦提示学习两类主流方法，并总结联邦预训练和联邦智能体等新兴方向，从效率、个性化和安全三方面评估现有技术。

Result: 系统梳理了FedLLM领域的最新进展，识别了联邦微调和联邦提示学习作为核心方法，并指出了联邦预训练和联邦智能体等前沿方向，同时归纳了数据异质性、通信效率、隐私安全等关键挑战的现有解决方案。

Conclusion: FedLLM是一个快速发展的领域，联邦微调和提示学习是当前主流范式，而联邦预训练和联邦智能体代表了未来重要方向。该领域仍需进一步研究以解决效率、个性化和安全之间的平衡问题。

Abstract: Large Language Models have achieved impressive performance across diverse applications, yet their training typically depends on centralized data collection, raising serious privacy and governance concerns. Federated Learning offers a decentralized alternative by enabling multiple clients to collaboratively train shared models without exposing raw local data. However, integrating FL with LLMs introduces new challenges, including data heterogeneity, convergence instability, communication overhead, and computational constraints. This survey provides a comprehensive and up-to-date overview of Federated Learning for Large Language Models (FedLLM). We systematically review recent advances, with particular emphasis on federated fine-tuning and federated prompt learning, and analyze how existing methods address efficiency, personalization, and security challenges. We further summarize emerging directions such as federated pre-training and federated agents. Our goal is to offer a structured perspective on this rapidly evolving field and to highlight promising avenues for future research.

</details>


### [638] [Communication-Efficient Federated Learning under Dynamic Device Arrival and Departure: Convergence Analysis and Algorithm Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.05662)
*Zhan-Lun Chang,Dong-Jun Han,Seyyedali Hosseinalipour,Mung Chiang,Christopher G. Brinton*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对动态设备集下的联邦学习，提出了基于梯度相似性的加权历史全局模型初始化算法，实现快速适应设备加入/离开带来的分布漂移，收敛速度提升一个数量级以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦学习假设设备集固定，但真实场景中设备动态加入或离开，导致优化目标随设备集变化、历史全局模型难以作为有效初始化，阻碍适应、延迟收敛、降低资源效率。

Method: 首先对动态设备集下的联邦学习进行收敛性分析，然后提出模型初始化算法：基于梯度相似性对历史全局模型进行加权平均，优先选择与当前设备集数据分布更一致的模型，加速分布漂移恢复。

Result: 实验表明该方法相比基线通常实现一个数量级以上的收敛加速，并显著降低达到目标精度所需的能耗。

Conclusion: 提出了一种即插即用的模型初始化算法，可无缝集成现有联邦学习方法，有效解决动态设备集场景下的适应性问题。

Abstract: Most federated learning (FL) approaches assume a fixed device set. However, real-world scenarios often involve devices dynamically joining or leaving the system, driven by, e.g., user mobility patterns or handovers across cell boundaries. This dynamic setting introduces unique challenges: (1) the optimization objective evolves with the active device set, unlike traditional FL's static objective; and (2) the current global model may no longer serve as an effective initialization for subsequent rounds, potentially hindering adaptation, delaying convergence, and reducing resource efficiency. To address these challenges, we first provide a convergence analysis for FL under a dynamic device set, accounting for factors such as gradient noise, local training iterations, and data heterogeneity in this practical setting. Motivated by this analysis, we propose a model initialization algorithm that enables rapid adaptation whenever devices join or leave the network. Our key idea is to compute a weighted average of previous global models, guided by gradient similarity, to prioritize models trained on data distributions that closely align with the current device set, thereby accelerating recovery from distribution shifts in fewer training rounds. This plug-and-play algorithm is designed to integrate seamlessly with existing FL methods, offering broad applicability. Experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves convergence speedups typically an order of magnitude or more compared to baselines, which we show drastically reduces energy consumption to reach a target accuracy.

</details>


### [639] [Discovering Data Structures: Nearest Neighbor Search and Beyond](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.03253)
*Omar Salemohamed,Laurent Charlin,Shivam Garg,Vatsal Sharan,Gregory Valiant*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种用于端到端学习数据结构的通用框架，能够从零开始学习数据结构和查询算法，无需精心初始化或候选算法种子。在最近邻搜索和流数据频率估计任务中，模型能自动发现或近似最优算法（如二分搜索、插值搜索、k-d树、LSH等）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统数据结构设计依赖于人工专家知识，难以自适应数据分布，且需要在查询效率与空间开销之间进行精细权衡。本文旨在提出一种能从数据中端到端学习数据结构和查询算法的通用框架，以自动发现适应特定数据分布的最优或近似最优方案。

Method: 构建一个通用框架，将数据结构的构建和查询过程建模为可微分的学习过程，使模型能够从零开始学习数据结构和查询算法。在最近邻搜索任务中，模型在1D场景下自动学习到二分搜索和插值搜索的变体，在高维场景下学习到类似k-d树或局部敏感哈希（LSH）的解决方案；同时支持学习高维数据的有效表示并利用它们设计数据结构。该框架还扩展到流数据频率估计问题。

Result: 在多个设置下，模型能够反向工程学习到的数据结构和查询算法。1D最近邻搜索中，模型发现了最优的分布相关/无关算法（如二分搜索和插值搜索变体）；高维场景下，模型在某些情况下学习到类似k-d树的解决方案，在另一些情况下表现出LSH的元素；模型还能学习高维数据的有用表示来设计有效的数据结构。

Conclusion: 本文提出的端到端学习数据结构的通用框架是有效的，能够自动发现适应数据分布的数据结构和查询算法，具有强大的逆向工程能力，并且可以推广到其他问题（如流数据频率估计），有望成为新的问题发现工具。

Abstract: We propose a general framework for end-to-end learning of data structures. Our framework adapts to the underlying data distribution and provides fine-grained control over query and space complexity. Crucially, the data structure is learned from scratch, and does not require careful initialization or seeding with candidate data structures/algorithms. We first apply this framework to the problem of nearest neighbor search. In several settings, we are able to reverse-engineer the learned data structures and query algorithms. For 1D nearest neighbor search, the model discovers optimal distribution (in)dependent algorithms such as binary search and variants of interpolation search. In higher dimensions, the model learns solutions that resemble k-d trees in some regimes, while in others, they have elements of locality-sensitive hashing. The model can also learn useful representations of high-dimensional data and exploit them to design effective data structures. We also adapt our framework to the problem of estimating frequencies over a data stream, and believe it could also be a powerful discovery tool for new problems.

</details>


### [640] [Modeling Stochastic Conditional Dynamics from Sparse Observations via Kernel-Stabilized Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.08314)
*Adam P. Generale,Andreas E. Robertson,Surya R. Kalidindi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出条件变量流匹配（CVFM）框架，通过学习状态和条件变量的联合流，利用条件不匹配核与Wasserstein距离重加权最优传输目标，从稀疏、非配对的连续条件数据中学习随机非线性动力系统的概率密度演化，在材料结构演化等应用中取得更优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流模型假设离散条件且样本跨时间配对，限制了在稀疏、非配对连续条件数据场景（如生物和物理领域）中的科学适用性，亟需一种能处理非配对连续条件数据的条件分布演化学习方法。

Method: 提出条件变量流匹配（CVFM）框架，通过联合采样状态变量和条件变量的流，引入条件不匹配核（conditioning mismatch kernel）和条件Wasserstein距离来重加权条件最优传输目标，从而在连续条件密度空间上实现摊销式学习。

Result: 在条件映射基准测试和材料制造过程中内部结构时间演化案例研究上，CVFM相比现有条件变体展现出更优的性能和收敛特性。

Conclusion: CVFM有效解决了先前方法的高方差不稳定性问题，能够从稀疏的非配对测量数据中学习随机动力学系统的密度演化，在科学和工程领域具有广泛的应用潜力。

Abstract: Learning to transform conditional probability densities over time is a fundamental challenge spanning probabilistic modeling and the natural sciences. This task is paramount when forecasting the evolution of stochastic nonlinear dynamical systems in biological and physical domains. While flow-based models can predict the temporal evolution of probability distributions, existing approaches often assume discrete conditioning with samples that are paired across time, limiting their scientific applicability where frequently only sparse data with unpaired continuous conditioning is available. We propose Conditional Variable Flow Matching (CVFM), a framework for learning flows transforming conditional distributions with amortization across the continuous space of conditional densities. CVFM addresses the high-variance instability of prior methods by jointly sampling flows over state and conditioning variables, utilizing a conditioning mismatch kernel alongside a conditional Wasserstein distance to reweight the conditional optimal transport objective. Collectively, these advances allow for learning dynamics from sparse unpaired measurements of state-condition across time. We evaluate CVFM on conditional mapping benchmarks and a case study modeling the temporal evolution of materials internal structure during manufacturing processes, observing improved performance and convergence characteristics over existing conditional variants. Code is available at https://github.com/agenerale/conditional-variable-flow-matching.

</details>


### [641] [Zero and Few Shot Load Forecasting with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.11350)
*Wenlong Liao,Chengrui Zhang,Zhe Yang,Mengshuo Jia,Christian Rehtanz,Jiannong Fang,Fernando Porté-Agel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Chronos模型，利用预训练语言模型框架实现零样本和少样本负荷预测，在数据稀缺场景下显著优于9种基线模型，RMSE降低7.34%-84.30%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习负荷预测模型需要大量数据训练，在数据稀缺场景下效果受限，亟需一种无需大量场景特定数据的预测方法。

Method: 借鉴预训练语言模型（LLM）的成功经验，采用Chronos框架在零样本和少样本设置下进行负荷预测，利用其广泛预训练知识直接迁移至新场景，无需针对特定负荷数据集进行微调。

Result: 在5个真实数据集上，Chronos在确定性和概率性负荷预测中全面优于9种基线模型，RMSE降低7.34%-84.30%，CRPS降低19.63%-60.06%，QS降低22.83%-54.49%，预测时长覆盖1至48小时。

Conclusion: Chronos模型在数据稀缺场景下展现出优越性和灵活性，是一种有效的负荷预测解决方案。

Abstract: Deep learning models have shown strong performance in load forecasting, but they generally require large amounts of data for model training before being applied to new scenarios, which limits their effectiveness in data-scarce scenarios. Inspired by the great success of pre-trained language models (LLMs) in natural language processing, this paper proposes a zero and few shot load forecasting approach using an advanced LLM framework denoted as the Chronos model. By utilizing its extensive pre-trained knowledge, the Chronos model enables accurate load forecasting in data-scarce scenarios. Simulation results across five real-world datasets demonstrate that the Chronos model significantly outperforms nine popular baseline models for both deterministic and probabilistic load forecasting with various forecast horizons (e.g., 1 to 48 hours), even though the Chronos model is neither tailored nor fine-tuned to these specific load datasets. Notably, Chronos reduces root mean squared error (RMSE), continuous ranked probability score (CRPS), and quantile score (QS) by approximately 7.34%-84.30%, 19.63%-60.06%, and 22.83%-54.49%, respectively, compared to baseline models. These results highlight the superiority and flexibility of the Chronos model, positioning it as an effective solution in data-scarce scenarios.

</details>


### [642] [BlendServe: Optimizing Offline Inference for Auto-regressive Large Models with Resource-aware Batching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.16102)
*Yilong Zhao,Shuo Yang,Kan Zhu,Lianmin Zheng,Baris Kasikci,Yang Zhou,Jiarong Xing,Ion Stoica*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BlendServe是一个通过资源感知前缀树结合资源重叠与前缀共享优势的离线批量推理系统，在多样化多模态工作负载下相比vLLM和SGLang实现高达1.44倍吞吐量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线批量推理中，请求在计算和内存需求上日趋多样化，资源重叠可以提升吞吐量，但最大化资源重叠的请求调度与最大化前缀共享的调度存在冲突，导致次优推理吞吐量。

Method: 提出BlendServe系统，利用资源感知前缀树（resource-aware prefix tree），在离线批量推理的宽松延迟约束下重新排序和重叠具有不同资源需求的请求，同时确保高前缀共享率。

Result: 在多种合成多模态工作负载上，相比vLLM和SGLang等业界广泛使用的系统，吞吐量提升高达1.44倍。

Conclusion: BlendServe通过巧妙结合资源重叠与前缀共享，有效解决了二者调度冲突问题，显著提升了离线批量推理的资源利用率和吞吐量。

Abstract: Offline batch inference, which leverages the flexibility of request batching to achieve higher throughput and lower costs, is becoming more popular for latency-insensitive applications. Meanwhile, recent progress in model capability and modality makes requests more diverse in compute and memory demands, creating unique opportunities for throughput improvement by resource overlapping. However, a request schedule that maximizes resource overlapping can conflict with the schedule that maximizes prefix sharing, a widely-used performance optimization, causing sub-optimal inference throughput. We present BlendServe, a system that maximizes resource utilization of offline batch inference by combining the benefits of resource overlapping and prefix sharing using a resource-aware prefix tree. BlendServe exploits the relaxed latency requirements in offline batch inference to reorder and overlap requests with varied resource demands while ensuring high prefix sharing. We evaluate BlendServe on a variety of synthetic multi-modal workloads and show that it provides up to $1.44\times$ throughput boost compared to widely-used industry standards, vLLM and SGLang.

</details>


### [643] [Graph-to-SFILES: Control structure prediction from process topologies using generative artificial intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.00508)
*Lukas Schulze Balhorn,Kevin Degens,Artur M. Schweidtmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Graph-to-SFILES模型，利用图编码器（含GNN）从流程图拓扑预测控制结构，在小型数据集上（1000个流程图）显著优于序列方法（top-5准确率从0.9%提升至28.4%），但在大规模数据集上序列方法更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: P&ID开发中控制结构设计步骤繁琐耗时，现有生成式AI方法主要基于序列表示流程，而图结构具有置换不变性，有望更高效地预测控制结构以加速P&ID开发。

Method: 提出Graph-to-SFILES模型，以流程图拓扑作为图输入，采用四种不同的图编码器架构（含本文提出的GNN），输出SFILES 2.0格式的控制扩展流程图序列。

Result: 在10,000个流程图拓扑上训练达到73.2%的top-5准确率；在1,000个流程图的少量数据场景下，top-5准确率从序列方法的0.9%提升至28.4%；但在100,000个流程图的规模下序列方法表现更好。

Conclusion: 基于图的AI模型在少量数据场景下具有加速P&ID开发的潜力，本文提出的GNN在编码器架构中表现最佳，但其在工业相关案例中的有效性仍需进一步验证。

Abstract: Control structure design is an important but tedious step in P&ID development. Generative artificial intelligence (AI) promises to reduce P&ID development time by supporting engineers. Previous research on generative AI in chemical process design mainly represented processes by sequences. However, graphs offer a promising alternative because of their permutation invariance. We propose the Graph-to-SFILES model, a generative AI method to predict control structures from flowsheet topologies. The Graph-to-SFILES model takes the flowsheet topology as a graph input and returns a control-extended flowsheet as a sequence in the SFILES 2.0 notation. We compare four different graph encoder architectures, one of them being a graph neural network (GNN) proposed in this work. The Graph-to-SFILES model achieves a top-5 accuracy of 73.2% when trained on 10,000 flowsheet topologies. In addition, the proposed GNN performs best among the encoder architectures. Compared to a purely sequence-based approach, the Graph-to-SFILES model improves the top-5 accuracy for a relatively small training dataset of 1,000 flowsheets from 0.9% to 28.4%. However, the sequence-based approach performs better on a large-scale dataset of 100,000 flowsheets. These results highlight the potential of graph-based AI models to accelerate P&ID development in small-data regimes but their effectiveness on industry relevant case studies still needs to be investigated.

</details>


### [644] [Advancements in Machine Learning and Deep Learning for Early Detection and Management of Mental Health Disorder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.06147)
*Kamala Devi Kannan,Senthil Kumar Jagatheesaperumal,Rajesh N. V. P. S. Kandala,Mojtaba Lotfaliany,Roohallah Alizadehsanid,Mohammadreza Mohebbi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文综述了机器学习和深度学习在心理疾病早期诊断与治疗中的应用，涵盖医学影像、遗传/生物标志物分析、行为评估等方向，讨论了数据整合、伦理问题等挑战，并指出ML/DL可提升诊断准确性和治疗效果，未来需加强实时监测系统、数据融合技术和跨学科合作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 利用ML/DL技术改善心理健康疾病的早期识别、诊断和治疗效果，解决传统方法在复杂数据分析上的局限性。

Method: 对ML/DL在心理健康领域的应用进行系统性综述，重点分析其在医学影像、遗传与生物标志物分析、行为评估三大类数据上的应用，并讨论预测建模（风险预测模型、纵向研究）的方法。

Result: ML/DL能够提升抑郁症、双相情感障碍、精神分裂症等疾病的诊断准确率和治疗效果，但面临方法学不一致、数据整合困难、伦理问题等挑战。

Conclusion: 未来应聚焦于开发实时监测系统、改进数据融合技术、加强跨学科协作，以推动ML/DL在心理健康服务中的有效且合乎伦理的应用。

Abstract: For the early identification, diagnosis, and treatment of mental health illnesses, the integration of deep learning (DL) and machine learning (ML) have started playing a significant role. By evaluating complex data from imaging, genetics, and behavioral assessments, these technologies have the potential to improve clinical results significantly. However, they also present unique challenges relating to data integration and ethical issues. The development of ML and DL methods for the early diagnosis and treatment of mental health issues is reviewed in this survey. It examines a range of applications, with a particular emphasis on behavioral assessments, genetic and biomarker analysis, and medical imaging for the diagnosis of diseases like depression, bipolar disorder, and schizophrenia. Predictive modeling for illness development is further discussed in the review, focusing on the function of risk prediction models and longitudinal investigations. Important discoveries show how ML and DL might improve treatment outcomes and diagnostic accuracy while tackling methodological inconsistency, data integration, and ethical concerns. The study emphasizes the significance of building real-time monitoring systems for individualized treatment, improving data fusion techniques, and interdisciplinary collaboration. Upcoming studies should concentrate on surmounting these obstacles to maximize ML and DL's valuable and moral implementation in mental health services.

</details>


### [645] [Adaptive Prior Selection in Gaussian Process Bandits with Thompson Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.01226)
*Jack Sandberg,Morteza Haghir Chehreghani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了在GP bandits中联合先验选择和遗憾值最小化的两种算法：PE-GP-TS（通过剔除预测性能差的先验）和HP-GP-TS（采用双层汤普森采样），并对HP-GP-TS建立了次线性遗憾界，实验验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际应用中GP先验通常未知，而常用的最大似然估计缺乏理论保证，因此需要理论上有保障的联合先验选择与遗憾最小化算法。

Method: 提出两种基于GP汤普森采样的算法：PE-GP-TS（淘汰预测性能差的先验）和HP-GP-TS（采用双层汤普森采样机制进行先验选择）。

Result: 为HP-GP-TS建立了次线性遗憾界理论保证，并通过合成数据与真实数据实验验证了算法有效性。

Conclusion: HP-GP-TS在理论上具有次线性遗憾保证，两种算法在实际中均优于现有替代方案。

Abstract: Gaussian process (GP) bandits provide a powerful framework for performing blackbox optimization of unknown functions. The characteristics of the unknown function depend heavily on the assumed GP prior. Most work in the literature assume that this prior is known but in practice this seldom holds. Instead, practitioners often rely on maximum likelihood estimation to select the hyperparameters of the prior - which lacks theoretical guarantees. In this work, we study two algorithms for joint prior selection and regret minimization in GP bandits based on GP Thompson sampling (GP-TS): Prior-Elimination GP-TS (PE-GP-TS) that disqualifies priors with poor predictive performance, and HyperPrior GP-TS (HP-GP-TS) that utilizes a bi-level Thompson sampling scheme. We theoretically analyze the algorithms and establish a sublinear regret bound for HP-GP-TS. In addition, we demonstrate the effectiveness of these algorithms compared to the alternatives through extensive experiments with synthetic and real-world data.

</details>


### [646] [AccioScene: Compositional 3D Scene Generation via Graph Diffusion and Interaction-driven Critics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.06819)
*Yao Wei,Matteo Toso,Pietro Morerio,Changjae Oh,Michael Ying Yang,Alessio Del Bue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种多阶段管道，通过图扩散生成场景图、预测物体布局并结合轻量级人-物交互先验与空间约束，从文本提示生成具备物理合理性与功能性的3D室内场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将场景合成建模为基于单一模态（文本描述、房间形状或场景图）的物体布局预测问题，导致物体碰撞、功能合理性不足，降低了实际应用性。

Method: 多阶段管道：1) 图扩散生成上下文连贯的场景图；2) 预测逼真的物体布局；3) 引入轻量级人-物交互先验以鼓励以人为中心的功能性排布；4) 施加显式空间约束以减少物体穿插。

Result: 在3D-FRONT数据集上达到竞争性或SOTA性能，同时提升了生成场景的物理合理性。

Conclusion: 该方法能生成连贯的3D场景，具备可行的布局且更好地支持人机交互，反映了实际场景创建的需求。

Abstract: This paper presents a framework for generating 3D indoor scenes from text prompts. Existing methods often formulate scene synthesis as an object layout prediction problem conditioned on a single input modality, such as a text description, room shape, or scene graph. This design can lead to object collisions and limited functional plausibility, reducing its practical applicability. To address these limitations, we introduce a multi-stage pipeline that better reflects practical scene creation scenarios. Given a text prompt describing partial scene content, our method first uses graph diffusion to produce a contextually coherent scene graph and then predicts a realistic object layout. In addition, we incorporate lightweight human-object interaction priors to encourage human-centric and functional arrangements, with explicit spatial constraints to reduce interpenetration. Our approach generates coherent 3D scenes with viable layouts that better support human interaction. Experiments on the 3D-FRONT dataset demonstrate that our method achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance compared with existing approaches, while improving the physical plausibility of generated scenes.

</details>


### [647] [In-Context Learning of Stochastic Differential Equations with Foundation Inference Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.19049)
*Patrick Seifner,Kostadin Cvejoski,David Berghaus,Cesar Ojeda,Ramses J. Sanchez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FIM-SDE，一种预训练的基础推理模型，能够从含噪时间序列数据中对低维随机微分方程的漂移函数和扩散函数进行零样本（上下文）估计，并支持快速微调，在合成和真实数据上表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法要么严重依赖动力学先验知识，要么涉及复杂的训练流程，缺乏一种高效、通用的SDE函数估计方法。

Method: 借鉴摊销推理和神经算子思想，通过监督预训练将大量含噪离散观测的SDE路径映射到漂移和扩散函数空间，实现上下文学习式的零样本估计。

Result: 在多种合成系统（双阱势、弱扰动洛伦兹吸引子）和真实数据（股价、油价、风速）上，零样本性能匹配符号方法、高斯过程和神经SDE基线；微调后一致超越所有基线。

Conclusion: FIM-SDE提供了一种高效、准确且可微调的SDE函数估计框架，兼具零样本推理能力和微调可塑性。

Abstract: Stochastic differential equations (SDEs) describe dynamical systems where deterministic flows, governed by a drift function, are superimposed with random fluctuations, dictated by a diffusion function. The accurate estimation (or discovery) of these functions from data is a central problem in machine learning, with wide application across the natural and social sciences. Yet current solutions either rely heavily on prior knowledge of the dynamics or involve intricate training procedures. We introduce FIM-SDE (Foundation Inference Model for SDEs), a pretrained recognition model that delivers accurate in-context (or zero-shot) estimation of the drift and diffusion functions of low-dimensional SDEs, from noisy time series data, and allows rapid finetuning to target datasets. Leveraging concepts from amortized inference and neural operators, we (pre)train FIM-SDE in a supervised fashion to map a large set of noisy, discretely observed SDE paths onto the space of drift and diffusion functions. We demonstrate that FIM-SDE achieves robust in-context function estimation across a wide range of synthetic and real-world processes -- from canonical SDE systems (e.g., double-well dynamics or weakly perturbed Lorenz attractors) to stock price recordings and oil-price and wind-speed fluctuations -- while matching the performance of symbolic, Gaussian process and Neural SDE baselines trained on the target datasets. When finetuned to the target processes, we show that FIM-SDE consistently outperforms all these baselines.

</details>


### [648] [phepy: Visual benchmarks and improvements for out-of-distribution detectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.05169)
*Felix Krumbiegel,Juniper Tyree,Michael Boy,Petri Clusius,Andreas Rupp*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对高维稀疏/有偏数据下的OOD检测问题，设计了一个包含三个可视化玩具示例的基准测试，评估了多种OOD检测方法，并提出了t-poking和OOD样本加权两种改进监督方法，最终给出了OOD检测器的构建和应用建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维机器学习模型面临OOD输入时预测误差可能无界，而现有OOD检测方法在真实数据集上测试复杂，缺乏简单直观的评估基准。

Method: 设计了三个可视化玩具示例基准（线性/非线性概念检测+高维空间中的薄ID子空间检测）；提出了t-poking和OOD样本加权两种改进方法以优化ID-OOD决策边界。

Result: 通过玩具基准评估了多种文献中的OOD检测方法；t-poking和OOD样本加权能有效提高监督检测器在ID-OOD边界的精确度，缓解真实ID与合成OOD样本间的冲突。

Conclusion: 提供了构建和应用OOD检测器的实践建议，强调简单可视化基准对理解检测器行为的重要性，以及边界精确度在监督训练中的关键作用。

Abstract: Applying machine learning to increasingly high-dimensional problems with sparse or biased training data increases the risk that a model is used on inputs outside its training domain. For such out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs, the model can no longer make valid predictions, and its error is potentially unbounded. Since testing OOD detection methods on real-world datasets is complicated, we design a benchmark for OOD detection, which includes three novel and easily-visualisable toy examples. These simple examples provide direct and intuitive insight into whether the detector is able to detect (1) linear and (2) non-linear concepts and (3) identify thin in-distribution (ID) subspaces (needles) within high-dimensional spaces (haystacks). We use our benchmark to evaluate the performance of various methods from the literature. Since tactile examples of OOD inputs may benefit OOD detection, we also review several simple methods to synthesise OOD inputs for supervised training. We introduce two improvements, $t$-poking and OOD sample weighting, to make supervised detectors more precise at the ID-OOD boundary. This is especially important when conflicts between real ID and synthetic OOD sample blur the decision boundary. Finally, we provide recommendations for constructing and applying OOD detectors in machine learning.

</details>


### [649] [LoTUS: Large-Scale Machine Unlearning with a Taste of Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.18314)
*Christoforos N. Spartalis,Theodoros Semertzidis,Petros Daras,Efstratios Gavves*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LoTUS是一种新型机器遗忘方法，通过信息论界平滑模型预测概率来消除预训练模型中训练样本的影响，避免从头重新训练，在多个数据集和模型上优于现有方法，并提出了无需重新训练的RF-JSD评估指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法通常需要重新训练模型，在大规模数据集上计算成本高昂且不切实际。本文旨在开发一种无需重新训练的高效遗忘方法，同时解决模型因数据记忆而产生的过度自信问题。

Method: LoTUS通过信息论界（information-theoretic bound）平滑模型的预测概率，从而减轻模型因数据记忆导致的过度自信。该方法避免了从头重新训练，并在Transformer和ResNet18模型上进行了评估。此外，提出了无需重新训练的RF-JSD（Retrain-Free Jensen-Shannon Divergence）评估指标。

Result: 在五个公开数据集上，对Transformer和ResNet18模型与八个基线方法对比，LoTUS在效率和有效性方面均优于现有最先进方法。特别是在ImageNet1k大规模数据集上，也验证了其在实际条件下的可行性。

Conclusion: LoTUS提供了一种高效、无需重新训练的机器遗忘解决方案，通过信息论平滑机制有效消除训练样本影响，并引入RF-JSD指标实用化了大规模场景下的遗忘评估。

Abstract: We present LoTUS, a novel Machine Unlearning (MU) method that eliminates the influence of training samples from pre-trained models, avoiding retraining from scratch. LoTUS smooths the prediction probabilities of the model up to an information-theoretic bound, mitigating its over-confidence stemming from data memorization. We evaluate LoTUS on Transformer and ResNet18 models against eight baselines across five public datasets. Beyond established MU benchmarks, we evaluate unlearning on ImageNet1k, a large-scale dataset, where retraining is impractical, simulating real-world conditions. Moreover, we introduce the novel Retrain-Free Jensen-Shannon Divergence (RF-JSD) metric to enable evaluation under real-world conditions. The experimental results show that LoTUS outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of both efficiency and effectiveness. Code: https://github.com/cspartalis/LoTUS.

</details>


### [650] [Enhancing Strawberry Yield Forecasting with Backcasted IoT Sensor Data and Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.18451)
*Tewodros Alemu Ayall,Andy Li,Matthew Beddows,Milan Markovic,Georgios Leontidis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究通过部署IoT传感器收集两季草莓生产数据，并利用AI反向预测方法合成缺失的两季传感器数据，将真实与合成数据结合训练产量预测模型，结果证明合成数据能显著提升预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球人口快速增长，需要数字化农业系统支持可持续粮食生产。IoT技术可捕获实时环境与操作参数，但动态农场环境中数据有限，需多季积累才能有效训练AI模型，制约了产量预测效果。

Method: 在两季草莓生产隧道中部署IoT传感器收集用水、温湿度、土壤参数及光合有效辐射数据，结合四季人工产量记录。针对无传感器覆盖的两季，利用邻近气象站历史天气数据和已有隧道测量值，开发AI反向预测方法合成缺失传感器观测值。随后训练基于真实与合成数据集的AI产量预测模型。

Result: 回顾性评估表明，结合合成数据可提升产量预测精度，使用真实+合成数据训练模型优于仅使用真实传感器、天气和产量数据的模型。

Conclusion: AI反向预测合成的缺失IoT观测数据能有效弥补数据缺口，提升产量预测模型的准确性，为数字化农业中数据有限问题提供了可行解决方案。

Abstract: Rapid global population growth underscores the need for digitally enabled agricultural systems that support sustainable food production and data-driven resource management for farmers and stakeholders. The adoption of Internet of Things (IoT) technologies, capable of capturing real-time environmental (e.g., temperature, humidity) and operational (e.g., irrigation) parameters, is a crucial step toward enabling advanced applications such as AI-based yield forecasting. However, the effectiveness of such models is often constrained by limited data availability, particularly in dynamic farm environments where IoT observations must be accumulated over multiple growing seasons. In this study, we deployed IoT sensors in strawberry production polytunnels over two growing seasons to collect data on water usage, internal and external temperature and humidity, soil moisture, soil temperature, and photosynthetically active radiation. These observations were combined with manually recorded yield data spanning four seasons. To address gaps in IoT data for the two seasons without sensor coverage, we developed an AI-based backcasting approach that synthesizes missing sensor observations using historical weather data from a nearby station and existing polytunnel measurements. We then trained AI-based yield forecasting models using both real and synthetic datasets. In this retrospective evaluation, results show that incorporating synthetic data improved yield forecasting accuracy, with models trained on the combined dataset outperforming those using only real sensor, weather, and yield data.

</details>


### [651] [LLMSynthor: Macro-Aligned Micro-Records Synthesis with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.14752)
*Yihong Tang,Menglin Kong,Junlin He,Tong Nie,Wei Ma,Lijun Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LLMSynthor利用预训练LLM作为宏观感知模拟器，通过迭代生成与目标宏观统计一致的微观记录，实现从宏观数据到微观记录的可靠合成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 宏观对齐的微观记录对于社会科学和城市研究的可信模拟至关重要（如流行病模型需要个体级的真实移动和接触数据），但大规模收集细粒度数据不切实际，研究者通常只有宏观数据可用。

Method: 将LLM作为非参数Copula，迭代构建合成数据集：每步中LLM生成记录批次以最小化合成统计量与目标宏观统计量之间的差异；LLM Proposal Sampling引导LLM提出有针对性的记录批次，指定变量范围和计数，高效纠正偏差同时保持模型先验的现实性。

Result: 在移动性、电子商务、人口等多个领域的评估中，LLMSynthor实现了强现实性、统计保真度和实用效用。

Conclusion: LLMSynthor可广泛应用于经济学、社会科学和城市研究领域，为仅掌握宏观数据的研究者提供生成现实微观记录的有效工具。

Abstract: Macro-aligned micro-records are crucial for credible simulations in social science and urban studies. For example, epidemic models are only reliable when individual-level mobility and contacts mirror real behavior, while aggregates match real-world statistics like case counts or travel flows. However, collecting such fine-grained data at scale is impractical, leaving researchers with only macro-level data. LLMSynthor addresses this by turning a pretrained LLM into a macro-aware simulator that generates realistic micro-records consistent with target macro-statistics. It iteratively builds synthetic datasets: in each step, the LLM generates batches of records to minimize discrepancies between synthetic and target aggregates. Treating the LLM as a nonparametric copula allows the model to capture realistic joint dependencies among variables. To improve efficiency, LLM Proposal Sampling guides the LLM to propose targeted record batches, specifying variable ranges and counts, to efficiently correct discrepancies while preserving realism grounded in the model's priors. Evaluations across domains (mobility, e-commerce, population) show that LLMSynthor achieves strong realism, statistical fidelity, and practical utility, making it broadly applicable to economics, social science, and urban studies.

</details>


### [652] [SpectraLDS: Provable Distillation for Linear Dynamical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.17868)
*Devan Shah,Shlomo Fortgang,Sofiia Druchyna,Elad Hazan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SpectraLDS，首个可证明的对称线性动力系统识别方法，其精度保证与系统状态维度或有效记忆无关。通过将对称LDS表示为可通过固定谱变换学习的卷积，并逆转该表示从谱变换中恢复LDS模型，实现端到端凸优化。该方法在保持预测精度的同时，实现每token常数时间和空间推理（与序列长度无关），在语言建模等任务上提升了推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对称线性动力系统识别方法缺乏与状态维度或有效记忆无关的精度保证，且推理效率随序列长度增长而下降。

Method: 将对称LDS表示为可通过固定谱变换学习的卷积，逆转该表示从谱变换中恢复LDS模型，形成端到端凸优化过程。

Result: 在保持预测精度的前提下，实现每token常数时间和常数空间推理（与序列长度独立），在语言建模等任务上提升了推理效率。

Conclusion: SpectraLDS作为序列预测架构组件，能在保持精度的同时显著提升推理效率。

Abstract: We present the first provable method for identifying symmetric linear dynamical systems (LDS) with accuracy guarantees that are independent of the systems' state dimension or effective memory. Our approach builds upon recent work that represents symmetric LDSs as convolutions learnable via fixed spectral transformations. We show how to invert this representation, thereby recovering an LDS model from its spectral transform and yielding an end-to-end convex optimization procedure. This distillation preserves predictive accuracy while enabling constant-time and constant-space inference per token, independent of sequence length. We evaluate our method, SpectraLDS, as a component in sequence prediction architectures and demonstrate that accuracy is preserved while inference efficiency is improved on tasks such as language modeling.

</details>


### [653] [ePC: Fast and Deep Predictive Coding in Digital Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.20137)
*Cédric Goemaere,Gaspard Oliviers,Rafal Bogacz,Thomas Demeester*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出现有预测编码（PC）框架在数字模拟中存在根本性的信号衰减问题，导致计算低效且难以扩展至深层架构。为此，作者提出了基于误差的PC（ePC）重新参数化方法，虽失去生物合理性但能精确计算梯度，速度比传统状态型PC快数个数量级，并在多种架构和数据集上匹配了反向传播的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测编码（PC）虽被提出作为反向传播的大脑启发式替代方案，但实际中主要通过数字模拟实现，存在计算开销大且难以扩展到深层架构的问题。作者试图解决这一硬件-算法不匹配问题。

Method: 首先分析了传统状态型PC（sPC）在数字模拟中因设计导致的指数级信号衰减问题；随后提出基于误差的PC（ePC）重新参数化，能够数值计算精确的PC权重梯度，避免了信号衰减。

Result: ePC运行速度比sPC快数个数量级，在多种架构和数据集上匹配了反向传播的性能，且能够扩展到sPC难以处理的更深层模型。

Conclusion: 该工作不仅提供了对PC动力学的理论洞察，还为在数字硬件及更广泛场景下将PC学习扩展到更深层架构奠定了基础。

Abstract: Predictive Coding (PC) offers a brain-inspired alternative to backpropagation for neural network training, described as a physical system minimizing its internal energy. However, in practice, PC is predominantly digitally simulated, requiring excessive amounts of compute while struggling to scale to deeper architectures. This paper reformulates PC to overcome this hardware-algorithm mismatch. First, we uncover how the canonical state-based formulation of PC (sPC) is, by design, deeply inefficient in digital simulation, inevitably resulting in exponential signal decay that stalls the entire minimization process. Then, to overcome this fundamental limitation, we introduce error-based PC (ePC), a novel reparameterization of PC which does not suffer from signal decay. Though no longer biologically plausible, ePC numerically computes exact PC weights gradients and runs orders of magnitude faster than sPC. Experiments across multiple architectures and datasets demonstrate that ePC matches backpropagation's performance even for deeper models where sPC struggles. Besides practical improvements, our work provides theoretical insight into PC dynamics and establishes a foundation for scaling PC-based learning to deeper architectures on digital hardware and beyond.

</details>


### [654] [A Robust $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/\sqrt{T})$ Rate for Unprojected TD Learning with Linear Function Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.01052)
*Wei-Cheng Lee,Francesco Orabona*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了无投影的TD(0)算法在马尔可夫噪声下以$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\left(\frac{\|\theta^*\|^2_2}{\sqrt{T}}\right)$的速率收敛，无需额外正则条件，仅需对学习率进行微小对数修正，通过发现TD更新的自限界性质保证迭代有界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前TD学习的鲁棒收敛保证依赖于每次迭代投影到有界集的人为假设，移除该条件被Bhandari等人列为开放问题。本文旨在证明无投影TD(0)在无额外正则条件下的收敛性。

Method: 发现并利用TD更新过程的"自限界"性质(self-bounding property)，在不依赖势函数最小曲率的情况下保证迭代有界；对学习率施加微小的对数修正（polylog correction）。

Result: 无投影TD(0)在马尔可夫噪声下以$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\left(\frac{\|\theta^*\|^2_2}{\sqrt{T}}\right)$的期望速率收敛，无需额外正则条件或投影操作。

Conclusion: 解决了Bhandari等人提出的开放问题，表明简单的无投影TD(0)在鲁棒设定下即可实现有限时间收敛，为线性函数近似的TD学习提供了更简洁的理论保证。

Abstract: We investigate the finite-time convergence properties of Temporal Difference (TD) learning with linear function approximation, a cornerstone of reinforcement learning.
  We are interested in the so-called ``robust'' setting, where the convergence guarantee does not depend on the potential function's minimal curvature.
  While prior work has established convergence guarantees in this setting, these results typically rely on the artificial assumption that each iterate is projected onto a bounded set. Removing such a condition was left as an open problem by Bhandari et al. (COLT'18), hypothesizing the need for additional ``regularity conditions''.
  In this paper, we show that the simple unprojected TD(0) converges with a rate of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\left(\frac{\|θ^*\|^2_2}{\sqrt{T}}\right)$ in expectation, even in the presence of Markovian noise. We do not require an additional regularity condition, but only a minor polylog correction to the learning rate. Our analysis reveals a novel self-bounding property of the TD updates and exploits it to guarantee bounded iterates.

</details>


### [655] [dLLM-Cache: Accelerating Diffusion Large Language Models with Adaptive Caching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.06295)
*Zhiyuan Liu,Yicun Yang,Yaojie Zhang,Junjie Chen,Chang Zou,Qingyan Wei,Shaobo Wang,Yichen Zhu,Linfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出dLLM-Cache，一种无需训练的适配缓存框架，通过结合长间隔提示缓存和基于特征相似性的部分响应更新，显著降低扩散型大语言模型（dLLM）的推理延迟，在保持输出质量的同时实现高达9.1倍的FLOPs减少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散型大语言模型（dLLM）相比自回归模型（ARM）具有显著优势，但存在高推理延迟问题。传统ARM加速技术（如KV缓存）因dLLM的双向注意力机制而无法兼容，亟需针对dLLM特性的高效推理加速方法。

Method: 基于dLLM推理中静态提示和部分动态响应（多数token在相邻去噪步骤中保持稳定）的关键观察，提出dLLM-Cache：一种无需训练的自适应缓存框架，结合长间隔提示缓存与基于特征相似性的部分响应更新，实现中间计算的高效复用。

Result: 在LLaDA 8B和Dream 7B等代表性dLLM上的实验表明，dLLM-Cache在LongBench-HotpotQA上实现高达9.1倍FLOPs减少，同时保持竞争力的输出质量，使dLLM推理延迟接近ARM水平。

Conclusion: dLLM-Cache有效解决了dLLM的高推理延迟问题，通过巧妙的缓存设计在不影响性能的前提下大幅提升推理效率，缩小了dLLM与ARM之间的推理速度差距，为dLLM的实际部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Autoregressive Models (ARMs) have long dominated the landscape of Large Language Models. Recently, a new paradigm has emerged in the form of diffusion-based Large Language Models (dLLMs), which generate text by iteratively denoising masked segments. This approach has shown significant advantages and potential. However, dLLMs suffer from high inference latency. Traditional ARM acceleration techniques, such as Key-Value caching, are incompatible with dLLMs due to their bidirectional attention mechanism. To address this specific challenge, our work begins with a key observation that dLLM inference involves a static prompt and a partially dynamic response, where most tokens remain stable across adjacent denoising steps. Based on this, we propose dLLM-Cache, a training-free adaptive caching framework that combines long-interval prompt caching with partial response updates guided by feature similarity. This design enables efficient reuse of intermediate computations without compromising model performance. Extensive experiments on representative dLLMs, including LLaDA 8B and Dream 7B, show that dLLM-Cache achieves up to 9.1x FLOPs reduction on LongBench-HotpotQA while maintaining competitive output quality. Notably, our method brings dLLM inference latency close to that of ARMs under many settings. The code for this work is publicly available at: https://github.com/maomaocun/dLLM-cache.

</details>


### [656] [Robust In-Context Reinforcement Learning Under Reward Poisoning Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.06891)
*Paulius Sasnauskas,Yiğit Yalın,Goran Radanović*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出对抗训练框架AT-DPT，通过同时训练攻击者和决策预训练Transformer（DPT），使ICRL在面对奖励投毒攻击时具有更强的鲁棒性，在赌博机环境中显著优于现有鲁棒基线方法，并能泛化到自适应攻击者和MDP等复杂场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有决策预训练Transformer（DPT）在上下文强化学习（ICRL）中易受奖励投毒攻击威胁，缺乏针对性的鲁棒性研究，因此需要提出有效的防御机制。

Method: 提出Adversarially Trained DPT（AT-DPT）对抗训练框架，同时训练一个攻击者群体（通过投毒环境奖励最小化DPT的真实奖励）和一个DPT模型（从被投毒的数据中推断最优动作），形成攻防对抗训练。

Result: AT-DPT在赌博机环境中显著优于包括鲁棒基线在内的标准算法，并成功泛化到自适应攻击者和马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）等更复杂环境。

Conclusion: AT-DPT作为元强化学习方法，在上下文强化学习中展现出学习有效抗污染算法的潜力，为ICRL提供了一种鲁棒性增强的新途径。

Abstract: We study the corruption-robustness of in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL), focusing on the Decision-Pretrained Transformer (DPT, Lee et al., 2023). To address the challenge of reward poisoning attacks targeting the DPT, we propose a novel adversarial training framework, called Adversarially Trained DPT (AT-DPT). Our method simultaneously trains a population of attackers to minimize the true reward of the DPT by poisoning environment rewards, and a DPT model to infer optimal actions from the poisoned data. We evaluate the effectiveness of our approach against standard bandit algorithms, including robust baselines designed to handle reward contamination. Our results show that AT-DPT significantly outperforms them in bandit settings under a learned attacker, and generalizes to more complex environments such as adaptive attackers and MDPs. It shows promise in ICRL as a meta-RL approach to learning effective corruption-robust algorithms.

</details>


### [657] [Formalizing Learning from Language Feedback with Provable Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.10341)
*Wanqiao Xu,Allen Nie,Ruijie Zheng,Aditya Modi,Adith Swaminathan,Ching-An Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文形式化了语言反馈学习（LLF）问题，引入迁移埃尔泽维度来刻画其学习难度，证明了丰富的语言反馈可以比奖励信号带来指数级加速，并提出了具有无遗憾保证的HELiX算法，在多个经验域中表现良好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管基于大语言模型的智能体在交互学习方面取得了令人印象深刻的实证结果，但缺乏对这些决策问题原则性的理论框架。研究者希望从理论上形式化语言反馈学习问题，给出可学习性的充分条件和复杂度度量。

Method: 形式化定义了LLF问题，引入了迁移埃尔泽维度（transfer eluder dimension）作为衡量语言反馈学习难度的指标；基于该维度设计了无遗憾算法HELiX，并通过理论分析给出性能保证。

Result: 证明了丰富语言反馈下的学习可以比从奖励信号中学习快指数级；HELiX算法在多个经验域中表现良好，即使在重复提示LLM不可靠的场景下也有效。

Conclusion: 本文为使用通用语言反馈设计原则性的交互学习算法迈出了重要一步，为语言反馈学习提供了理论基础和可证明的算法。

Abstract: Interactively learning from observation and language feedback is an increasingly studied area driven by the emergence of large language model (LLM) agents. Despite impressive empirical demonstrations, so far a principled framing of these decision problems remains lacking. We formalize the Learning from Language Feedback (LLF) problem, assert sufficient assumptions to enable learning despite latent rewards, and introduce $\textit{transfer eluder dimension}$ as a measure to characterize the hardness of LLF. We formalize the intuition that information in the language feedback governs the learning complexity, and demonstrate cases where learning from rich language feedback can be exponentially faster than learning from reward. We develop a no-regret algorithm, called $\texttt{HELiX}$, that provably solves LLF problems through sequential interactions, with performance guarantees that scale with the transfer eluder dimension. Across several empirical domains, we show that $\texttt{HELiX}$ performs well even when repeatedly prompting LLMs does not work reliably. Our contributions mark an important step towards designing principled interactive learning algorithms using generic language feedback.

</details>


### [658] [The Sample Complexity of Parameter-Free Stochastic Convex Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.11336)
*Jared Lawrence,Ari Kalinsky,Hannah Bradfield,Yair Carmon,Oliver Hinder*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了随机凸优化在问题参数（如到最优点的距离和Lipschitz常数）未知时的样本复杂度，提出了两种策略：一种可靠模型选择方法避免过拟合验证集，以及一种基于正则化的方法专门应对距离未知的情况。实验表明可靠模型选择方法能缓解小验证集上的过拟合问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际应用中随机凸优化问题的最优距离和Lipschitz常数等参数往往是未知的，需要开发不依赖这些参数先验知识的方法。

Method: 提出两种策略：1）可靠模型选择方法，避免过拟合验证集，通用调节学习率达到最优已知参数样本复杂度（忽略log log因子）；2）基于正则化的方法，使用范数正则化经验风险最小化估计最优距离常数因子，实现完全自适应。

Result: 可靠模型选择方法在CIFAR-10小样本微调CLIP模型和Gemini计数形状的实验中缓解了小验证集过拟合问题；两种方法结合可同时自适应多种问题结构。

Conclusion: 提出的方法实现了对未知参数的自适应，展示了无参数随机凸优化中样本复杂度与计算复杂度之间的分离，提供了理论保证。

Abstract: We study the sample complexity of stochastic convex optimization when problem parameters such as the distance to optimality and the Lipschitz constant are unknown. We pursue two strategies. First, we develop a reliable model selection method that avoids overfitting to the validation set. This method allows us to generically tune the learning rate of stochastic optimization methods to match the optimal known-parameter sample complexity up to log log factors. Second, we develop a regularization-based method that is specialized to the case that only the distance to optimality is unknown. More specifically, it uses norm-regularized empirical risk minimization to estimate the distance to optimality to within a constant factor, allowing known-parameter stochastic optimization methods to achieve optimal sample complexity. This method provides perfect adaptability to unknown distance to optimality, demonstrating a separation between the sample and computational complexity of parameter-free stochastic convex optimization. Combining these two methods allows us to simultaneously adapt to multiple problem structures.
  Experiments performing few-shot learning on CIFAR-10 by fine-tuning CLIP models and prompt engineering Gemini to count shapes indicate that our reliable model selection method can help mitigate overfitting to small validation sets.

</details>


### [659] [Structural Decoupling: A Scaffold-Flow Theory of Generalization and Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.20699)
*Xin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出结构学习理论（StrLT），填补统计学习理论（SLT）在非平稳和多上下文环境中未能处理的结构性缺失。StrLT引入"宽度"概念作为核心结构对象，并提出结构解耦原则，将维护结构支架的机制与上下文内优化的机制分离。该理论可解释幻觉、奖励模型边界错误、欺骗性对齐等安全失效问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有统计学习理论（SLT）擅长处理固定情境下的预测与控制（即"漏斗"），但无法应对非平稳和多上下文环境中需要发现上下文、路由输入、保留旧上下文、修订上下文库的结构性挑战。论文旨在填补这一结构性缺失。

Method: 提出结构学习理论（StrLT），核心概念是"宽度"——覆盖一个问题所需的最小局部可行上下文数量。证明宽度与VC维不可比；学习在真实宽度处存在相变；宽度可通过收缩-相似（CS）算子估计，该算子将任务诱导的非收缩性转化为谱分离。基于此提出结构解耦原则：维护结构支架的机制不应与优化上下文内流程的梯度共享同一训练过程。

Result: 三个基本结果：宽度与VC维不可比；学习在真实宽度处出现相变；宽度可通过CS算子估计。结构解耦原则启示支架-流程模型在架构上分离对齐与泛化。

Conclusion: StrLT将幻觉、奖励模型边界错误、欺骗性对齐等安全失效重新解释为支架分辨率或支架维护失败，而非仅仅是输出层级的预测错误。这为理解和解决AI安全问题提供了新的理论视角。

Abstract: Learning in non-stationary and multi-context environments requires more than ordinary within-task generalization. A system must also discover which contexts exist, route inputs to the correct context, preserve old contexts, and revise the context library when the environment changes. This paper presents Structural Learning Theory (StrLT) as a framework of filling this missing structural gap. StrLT complements Vapnik's Statistical Learning Theory (SLT): SLT governs the \emph{funnel}, prediction or control within a fixed regime; while StrLT governs the \emph{trap}, the discovery and maintenance of structural regimes. The core StrLT object is \emph{width}, the minimum number of locally feasible contexts needed to cover a problem. We summarize three basic results: width is incomparable with VC dimension; learning exhibits a phase transition at the true width; and width can be estimated by a contractive-similarity (CS) operator that converts task-induced non-contractivity into spectral separation. Under the StrLT framework, we explain how fixed-class structural learnability leads to a \emph{structural decoupling principle}: the mechanisms that maintain the structural scaffold should not be trained by the same gradients that optimize within-context flow. This principle motivates a scaffold-flow model in which alignment and generalization separate architecturally. Finally, we argue that several safety failures, including hallucination, reward-model boundary errors, and deceptive alignment, can be interpreted as scaffold-resolution or scaffold-preservation failures rather than merely output-level prediction errors.

</details>


### [660] [How Reliable are Fairness Audits with Unreliable Data?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.23033)
*Yash Vardhan Tomar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究公平性审计中受保护标签缺失对审计建议可靠性的影响，引入种子校准压力测试区分缺失效应与随机波动，发现正可用性缺失通常不会改变完整标签下的基线结果，但阈值优化可能将单轴公平性改进转化为跨维度的群体伤害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公平性审计是负责任机器学习部署的关键环节，但在受保护标签不完整的情况下，审计建议的可靠性尚未被充分理解。

Method: 提出种子校准压力测试，在ACS/Folktables任务上评估不同缺失模式（正可用性缺失、无标签端点）对选定的缓解方法的影响，并分析阈值优化的交叉效应。

Result: 正可用性缺失通常不会使缓解方法超出完整标签下的基线波动范围；无标签端点暴露的是ERM等价候选和确定性断点解决而非广泛的缺失效应；阈值优化可将单轴公平性提升转化为高于零基准的交叉群体伤害。

Conclusion: 受保护标签缺失在作为审计脆弱性证据之前，应报告种子空值校准、候选集上下文和交叉群体后果。

Abstract: Fairness audits are a key component of responsible machine-learning deployment. Yet, the reliability of audit recommendations under incomplete protected-label access is still poorly understood. In this work, we focused on protected-label missingness in fairness mitigation audits. We introduced a seed-calibrated stress test to separate missingness effects from seed-to-seed movement that is already present under complete labels. Across ACS/Folktables tasks, we found that positive-availability missingness usually does not move selected mitigation methods beyond the complete-label seed floor. The no-label endpoint behaves differently, exposing ERM-equivalent candidates and deterministic tie-breaking rather than a broad missingness effect. We also found that threshold optimization can turn single-axis fairness gains into above-null intersectional harm, a sharper failure pattern that appears to remain visible under random-forest validation. Overall, our results highlight that protected-label missingness should be reported with seed-null calibration, candidate-set context, and intersectional consequences before it is treated as evidence of audit fragility.

</details>


### [661] [Convergence Bound and Critical Batch Size of Muon Optimizer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.01598)
*Naoki Sato,Hiroki Naganuma,Hideaki Iiduka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对Muon优化器进行了理论分析，提供了其在四种实际设置下的收敛性证明，证明了权重衰减能确保参数和梯度范数的几乎必然有界性，推导了Muon关键批量大小的下界，并通过实验验证了超参数依赖的预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon优化器利用神经网络参数的矩阵结构，在实际应用中表现出优于AdamW等标准优化器的性能，但其理论基础尚不完善。本文旨在为Muon的实际成功提供理论支撑。

Method: 对Muon在四种实际设置下（含/不含Nesterov动量、含/不含权重衰减）进行收敛性证明；分析权重衰减对参数和梯度范数有界性的影响；推导Muon关键批量大小的下界公式。

Result: 证明了权重衰减能确保参数和梯度范数的几乎必然有界性，无需常见的有界梯度假设；推导出关键批量大小的下界，揭示了超参数β（动量）和λ（权重衰减）对该值的定性缩放规律。

Conclusion: Muon优化器具有坚实的理论基础，其成功可归因于对矩阵结构的利用和权重衰减的正则化作用；关键批量大小受超参数β和λ的调控，实验验证了理论预测。

Abstract: Muon, a recently proposed optimizer that leverages the inherent matrix structure of neural network parameters, has demonstrated strong empirical performance, indicating its potential as a successor to standard optimizers such as AdamW. This paper presents theoretical analysis to support its practical success. We provide convergence proofs for Muon across four practical settings, systematically examining its behavior with and without the inclusion of Nesterov momentum and weight decay. We then demonstrate that the addition of weight decay ensures almost-sure boundedness of the parameter and gradient norms -- without relying on the commonly imposed bounded-gradient assumption -- and clarify the interplay between the weight decay coefficient and the learning rate. Finally, we derive a lower bound on the critical batch size for Muon -- the batch size that minimizes the stochastic first-order oracle (SFO) complexity of training. Because the resulting formula involves problem-dependent quantities that are not directly observable (gradient variance, target precision, effective rank), it does not predict the critical batch size in absolute terms; rather, it reveals how the hyperparameters $β$ (momentum) and $λ$ (weight decay) govern the qualitative scaling of this value. Our experiments validate these hyperparameter-dependent predictions across workloads including image classification and language modeling.

</details>


### [662] [Learning Task Mixtures from Task Affinities: A Probabilistic Graphical Model for Supervised Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.12612)
*Prateek Chanda,Saral Sureka,Parth Pratim Chatterjee,Krishnateja Killamsetty,Nikhil Shivakumar Nayak,Ganesh Ramakrishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TaskPGM框架，通过基于能量的模型学习任务混合比例，利用成对势能编码任务间关系，在有限预算下优化混合策略，提升大模型微调性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有监督微调中，异构任务集合上的训练预算分配方式对模型性能影响显著。现有简单启发式方法（如均匀采样或按数据量比例采样）忽略任务间交互，导致负迁移和预算浪费。

Method: 将任务作为马尔可夫随机场的节点：一元势能捕获单任务效用，成对势能通过单任务微调模型的预测分布计算行为散度（如JS散度和PMI）编码任务间关系。优化该能量函数得到平衡覆盖度与冗余度的混合比例，并证明该集合函数在预算约束下具有弱子模性，为离散选择变体提供近似保证。

Result: 在LLaMA-7B和Qwen2-7B等多个模型家族及BIG-Bench Hard评估套件上，TaskPGM优于标准混合策略。

Conclusion: TaskPGM不仅提升微调性能，还提供可解释的任务交互结构。

Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning performance for large language models depends strongly on how training budget is distributed across a heterogeneous set of tasks. In practice, mixtures are often fixed using simple heuristics (e.g., uniform or size-proportional sampling) that ignore task interactions, which can hurt transfer and waste budget on redundant sources. We introduce TaskPGM, a framework for learning continuous task mixtures via an energy-based model over tasks. Tasks form the nodes of a Markov random field: unary potentials capture per-task utility, and pairwise potentials encode inter-task relationships using behavioral divergences computed from predictive distributions of single-task fine-tuned models (e.g., Jensen--Shannon divergence and pointwise mutual information). Optimizing this objective yields mixtures that balance coverage against redundancy. We show that the resulting set function is weakly submodular under budget constraints, enabling approximation guarantees for discrete selection variants. Across multiple model families (LLaMA-7B, Qwen2-7B) and evaluation suites (BIG-Bench Hard), TaskPGM improves over standard mixing strategies and provides interpretable structure over task interactions.

</details>


### [663] [Are Two Datasets Close Enough With Statistical Significance? A Kernel Distributional Closeness Testing Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.12843)
*Zhijian Zhou,Liuhua Peng,Xunye Tian,Mingming Gong,Feng Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的分布距离度量NAMMD（范数自适应最大均值差异），通过利用分布RKHS范数对MMD值进行缩放，使其在分布接近性测试（DCT）中具有更高的检验功效，同时保持有界的I类错误率，实验验证了其在合成噪声和真实图像数据上的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统DCT方法主要针对离散空间上的分布，难以应用于图像等复杂数据。引入MMD到DCT虽自然，但MMD存在信息不足的问题：不同分布对可能具有相同的MMD值，却在RKHS范数上不同，导致有限样本可区分性和实际接近程度不同，使得MMD在DCT中缺乏区分力。

Method: 设计了一种新度量NAMMD，通过分布RKHS范数对MMD值进行自适应缩放；基于NAMMD的渐近分布，构建了NAMMD-based DCT检验方法。

Result: 理论上证明了NAMMD-based DCT比MMD-based DCT具有更高的检验功效，同时保持有界的I类错误。在合成噪声和真实图像等多样数据类型上的实验验证了该方法的优越性。

Conclusion: NAMMD通过引入RKHS范数自适应缩放，有效提升了MMD在分布接近性测试中的区分能力和检验功效，拓展了DCT在复杂数据上的应用范围。

Abstract: Are two distributions close to each other with statistical significance? Distribution closeness testing (DCT) formalizes this question by testing whether the distance between a distribution pair is at least epsilon-far. Existing DCT methods mainly measure discrepancies between distribution pairs defined on discrete spaces, for example using total variation, which limits their application to complex data such as images. To extend DCT to more types of data, a natural idea is to introduce maximum mean discrepancy (MMD), a powerful measure of distributional discrepancy between complex distributions, into DCT scenarios. However, empirical results indicate that many distribution pairs can have the same MMD value despite having different norms in the same reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS). These pairs may exhibit different finite-sample distinguishability and reflect different practical closeness levels, making MMD less informative for DCT. To mitigate this issue, we design a new measure of distributional discrepancy, norm-adaptive MMD (NAMMD), which scales the MMD value using the RKHS norms of distributions. Based on the asymptotic distribution of NAMMD, we propose NAMMD-based DCT to assess the closeness level of a distribution pair. Theoretically, we prove that NAMMD-based DCT has higher test power than MMD-based DCT while maintaining bounded type-I error. This is further validated by extensive experiments on multiple types of data, including synthetic noise and real images. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhijianzhouml/NAMMD.

</details>


### [664] [Disjoint Generation of Synthetic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.19700)
*Anton Danholt Lautrup,Muhammad Rajabinasab,Tobias Hyrup,Arthur Zimek,Peter Schneider-Kamp*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种通过分离生成模型来生成表格合成数据的新框架，将数据集划分为不相交的子集分别训练生成模型，再通过无需共同标识符的连接操作合并结果，在提升隐私性、计算可行性和混合模型合成方面取得了优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格合成数据生成方法通常对整个数据集使用单一生成模型，存在隐私风险高、计算成本大、模型选择受限等问题，因此需要一种既能提升隐私保护又能保持数据效用性的新范式。

Method: 将原始数据集划分为多个不相交的子集，每个子集分别输入独立的生成模型实例进行训练，然后在没有任何共同变量/标识符的情况下，通过一种后验的连接操作将各生成结果合并为完整的合成数据集。

Result: 通过多个案例研究和表格数据实验验证了框架的有效性。混合模型合成在隐私与效用之间取得了高度竞争力的平衡，在下游任务中Accuracy和AUC表现优异，同时显著降低了经验重识别风险。

Conclusion: 分离生成框架能够提升隐私保护水平、增加某些模型类型的计算可行性、支持混合使用不同生成模型，其中混合模型合成尤其能够弥补隐私与效用之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: We propose a new framework for generating tabular synthetic datasets via disjoint generative models. In this paradigm, a dataset is partitioned into disjoint subsets that are supplied to separate instances of generative models. The results are then combined post hoc by a joining operation that works in the absence of common variables/identifiers. The success of the framework is demonstrated through several case studies and examples on tabular data that help illuminate some of the design choices that one may make. The advantages achieved by the disjoint generation include: i) An observed increase in the empirical measurement of privacy. ii) Increased computational feasibility of certain model types. iii) Ability to generate synthetic data using a mixture of different generative models. Specifically, mixed-model synthesis bridges the gap between privacy and utility performance, providing highly competitive performance on Accuracy and Area Under the Curve for downstream tasks while significantly lowering the empirical re-identification risk.

</details>


### [665] [Unsupervised Partner Design Enables Robust Ad-hoc Teamwork](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.06336)
*Constantin Ruhdorfer,Matteo Bortoletto,Victor Oei,Anna Penzkofer,Andreas Bulling*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出无监督伙伴设计(UPD)方法，一种无种群多智能体强化学习方法，通过在线生成并基于可学习性标准自适应选择训练伙伴，在多个基准测试和人类-AI用户研究中表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ad-hoc团队协作方法依赖预先生成的伙伴种群或手动参数调优，限制了方法的泛化性和实用性，亟需一种无需预训练种群且能自适应生成多样化伙伴的方法。

Method: UPD在线生成训练伙伴，并基于可学习性标准自适应选择伙伴；可扩展至联合伙伴-环境选择（当存在程序化关卡生成器时）。

Result: 在Level-Based Foraging、Overcooked-AI及Overcooked泛化挑战中，UPD持续优于基于种群和无种群的基线方法；人类-AI用户研究中，UPD训练的agent获得更高回报，且在适应性、类人性、挫败感方面均优于所有基线。

Conclusion: UPD作为一种简单有效的无种群方法，能够通过自适应伙伴选择机制实现有效的伙伴多样性，在ad-hoc团队协作任务中展现出强大性能，同时具备扩展到环境选择的潜力。

Abstract: We introduce Unsupervised Partner Design (UPD), a population-free multi-agent reinforcement learning method for robust ad-hoc teamwork. UPD generates training partners on-the-fly and selects them adaptively based on a learnability criterion, removing the need for pre-trained partner populations or manual parameter tuning. We show that this simple mechanism enables effective partner diversity and can be extended to joint partner-environment selection when a procedural level generator is available. Across Level-Based Foraging, Overcooked-AI, and the Overcooked Generalisation Challenge, UPD consistently achieves strong performance compared to both population-based and population-free baselines. In a human-AI user study, agents trained with UPD achieve higher returns and are rated as more adaptive, more human-like, and less frustrating than all evaluated baseline methods.

</details>


### [666] [In-Context Reinforcement Learning via Communicative World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.06659)
*Fernando Martinez-Lopez,Tao Li,Yingdong Lu,Juntao Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CORAL框架，通过将上下文强化学习转化为双智能体通信问题，利用预训练的信息智能体(IA)生成可迁移的通信表征，使控制智能体(CA)实现零样本适应和高效学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准RL智能体在新任务中需要更新参数才能泛化，因为其表征和策略过度拟合训练环境，缺乏上下文强化学习(ICRL)能力。

Method: 将ICRL建模为双智能体涌现通信问题。信息智能体(IA)预训练为世界模型，通过因果影响损失(Causal Influence Loss)度量消息对动作的影响来塑造通信协议。部署时，固定IA为控制智能体(CA)提供上下文表征。

Result: CA在多种在线和离线环境中实现了显著的样本效率提升，并借助预训练IA成功进行零样本适应。

Conclusion: 学习可迁移的通信表征是提升ICRL能力的有效途径，功能分离的表征学习与控制可以解决RL泛化问题。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) agents often struggle to generalize to new tasks and contexts without updating their parameters, mainly because their learned representations and policies are overfit to the specifics of their training environments. To boost agents' in-context RL (ICRL) ability, this work formulates ICRL as a two-agent emergent communication problem and introduces CORAL (Communicative Representation for Adaptive RL), a framework that learns a transferable communicative context by functionally separating latent representation learning from control. In CORAL, an Information Agent (IA) is pre-trained as a world model on a diverse distribution of tasks. Its objective is not direct return maximization, but world modeling and distilling its understanding into concise messages. The emergent communication protocol is shaped by a novel Causal Influence Loss, which measures the effect that the message has on the next action. During deployment, the previously trained IA serves as a fixed contextualizer for a new Control Agent (CA), which learns to solve tasks by interpreting the provided communicative context. Our experiments demonstrate that this approach enables the CA to achieve significant gains in sample efficiency and successfully perform zero-shot adaptation with the help of pre-trained IA in diverse online and offline environments, validating the efficacy of learning a transferable communicative representation.

</details>


### [667] [Quantum latent distributions in deep generative models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.19857)
*Omar Bacarreza,Thorin Farnsworth,Alexander Makarovskiy,Hugo Wallner,Tessa Hicks,Santiago Sempere-Llagostera,John Price,Robert J. A. Francis-Jones,William R. Clements*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了量子处理器产生的潜变量分布（量子潜分布）在生成模型中的应用，从理论上证明了在某些条件下量子潜分布能生成经典潜分布无法高效生成的数据分布，并通过理论分析、直觉解释以及在合成量子数据集和QM9分子数据集上的实验验证，表明量子干涉导致的统计特性能够提升生成模型的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管经典生成模型常使用简单的潜变量分布，但分布选择对模型性能影响显著。近期实验表明量子处理器产生的概率分布（高度相关且经典难解）能在某些数据集上带来性能提升，但何时、为何以及这种提升是否与量子特性相关尚不清楚，本文旨在解答这些问题。

Method: 理论证明量子潜分布在某些条件下能生成经典潜分布无法高效生成的数据分布；提供直觉解释说明其在真实数据集上可能优于经典方法的机制；在合成量子数据集和QM9分子数据集上，使用模拟和真实光子量子处理器进行大规模基准测试。

Result: 量子潜分布能生成经典潜分布无法高效生成的数据分布；量子干涉导致的统计特性在合成量子数据集和QM9分子数据集上均展现出优于经典基线的生成性能。

Conclusion: 量子处理器可以通过提供具有量子干涉统计特性的潜变量分布来扩展深度生成模型的能力，在特定条件下具有超越经典方法的理论优势。

Abstract: Many successful families of generative models leverage a low-dimensional latent distribution that is mapped to a data distribution. Though simple latent distributions are often used, the choice of distribution has a strong impact on model performance. Recent experiments have suggested that the probability distributions produced by quantum processors, which are typically highly correlated and classically intractable, can lead to improved performance on some datasets. However, when and why latent distributions produced by quantum processors can improve performance, and whether these improvements are connected to quantum properties of these distributions, are open questions that we investigate in this work. We show in theory that, under certain conditions, these "quantum latent distributions" enable generative models to produce data distributions that classical latent distributions cannot efficiently produce. We provide intuition as to the underlying mechanisms that could explain a performance advantage on real datasets. Based on this, we perform extensive benchmarking on a synthetic quantum dataset and the QM9 molecular dataset, using both simulated and real photonic quantum processors. We find that the statistics arising from quantum interference lead to improved generative performance compared to classical baselines, suggesting that quantum processors can play a role in expanding the capabilities of deep generative models.

</details>


### [668] [Causal Representation Learning from Network Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.01916)
*Jifan Zhang,Michelle M. Li,Elena Zheleva*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GraCE-VAE模型，利用图神经网络编码器结合生物交互网络（如蛋白质相互作用、通路-基因隶属关系）作为辅助信息，改进因果解耦的变分推断，在CRISPR扰动数据上提升干预结果预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果解耦方法假设线性干预忠实性，但未利用观测变量间的已知关系结构（如生物交互网络），而这些结构在科学应用中（如蛋白质相互作用）广泛存在且蕴含重要因果信息。

Method: GraCE-VAE：图神经网络编码器以生物交互图和通路信息为条件，进行摊销推断；因果解码器保持为具有软干预的潜在结构因果模型（SCM），在观测和干预数据上联合学习。

Result: 在三个CRISPR扰动数据集上，利用结构化生物上下文显著提升了干预结果（包括未见过的干预组合）的预测性能，并继承了因果差异VAE的可识别性保证。

Conclusion: 将已知关系结构（如生物网络）作为辅助信息引入因果解耦框架，既能保持可识别性保证，又能提升干预预测效果，尤其对未见过的干预组合泛化能力更强。

Abstract: Causal disentanglement from soft interventions is identifiable under the assumptions of linear interventional faithfulness and availability of both observational and interventional data. Prior work has focused on unstructured observations without leveraging known relational context among measured entities. In many scientific applications, however, the measured variables come with an observed interaction network that provides structured context, such as protein-protein interactions and pathway-gene membership. We propose GraCE-VAE, a graph-aware causal discrepancy variational autoencoder that treats pathway-level information as an auxiliary view of the latent causal programs. The graph neural network encoder conditions on this auxiliary pathway view and the biological graph to improve amortized inference, while the causal decoder remains a latent SCM with soft interventions. Assuming samples are i.i.d. within each intervention regime, we show that GraCE-VAE inherits the identifiability guarantees of causal discrepancy VAEs and identifies the latent causal graph and intervention targets up to the standard equivalence class. Experiments on three CRISPR perturbation datasets demonstrate that leveraging structured biological context improves prediction of interventional outcomes, including unseen perturbation combinations.

</details>


### [669] [Decoupling the "What" and "Where" With Polar Coordinate Positional Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.10534)
*Anand Gopalakrishnan,Robert Csordás,Jürgen Schmidhuber,Michael C. Mozer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文分析了RoPE位置编码中"内容"与"位置"信息纠缠的问题，提出极化坐标位置编码（PoPE）来消除这种混淆，在诊断任务、自回归序列建模（音乐、基因组、自然语言）以及零样本长度外推方面均优于RoPE和YaRN。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RoPE位置编码中内容和位置信息存在纠缠，当任务需要独立匹配这两个因素时，这种纠缠会损害模型性能。

Method: 提出极化坐标位置嵌入（PoPE），消除RoPE中内容和位置的混淆，使Transformer能独立地基于内容或位置进行匹配。

Result: 在诊断任务上，PoPE在纯位置索引和纯内容索引上远优于RoPE；在音乐、基因组和自然语言的自回归序列建模中，PoPE在困惑度和下游任务上均优于RoPE；在语言模型上，从124M到774M参数规模下增益持续存在；PoPE在零样本长度外推上强于RoPE和需要微调与频率插值的YaRN。

Conclusion: PoPE通过解耦内容和位置信息，有效提升了Transformer在多种序列建模任务上的性能和长度外推能力。

Abstract: The attention mechanism in a Transformer architecture matches key to query based on both content -- the what -- and position in a sequence -- the where. We present an analysis indicating that what and where are entangled in the popular RoPE rotary position embedding. This entanglement can impair performance particularly when decisions require independent matches on these two factors. We propose an improvement to RoPE, which we call Polar Coordinate Position Embeddings or PoPE, that eliminates the what-where confound. PoPE is far superior on a diagnostic task requiring indexing solely by position or by content. On autoregressive sequence modeling in music, genomic, and natural language domains, Transformers using PoPE as the positional encoding scheme outperform baselines using RoPE with respect to evaluation loss (perplexity) and downstream task performance. On language modeling, these gains persist across model scale, from 124M to 774M parameters. Crucially, PoPE shows strong zero-shot length extrapolation capabilities compared not only to RoPE but even a method designed for extrapolation, YaRN, which requires additional fine tuning and frequency interpolation.

</details>


### [670] [Similarity-Distance-Magnitude Activations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.12760)
*Allen Schmaltz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SDM激活函数（替代Softmax），融合相似度（训练深度匹配）、距离（到训练分布的距离）和幅度（决策边界）三种感知能力，并基于SDM估计器实现选择性分类中类别与预测条件准确率的可控性，在预训练语言模型上对协变量偏移和分布外输入更鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准Softmax激活函数仅具备输出幅度（决策边界）感知能力，缺乏对样本与训练数据相似度、距离分布信息的利用，导致在协变量偏移和分布外输入场景下校准性能下降。

Method: 1) 提出SDM激活函数，在Softmax基础上增加相似度感知（正确预测的深度匹配）和距离感知（到训练分布的距离）；2) 提出SDM估计器，基于数据驱动的类别经验CDF划分，通过SDM激活控制类别和预测条件准确率；3) 在预训练语言模型上作为最终层激活用于选择性分类。

Result: SDM估计器在协变量偏移和分布外输入上比现有基于Softmax的校准方法更鲁棒，同时在分布内数据上保持信息量。

Conclusion: SDM激活函数及其估计器为选择性分类提供了更鲁棒且可解释的方案，通过密集匹配实现基于示例的可解释性。

Abstract: We introduce the Similarity-Distance-Magnitude (SDM) activation function, a more robust and interpretable formulation of the standard softmax activation function, adding Similarity (i.e., correctly predicted depth-matches into training) awareness and Distance-to-training-distribution awareness to the existing output Magnitude (i.e., decision-boundary) awareness, and enabling interpretability-by-exemplar via dense matching. We further introduce the SDM estimator, based on a data-driven partitioning of the class-wise empirical CDFs via the SDM activation, to control the class- and prediction-conditional accuracy among selective classifications. When used as the final-layer activation over pre-trained language models for selective classification, the SDM estimator is more robust to covariate shifts and out-of-distribution inputs than existing calibration methods using softmax activations, while remaining informative over in-distribution data.

</details>


### [671] [LiMuon: Light and Fast Muon Optimizer for Large Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14562)
*Feihu Huang,Yuning Luo,Songcan Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 LiMuon 优化器，基于动量方差缩减技术和随机 SVD，在降低内存和样本复杂度的同时高效训练大模型，理论证明达到 O(ε⁻³) 样本复杂度，实验验证在 Mamba-130M、Qwen2.5-0.5B 和 ViT 上的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Muon 优化器及其变体在大模型训练中存在样本复杂度高或内存占用高的问题，亟需一种兼具低内存和低样本复杂度的优化方法。

Method: 基于动量方差缩减技术和随机奇异值分解（SVD），设计轻量快速的 LiMuon 优化器；针对 Newton-Schulz 步骤也给出了理论分析。

Result: 在非凸随机优化广义光滑条件下达到 O(ε⁻³) 样本复杂度；与 Muon 及其变体相比，内存和样本复杂度均更低；Newton-Schulz 版本的样本复杂度也优于 Muon+Newton-Schulz；Mamba-130M、Qwen2.5-0.5B 和 ViT 实验验证有效性。

Conclusion: LiMuon 是一种兼具低内存和低样本复杂度的大模型训练优化器，有效缩小了理论与实践的差距。

Abstract: Large models recently are widely applied in machine learning, so efficient training of large models has received widespread attention. More recently, the useful Muon optimizer is specifically designed for matrix-structured parameters of large models. Although some works have begun to study the Muon optimizer, the existing Muon and its variants still suffer from high sample complexity or high memory for large models. To fill this gap, we propose a light and fast Muon (LiMuon) optimizer for training large models, which builds on the momentum-based variance reduced technique and randomized Singular Value Decomposition (SVD). In particular, our LiMuon simultaneously has a lower memory and lower sample complexity than the Muon and its variants. Moreover, we prove that our LiMuon with lower memory has a lower sample complexity of $O(ε^{-3})$ for finding an $ε$-stationary solution of non-convex stochastic optimization under the generalized smoothness condition. To further narrow practice and theory gap, we also prove that our LiMuon with Newton-Schulz steps has a lower sample complexity than the Muon with Newton-Schulz steps. Numerical experimental results on training Mamba-130M, Qwen2.5-0.5B and ViT models demonstrate effectiveness of our LiMuon.

</details>


### [672] [Multi-resolution Enhancement for Full Spectrum Neural Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.15494)
