### [711] [Nonparametric LLM Evaluation from Preference Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.21816)
*Dennis Frauen,Athiya Deviyani,Mihaela van der Schaar,Stefan Feuerriegel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个非参数统计框架DMLRank，利用去偏机器学习从人类偏好数据中对大语言模型进行比较和排名，通过广义平均排名分数(GARS)统一了Bradley-Terry模型和PageRank等经典模型，支持黑箱机器学习方法、预训练LLM评估器，并能给出预算约束下的最优数据收集策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有从人类偏好数据评估LLM性能的方法要么依赖严格的参数假设，要么在使用灵活机器学习方法时缺乏有效的量化不确定性，因此需要一种既灵活又具有有效统计推断能力的排名框架。

Method: 提出DMLRank框架，引入广义平均排名分数(GARS)统一多种排名模型；利用去偏机器学习(DML)进行非参数估计，支持黑箱机器学习方法；可与预训练LLM评估器结合；提供预算约束下的最优偏好数据收集策略。

Result: 产生统计有效的GARS排名分数估计；自然允许融入黑箱机器学习方法；可与预训练LLM评估器结合；给出预算约束下的最优数据收集策略；在合成和真实偏好数据集上均验证了理论优势。

Conclusion: DMLRank框架为LLM排行榜的构建提供了强大且先进的比较与排名方法，兼具统计效率、灵活性和实用性。

Abstract: Evaluating the performance of large language models (LLMs) from human preference data is crucial for obtaining LLM leaderboards. However, many existing approaches either rely on restrictive parametric assumptions or lack valid uncertainty quantification when flexible machine learning methods are used. In this paper, we propose a nonparametric statistical framework, called DMLRank, for comparing and ranking LLMs from preference data using debiased machine learning (DML). For this, we introduce generalized average ranking scores (GARS), which generalize commonly used ranking models, including the Bradley-Terry model or PageRank/ Rank centrality, with complex human responses such as ties. DMLRank comes with the following advantages: (i)~It produces statistically efficient estimates of GARS ranking scores. (ii) It naturally allows the incorporation of black-box machine learning methods for estimation. (iii) It can be combined with pre-trained LLM evaluators (e.g., using LLM-as-a-judge). (iv) It suggests optimal policies for collecting preference data under budget constraints. We demonstrate these advantages both theoretically and empirically using both synthetic and real-world preference datasets. In summary, our framework provides practitioners with powerful, state-of-the-art methods for comparing or ranking LLMs for leaderboards.

</details>


### [712] [Latent Spherical Flow Policy for Reinforcement Learning with Combinatorial Actions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22211)
*Lingkai Kong,Anagha Satish,Hezi Jiang,Akseli Kangaslahti,Andrew Ma,Wenbo Chen,Mingxiao Song,Lily Xu,Milind Tambe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LSFlow，一种基于潜变量球面流匹配的随机策略方法，通过将策略学习与组合优化求解器结合，在保证可行性的同时实现高效的组合动作空间强化学习，平均性能优于基线20.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组合动作空间的强化学习面临动作集指数级庞大且受复杂可行性约束的挑战，现有方法或牺牲通用性、或限制策略表达能力，缺乏一种兼具表达力和可行性保证的随机策略方法。

Method: 在紧凑连续潜空间中通过球面流匹配学习随机策略，利用组合优化求解器将潜变量样本映射为有效结构化动作；在潜空间中直接训练价值网络以避免重复求解器调用；引入平滑贝尔曼算子处理求解器导致的非连续值函数景观。

Result: 在多个具有挑战性的组合RL任务中，LSFlow平均优于现有最先进基线20.6%。

Conclusion: LSFlow通过将现代生成式策略的表达力与求解器的可行性保证相结合，为组合动作空间RL提供了一种高效且通用的解决方案，平滑贝尔曼算子的引入稳定了学习过程。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) with combinatorial action spaces remains challenging because feasible action sets are exponentially large and governed by complex feasibility constraints, making direct policy parameterization impractical. Existing approaches embed task-specific value functions into constrained optimization programs or learn deterministic structured policies, sacrificing generality and policy expressiveness. We propose a solver-induced \emph{latent spherical flow policy} that brings the expressiveness of modern generative policies to combinatorial RL while guaranteeing feasibility by design. Our method, LSFlow, learns a \emph{stochastic} policy in a compact continuous latent space via spherical flow matching, and delegates feasibility to a combinatorial optimization solver that maps each latent sample to a valid structured action. To improve efficiency, we train the value network directly in the latent space, avoiding repeated solver calls during policy optimization. To address the piecewise-constant and discontinuous value landscape induced by solver-based action selection, we introduce a smoothed Bellman operator that yields stable, well-defined learning targets. Empirically, our approach outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by an average of 20.6\% across a range of challenging combinatorial RL tasks.

</details>


### [713] [Beyond Fixed Rounds: Data-Free Early Stopping for Practical Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22669)
*Youngjoon Lee,Hyukjoon Lee,Seungrok Jung,Andy Luo,Jinu Gong,Yang Cao,Joonhyuk Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无需数据（data-free）的联邦学习早停框架，通过监控服务器端任务向量的增长率来确定最优停止点，无需依赖验证数据或固定轮次。在皮肤病变/血细胞/结肠病理分类任务上，该方法与基于验证的早停效果相当，且平均仅需额外9-31轮即可显著提升性能（3.9%-12.3%），同时能以极少的额外轮次（<3%固定预算）筛选不良配置。这是首个面向联邦学习的数据无关早停框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习依赖固定全局轮次或验证数据进行超参数调优，导致计算成本高、隐私风险大，阻碍了实际部署。因此需要一种无需数据、仅利用服务端参数即可确定最优停止点的早停方法。

Method: 提出一种数据无关的早停框架，通过仅利用服务端参数监控任务向量（task vector）的增长率来决定最优停止点，完全避免了对验证数据的依赖。

Result: 在皮肤病变、血细胞、结肠病理三个医学图像分类任务上，该方法与基于验证数据的早停在多种先进FL方法上性能相当。具体地，相比验证早停，该方法平均仅需额外45/12/31轮即可实现12.3%/8.9%/3.9%的性能提升；在筛选不良配置时，仅需额外9/8/14轮，不足固定预算的3%。

Conclusion: 这是首个针对联邦学习提出的数据无关早停框架，能够有效替代基于验证数据的早停方法，在降低计算成本和隐私风险的同时保持甚至提升模型性能，为FL的实际部署提供了一种实用方案。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) facilitates decentralized collaborative learning without transmitting raw data. However, reliance on fixed global rounds or validation data for hyperparameter tuning hinders practical deployment by incurring high computational costs and privacy risks. To address this, we propose a data-free early stopping framework that determines the optimal stopping point by monitoring the task vector's growth rate using only server-side parameters. The numerical results on skin lesion/blood cell/colon pathology classification demonstrate that our approach is comparable to the validation-based early stopping across various state-of-the-art FL methods. In particular, the proposed framework requires an average of 45/12/31 (skin lesion/blood cell/colon pathology) additional rounds to achieve over 12.3%/8.9%/3.9% higher performance than early stopping based on validation data. Moreover, the proposed framework requires only 9/8/14 additional rounds to screen bad configurations, which is less than 3% of the fixed-round budget. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to propose a data-free early stopping framework for FL methods. Our code is available at this open repository.

</details>


### [714] [UA-DCM: Uncertainty-aware Causal Decision Making via Effect Bound Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22736)
*Md Musfiqur Rahman,Ziwei Jiang,Hilaf Hasson,Murat Kocaoglu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种新框架，能够区分因果效应值中哪些可能通过收集更多观测样本被消除，哪些即使增加样本也无法消除（高概率），从而帮助决策者判断何时应停止收集观测数据并转向非观测研究或测量未观测混杂因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果效应上下界估计方法（如符号方法和神经网络方法）虽然融合了识别不确定性和有限样本不确定性，但无法告知收集更多样本是否有助于确定最优行动，导致决策者无法优化数据收集策略。

Method: 通过求解max-min和min-max优化问题，将因果效应值的取值范围划分为两个部分：可能通过增加样本消除的部分，以及高概率无法通过更多观测样本消除的部分。实践中利用神经因果模型近似实现该分解。

Result: 在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验表明，该算法能够有效判断何时收集更多样本无助于确定最优行动。

Conclusion: 该框架可帮助实践者在决策时决定何时应转向非观测研究或测量未观测混杂因素，从而优化数据收集和决策策略。

Abstract: Causal inference from observational data can provide strong evidence for finding the best action in a decision-making scenario without having to perform expensive randomized trials. The causal effect of an action is often not pointwise identifiable even with infinite data due to unobserved confounding factors. Furthermore, having only finitely many samples adds another layer of uncertainty to causal effect estimation. Several existing methods can be used to obtain upper and lower bounds to the causal effect, ranging from symbolic methods to the more recent neural network-based approaches, which implicitly incorporate both sources of uncertainty. However, these methods do not inform whether collecting more samples may or may not help identify the best action from observational data, leaving experts in the dark about their data collection strategies. We address this problem with a novel framework that can distinguish the range of causal effect values that might be eliminated by collecting more samples from the range of values that, with high probability, cannot be eliminated with more observational samples. We show that this partitioning can be obtained by solving max-min and min-max optimization problems. We leverage neural causal models to approximately recover this decomposition in practice. We demonstrate via experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets that our algorithm can determine when collecting more samples will not help determine the best action. Our framework can help practitioners decide when to resort to non-observational studies or seek to measure some of the unmeasured confounders for optimal decision-making.

</details>


### [715] [Optimal Fair Aggregation of Crowdsourced Noisy Labels using Demographic Parity Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.23221)
*Gabriel Singer,Samuel Gruffaz,Olivier Vo Van,Nicolas Vayatis,Argyris Kalogeratos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了众包标注聚合中的公平性问题，分析了多数投票和最优贝叶斯聚合在ε-公平框架下的表现，推导了小众包规模下公平性差距的上界，证明了聚合共识的公平性差距以指数速度收敛到真实标签，并将公平性后处理算法从连续设置推广到离散设置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 众包标注聚合中的主观偏差可能放大个体偏见，引发公平性问题，但现有研究缺乏收敛性保证且仅有有限的后处理方法。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 在ε-公平框架下分析多数投票和最优贝叶斯聚合的公平性；推导小众包规模下公平性差距上界；证明聚合共识公平性差距的指数收敛性；将多类公平性后处理算法从连续设置推广到离散设置以实施严格的群体平等约束。

Result: 推导出多数投票法的公平性差距上界与个体标注者公平性差距相关；聚合共识的公平性差距在可解释条件下指数收敛到真实标签；提出的离散公平性后处理算法可应用于任意聚合规则。

Conclusion: 基于合成数据和真实数据的实验验证了方法的有效性并支持了理论分析结果。

Abstract: As acquiring reliable ground-truth labels is usually costly, or infeasible, crowdsourcing and aggregation of noisy human annotations is the typical resort. Aggregating subjective labels, though, may amplify individual biases, particularly regarding sensitive features, raising fairness concerns. Nonetheless, fairness in crowdsourced aggregation remains largely unexplored, with no existing convergence guarantees and only limited post-processing approaches for enforcing $\varepsilon$-fairness under demographic parity. We address this gap by analyzing the fairness s of crowdsourced aggregation methods within the $\varepsilon$-fairness framework, for Majority Vote and Optimal Bayesian aggregation. In the small-crowd regime, we derive an upper bound on the fairness gap of Majority Vote in terms of the fairness gaps of the individual annotators. We further show that the fairness gap of the aggregated consensus converges exponentially fast to that of the ground-truth under interpretable conditions. Since ground-truth itself may still be unfair, we generalize a state-of-the-art multiclass fairness post-processing algorithm from the continuous to the discrete setting, which enforces strict demographic parity constraints to any aggregation rule. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach and corroborate the theoretical insights.

</details>


### [716] [Your Self-Play Algorithm is Secretly an Adversarial Imitator: Understanding LLM Self-Play through the Lens of Imitation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01357)
*Shangzhe Li,Xuchao Zhang,Chetan Bansal,Weitong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过将自对弈微调与对抗模仿学习相联系，建立了统一的理论框架，并基于χ²散度提出了新的自对弈算法，在多个语言模型微调任务上取得了一致改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自对弈后训练方法已被证明能有效微调大语言模型，但其理论基础尚不清晰，缺乏系统的理论分析。

Method: 将自对弈微调表述为模型与以自身参数化的正则化隐式奖励玩家之间的最小最大博弈，连接自对弈模仿与偏好对齐；基于χ²散度变分目标提出新的自对弈模仿微调算法，具有有界奖励和改进的稳定性。

Result: 在多种语言模型微调任务上，所提方法相较于现有自对弈方法取得了一致且稳定的性能提升。

Conclusion: 自对弈微调最终会收敛到其均衡点，所提理论框架和算法有效且具有实践指导意义。

Abstract: Self-play post-training methods has emerged as an effective approach for finetuning large language models and turn the weak language model into strong language model without preference data. However, the theoretical foundations for self-play finetuning remain underexplored. In this work, we tackle this by connecting self-play finetuning with adversarial imitation learning by formulating finetuning procedure as a min-max game between the model and a regularized implicit reward player parameterized by the model itself. This perspective unifies self-play imitation and general preference alignment within a common framework. Under this formulation, we present a game-theoretic analysis showing that the self-play finetuning will converge to it's equilibrium. Guided by this theoretical formulation, we propose a new self-play imitation finetuning algorithm based on the $χ^2$-divergence variational objective with bounded rewards and improved stability. Experiments on various of language model finetuning tasks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing self-play methods and validate our theoretical insights.

</details>


### [717] [Reward Shaping for (Inference-Time) Alignment: A Stackelberg Game Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02572)
*Haichuan Wang,Tao Lin,Lingkai Kong,Ce Li,Hezi Jiang,Milind Tambe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出现有基于KL正则化的对齐方法会使LLM继承基础策略中与用户偏好冲突的偏差，并提出将奖励模型优化形式化为Stackelberg博弈，通过简单的奖励塑形方案来近似最优奖励模型，实验表明该方法能无缝集成到现有对齐方法中，平均胜率超过66%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对齐方法在使用奖励模型优化LLM策略时，KL正则化可能导致模型继承基础策略中与用户偏好冲突的偏差，同时放大奖励会带来奖励破解风险，需要在两者间寻找最优权衡。

Method: 将奖励模型优化问题形式化为Stackelberg博弈，提出一种简单的奖励塑形方案来近似最优奖励模型。

Result: 在推理时对齐设置中，该方法可无缝集成到现有对齐方法中，持续提升平均奖励，在所有评估设置下平均胜率超过66%。

Conclusion: 通过Stackelberg博弈框架和奖励塑形，可以有效缓解KL正则化带来的偏差继承问题，同时控制奖励破解风险，提升对齐效果。

Abstract: Existing alignment methods directly use the reward model learned from user preference data to optimize an LLM policy, subject to KL regularization with respect to the base policy. This practice is suboptimal for maximizing user's utility because the KL regularization may cause the LLM to inherit the bias in the base policy that conflicts with user preferences. While amplifying rewards for preferred outputs can mitigate this bias, it also increases the risk of reward hacking. This tradeoff motivates the problem of optimally designing reward models under KL regularization. We formalize this reward model optimization problem as a Stackelberg game, and show that a simple reward shaping scheme can effectively approximate the optimal reward model. We empirically evaluate our method in inference-time alignment settings and demonstrate that it integrates seamlessly into existing alignment methods with minimal overhead. Our method consistently improves average reward and achieves win-tie rates exceeding 66% against all baselines, averaged across evaluation settings.

</details>


### [718] [The Label Horizon Paradox: Rethinking Supervision Targets in Financial Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03395)
*Chen-Hui Song,Shuoling Liu,Liyuan Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文挑战了金融预测中标签必须与推理目标严格对齐的传统假设，发现了"标签视界悖论"：最优监督信号往往偏离预测目标，而位于由市场动态决定的中间视界。作者通过动态信噪比权衡进行理论解释，并提出双层优化框架在单次训练中自动识别最优代理标签，实验证明该方法显著优于传统基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习在金融预测中取得了巨大成功，但监督信号本身的设计却极少受到审视。作者挑战标签必须严格对齐推理目标的经典假设，试图揭示并解决其中的矛盾。

Method: 1) 理论层面：提出动态信噪比权衡（动态信噪比权衡），论证泛化性能取决于边际信号实现与噪声积累之间的竞争；2) 方法层面：提出双层优化框架，在单次训练中自动识别最优代理标签，无需额外调参。

Result: 在大规模金融数据集上的大量实验表明，所提方法相较于传统基线取得了一致的性能提升。

Conclusion: 标签视界悖论揭示了金融预测中监督信号设计的新方向，为标签中心研究开辟了新途径，表明最优训练标签可能并非推理目标本身。

Abstract: While deep learning has revolutionized financial forecasting through sophisticated architectures, the design of the supervision signal itself is rarely scrutinized. We challenge the canonical assumption that training labels must strictly mirror inference targets, uncovering the Label Horizon Paradox: the optimal supervision signal often deviates from the prediction goal, shifting across intermediate horizons governed by market dynamics. We theoretically ground this phenomenon in a dynamic signal-noise trade-off, demonstrating that generalization hinges on the competition between marginal signal realization and noise accumulation. To operationalize this insight, we propose a bi-level optimization framework that autonomously identifies the optimal proxy label within a single training run. Extensive experiments on large-scale financial datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over conventional baselines, thereby opening new avenues for label-centric research in financial forecasting.

</details>


### [719] [On the Superlinear Relationship between SGD Noise Covariance and Loss Landscape Curvature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.05600)
*Yikuan Zhang,Ning Yang,Yuhai Tu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现SGD的噪声协方差矩阵与Hessian矩阵之间并非简单的正比关系，而是存在更一般的近似交换关系，且在多层感知机中二者对角元满足层相关的幂律关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前工作通常假设Fisher信息矩阵与Hessian等价，从而声称SGD噪声协方差正比于Hessian。作者试图检验这一假设在深度神经网络中的有效性，并探索更一般化的噪声-曲率关系。

Method: 利用Activity--Weight Duality理论，推导出噪声协方差与每样本Hessian平方的期望成正比的一般关系；并在全连接层中对角元进行幂律拟合分析，通过跨数据集、架构和损失函数的实验验证。

Result: 发现C与H近似交换而非严格相等；对角元满足C_{ii} ∝ H_{ii}^γ，其中γ为层相关的指数，范围1≤γ≤2。

Conclusion: SGD噪声与曲率的关系比以往假设更为复杂，本文给出了一个统一的层间分界刻画，为理解SGD的隐式偏差提供了新视角。

Abstract: Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) introduces anisotropic noise that is correlated with the local curvature of the loss landscape, thereby biasing optimization toward flat minima. Prior work often assumes an equivalence between the Fisher Information Matrix and the Hessian for negative log-likelihood losses, leading to the claim that the SGD noise covariance $\mathbf{C}$ is proportional to the Hessian $\mathbf{H}$. We show that this assumption holds only under restrictive conditions that are typically violated in deep neural networks. Using the recently discovered Activity--Weight Duality, we find a more general relationship agnostic to the specific loss formulation, showing that $\mathbf{C} \propto \mathbb{E}_p[\mathbf{h}_p^2]$, where $\mathbf{h}_p$ denotes the per-sample Hessian with $\mathbf{H} = \mathbb{E}_p[\mathbf{h}_p]$. As a consequence, $\mathbf{C}$ and $\mathbf{H}$ commute approximately rather than coincide exactly. We further find that, within the analyzed fully connected layers, their diagonal elements follow per-layer empirical power laws $C_{ii} \propto H_{ii}^γ$, with layer-dependent fitted exponents bounded by $1 \leq γ\leq 2$. Experiments across datasets, architectures, and loss functions support the resulting layerwise bounds, providing a unified characterization of the noise-curvature relationship in deep learning.

</details>


### [720] [Variational Speculative Decoding: Rethinking Draft Training from Token Likelihood to Sequence Acceptance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.05774)
*Xiandong Zou,Jianshu Li,Jing Huang,Pan Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出变分推测解码（VSD），将草稿训练建模为潜变量（草稿路径）上的变分推断，通过最大化目标模型接受概率的ELBO，结合期望最大化（EM）过程与路径级效用、自适应拒绝加权和置信感知正则化，显著提升了LLM/MLLM的推理加速效果，相比EAGLE-3和ViSpec分别获得最高9.6%和7.9%的加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推测解码方法存在训练-解码不一致问题：训练时优化单一贪心轨迹，而解码时需验证和排序多个采样草稿路径，这种不匹配限制了推理效率的提升。

Method: 1) 将草稿训练形式化为潜变量（草稿路径）上的变分推断，最大化目标模型接受概率的ELBO；2) 引入路径级效用降低方差；3) 采用期望最大化（EM）过程：E步从经过滤的后验中采样蒙特卡洛样本，M步使用自适应拒绝加权（ARW）和置信感知正则化（CAR）最大化加权似然。

Result: 在多个LLM和MLLM上的实验表明，VSD相比EAGLE-3最高获得9.6%的加速，相比ViSpec最高获得7.9%的加速。

Conclusion: VSD通过变分推断框架解决了推测解码中的训练-解码不一致问题，理论分析和实验均证实其能有效提升期望接受长度和推理加速比，显著提高解码效率。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates inference for (M)LLMs, yet a training-decoding discrepancy persists: while existing methods optimize single greedy trajectories, decoding involves verifying and ranking multiple sampled draft paths. We propose Variational Speculative Decoding (VSD), formulating draft training as variational inference over latent proposals (draft paths). VSD maximizes the marginal probability of target-model acceptance, yielding an ELBO that promotes high-quality latent proposals while minimizing divergence from the target distribution. To enhance quality and reduce variance, we incorporate a path-level utility and optimize via an Expectation-Maximization procedure. The E-step draws Monte Carlo samples from an oracle-filtered posterior, while the M-step maximizes weighted likelihood using Adaptive Rejection Weighting (ARW) and Confidence-Aware Regularization (CAR). Theoretical analysis confirms that VSD increases expected acceptance length and speedup. Extensive experiments across LLMs and MLLMs show that VSD achieves up to a 9.6% speedup over EAGLE-3 and 7.9% over ViSpec, significantly improving decoding efficiency.

</details>


### [721] [Foundation Inference Models for Ordinary Differential Equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.08733)
*Maximilian Mauel,Johannes R. Hübers,David Berghaus,Patrick Seifner,Ramses J. Sanchez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FIM-ODE是一个预训练的基础推理模型，能从含噪轨迹数据中直接预测ODE向量场，在零样本和微调场景下均表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从含噪轨迹数据中推断ODE向量场是科学建模的核心问题，但现有方法（符号回归、高斯过程、神经常微分方程）要么需要复杂的训练流程和机器学习专业知识，要么严重依赖系统特定的先验知识。

Method: 提出FIM-ODE，一个预训练的基础推理模型。在低阶多项式向量场ODE的先验分布上进行预训练，使用神经算子表示目标场，能从含噪轨迹数据中直接预测向量场，仅需一次前向传播。

Result: FIM-ODE在零样本设置下达到与ODEFormer相当或更优的性能；作为微调初始化时，收敛快速且稳定，超越现代神经方法和GP基线。

Conclusion: FIM-ODE以更简单的预训练先验分布实现了与更复杂的符号基线相当的性能，且微调适应性强，降低了对机器学习专业知识的需求。

Abstract: Ordinary differential equations (ODEs) are central to scientific modelling, but inferring their vector fields from noisy trajectories remains challenging. Current approaches such as symbolic regression, Gaussian process (GP) regression, and Neural ODEs often require complex training pipelines and substantial machine learning expertise, or they depend strongly on system-specific prior knowledge. We propose FIM-ODE, a pretrained Foundation Inference Model that amortises low-dimensional ODE inference by predicting the vector field directly from noisy trajectory data in a single forward pass. We pretrain FIM-ODE on a prior distribution over ODEs with low-degree polynomial vector fields and represent the target field with neural operators. FIM-ODE achieves strong zero-shot performance, matching and often improving upon ODEFormer, a recent pretrained symbolic baseline, across a range of regimes despite using a simpler pretraining prior distribution. Pretraining also provides a strong initialisation for finetuning, enabling fast and stable adaptation that outperforms modern neural and GP baselines without requiring machine learning expertise.

</details>


### [722] [A Graphop Analysis of Graph Neural Networks on Sparse Graphs: Generalization and Universal Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.08785)
*Ofek Amran,Tom Gilat,Ron Levie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种统一的度量空间方法，使得消息传递图神经网络（MPNNs）在任意大小的稀疏和稠密图上都满足等度连续性，从而得到更强的通用逼近定理和泛化界限。该理论基于并扩展了图算子分析这一图极限理论方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的MPNN泛化能力分析存在分裂：要么适用于任意大小但仅限于稠密图，要么适用于稀疏图但仅限于有界大小图。缺少一个能够统一处理稀疏和稠密图且允许图大小无界的理论框架。

Method: 基于图算子分析（graphop analysis）这一图极限理论，定义了一个紧度量空间，该空间包含所有大小的图（包括稀疏和稠密），并证明在此度量下MPNNs是等度连续的。

Result: 得到了比以往工作更强的通用逼近定理和泛化界限，首次在统一框架下处理了任意大小图的稀疏与稠密情形。

Conclusion: 该工作弥合了现有MPNN理论研究在稠密图与稀疏图之间的鸿沟，为图神经网络的理论分析提供了更统一的视角。

Abstract: Generalization and approximation capabilities of message passing graph neural networks (MPNNs) are often studied by defining a compact metric on a space of input graphs under which MPNNs are equicontinuous. Such analyses are of two varieties: 1) when the metric space includes graphs of unbounded sizes, the theory is only appropriate for dense graphs, and, 2) when studying sparse graphs, the metric space only includes graphs of uniformly bounded size. In this work, we present a unified approach, defining a compact metric on the space of graphs of all sizes, both sparse and dense, under which MPNNs are equicontinuous. This leads to more powerful universal approximation theorems and generalization bounds than previous works. The theory is based on, and extends, a recent approach to graph limit theory called graphop analysis.

</details>


### [723] [On the Complexity of Offline Reinforcement Learning with $Q^\star$-Approximation and Partial Coverage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.12107)
*Haolin Liu,Braham Snyder,Chen-Yu Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了在Q*近似和部分覆盖下的离线强化学习，通过信息论下界否定了Q*可实现性和Bellman完备性足以实现样本高效离线强化学习的猜想，并提出了一个通用的决策-估计框架来统一和改进了现有结果，包括首次获得ε^{-2}样本复杂度、消除额外在线交互需求，以及首次刻画了低Bellman秩MDP的离线可学习性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有离线强化学习算法（如CQL）在实践中取得了成功，但在Q*近似和部分覆盖设定下缺乏充分的理论理解。一个核心开放问题是：Q*可实现性和Bellman完备性是否足以保证样本高效的离线强化学习？本文旨在回答这一问题并探索足以实现高效学习的额外结构。

Method: 1) 通过信息论下界否定猜想；2) 提出通用决策-估计框架（受DEC启发），将离线RL复杂度分解为决策复杂度和值估计误差两部分，进行模块化研究；3) 在该框架下统一、改进和推广现有结果。

Result: 1) Q*可实现性和Bellman完备性在部分覆盖下不足以实现样本高效离线RL（信息论下界）；2) Soft Q-learning在部分覆盖下首次达到ε^{-2}样本复杂度（改进Uehara等人ε^{-4}）；3) 消除了Chen和Jiang价值间隙设定中对额外在线交互的需求；4) 首次刻画了低Bellman秩MDP的离线可学习性；5) 给出了CQL在函数近似设定下的首次理论分析。

Conclusion: 该框架统一并改进了离线强化学习的理论理解，不仅回答了开放问题，还开辟了新的可学习设定，并为CQL等实用算法提供了理论支撑。

Abstract: We study offline reinforcement learning under $Q^\star$-approximation and partial coverage, a setting that motivates practical algorithms such as Conservative $Q$-Learning (CQL; Kumar et al., 2020) but has received limited theoretical attention. Our work is inspired by the following open question: "Are $Q^\star$-realizability and Bellman completeness sufficient for sample-efficient offline RL under partial coverage?"
  We answer in the negative via an information-theoretic lower bound. To identify additional structure that enables sample-efficient offline RL under partial coverage, we introduce a general decision-estimation framework, inspired by model-free decision-estimation coefficients (DEC) for online RL (Foster et al., 2023b; Liu et al., 2025b). Our framework decomposes offline RL complexity into decision complexity and value estimation error. This allows modular study of both sub-problems. Our result not only unifies existing results (Chen and Jiang, 2022; Uehara et al., 2023), but further improves and generalizes them. On the decision complexity side, our improvement includes: the first $ε^{-2}$ sample complexity bound for soft $Q$-learning under partial coverage that improves Uehara et al.'s (2023) $ε^{-4}$ bound, the removal of the need for additional online interaction in the value-gap setting of Chen and Jiang (2022), and new learnable settings beyond the above two cases. On the value estimation side, we provide a new characterization of the role of Bellman completeness under partial coverage, and the first characterization of offline learnability for general low-Bellman-rank MDPs (Jiang et al., 2017; Du et al., 2021; Jin et al., 2021). The latter is a canonical online RL setting that has remained unexplored in offline RL except for special cases. As a side contribution, our techniques give the first analysis of CQL in the function approximation setting.

</details>


### [724] [Scaling Laws for Masked-Reconstruction Transformers on Single-Cell Transcriptomics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15253)
*Ihor Kendiukhov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究了单细胞RNA测序数据上掩码重建Transformer的神经缩放定律，发现在数据充足（20万细胞，512高变基因）时验证MSE呈现清晰的幂律缩放（不可约损失下限c≈1.44），而数据匮乏（1万细胞，1024基因）时缩放效应可忽略，表明数据-参数比是缩放行为的关键决定因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管神经缩放定律在语言和视觉Transformer中已被广泛证实，但在单细胞基因组学领域是否存在类似的缩放行为尚不清楚。本文旨在填补这一空白，探索单细胞转录组学中Transformer模型的缩放规律。

Method: 使用CELLxGENE Census的scRNA-seq数据，构建数据丰富（512基因，20万细胞）和数据有限（1024基因，1万细胞）两种实验设置，训练7种不同规模（533到3.4×10^8参数）的掩码重建Transformer，并拟合参数化缩放定律到验证均方误差（MSE）。

Result: 数据丰富 regime 展现出清晰的幂律缩放，不可约损失下限c≈1.44；数据有限 regime 缩放效应可忽略。初步将数据丰富 regime 的渐近下限转换为信息论单位，得到每个掩码基因位置约2.30比特的熵估计。

Conclusion: 单细胞转录组学中当数据充足时会出现与自然语言处理类似的缩放定律，数据-参数比是缩放行为的关键决定因素。研究结果对单细胞基础模型的设计具有指导意义，并指出了进一步完善熵估计所需的额外测量。

Abstract: Neural scaling laws -- power-law relationships between loss, model size, and data -- have been extensively documented for language and vision transformers, yet their existence in single-cell genomics remains largely unexplored. We present the first systematic study of scaling behaviour for masked-reconstruction transformers trained on single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data. Using expression profiles from the CELLxGENE Census, we construct two experimental regimes: a data-rich regime (512 highly variable genes, 200,000 cells) and a data-limited regime (1,024 genes, 10,000 cells). Across seven model sizes spanning three orders of magnitude in parameter count (533 to 3.4 x 10^8 parameters), we fit the parametric scaling law to validation mean squared error (MSE). The data-rich regime exhibits clear power-law scaling with an irreducible loss floor of c ~ 1.44, while the data-limited regime shows negligible scaling, indicating that model capacity is not the binding constraint when data are scarce. These results establish that scaling laws analogous to those observed in natural language processing do emerge in single-cell transcriptomics when sufficient data are available, and they identify the data-to-parameter ratio as a critical determinant of scaling behaviour. A preliminary conversion of the data-rich asymptotic floor to information-theoretic units yields an estimate of approximately 2.30 bits of entropy per masked gene position. We discuss implications for the design of single-cell foundation models and outline the additional measurements needed to refine this entropy estimate.

</details>


### [725] [Prescriptive Scaling Reveals the Evolution of Language Model Capabilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15327)
*Hanlin Zhang,Jikai Jin,Vasilis Syrgkanis,Sham Kakade*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文基于大规模观测评估（5000个现有+2000个新评估的模型检查点，时间跨度2022-2026年），提出了一种通过单调饱和sigmoid参数化的平滑分位数回归来估计预训练算力与下游基准准确率之间缩放定律的方法，并验证了其时间稳定性。研究发现多数任务上分布外覆盖误差低于2%，数学推理边界持续演进。同时提出了一种平衡I-最优采样算法，仅用约20%的评估预算即可恢复近全数据前沿。论文发布了Proteus-2k数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器学习模型性能提升主要源于竞争与应用，但缺乏系统性的方法将预训练算力预算转化为可靠的下游任务准确率预期，且该映射关系随领域演化是否稳定尚不明确。

Method: 采用大规模观测评估，利用5000个现有和2000个新评估的模型检查点，通过单调饱和sigmoid参数化的平滑分位数回归，估计基准分数作为log预训练FLOPs函数的高条件分位数。通过在早期模型上拟合并在后续模型上评估来验证时间可靠性。引入平衡I-最优采样算法降低评估成本。

Result: 在六项基准任务中四项的分布外覆盖误差低于2%，数学推理的边界随时间持续推进。例如，10^24 FLOPs预算下IFEval准确率0.83，MATH Lvl 5准确率0.54。采样算法使用约20%评估预算（低至5%）即可恢复近全数据前沿并保持良好校准。

Conclusion: 本文建立了将算力预算转化为可靠性能预期的实用方法论，可用于监测能力边界随时间的变化；发布了Proteus-2k数据集，并提出了高效的评估采样策略。

Abstract: Machine learning model performance improvements tend to arise from competition and application. For deployment, we consider prescriptive scaling laws: given a pre-training compute budget, what downstream accuracy is attainable with contemporary post-training practice, and how stable is that mapping as the field evolves? Using large-scale observational evaluations with 5k existing and 2k newly evaluated model checkpoints spanning 2022-2026 across six benchmarks, we estimate capability boundaries, high conditional quantiles of benchmark scores as a function of log pre-training FLOPs, via smoothed quantile regression with a monotone, saturating sigmoid parameterization. We validate temporal reliability by fitting on earlier model generations and evaluating on later releases: across four of six tasks, the out-of-distribution coverage error remains below 2%, while math reasoning exhibits a consistently advancing boundary over time. For instance, at a budget of 10^24 FLOPs, the estimated attainable accuracies are 0.83 on IFEval and 0.54 on MATH Lvl 5. We then extend our approach to analyze task-dependent saturation and to probe contamination-related shifts on math reasoning tasks. Finally, we introduce a balanced I-optimal sampling algorithm that recovers near-full-data frontiers using roughly 20% of the parameter-count-weighted evaluation budget, as low as 5% on some tasks, while maintaining comparable calibration. Together, our work releases Proteus-2k, the latest model performance evaluation dataset, and introduces a practical methodology for translating compute budgets into reliable performance expectations and for monitoring when capability boundaries shift across time.

</details>


### [726] [Operationalising the Superficial Alignment Hypothesis via Task Complexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15829)
*Tomás Vergara-Browne,Darshan Patil,Ivan Titov,Siva Reddy,Tiago Pimentel,Marius Mosbach*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"任务复杂度"新指标（实现目标性能的最短程序长度），用以精确定义浅层对齐假说(SAH)：预训练模型大幅降低了在众多任务上达到高性能所需的复杂度。实验表明，数学推理、机器翻译和指令遵循等任务在预训练模型上的复杂度极低（仅需几KB），但访问这些性能需要GB级别的程序；后训练则将复杂度降低了数个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 浅层对齐假说(SAH)缺乏精确定义，导致支持该假说的论据看似正交且相互独立，同时也招致重要批评。需要一个形式化框架来统一理解和检验SAH。

Method: 提出"任务复杂度"指标，定义为在任务上达到目标性能的最短程序长度。将SAH重新表述为：预训练模型显著降低了在众多任务上达到高性能的复杂度。实验在数学推理、机器翻译和指令遵循三个任务上估计任务复杂度。

Result: (1) 基于预训练模型时，任务复杂度可以极低（仅需几KB）；(2) 预训练使模型能够访问强性能，但需要GB级别的程序才能访问这些性能；(3) 后训练将达到相同性能的复杂度降低了数个数量级。

Conclusion: 任务适应通常只需要极少量的信息（几KB），该框架统一了支持SAH的多种先前论据，为理解预训练与后训练的作用提供了形式化基础。

Abstract: The superficial alignment hypothesis (SAH) posits that large language models learn most of their knowledge during pre-training, and that post-training merely surfaces this knowledge. The SAH, however, lacks a precise definition, which has led to (i) different and seemingly orthogonal arguments supporting it, and (ii) important critiques to it. We propose a new metric called task complexity: the length of the shortest program that achieves a target performance on a task. In this framework, the SAH simply claims that pre-trained models drastically reduce the complexity of achieving high performance on many tasks. Our definition unifies prior arguments supporting the SAH, interpreting them as different strategies to find such short programs. Experimentally, we estimate the task complexity of mathematical reasoning, machine translation, and instruction following; we then show that these complexities can be remarkably low when conditioned on a pre-trained model. Further, we find that pre-training enables access to strong performances on our tasks, but it can require programs of gigabytes of length to access them. Post-training, on the other hand, collapses the complexity of reaching this same performance by several orders of magnitude. Overall, our results highlight that task adaptation often requires surprisingly little information -- often just a few kilobytes.

</details>


### [727] [Geometry-Aware Uncertainty Quantification via Conformal Prediction on Manifolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16015)
*Marzieh Amiri Shahbazi,Ali Baheri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出自适应测地线共形预测框架，通过测地距离构建非一致性分数并利用交叉验证局部难度归一化，在流形输出空间（如球面）上实现了保持边缘覆盖有效性的同时，减少条件覆盖波动并改善最差情况覆盖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准共形预测适用于欧几里得输出空间，但当响应变量位于黎曼流形上时，欧几里得残差和基于坐标的区域会忽略流形几何结构，导致有意义的误差定义失效。

Method: 从测地距离构建非一致性分数，并利用交叉验证估计的局部预测难度进行归一化；在球面上生成测地帽，其面积与位置无关但半径自适应异方差噪声。

Result: 在合成球面实验和IGRF-14地磁场预测任务中，自适应方法保持了有效的边缘覆盖，降低了条件覆盖变化，并改善了最差情况覆盖。

Conclusion: 提出的自适应测地线共形预测框架在流形输出空间上优于非自适应和基于坐标的基线方法。

Abstract: Conformal prediction gives finite-sample coverage guarantees for regression, but most standard constructions are designed for Euclidean output spaces. When the response lies on a Riemannian manifold, Euclidean residuals and coordinate-based regions can ignore the geometry that defines meaningful error. We propose adaptive geodesic conformal prediction, a simple framework that builds nonconformity scores from geodesic distances and normalizes them with a cross-validated estimate of local prediction difficulty. On the sphere, this produces geodesic caps whose area is independent of position, while their radii still adapt to heteroscedastic noise. In both a synthetic sphere experiment and an IGRF-14 geomagnetic field forecasting task, the adaptive method preserves valid marginal coverage, reduces variation in conditional coverage, and improves worst-case coverage relative to non-adaptive and coordinate-based baselines.

</details>


### [728] [Amortized Predictability-aware Training Framework for Time Series Forecasting and Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16224)
*Xu Zhang,Peng Wang,Yichen Li,Wei Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种通用可扩展的基于可预测性感知的训练框架（APTF），通过层次化可预测性感知损失（HPL）和摊销模型，分别用于时间序列预测和分类任务，以识别并惩罚低可预测性样本，提升模型训练稳定性与性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列数据易受噪声干扰，训练样本中可能存在偏离正常数据分布的低可预测性模式，导致训练不稳定或收敛到较差的局部最小值。现有深度学习方法鲜有从训练角度识别并惩罚低可预测性样本以提升模型性能。

Method: 提出APTF框架，包含两个关键设计：(i) 层次化可预测性感知损失（HPL），动态识别低可预测性样本，并随着训练进行逐步扩大对其的损失惩罚；(ii) 摊销模型，用于减轻模型偏差引起的可预测性估计误差，增强HPL的有效性。

Result: 该方法能够使模型聚焦于高可预测性样本，同时仍适当学习低可预测性样本的信息，在时间序列预测和分类任务中均能提升性能。

Conclusion: APTF是一种通用的可预测性感知训练框架，弥补了现有方法在训练层面处理低可预测性样本的空白，适用于时间序列预测与分类两大任务。

Abstract: Time series data are prone to noise in various domains, and training samples may contain low-predictability patterns that deviate from the normal data distribution, leading to training instability or convergence to poor local minima. Therefore, mitigating the adverse effects of low-predictability samples is crucial for time series analysis tasks such as time series forecasting (TSF) and time series classification (TSC). While many deep learning models have achieved promising performance, few consider how to identify and penalize low-predictability samples to improve model performance from the training perspective. To fill this gap, we propose a general Amortized Predictability-aware Training Framework (APTF) for both TSF and TSC. APTF introduces two key designs that enable the model to focus on high-predictability samples while still learning appropriately from low-predictability ones: (i) a Hierarchical Predictability-aware Loss (HPL) that dynamically identifies low-predictability samples and progressively expands their loss penalty as training evolves, and (ii) an amortization model that mitigates predictability estimation errors caused by model bias, further enhancing HPL's effectiveness. The code is available at https://github.com/Meteor-Stars/APTF.

</details>


### [729] [Insertion Based Sequence Generation with Learnable Order Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.18695)
*Dhruvesh Patel,Benjamin Rozonoyer,Gaurav Pandey,Tahira Naseem,Ramón Fernandez Astudillo,Andrew McCallum*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LoFlexMDM是一种基于插入的掩码扩散模型，通过学习数据相关的插入和去掩码速率，在分子生成任务上相比FlexMDM提升了最高17.5%的样本质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于插入的掩码扩散模型使用固定调度，未考虑数据依赖性。对于图和分子等结构化序列，学习数据相关的生成顺序可以减少动作空间的不确定性，提升生成质量。

Method: 提出了LoFlexMDM，一种具有可学习顺序动态的插入式掩码扩散模型。将离散流匹配框架推广到变长序列，提出了可处理的调度参数化和联合训练目标，用于同时训练生成器和目标顺序动态。

Result: 在从头分子生成任务上相比FlexMDM提升17.5%，在片段约束分子生成任务上提升6.7%。

Conclusion: 学习目标生成顺序可以在不牺牲可处理训练的前提下改进基于插入的扩散模型。

Abstract: Existing insertion-based masked diffusion models that generate sequences by interleaving token insertion with unmasking use fixed schedules that are not dependent on the data. For structured sequences like graphs and molecules, learning data-dependent generation orders can improve generation quality by reducing uncertainty over the action space. We propose LoFlexMDM, an insertion-based masked diffusion model with learnable order dynamics that learns data-dependent insertion and unmasking rates. We generalize the discrete flow matching framework to work with variable-length sequences, propose a tractable schedule parameterization and a training objective for joint training of the generator and the target order dynamics. On De Novo and fragment-constrained molecule generation, LoFlexMDM improves sample quality over FlexMDM by up to 17.5% and 6.7%, respectively. These results show that learning the target generation order can improve insertion-based diffusion models without giving up tractable training. We open source the code at https://github.com/dhruvdcoder/LoFlexMDM.

</details>


### [730] [CTS-Bench: Benchmarking Graph Coarsening Trade-offs for GNNs in Clock Tree Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.19330)
*Barsat Khadka,Kawsher Roxy,Md Rubel Ahmed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了CTS-Bench基准测试套件，用于系统评估图粗化在图神经网络时钟树综合分析中的精度-效率权衡。实验表明，图粗化虽能大幅降低GPU内存（最高17.2倍）并加速训练（最高3倍），但在零样本评估中常导致负R²分数，表明通用图聚类技术会破坏CTS关键学习目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN在EDA物理设计分析（特别是CTS行为建模）中具有潜力，但由于原始门级网表的巨大内存和运行时间成本，实际部署受限。图粗化虽用于提升可扩展性，但其对CTS关键学习目标的影响尚未得到充分研究。

Method: 构建CTS-Bench基准套件，包含5种架构的4,860个收敛物理设计方案，提供原始门级和聚类后的图表示。以时钟偏斜预测为代表性CTS任务，系统评估图粗化对预测精度和计算效率的权衡。

Result: 图粗化可将GPU内存使用降低17.2倍，训练加速3倍；但零样本评估下频繁出现负R²分数，表明通用图聚类技术消除了对时钟分布建模至关重要的结构信息。

Conclusion: 通用图聚类技术即使保持全局物理指标不变，也会从根本上损害CTS学习目标。CTS-Bench支持CTS感知的图粗化策略评估、GNN架构和加速器的基准测试，为开发学习辅助的CTS分析优化技术奠定基础。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are increasingly explored for physical design analysis in Electronic Design Automation, particularly for modeling Clock Tree Synthesis behavior such as clock skew and buffering complexity. However, practical deployment remains limited due to the prohibitive memory and runtime cost of operating on raw gate-level netlists. Graph coarsening is commonly used to improve scalability, yet its impact on CTS-critical learning objectives is not well characterized. This paper introduces CTS-Bench, a benchmark suite for systematically evaluating the trade-offs between graph coarsening, prediction accuracy, and computational efficiency in GNN-based CTS analysis. CTS-Bench consists of 4,860 converged physical design solutions spanning five architectures and provides paired raw gate-level and clustered graph representations derived from post-placement designs. Using clock skew prediction as a representative CTS task, we demonstrate a clear accuracy-efficiency trade-off. While graph coarsening reduces GPU memory usage by up to 17.2x and accelerates training by up to 3x, it also removes structural information essential for modeling clock distribution, frequently resulting in negative $R^2$ scores under zero-shot evaluation. Our findings indicate that generic graph clustering techniques can fundamentally compromise CTS learning objectives, even when global physical metrics remain unchanged. CTS-Bench enables principled evaluation of CTS-aware graph coarsening strategies, supports benchmarking of GNN architectures and accelerators under realistic physical design constraints, and provides a foundation for developing learning-assisted CTS analysis and optimization techniques.

</details>


### [731] [POET-X: Memory-efficient LLM Training by Scaling Orthogonal Transformation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.05500)
*Zeju Qiu,Lixin Liu,Adrian Weller,Han Shi,Weiyang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: POET-X是一种改进版重参数化正交等价训练方法，在保持POET训练稳定性和泛化优势的同时，大幅降低内存消耗和计算开销，使得十亿参数大语言模型能在单张H100 GPU上完成预训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: POET的原始实现因密集矩阵乘法导致高内存消耗和计算开销，难以扩展到大规模模型。

Method: POET-X通过可扩展且内存高效的正交等价变换设计，显著降低计算成本。

Result: POET-X在单张Nvidia H100 GPU上成功预训练十亿参数LLM，而AdamW等标准优化器在相同设置下因内存不足而失败；同时在吞吐量和内存效率上取得显著提升。

Conclusion: POET-X解决了POET的可扩展性问题，为大语言模型的高效稳定训练提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Efficient and stable training of large language models (LLMs) remains a core challenge in modern machine learning systems. To address this challenge, Reparameterized Orthogonal Equivalence Training (POET), a spectrum-preserving framework that optimizes each weight matrix through orthogonal equivalence transformation, has been proposed. Although POET provides strong training stability, its original implementation incurs high memory consumption and computational overhead due to intensive matrix multiplications. To overcome these limitations, we introduce POET-X, a scalable and memory-efficient variant that performs orthogonal equivalence transformations with significantly reduced computational cost. POET-X maintains the generalization and stability benefits of POET while achieving substantial improvements in throughput and memory efficiency. In our experiments, POET-X enables the pretraining of billion-parameter LLMs on a single Nvidia H100 GPU, and in contrast, standard optimizers such as AdamW run out of memory under the same settings.

</details>


### [732] [Integral Formulas for Vector Signal Tensor Products](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.08630)
*Valentin Heyraud,Zachary Weller-Davies,Jules Tilly*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文推导了Vector Signal Tensor Product的积分公式，获得了反对称Gaunt系数的闭式表达式，实现了用单个Vector Signal Tensor Product模拟Clebsch-Gordan张量积，最多可减少9倍张量积计算量，并讨论了不同张量积在SO(3)-等变神经网络中表达性与运行时之间的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 简化Xie等人提出的Vector Signal Tensor Product的计算，使其能够高效地应用于SO(3)-等变神经网络中，弥补Gaunt张量积仅适用于对称耦合的局限。

Method: 推导出Vector Signal Tensor Product的积分公式，获得反对称Gaunt系数的显式闭式表达式，利用该表达式将Clebsch-Gordan张量积模拟为单个Vector Signal Tensor Product，并研究相关张量积归一化的低秩分解。

Result: 获得了反对称Gaunt系数的解析闭式解，实现了最多9倍的张量积计算量缩减，并揭示了Gaunt和Vector Signal Tensor Product在表达性与运行时之间的权衡关系。

Conclusion: 该工作为Vector Signal Tensor Product的高效实用实现铺平了道路，推动了其在SO(3)-等变神经网络中的应用，同时为不同张量积的选择提供了表达性-运行时权衡的理论依据。

Abstract: We derive integral formulas that simplify the Vector Signal Tensor Product recently introduced by Xie et al., which generalizes the Gaunt tensor product to anti-symmetric couplings. In particular, we obtain explicit closed-form expressions for the anti-symmetric analogues of the Gaunt coefficients. This enables us to simulate the Clebsch-Gordan tensor product using a single Vector Signal Tensor Product, yielding up to a $9\times$ reduction in the required tensor product evaluations. Our results enable efficient and practical implementations of the Vector Signal Tensor Product, paving the way for applications of this generalization of Gaunt Tensor Products in $\mathrm{SO}(3)$-equivariant neural networks. Moreover, we discuss how the Gaunt and the Vector Signal Tensor Products allow to control the expressivity-runtime tradeoff associated with the usual Clebsch-Gordan Tensor Products. Finally, we investigate low rank decompositions of the normalizations of the considered tensor products in view of their use in equivariant neural networks.

</details>


### [733] [Graph-GRPO: Training Graph Flow Models with Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.10395)
*Baoheng Zhu,Deyu Bo,Delvin Ce Zhang,Xiao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Graph-GRPO，一个基于在线强化学习的图流匹配模型训练框架，通过推导GFM转移概率的解析表达式（替代蒙特卡洛采样）和局部扰动-再生策略，实现可微分的强化学习训练，在图生成和分子优化任务上达到最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的离散流匹配图生成模型（GFM）性能优异但难以有效对齐复杂的人类偏好或任务特定目标，亟需一种能够将强化学习与GFM结合的训练框架。

Method: (1) 推导了GFM转移概率的解析表达式，替代蒙特卡洛采样，实现完全可微分的强化学习训练过程；(2) 提出随机扰动图中特定节点和边并重新生成的细化策略，实现局部探索和生成质量的自改进。

Result: 仅用50步去噪，在平面图和树数据集上分别达到95.0%和97.5%的Valid-Unique-Novelty分数；在分子优化任务上超越基于图、基于片段的强化学习方法以及经典遗传算法，达到最优性能。

Conclusion: Graph-GRPO通过可微分的强化学习框架有效提升了图流匹配模型的生成质量和对齐能力，在合成数据和真实分子数据集上均验证了其优越性。

Abstract: Graph generation is a fundamental task with broad applications, such as drug discovery. Recently, discrete flow matching-based graph generation, \aka, graph flow model (GFM), has emerged due to its superior performance and flexible sampling. However, effectively aligning GFMs with complex human preferences or task-specific objectives remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we propose Graph-GRPO, an online reinforcement learning (RL) framework for training GFMs under verifiable rewards. Our method makes two key contributions: (1) We derive an analytical expression for the transition probability of GFMs, replacing the Monte Carlo sampling and enabling fully differentiable rollouts for RL training; (2) We propose a refinement strategy that randomly perturbs specific nodes and edges in a graph, and regenerates them, allowing for localized exploration and self-improvement of generation quality. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of Graph-GRPO. With only 50 denoising steps, our method achieves 95.0\% and 97.5\% Valid-Unique-Novelty scores on the planar and tree datasets, respectively. Moreover, Graph-GRPO achieves state-of-the-art performance on the molecular optimization tasks, outperforming graph-based and fragment-based RL methods as well as classic genetic algorithms.

</details>


### [734] [RetroReasoner: A Reasoning LLM for Strategic Retrosynthesis Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.12666)
*Hanbum Ko,Chanhui Lee,Ye Rin Kim,Rodrigo Hormazabal,Sehui Han,Sungbin Lim,Sungwoong Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RetroReasoner，一种通过有监督微调和强化学习训练的逆合成推理模型，能够模拟化学家的断键策略思维，在单步和多步逆合成预测中均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有逆合成预测方法要么直接生成反应物，要么仅提供通用的产物级分析，缺乏对断键策略的显式推理，无法解释特定反应物选择背后的化学逻辑。

Method: RetroReasoner采用两阶段训练：1) 有监督微调阶段使用SyntheticRetro生成结构化断链推理与反应物预测对；2) 强化学习阶段通过往返奖励（将预测的反应物输入前向合成模型，奖励能重构原产物的预测）优化模型。此外，结合并行化蒙特卡洛树搜索实现多步逆合成规划。

Result: RetroReasoner在单步和多步逆合成预测中均优于现有基线，包括分子大语言模型和逆合成专用专家模型，能生成更广泛可行的反应物方案，尤其对困难反应实例效果显著。

Conclusion: 融入化学家断链策略的显式推理能有效提升逆合成预测的准确性和可解释性，往返奖励机制和并行MCTS框架进一步增强了模型在复杂合成规划中的实用价值。

Abstract: Retrosynthesis prediction aims to identify reactants that can synthesize a given product molecule. Although molecular large language models (LLMs) have recently shown promising results, most existing methods either generate reactants directly or provide only generic product-level analysis, without explicitly reasoning about bond-disconnection strategies that justify specific reactant choices. This paper proposes RetroReasoner, a retrosynthetic reasoning model that captures chemists' strategic disconnection-based thinking. RetroReasoner is trained with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. For supervised fine-tuning, SyntheticRetro generates structured disconnection rationales paired with reactant predictions. For reinforcement learning, a round-trip reward evaluates predicted reactants by passing them through a forward synthesis model and rewarding predictions that reconstruct the original product. RetroReasoner can also be applied to multi-step retrosynthetic planning by incorporating it into a parallelized Monte Carlo tree search framework, reducing search time while increasing the number and diversity of valid synthetic pathways. Experimental results show that RetroReasoner outperforms prior baselines, including not only molecular LLMs but also retrosynthesis-specific expert models, and generates a broader range of feasible reactant proposals, especially for challenging reaction instances.

</details>


### [735] [CHIMERA-Bench: A Benchmark Dataset for Epitope-Specific Antibody Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13431)
*Mansoor Ahmed,Nadeem Taj,Imdad Ullah Khan,Hemanth Venkateswara,Murray Patterson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CHIMERA-Bench是一个用于抗体CDR序列-结构共设计的统一基准，包含2,922个抗体-抗原复合物数据集、三种生物学驱动的数据划分和五组评估指标，对11种方法进行了系统基准测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算抗体设计领域虽然进展迅速，但缺乏标准化基准，现有方法使用不同的SAbDab快照、非重叠测试集和不兼容的评估指标，导致难以进行公平比较和模型开发。

Method: 构建CHIMERA-Bench基准，包含：(1) 经过去重和注释的2,922个抗体-抗原复合物数据集；(2) 三种生物学驱动的数据划分（未见表位、未见抗原折叠、前瞻性时间目标）；(3) 五组评估指标（包括新颖的表位特异性度量）。并对11种涵盖6种生成范式的方法进行基准测试。

Result: 提供了11种方法在所有数据划分上的基准测试结果，是目前该领域最大的标准化数据集和评估框架。

Conclusion: CHIMERA-Bench为抗体设计领域提供了统一的评估平台，有助于社区公平比较和开发新方法，并评估其泛化能力。

Abstract: Computational antibody design has seen rapid methodological progress, with dozens of deep generative methods proposed in the past three years, yet the field lacks a standardized benchmark for fair comparison and model development. These methods are evaluated on different SAbDab snapshots, non-overlapping test sets, and incompatible metrics, and the literature fragments the design problem into numerous sub-tasks with no common definition. We introduce CHIMERA-Bench: (CDR Modeling with Epitope-guided Redesign), a unified benchmark built around a single canonical task: epitope-conditioned CDR sequence-structure co-design. CHIMERA-Bench provides three components. The first is a curated, deduplicated dataset of 2,922 antibody-antigen complexes with epitope and paratope annotations. The second is a set of three biologically motivated splits that test generalization to unseen epitopes, unseen antigen folds, and prospective temporal targets. The third is a comprehensive evaluation protocol with five metric groups, including novel epitope-specificity measures. We benchmark eleven methods spanning six generative paradigms and report results across all splits. CHIMERA-Bench is the largest dataset of its kind for the antibody design problem, allowing the community to develop and test novel methods and evaluate their generalizability.

</details>


### [736] [GraphER: An Efficient Graph-Based Enrichment and Reranking Method for Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.24925)
*Ruizhong Miao,Yuying Wang,Rongguang Wang,Chenyang Li,Tao Sheng,Sujith Ravi,Dan Roth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GraphER是一个即时的图增强重排序框架，通过在查询时基于数据组织关系构建图并应用图排序，在不依赖知识图谱等额外基础设施的情况下，提升RAG系统在多源复杂查询中的检索完整性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG系统在复杂查询（信息分布于多个来源）时，基于语义搜索的方法难以检索到完整的证据集；迭代式智能体检索效率低下，而知识图谱等方法引入了额外的存储和维护开销。

Method: GraphER框架包含三个步骤：(1) 利用数据的组织结构捕获超越语义相似度的邻近关系；(2) 在查询时基于这些邻近关系构建图；(3) 应用基于图的排序来选出最相关的候选文档。该框架与检索器无关，支持多种邻近性度量，且查询时延极低。

Result: 在表格检索、多跳检索和长文档检索等多个基准测试中，GraphER在检索完整性（retrieval completeness）方面取得了一致的改进。

Conclusion: GraphER无需额外的图基础设施，能与标准向量存储无缝集成，以极小的查询时延代价显著提升复杂查询下的检索完整性，是一种高效且轻量的RAG增强方案。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems that rely on semantic search often fail to retrieve the complete set of evidence for complex queries, particularly when information is distributed across multiple sources. Existing approaches either rely on iterative agentic retrieval, which can be inefficient, or maintain additional structures such as knowledge graphs, which introduce storage and maintenance overhead. In this paper, we propose GraphER, a graph-based enrichment and reranking framework that (1) leverages the organizational structure of data to capture proximity relationships beyond semantic similarity, (2) constructs a graph at query time based on these proximities, and (3) applies graph-based ranking to surface the top candidate documents. Experiments across table retrieval, multi-hop retrieval, and long-document retrieval benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in terms of retrieval completeness. Additionally, GraphER requires no additional graph infrastructure and integrates seamlessly with standard vector stores. The framework is retriever-agnostic, supports multiple forms of proximity, and introduces minimal query-time latency.

</details>


### [737] [Train at Moving Edge: Online-Verified Prompt Selection for Efficient RL Training of Large Reasoning Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.25184)
*Jiahao Wu,Ning Lu,Shengcai Liu,Kun Wang,Yanting Yang,Bailong Lin,Chen Jason Zhang,Li Qing,Ke Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出HIVE框架，通过历史奖励轨迹和实时熵值过滤低效用prompt，在数学推理任务中实现高效强化学习，减少rollout开销且不牺牲性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO等RL算法中每个prompt生成多个rollout计算成本高昂，而大部分prompt梯度贡献微薄、效用低下，亟需一种在rollout前筛选高效用prompt的方法以提升数据效率。

Method: 提出HIVE双阶段框架：①基于历史奖励轨迹进行粗粒度筛选；②以prompt熵作为实时代理指标，剔除效用已过时的实例。聚焦于"学习边缘"（中等难度+高不确定性）区域，该区域随训练动态迁移。

Result: 在多个数学推理基准和模型上，HIVE在不牺牲性能的前提下显著降低了rollout计算开销。

Conclusion: 样本效用具有非均匀性和动态演化特性，通过历史信息和在线验证相结合的选择策略可以高效识别高价值样本，为大规模LLM后训练的RL阶段提供经济可行的方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become essential for post-training large language models (LLMs) in reasoning tasks. While scaling rollouts can stabilize training and enhance performance, the computational overhead is a critical issue. In algorithms like GRPO, multiple rollouts per prompt incur prohibitive costs, as a large portion of prompts provide negligible gradients and are thus of low utility. To address this problem, we investigate how to select high-utility prompts before the rollout phase. Our experimental analysis reveals that sample utility is non-uniform and evolving: the strongest learning signals concentrate at the ``learning edge", the intersection of intermediate difficulty and high uncertainty, which shifts as training proceeds. Motivated by this, we propose HIVE (History-Informed and online-VErified prompt selection), a dual-stage framework for data-efficient RL. HIVE utilizes historical reward trajectories for coarse selection and employs prompt entropy as a real-time proxy to prune instances with stale utility. By evaluating HIVE across multiple math reasoning benchmarks and models, we show that HIVE yields significant rollout efficiency without compromising performance.

</details>


### [738] [Stochastic Dimension Implicit Functional Projections for Global Integral Conservation in High-Dimensional PINNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.29237)
*Zhangyong Liang,Huanhuan Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SDIFP框架，通过全局仿射校正机制在无网格神经PDE求解器中强制执行指定的第一和第二空间矩，避免了张量积投影方法在高维空间中的可扩展性问题，并实现了与随机采样PINNs的兼容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有投影方法依赖固定网格或均匀求积，与随机采样的PINNs冲突且高维扩展性差；高阶微分算子增加反向模式自动微分的内存成本。需要一种不依赖张量积求积、与随机采样兼容且内存高效的全局积分约束强制执行方法。

Method: 提出SDIFP：通过两个标量系数的全局仿射校正（加权求积范数下的最近点投影）强制执行第一、二阶矩；结合仿射矩校正与随机算子子集采样处理可分解的高维线性算子；采用独立残差与导数采样以及条件无偏系数梯度估计。

Result: 对于选定求积规则，规定矩是精确的；连续误差被校正场的求积误差所控制。独立采样模式下的估计器对于指定的基于求积的残差目标是无偏的；共享子集快速模式在一般情况下有偏。

Conclusion: SDIFP避免了张量积求积进行矩强制执行，将前向求积评估与反向传播图分离，且在仿射系数固定或预计算后保留了逐点推理效率。

Abstract: Enforcing prescribed global integral constraints in mesh-free neural PDE solvers is challenging in high-dimensional domains. Existing projection methods for spatial integrals are often tied to fixed grids or uniform quadrature, which can conflict with randomly sampled physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and scale poorly with dimension. High-order differential operators also increase reverse-mode automatic differentiation memory costs. We propose Stochastic Dimension Implicit Functional Projection (SDIFP), a quadrature-level framework for enforcing prescribed first and second spatial moments. SDIFP replaces tensor-product nodal projection by a global affine correction of the neural-network output, with two scalar coefficients determined from a weighted quadrature rule. Under positive target variance and nonzero empirical raw variance, this correction is the nearest-point projection, in the weighted quadrature norm, onto the empirical two-moment constraint set. Thus, the prescribed moments are exact for the selected quadrature rule, while continuum errors are quadrature errors of the corrected field. For decomposable high-dimensional linear operators, SDIFP combines affine moment correction with stochastic operator-subset sampling. With independent residual and derivative sampling and conditionally unbiased coefficient-gradient estimation, the resulting estimator is unbiased for the specified quadrature-based residual objective; the shared-subset fast mode is biased in general. SDIFP avoids tensor-product quadrature for moment enforcement, separates forward quadrature evaluation from the reverse-mode graph, and retains pointwise inference efficiency once the affine coefficients are fixed or precomputed.

</details>


### [739] [Curvature-Guided LoRA: Matching Full Fine-Tuning in Function Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.29824)
*Frédéric Zheng,Alexandre Proutière*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CG-LoRA方法，从函数空间视角出发，通过曲率感知的二阶优化策略对齐LoRA与全参数微调的预测输出，在自然语言理解基准上实现了更快的收敛和更好的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的参数高效微调方法（如LoRA）在收敛速度和最终性能上落后于全参数微调，而现有方法仅在参数空间对齐，无法直接控制模型预测，因此需要从函数空间（预测输出）角度缩小差距。

Method: 将预测对齐问题形式化为匹配LoRA与全参数微调的输出目标，推导出该目标自然导向曲率感知的二阶优化形式，最优低秩更新对应牛顿式的曲率白化梯度，据此提出CG-LoRA算法，利用局部曲率信息选择适配方向，避免显式构造二阶矩阵。

Result: 在标准自然语言理解基准上，CG-LoRA相比现有LoRA变体在性能和收敛速度上均有所提升。

Conclusion: 从函数空间视角出发的曲率引导策略能有效缩小LoRA与全参数微调之间的差距，且计算高效。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as LoRA enable efficient adaptation of large pretrained models, but often lag behind full fine-tuning in both convergence speed and final performance. Recent approaches aim to reduce this gap by aligning LoRA parameter updates with those of full fine-tuning, but such parameter-space alignment only indirectly controls model predictions. Instead, we adopt a function-space perspective and formulate the \emph{prediction alignment problem}, whose objective is to match the outputs of LoRA fine-tuning to those of full fine-tuning. We show that this objective naturally leads to a curvature-aware, second-order formulation, where optimal low-rank updates correspond to a Newton-like, curvature-whitened gradient. Based on this insight, we propose Curvature-Guided LoRA (CG-LoRA), an algorithm that selects adaptation directions using local curvature information. Our method is computationally efficient and avoids explicit second-order matrix construction. Experiments on standard natural language understanding benchmarks demonstrate improved performance and faster convergence compared to existing LoRA variants.

</details>


### [740] [SPAMoE: Spectrum-Aware Hybrid Operator Framework for Full-Waveform Inversion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07421)
*Zhenyu Wang,Peiyuan Li,Yongxiang Shi,Ruoyu Wu,Chenfei Liao,Lei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SPAMoE框架，通过频谱保持DINO编码器和混合专家网络（FNO、MNO、LNO），解决全波形反演中多尺度地质特征的频率纠缠问题，在OpenFWI数据集上将MAE降低44.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全波形反演（FWI）计算成本高且不适定，现有深度学习方法和神经算子存在多尺度地质特征的频率纠缠问题，导致无法有效解耦不同尺度的频率信息。

Method: 提出频谱保持自适应MoE（SPAMoE）框架：1) 频谱保持DINO编码器，通过对高-低频能量比施加下界来缓解高频坍缩；2) 频谱分解与路由机制，将不同频段动态分配给由FNO、MNO、LNO组成的混合专家网络。

Result: 在10个OpenFWI子数据集上进行实验，相比官方最佳基线，平均MAE降低44.4%。

Conclusion: SPAMoE为基于学习的全波形反演建立了新的架构框架，有效解决了频率纠缠问题，显著提升了反演精度。

Abstract: Full-waveform inversion (FWI) is pivotal for reconstructing high-resolution subsurface velocity models but remains computationally intensive and ill-posed. While deep learning approaches promise efficiency, existing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and single-paradigm Neural Operators (NOs) struggle with one fundamental issue: frequency entanglement of multi-scale geological features. To address this challenge, we propose Spectral-Preserving Adaptive MoE (SPAMoE), a novel spectrum-aware framework for solving inverse problems with complex multi-scale structures. Our approach introduces a Spectral-Preserving DINO Encoder that enforces a lower bound on the high-to-low frequency energy ratio of the encoded representation, mitigating high-frequency collapse and stabilizing subsequent frequency-domain modeling. Furthermore, we design a novel Spectral Decomposition and Routing mechanism that dynamically assigns frequency bands to a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) ensemble comprising FNO, MNO, and LNO. On the ten OpenFWI sub-datasets, experiments show that SPAMoE reduces the average MAE by 44.4% relative to the best officially reported OpenFWI baseline, thereby establishing a new architectural framework for learning-based full-waveform inversion. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/zhenyuwang12366/SPAMoE

</details>


### [741] [Information-Theoretic Requirements for Gradient-Based Task Affinity Estimation in Multi-Task Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07848)
*Jasper Zhang,Bryan Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现多任务学习（MTL）中梯度分析有效性的关键前提：任务必须共享训练实例。当样本重叠率低于30%时，梯度-任务相关性接近噪声；高于40%时能可靠恢复生物学结构。标准基准（MoleculeNet <5%，TDC 8-14%）远低于该阈值，解释了七年来MTL结果不一致的根本原因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多任务学习中存在令人困惑的不一致结果——有时联合训练显著提升性能，有时反而有害，但缺乏预测这些结果的原理性框架。

Method: 识别出梯度分析中未被言明的假设——任务必须共享训练实例；通过样本重叠率的相变实验（30%以下为噪声，40%以上有效）验证该要求；并在多个数据集上进行综合验证。

Result: 样本重叠率存在尖锐相变：低于30%时梯度-任务相关性统计上无法与噪声区分；高于40%时能可靠恢复已知的生物学结构。标准基准的样本重叠率（<5%-14%）远低于该阈值。

Conclusion: 为七年来的多任务学习不一致结果提供了首个原理性解释：现有基准系统性地违反了梯度分析有效的样本重叠前提条件。

Abstract: Multi-task learning shows strikingly inconsistent results -- sometimes joint training helps substantially, sometimes it actively harms performance -- yet the field lacks a principled framework for predicting these outcomes. We identify a fundamental but unstated assumption underlying gradient-based task analysis: tasks must share training instances for gradient conflicts to reveal genuine relationships. When tasks are measured on the same inputs, gradient alignment reflects shared mechanistic structure; when measured on disjoint inputs, any apparent signal conflates task relationships with distributional shift. We discover this sample overlap requirement exhibits a sharp phase transition: below 30% overlap, gradient-task correlations are statistically indistinguishable from noise; above 40%, they reliably recover known biological structure. Comprehensive validation across multiple datasets achieves strong correlations and recovers biological pathway organization. Standard benchmarks systematically violate this requirement -- MoleculeNet operates at <5% overlap, TDC at 8-14% -- far below the threshold where gradient analysis becomes meaningful. This provides the first principled explanation for seven years of inconsistent MTL results.

</details>


### [742] [Muon$^2$: Boosting Muon via Adaptive Second-Moment Preconditioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09967)
*Ziyue Liu,Ruijie Zhang,Zhengyang Wang,Yequan Zhao,Yupeng Su,Zi Yang,Zheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Muon²通过引入Adam风格的自适应二阶矩预处理，改善了Muon优化器中极分解的矩阵条件数，从而在减少40%牛顿-舒尔茨迭代次数的同时，在大规模预训练中取得更优效果并节省最高1/4训练时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon优化器依赖牛顿-舒尔茨迭代进行正交化，但正交化质量受限于迭代次数，导致计算和通信成本高昂。核心挑战在于动量矩阵的条件数较差，影响极近似的收敛效率。

Method: 在正交化之前引入Adam风格的二阶矩自适应预处理，改善动量矩阵的谱分布，从而加速极近似收敛；并通过方向对齐度量来刻画实际正交化质量。

Result: 在GPT、LLaMA和MoE预训练实验（最高13B参数）中，Muon²及其内存高效变体Muon²-F一致优于Muon及其变体，减少40%的NS迭代次数，并在达到相同损失时节省最多1/4的训练时间。

Conclusion: Muon²通过预处理改善矩阵条件数，有效提升了正交化效率与质量，为大模型预训练优化器提供了一种高效且实用的改进方案。

Abstract: Muon has emerged as a promising optimizer for large-scale foundation model pre-training by exploiting the matrix structure of neural network updates through iterative orthogonalization. However, the orthogonalization quality of Muon hinges on the number of Newton--Schulz (NS) iterations performed, which poses efficiency challenges due to its non-trivial computation and communication cost. We propose Muon$^2$, an extension of Muon, to improve both quality and efficiency by applying Adam-style adaptive second-moment preconditioning before orthogonalization. Our key insight is that the core challenge of polar approximation in Muon lies in the ill-conditioned momentum matrix, of which the spectrum is substantially improved by Muon$^2$, leading to faster convergence toward a practically sufficient orthogonalization. We further characterize the practical orthogonalization quality via directional alignment, under which Muon$^2$ demonstrates dramatic improvement over Muon at each polar step. Across GPT, LLaMA, and Mixture-of-Experts pre-training experiments up to 13B parameters, Muon$^2$ (and its memory-efficient variant Muon$^2$-F that preserves most of its benefits) consistently outperforms Muon and its variants while reducing NS iterations by 40%, and saves up to 1/4 training time over Muon when achieving the same loss.

</details>


### [743] [Models Know Their Shortcuts: Deployment-Time Shortcut Mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12277)
*Jiayi Li,Shijie Tang,Gün Kaynar,Shiyi Du,Carl Kingsford*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Shortcut Guardrail框架，在部署阶段（仅使用已收敛模型）通过无监督梯度归因检测并缓解预训练文本编码器中的捷径学习问题，其性能在多种任务上可匹配甚至超越训练时缓解方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练文本编码器容易依赖token-标签之间的虚假相关性（捷径学习），导致分布偏移时性能下降。现有缓解方法大多在训练阶段进行，需要访问训练数据、训练动态或捷径标注，但这些在部署阶段通常不可用。

Method: 提出Shortcut Guardrail框架，利用已收敛模型自身的无监督梯度归因信号捕获捷径特征，并在部署阶段进行无监督捷径缓解，无需训练数据或额外标注。

Result: 在情感分类、毒性检测和自然语言推理任务上，Shortcut Guardrail在捷径分布偏移下恢复显著性能，匹配或超越训练时基线方法。同时理论证明了部署时缓解的信息论上界不超过训练时缓解。

Conclusion: 仅凭部署阶段已收敛的模型本身，通过无监督梯度归因即可有效缓解捷径学习，为无法获取训练数据的实际部署场景提供可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Pretrained text encoders are prone to shortcut learning, relying on token-label correlations that fail once the distribution shifts in deployment. Existing shortcut mitigation methods mainly operate at training time and assume access to training data, training dynamics, or shortcut annotations, which are hardly available during deployment, where only the converged model remains. We show that this model alone suffices to mitigate shortcuts during deployment: a biased model internalizes a signal of its learned shortcuts that can be captured via unsupervised gradient-based attribution. We further prove that deployment-time mitigation is information-theoretically upper-bounded by training-time mitigation. Nevertheless, exploiting this gradient signal, our proposed unsupervised deployment-time shortcut mitigation framework for pretrained text encoders, Shortcut Guardrail, recovers substantial performance under shortcut distribution shift, matching or outperforming training-time baselines across sentiment classification, toxicity detection, and natural language inference.

</details>


### [744] [Capacity-Controlled Global Attention for Graph Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17324)
*Yang Liu,Dongxin Guo,Tom Zheng,Siu Ming Yiu,Liam Ning,Jikun Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对图Transformer中softmax注意力机制固有的质量守恒约束（每行非负且和为1）导致过度平滑、低秩瓶颈和优化脆弱三个问题，本文提出SigGate-GT，通过在注意力输出上施加可学习的sigmoid门控来放松该约束，在五个基准上取得与SOTA相当或更优的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图Transformer的softmax注意力强制每个注意力行非负且和为1，导致每个头输出是值向量的质量守恒凸组合，节点无法"什么都不关注"。该守恒约束是过度平滑、低秩瓶颈和优化脆弱三个病理现象的共同根源，但目前这三个问题通常被孤立研究。

Method: 在GraphGPS框架内，对注意力输出施加可学习的、每头独立的、输入条件化的sigmoid门控。该门控是平滑的、逐维的"音量控制"，能将头输出推向零，在不放弃注意力概率解释的前提下放松约束。

Result: ZINC上达到0.059 MAE（匹配先前最优），ogbg-molhiv上达到82.47% ROC-AUC（图Transformer基线中最强），ogbg-molpcba和长程图基准上也具有竞争力；在所有五个数据集上相比GraphGPS有统计显著提升（p<0.05）；门控使表示多样性在4-16层上提升30%，注意力熵免于崩溃，训练在10倍学习率范围内保持稳定，参数量仅增加约1%，时间开销不到3%。

Conclusion: 放松注意力约束是解决图Transformer多个病理问题的有效途径，SigGate-GT以极小代价实现了显著性能提升和训练稳定性改善。

Abstract: Global self-attention drives modern graph transformers, yet the softmax at its core imposes a structural constraint rarely examined directly: every attention row is non-negative and sums to one, so each per-head output is a mass-conserving convex combination of value vectors. A node can never "attend to nothing." We argue this conservation constraint is a single root cause behind three pathologies usually studied in isolation: the collapse of node representations with depth (over-smoothing), a low-rank bottleneck on per-head outputs, and brittle optimization in deep stacks. Drawing on how sigmoid gating removes analogous attention sinks in language models, we introduce SigGate-GT, a graph transformer that applies a learned, per-head, input-conditioned sigmoid gate to the attention output inside the GraphGPS framework. The gate is a smooth, per-dimension "volume control" that can drive head outputs toward zero, relaxing the constraint without abandoning attention's probabilistic interpretation. Analytically and through synthetic experiments, we show the gate strictly increases the stable rank of per-head outputs, and connect this rank gain to all three manifestations. On five molecular and long-range benchmarks, SigGate-GT matches the prior best on ZINC (0.059 MAE), records the strongest result among the graph-transformer baselines we evaluate on ogbg-molhiv (82.47% ROC-AUC), and is competitive on ogbg-molpcba and the Long-Range Graph Benchmark, with statistically significant gains over GraphGPS on all five datasets (p < 0.05). Mechanism analyses confirm the diagnosis: gating slows over-smoothing (a 30% mean relative gain in representation diversity across 4-16 layers), keeps attention entropy from collapsing, and stabilizes training across a 10x learning-rate range, at about 1% parameter overhead on OGB and under 3% wall-clock cost.

</details>


### [745] [ML-Guided Primal Heuristics for Mixed Binary Quadratic Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.23053)
*Weimin Huang,Natalie M. Isenberg,Ján Drgoňa,Draguna L Vrabie,Bistra Dilkina*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于机器学习的原始启发式方法，用于加速混合二元二次规划（MBQP）的求解，通过引入新的神经网络架构、训练数据收集流程以及结合对比损失和加权交叉熵损失的扩展损失函数，在标准与真实世界基准上显著优于现有启发式方法和求解器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MBQP是一类重要的组合优化问题，但由于非线性和组合复杂性，大规模求解极具挑战。现有原始启发式方法效率有限，而机器学习辅助方法多聚焦于混合整数线性规划（MILP），缺乏针对MBQP的有效ML引导方法。

Method: 1) 提出用于MBQP解预测的新型神经网络架构；2) 设计新的训练数据收集流程；3) 扩展现有损失函数，提出结合对比损失与加权交叉熵损失的联合训练方式。

Result: 在标准MBQP基准和真实世界风电场布局优化问题上，所提ML引导方法在求解质量与速度上显著超越现有原始启发式方法和最先进求解器；结合扩展损失函数的模型性能优于从MILP直接迁移的ML方法，并在跨区域推理中展现出更强的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 将ML引导的解预测方法成功扩展到MBQP领域，验证了结合对比学习与加权交叉熵损失的有效性，为非线性组合优化问题的ML加速提供了新思路。

Abstract: Mixed Binary Quadratic Programs (MBQPs) are an important and complex set of problems in combinatorial optimization. As solving large-scale combinatorial optimization problems is challenging, primal heuristics have been developed to quickly identify high-quality solutions within a short amount of time. Recently, a growing body of research has also used machine learning to accelerate solution methods for challenging combinatorial optimization problems. Despite the increasing popularity of these ML-guided methods, a large body of work has focused on Mixed-Integer Linear Programs (MILPs). MBQPs are challenging to solve due to the combinatorial complexity coupled with nonlinearities. This work proposes ML-guided primal heuristics for Mixed Binary Quadratic Programs (MBQPs) by adapting and extending existing work on ML-guided MILP solution prediction to MBQPs. We introduce a new neural network architecture for MBQP solution prediction and a new training data collection procedure. Moreover, we extend existing loss functions in solution prediction and propose to combine contrastive and weighted cross-entropy losses. We evaluate the methods on standard and real-world MBQP benchmarks and show that the developed ML-guided methods significantly outperform existing primal heuristics and state-of-the-art solvers. Furthermore, models trained with our proposed extension with combined losses outperform other ML-based methods adapted from MILPs and improve generalization in cross-regional inference on a real-world wind farm layout optimization problem.

</details>


### [746] [Advancing Ligand-based Virtual Screening and Molecular Generation with Pretrained Molecular Embedding Distance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.24474)
*Shiyun Wa,Yifei Wang,Simone Sciabola,Ye Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出预训练嵌入距离（PED）作为分子相似性的度量方法，直接从预训练分子模型中计算，无需任务特定训练，在虚拟筛选和分子生成中表现有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统分子相似性度量（如基于指纹的Tanimoto系数、3D形状叠合）计算成本高且依赖手工描述符；深度学习方法则依赖相似性专用监督或昂贵的数据标注，泛化能力有限。

Method: 利用预训练分子模型直接计算嵌入距离（PED）作为分子相似性度量，无需针对相似性任务进行额外训练。

Result: PED与传统相似性度量具有显著相关性，在虚拟筛选的分子排序和基于奖励设计的分子生成引导中均表现良好。

Conclusion: 预训练分子嵌入能捕获丰富的结构信息，可作为现代AI辅助药物发现中一种有前景且可扩展的相似性度量方法。

Abstract: Molecular similarity plays a central role in ligand-based drug discovery, such as virtual screening, analog searching, and goal-directed molecular generation. However, traditional similarity measures, ranging from fingerprint-based Tanimoto coefficients to 3D shape overlays, are often computationally expensive at scale or rely on hand-crafted molecular descriptors. Meanwhile, many deep learning approaches to similarity-aware design still depend on similarity-specific supervision or costly data curation, limiting their generality across targets. In this work, we propose pretrained embedding distance (PED) as an effective alternative, computed directly from pretrained molecular models without task-specific training. Experimental results show that PED exhibits distinct correlations with traditional similarity metrics, and performs effectively in both ranking molecules for virtual screening and guiding molecular generation via reward design. These findings suggest that pretrained molecular embeddings capture rich structural information and can serve as a promising and scalable similarity measurement for modern AI-aided drug discovery.

</details>


### [747] [Do Larger Models Really Win in Drug Discovery? A Benchmark Assessment of Model Scaling in AI-Driven Molecular Property and Activity Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26498)
*Jinjiang Guo,Sheng Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究系统比较了经典机器学习、预训练分子模型、图神经网络和大语言模型在26个ADME、毒性和生物活性终点上的表现，发现经典ML在156项任务与指标对比中占据最大赢家份额（47.4%），模型性能取决于模型、任务与验证场景的匹配，而非单纯依赖规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证分子基础模型和大语言模型在药物发现中是否真的能够以规模优势取代经典化学信息学模型，测试“更大即更优”这一普遍假设。

Method: 构建覆盖165,541条化合物标签记录的基准，包含26个ADME/毒性/生物活性终点、78个端点与拆分条目，采用随机、Murcko骨架和结构分离三种5折交叉验证协议，对经典ML、预训练分子序列模型、GNN和LLM基线的表现进行系统比较。

Result: 经典ML以47.4%的份额获得最多最佳表现条目，其次是预训练分子序列模型（28.8%）、GNN（21.8%）和LLM（1.9%）。经典ML在随机拆分插值中占主导地位。GNN和序列模型在困难拆分中有竞争力，但对训练设置和模型选择敏感。成对bootstrap分析表明小数值差异不可视为决定性胜利。

Conclusion: 紧凑的专用模型仍然高效，预测性能取决于模型、任务与验证场景的匹配，而非仅依赖模型规模。SAR知识可改善LLM指标，但规则推理无法普遍替代监督预测器。

Abstract: The rapid growth of molecular foundation models and large language models (LLMs) has encouraged a scale centred view of AI in drug discovery, in which larger pretrained models are expected to supersede compact cheminformatics models. We test this assumption across 26 ADME, toxicity and bioactivity endpoints, covering 165,541 endpoint level compound label records. The benchmark contains 78 endpoint and split entries evaluated under random, Murcko scaffold and structure separated 5-fold cross validation protocols, representing increasing chemical generalization difficulty. Across 156 task and metric comparisons, classical machine learning (ML) provides the largest share of best performing entries (47.4%), followed by pretrained molecular sequence models (28.8%), graph neural networks (21.8%) and LLM based SAR baselines (1.9%). Classical ML dominates random split interpolation and remains the largest winner family overall. GNN and sequence models are competitive in selected harder splits, but their strict winner shares decrease under a fixed final-window readout, indicating sensitivity to training settings and model selection. Paired bootstrap analyses show that small numerical differences between individual models should not be read as decisive victories. SAR knowledge from training folds improves GPT5.5-SAR and Opus4.7-SAR metrics but does not make rule based reasoning a universal substitute for supervised predictors. Compact specialized models remain highly effective, and predictive performance depends on the fit among model, task and validation scenario, not on scale alone.

</details>


### [748] [Simple Self-Conditioning Adaptation for Masked Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26985)
*Michael Cardei,Huu Binh Ta,Ferdinando Fioretto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出自条件掩码扩散模型（SCMDM），一种无需重新训练即可改进掩码扩散模型的简单后训练适应方法，通过在去噪步骤中利用模型自身的上一轮干净状态预测来提升生成质量，在多个领域取得显著改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准掩码扩散模型中，若某标记在反向更新后仍处于掩码状态，模型会丢弃该位置之前的干净状态预测，导致仍被掩码的位置必须仅从掩码标记反复推断，限制了跨步骤的细化能力。

Method: SCMDM是一种后训练适应方法，在每一步去噪时，将模型上一轮生成的干净状态预测作为条件输入，无需引入循环隐状态通路、无需辅助参考模型、无需额外的去噪器评估，且仅需最小的架构改动。

Result: 在OWT训练模型上将生成困惑度从42.89降至23.72（降低近50%），并在离散图像合成、小分子生成和基因组分布建模等多个领域展示了一致的改进。

Conclusion: 本文证明了在训练后微调场景下，部分自条件方法（包括常用的50% dropout策略）是次优的；一旦模型自身的干净状态估计变得有信息量，专注于细化比混合条件与非条件目标更优。

Abstract: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate discrete sequences by iterative denoising under an absorbing masking process. In standard masked diffusion, if a token remains masked after a reverse update, the model discards its clean-state prediction for that position. Thus, still-masked positions must be repeatedly inferred from the mask token alone. This design choice limits cross-step refinement. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a simple, yet effective, post-training adaptation for MDMs that conditions each denoising step on the model's own previous clean-state predictions. The resulting method, called Self-Conditioned Masked Diffusion Models (SCMDM), requires minimal architectural change, does not introduce a recurrent latent-state pathway, does not rely on an auxiliary reference model, and adds no extra denoiser evaluations during sampling. This is an important departure from partial self-conditioning approaches which requires expensive model training from scratch. In particular, the paper shows that partial self-conditioning, including the commonly used 50% dropout strategy for training self-conditioned models from scratch, is suboptimal in the post-training regime. Instead, once the model's self-generated clean-state estimates become informative, the specialization to refinement is preferable to mixing conditional and unconditional objectives. SCMDM is evaluated across multiple domains, demonstrating consistent improvement over vanilla MDM baselines, achieving nearly a 50% reduction in generative perplexity on OWT-trained models (42.89 to 23.72), alongside strong improvements in discretized image synthesis quality, small molecular generation, and enhanced fidelity in genomic distribution modeling.

</details>


### [749] [Hyper-Dimensional Fingerprints as Molecular Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27810)
*Jonas Teufel,Luca Torresi,André Eberhard,Pascal Friederich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出超维指纹（HDF），用高维向量的代数运算替代图神经网络的学习变换，无需训练即可生成确定性分子表示，在多项任务中优于传统指纹，尤其低维下保持结构保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
