Motivation: 传统分子指纹通过哈希压缩损失结构信息，尤其低维时严重；而图神经网络虽表达力强但需任务特定训练和大量计算资源。作者希望找到一种无需训练、高效且保持结构保真度的分子表示方法。

Method: 将消息传递神经网络的 learned transformations 替换为高维向量上的代数运算，生成确定性的超维指纹（HDF），完全无需训练。

Result: HDF在多数性质预测任务上优于传统指纹；32维时HDF空间距离与图编辑距离的Pearson相关系数为0.9（Morgan指纹仅0.55）；64维下简单最近邻回归仍具预测能力；在贝叶斯分子优化中显著提升样本效率。

Conclusion: HDF是一种通用、无需训练的分子指纹替代方案，表明传统指纹的信息损失源于哈希编码方案而非指纹范式本身。

Abstract: Computational molecular representations underpin virtual screening, property prediction, and materials discovery. Conventional fingerprints are efficient and deterministic but lose structural information through hash-based compression, particularly at low dimensionalities. Learned representations from graph neural networks recover this expressiveness but require task-specific training and substantial computational resources. Here we introduce hyperdimensional fingerprints (HDF), which replace the learned transformations of message-passing neural networks with algebraic operations on high-dimensional vectors, producing deterministic molecular representations without any training. Across diverse property prediction benchmarks, HDF outperforms conventional fingerprints in the majority of tasks while exhibiting greater consistency across datasets and models. Crucially, HDF embeddings preserve molecular similarity faithfully: at 32 dimensions, distances in HDF space achieve a 0.9 Pearson correlation with graph edit distance, compared to 0.55 for Morgan fingerprints at equivalent size. This structural fidelity persists at low dimensions where hash-based methods degrade, allowing simple nearest-neighbor regression to remain predictive with as few as 64 components. We further demonstrate the practical impact in Bayesian molecular optimization, where HDF-based surrogate models achieve substantially improved sample efficiency in regimes where Morgan fingerprints perform comparably to random search. HDF thus provides a general-purpose, training-free alternative to conventional molecular fingerprints, suggesting that the information loss long accepted as inherent to fixed-length fingerprints is a limitation of the hash-based encoding scheme rather than the fingerprint paradigm itself.

</details>


### [750] [Label-Conditioned Cross-Modal Fusion for Adult-to-Pediatric ECG Transfer via Curriculum-Gated Contrastive Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.00647)
*Xinran Liu,Yuwen Li,Hongxiang Gao,Heyang Xu,Jianqing Li,Zongmin Wang,Chengyu Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PEACE框架，通过成人-儿童心电图跨模态对齐，利用标签特定双向对比学习与课程自适应融合，在有限儿科标签下实现从成人到儿童ECG诊断的有效迁移，性能优于多种基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化儿童心电图解读因心率、间期和波形随发育变化而面临挑战，成人数据训练的模型难以直接迁移，且专家标注的儿科ECG数据集稀缺。

Method: 提出PEACE框架：1) 在MIMIC-IV成人ECG上预训练；2) 标签特定双向对比学习(LSBC)对齐ECG表示与诊断语义；3) 课程自适应融合(CAF)在有限儿科监督下稳定优化；4) 标签条件短文本描述符提供辅助语义监督，推理时仅需ECG信号。

Result: 在ZZU-pECG数据集上，零样本、50-shot和全微调设置下宏平均AUC分别达59.39%、81.74%和91.56%；在PTB-XL上全微调达96.90%宏平均AUC；梯度注意力图显示与临床解释一致的波形关注区域。

Conclusion: 成人规模ECG预训练结合节律、形态和ST-T复极化语义描述符，能在儿科标签稀缺条件下提升可迁移的儿童诊断性能，同时保持临床可解释的波形关注。

Abstract: Automated pediatric electrocardiogram (ECG) interpretation remains challenging because developmental differences in heart rate, intervals, and waveforms limit the transferability of models trained mainly on adult data, while expert-labeled pediatric ECG cohorts are scarce. We propose PEACE (Pediatric-Adult ECG Alignment via Cross-modal Enhancement), an adult-to-pediatric ECG transfer framework pretrained on MIMIC-IV ECGs and adapted to pediatric targets. PEACE integrates label-specific bidirectional contrastive learning (LSBC) to align ECG representations with diagnostic semantics and curriculum adaptive fusion (CAF) to stabilize optimization under limited pediatric supervision. Label-conditioned short text descriptors provide auxiliary semantic supervision during training, whereas inference requires ECG signals only. On ZZU-pECG, PEACE achieves macro-average AUCs of 59.39%, 81.74%, and 91.56% under zero-shot, 50-shot, and full fine-tuning settings, respectively, outperforming ECG-only, multimodal, and generic domain adaptation baselines including DANN and MMD. On PTB-XL, it reaches 96.90% macro-average AUC after full fine-tuning over nine harmonized labels with nonzero mapped incidence. Gradient-based attention maps show increased saliency around QRS voltage and morphology regions for chamber-related RVH and around QRS-to-T/repolarization intervals for LQTS, broadly consistent with ECG regions commonly inspected during routine interpretation. These results suggest that adult-scale ECG pretraining coupled with rhythm, morphology, and ST-T repolarization semantic descriptors improves transferable pediatric diagnosis under label scarcity while preserving clinically interpretable waveform focus.

</details>


### [751] [Kernel Affine Hull Machines as Compute-Efficient Encoders for Frozen Semantic Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.02950)
*Mohit Kumar,Somayeh Kargaran,Bernhard A. Moser,Manuela Geiß*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出核仿射包机（KAHM）替代神经查询编码器，在固定的教师表示空间下，利用显式RKHS假设空间中的核方法从廉价词汇特征估计语义向量，实现无需反向传播的查询编码，在奥地利法律检索基准上以更低计算代价达到或超越Transformer编码器的检索性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在基于Transformer的语义编码检索系统中，在线查询编码是重复性瓶颈，而离线语料索引可复用。本文研究能否在固定教师表示空间和语料索引后，用轻量级解析估计器替代反复的神经查询编码。

Method: 将固定教师词法到语义编码视为条件均值估计问题：目标语义向量表示为语义原型带后验聚类权重的噪声混合。利用KAHM几何在显式RKHS假设空间中从廉价词汇特征估计后验权重，并通过归一化最小均方更新从含噪教师嵌入中精炼语义原型，构建无反向传播的查询端编码器。

Result: 在奥地利法律检索基准上（5000测试查询、84候选法律、10762对齐单元），KAHM在所有评估截断处取得最佳教师空间重建和排序敏感检索性能：MRR@20=0.504, Hit@20=0.694, Top-1 Accuracy=0.411，在线查询时间比Transformer编码器降低8.53倍（CPU设置）。

Conclusion: KAHM可作为监督固定表示部署场景下的计算高效编码器，支持端到端误差分解（后验逼近、有限样本/泛化、教师噪声三项），为替代重复神经查询编码提供了理论可行且实践有效的方案。

Abstract: Transformer-based semantic encoders are effective for retrieval, but in many deployments the recurring bottleneck is online query encoding rather than offline corpus indexing. This paper studies whether, once a strong teacher representation space and corpus index are fixed, repeated neural query encoding can be replaced by a substantially lighter and analytically explicit estimator. We formulate fixed-teacher lexical-to-semantic encoding as a conditional-mean estimation problem in which the target semantic vector is represented as a noisy mixture of semantic prototypes weighted by posterior cluster probabilities. Kernel Affine Hull Machine (KAHM) geometry is used to estimate these posterior weights from inexpensive lexical features in an explicitly identified RKHS hypothesis space, and the semantic prototypes are refined by normalized least-mean-squares updates from noisy teacher embeddings. This yields a backpropagation-free query-side encoder together with an end-to-end error decomposition into posterior-approximation, finite-sample/generalization, and teacher-noise terms. We instantiate the approach on a controlled Austrian-law retrieval benchmark with 5,000 test queries, 84 candidate laws, and 10,762 aligned retrieval units, using law-specific encoders into a frozen Mixedbread embedding space. Among evaluation-matched learned adapters, KAHM achieves the strongest teacher-space reconstruction and the best rank-sensitive retrieval performance at all evaluated cutoffs. At k=20, it obtains MRR@20 = 0.504, Hit@20 = 0.694, and Top-1 Accuracy = 0.411, while reducing online per-query time by 8.53 relative to direct transformer query encoding in the reported CPU setting. The results support KAHMs as compute-efficient encoders for supervised fixed-representation deployment regimes.

</details>


### [752] [Neuron-Anchored Rule Extraction for Large Language Models via Contrastive Hierarchical Ablation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.03058)
*Francesco Sovrano,Gabriele Dominici,Marc Langheinrich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MechaRule是一种通过定位并消融稀疏agonist激活来从LLM电路中提取规则的新方法，在算术和越狱任务上以仅2.14%的穷举消融成本实现了97.0%的agonist召回率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有规则提取方法通常学习未接地（ungrounded）的符号代理，而机械可解释性虽能将行为与神经元关联，但需要人工假设和昂贵的干预。因此，需要一种能够将规则提取与LLM内部电路机制连接起来的高效方法。

Method: MechaRule基于两个关键发现：(1)在固定基线/翻转（baseline/flip）机制下，稀疏agonist效应存在"overtopping"现象——少量高效应激活在较大组中仍可检测并主导较弱效应；采用自适应分组测试与置信度引导的保守剪枝，当k<<N时仅需O(k log(N/k)+k)次干预。(2)在接近忠实规则行为的数据划分上定位agonist更可靠；谱分割（spectral splits）提供无需规则的备选方案。

Result: 在算术和越狱任务上，MechaRule以仅2.14%的穷举消融成本平均召回97.0%的最高效应agonist。消融定位到的agonist可消除97.6-100.0%的合格正确算术答案和越狱行为，并可纠正高达72.8%的算术错误或诱导32.5%的越狱。

Conclusion: MechaRule成功实现了规则提取与LLM内部电路机制的有效连接，在效率和效果上均表现出显著优势，为可解释AI提供了新途径。

Abstract: A central goal of explainable AI is to express large language model (LLM) decision logic symbolically and ground it in internal mechanisms. Existing rule-extraction methods usually learn ungrounded symbolic surrogates, while mechanistic interpretability links behavior to neurons but often requires hand-crafted hypotheses and costly interventions. We introduce MechaRule, a pipeline that grounds rule extraction in LLM circuits by localizing sparse agonist activations whose ablation disrupts rule-related behavior. MechaRule rests on two findings. First, in a fixed baseline/flip regime, sparse agonist effects can exhibit overtopping: a few high-effect activations remain detectable within larger groups, dominate weaker ones, and flip many of the same examples. In such regimes, adaptive group testing with confidence-guided conservative pruning requires O(k log(N/k) + k) interventions over N candidates when k << N are agonists. Second, agonists are localized more reliably on data splits aligned with close-to-faithful rule behavior; spectral splits provide a rule-free fallback, whereas unfaithful splits degrade localization. Empirically, on arithmetic and jailbreaking, MechaRule recalls 97.0% of highest-effect agonists in matched brute-force validations at only 2.14% of exhaustive-ablation cost on average. Ablating the localized agonists eliminates 97.6--100.0% of eligible correct arithmetic answers and jailbreaks, and can correct arithmetic errors or induce jailbreaks by up to 72.8% and 32.5%.

</details>


### [753] [Self-Mined Hardness for Safety Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.03226)
*Prakhar Gupta,Garv Shah,Donghua Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的语言模型安全微调方法：通过模型自身 rollout 的 harmfulness 评分筛选高难度对抗样本，仅用这些困难样本及其非越狱响应进行微调。实验表明该方法能显著降低攻击成功率（由11.5%/20.1%降至1-3%），但会大幅提升对伪装成越狱的良性提示的拒答率（从14-22%升至74-94%）。通过1:1混合这些困难样本与对抗框架下的良性提示，可将拒答率降至30-72%，虽以2-6个百分点的攻击成功率为代价。在混合训练中，选择最困难的一半样本可额外降低35-50%的攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统安全微调依赖精心策划的对抗数据集，本文探索能否仅通过模型自身 rollout 的 harmfulness 评分来自动筛选困难样本进行微调，从而降低对人工数据集的依赖。

Method: 1) 对每个候选提示，用目标模型自身生成多个 rollout，根据 judge 评分统计有害内容出现频率作为难度指标；2) 仅对难度最高的提示及其对应的非越狱 rollout 进行 DPO 风格的安全微调；3) 进一步将困难对抗样本与对抗框架下的良性提示按1:1混合训练，并比较选择最困难一半 vs 随机一半样本的效果。

Result: Llama-3-8B-Instruct 和 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 上 WildJailbreak 攻击成功率从 11.5%/20.1% 降至 1-3%；但良性伪装越狱提示上的拒答率从 14-22% 升至 74-94%。混合训练将拒答率降至 30-51%（8B）和 52-72%（3B），攻击成功率增加 2-6 个百分点。选择最困难一半样本较随机一半额外降低 35-50% 攻击成功率。

Conclusion: 基于模型自身 rollout 困难度评分的自动化对抗样本筛选是可行的，但会带来严重的过度拒绝问题，需要通过与对抗框架良性提示的混合训练来缓解。在混合数据中优先选择最困难的样本能进一步提升安全性能与效率的平衡。

Abstract: Safety fine-tuning of language models typically requires a curated adversarial dataset. We take a different approach: score each candidate prompt's difficulty by how often the target model's own rollouts are judged harmful, then fine-tune on the hardest prompts paired with the model's own non-jailbroken rollouts. On Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, this approach cuts the WildJailbreak attack success rate from 11.5% and 20.1% down to 1-3%, but pushes refusal on jailbreak-shaped benign prompts from 14-22% to 74-94%. Interleaving the same hard prompts 1:1 with adversarially-framed benign prompts (prompts that look like jailbreaks but have benign intent) cuts that refusal back down to 30-51% on 8B and 52-72% on 3B, at a cost of 2-6 percentage points of attack success rate. Within the mixed regime, training on the hardest half of the eligible pool rather than a random half cuts the remaining ASR by 35-50% (about 3 percentage points) on both models.

</details>


### [754] [Population-Aware Imitation Learning in Mean-field Games with Common Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.03357)
*Grégoire Lambrecht,Mathieu Laurière*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了具有共同噪声的平均场博弈中的模仿学习问题，提出了两种学习目标（恢复纳什均衡和模仿专家表现）以及两种模仿代理（行为克隆和对抗散度），建立了有限样本误差界，并通过广义虚拟博弈和深度学习框架验证了群体感知策略的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在具有共同噪声的MFG中，群体分布随机演化，迫使智能体需要采用群体感知策略来应对聚合冲击。现有IL方法大多忽视这种随机性，导致策略失效，因此需要专门研究MFG中的IL问题。

Method: 提出了两种学习目标（恢复纳什均衡和最大化对抗专家表现），两种模仿代理（BC和ADV散度），建立了有限样本误差界证明最小化这些代理能有效控制策略的可剥削性和性能差距，并使用广义虚拟博弈和深度学习计算专家群体感知策略。

Result: 在三个环境上的实验表明，标准群体无感知策略无法捕捉均衡动态，学习群体感知策略对于避免被共同噪声中的随机性误导至关重要。

Conclusion: 群体感知策略是应对共同噪声下MFG模仿学习的关键，BC和ADV两种代理均能有效控制策略质量，数值框架能够成功计算专家策略。

Abstract: Mean Field Games (MFGs) provide a powerful framework for modeling the collective behavior of large populations of interacting agents. In this paper, we address the problem of Imitation Learning (IL) in MFGs subject to common noise, where the population distribution evolves stochastically. This stochasticity compels agents to adopt population-aware policies to respond to aggregate shocks. We formulate two distinct learning objectives: recovering a Nash equilibrium and maximizing performance against an expert population. We investigate two imitation proxies: Behavioral Cloning (BC) and Adversarial (ADV) divergence. We then establish finite-sample error bounds showing that minimizing these proxies effectively controls both the policy's exploitability and its performance gap relative to the expert. Furthermore, we propose a numerical framework using generalized Fictitious Play and Deep Learning to compute expert population-aware policies. Through experiments on three environments we demonstrate that standard population-unaware policies fail to capture the equilibrium dynamics. Our results highlight that learning population-aware policies is crucial to avoid being misled by the randomness inherent in common noise.

</details>


### [755] [MinMax Recurrent Neural Cascades](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06384)
*Alessandro Ronca*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MinMax循环神经级联（MinMax RNCs），一种基于MinMax代数的新型循环神经网络。该方法同时具备强形式表达能力（等价于正则语言）、高效并行计算（对数深度、线性工作）、稳定动态（状态均匀有界）、非消失梯度（梯度范数保持为1）等理想性质。实验表明，该模型在合成任务上表现完美，并在1.12亿参数的语言建模任务上取得有竞争力的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有循环神经网络在形式上表达能力有限、训练中易出现梯度消失/爆炸、状态动态不稳定等问题，难以同时兼顾强表达能力、高效计算和稳定训练。

Method: 基于MinMax代数构建新型循环神经网络（MinMax RNCs），利用该代数的性质实现状态均匀有界、梯度非消失、支持并行扫描计算（对数深度线性工作）等特性，其形式表达能力等价于正则语言。

Result: 合成任务完美解决且能泛化到长序列，优于对比的循环基线模型；1.12亿参数的下一个词预测任务取得有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: MinMax RNCs在形式表达力、计算效率、动态稳定性和梯度传播方面实现了难以同时获得的理想特性，具有扩展到实际序列建模任务的潜力。

Abstract: We introduce MinMax Recurrent Neural Cascades (MinMax RNCs), a class of recurrent neural networks built from a novel form of recurrence over the MinMax algebra. We show that MinMax RNCs enjoy key properties that are difficult to obtain simultaneously: strong formal expressivity, efficient evaluation, stable dynamics, and non-vanishing state gradients. First, their formal expressivity corresponds to the regular languages, arguably the maximal expressivity for finite-memory systems. Second, in addition to evaluation in recurrent form, they also admit parallel-scan evaluation with logarithmic depth and linear work in the input length. Third, their states and activations are uniformly bounded for all sequence lengths. Fourth, their loss gradients exist almost everywhere and are uniformly bounded for all sequence lengths. Fifth, they do not exhibit vanishing state gradients: the gradient of a state with respect to a past state can retain norm one independently of the temporal distance between the states. Empirically, we find that these theoretical properties translate into strong practical performance. MinMax RNCs solve the considered synthetic tasks perfectly, generalise to long sequences, and outperform the recurrent baselines considered in our experiments. We also train a 112M-parameter MinMax RNC for next-token prediction, obtaining competitive performance for its size and providing initial evidence that MinMax recurrence can scale to real-world sequence-modelling tasks.

</details>


### [756] [PairAlign: A Framework for Sequence Tokenization via Self-Alignment with Applications to Audio Tokenization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06582)
*Adhiraj Banerjee,Vipul Arora*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PairAlign 是一个通过序列级自对齐实现紧凑音频分词化的框架，将分词视为条件序列生成，通过内容保持视图间的交叉预测学习符号序列，在保持编辑距离的同时将存档令牌数减少55%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音频分词器依赖量化、聚类或编解码器重建，在局部层面分配令牌，导致序列一致性、紧凑性、长度控制、终止符位置和编辑相似度等全局属性很少被直接优化。

Method: 将分词化为条件序列生成：编码器将语音映射为连续条件，自回归解码器从BOS生成令牌，同时学习令牌身份、顺序、长度和EOS位置。通过内容保持视图间的交叉训练（每个视图的序列在另一视图表示下具有高似然），结合无关样本的竞争序列，实现编辑距离保持的替代目标。采用VQ风格初始化、EMA教师目标、交叉配对教师强制、前缀破坏、似然对比和长度控制等技术。

Result: 在3秒语音上学习到紧凑、非退化的序列，词汇使用广泛且跨视图一致性强。检索测试中保持编辑距离搜索能力，同时将存档令牌数减少55%。连续扫描探测显示，相比密集几何分词器局部重叠更低，但在100毫秒位移下具有更强的长度控制和有界编辑轨迹。

Conclusion: PairAlign 是一种序列符号预测学习器：类似JEPA目标，它从一个视图预测另一个视图的抽象目标，但输出的是可学习的变长符号序列而非连续潜变量。

Abstract: Many operations on sensory data -- comparison, memory, retrieval, and reasoning -- are naturally expressed over discrete symbolic structures. In language this interface is given by tokens; in audio, it must be learned. Existing audio tokenizers rely on quantization, clustering, or codec reconstruction, assigning tokens locally, so sequence consistency, compactness, length control, termination, and edit similarity are rarely optimized directly.
  We introduce PairAlign, a framework for compact audio tokenization through sequence-level self-alignment. PairAlign treats tokenization as conditional sequence generation: an encoder maps speech to a continuous condition, and an autoregressive decoder generates tokens from BOS, learning token identity, order, length, and EOS placement. Given two content-preserving views, each view's sequence is trained to be likely under the other's representation, while unrelated examples provide competing sequences. This gives a scalable surrogate for edit-distance preservation while discouraging many-to-one collapse.
  PairAlign starts from VQ-style tokenization and refines it with EMA-teacher targets, cross-paired teacher forcing, prefix corruption, likelihood contrast, and length control.
  On 3-second speech, PairAlign learns compact, non-degenerate sequences with broad vocabulary usage and strong cross-view consistency. On retrieval tests, it preserves edit-distance search while reducing archive token count by 55%. A continuous-sweep probe shows lower local overlap than a dense geometric tokenizer, but stronger length control and bounded edit trajectories under 100 ms shifts. PairAlign is a sequence-symbolic predictive learner: like JEPA-style objectives, it predicts an abstract target from another view as a learned variable-length symbolic sequence, not a continuous latent.

</details>


### [757] [OTora: A Unified Red Teaming Framework for Reasoning-Level Denial-of-Service in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08876)
*Xinyu Li,Ronghui Mu,Lin Li,Tianjin Huang,Gaojie Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出OTora框架，首个统一的两阶段红队测试框架，用于实例化推理层拒绝服务（R-DoS）攻击。该攻击通过优化对抗触发器诱导工具调用，并生成让模型过度思考的推理载荷，在保持任务正确性的同时大幅增加推理token数和延迟（最高10倍）。论文在WebShop、Email和OS等多个AI Agent上验证了攻击效果，并讨论了缓解策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型作为自主Agent部署时，延迟是关键因素，但现有研究忽略了推理层拒绝服务（R-DoS）攻击——攻击者在保持任务正确性的同时，通过膨胀Agent的推理深度或工具使用预算来降低可用性。

Method: 提出OTora两阶段红队测试框架：第一阶段通过插入感知评分和动态目标协同进化优化对抗触发器，诱导目标工具调用，支持黑盒和白盒设置；第二阶段通过ICL引导的遗传搜索生成Agent感知的推理载荷，放大过度思考行为同时保持任务正确性。

Result: 在基于LLaMA-70B和GPT-OSS-120B等多个骨干模型的WebShop、Email和OS Agent上，OTora实现了高达10倍的推理token增长和数量级的延迟增加，同时保持接近基线的任务准确率。

Conclusion: R-DoS攻击是LLM Agent部署中不可忽视的安全威胁，OTora框架有效揭示了这一漏洞，并提出了检测和约束异常推理及延迟峰值的缓解策略。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents that execute tool-augmented, multi-step tasks, where latency is a critical factor for real-world applications. Yet an overlooked threat is Reasoning-Level Denial-of-Service (R-DoS), in which an attacker preserves task correctness but degrades availability by inflating an agent's reasoning depth or tool-use budget. We introduce OTora, the first unified, two-stage red-teaming framework for instantiating R-DoS attacks. Stage I optimizes an adversarial trigger that induces targeted tool invocations using insertion-aware scoring and dynamic target co-evolution, supporting both black-box and white-box settings. Stage II generates agent-aware reasoning payloads via an ICL-guided genetic search that amplifies overthinking while maintaining correct task outcomes. Across WebShop, Email, and OS agents built on multiple backbone models such as LLaMA-70B and GPT-OSS-120B, OTora achieves up to 10 times increases in reasoning tokens and order-of-magnitude latency slowdowns, all while preserving near-baseline task accuracy. Finally, we discuss mitigation strategies for detecting and constraining abnormal reasoning and latency spikes. The code is available at https://github.com/llm2409/OTora.

</details>


### [758] [Improving the Performance and Learning Stability of Parallelizable RNNs Designed for Ultra-Low Power Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.11855)
*Julien Brandoit,Arthur Fyon,Damien Ernst,Guillaume Drion*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出累积更新公式解决BMRU的梯度阻塞问题，得到CMRU和αCMRU，在保持量化状态和持久记忆的同时，匹配或超越LRU和minGRU的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BMRU虽然支持超低功耗的硬件-软件协同设计，但在复杂序列任务上性能落后于可并行化的RNN，因其状态更新过程中存在梯度阻塞问题。

Method: 提出累积更新公式（cumulative update formulation），通过恢复梯度流并创建时间维度的跳跃连接，解决BMRU的梯度阻塞问题，由此得到CMRU及其松弛变体αCMRU。

Result: 累积公式显著提升收敛稳定性并降低初始化敏感性。在小规模模型下，CMRU和αCMRU在多个基准任务上匹配或超越LRU和minGRU，尤其在需要离散长程保持的任务上表现突出。

Conclusion: CMRU保持了量化状态、持久记忆和抗噪声动力学特性，适用于模拟电路实现，同时在性能上达到或领先于当前主流的并行化RNN架构。

Abstract: Sequence learning is dominated by Transformers and parallelizable recurrent neural networks (RNNs) such as state-space models, yet learning long-term dependencies remains challenging, and state-of-the-art designs trade power consumption for performance. The Bistable Memory Recurrent Unit (BMRU) was introduced to enable hardware-software co-design of ultra-low power RNNs: quantized states with hysteresis provide persistent memory while mapping directly to analog primitives. However, BMRU performance lags behind parallelizable RNNs on complex sequential tasks. In this paper, we identify gradient blocking during state updates as a key limitation and propose a cumulative update formulation that restores gradient flow while preserving persistent memory, creating skip-connections through time. This leads to the Cumulative Memory Recurrent Unit (CMRU) and its relaxed variant, the $α$CMRU. Experiments show that the cumulative formulation dramatically improves convergence stability and reduces initialization sensitivity. The CMRU and $α$CMRU match or outperform Linear Recurrent Units (LRUs) and minimal Gated Recurrent Units (minGRUs) across diverse benchmarks at small model sizes, with particular advantages on tasks requiring discrete long-range retention, while the CMRU retains quantized states, persistent memory, and noise-resilient dynamics essential for analog implementation.

</details>


### [759] [High-Rate Quantized Matrix Multiplication II](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13768)
*Or Ordentlich,Yury Polyanskiy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了量化矩阵乘法在权重后训练量化中的应用，提出了基于水填充（waterfilling）的非均匀比特分配方法（WaterSIC），相比GPTQ的均匀分配方案，在高码率下接近信息论极限，且具有基向量无关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM权重量化算法（如GPTQ）在坐标间均匀分配比特，未考虑各坐标方差差异。利用协方差矩阵信息进行非均匀比特分配有望提升量化性能，逼近信息论极限。

Method: 将权重量化建模为加权均方误差（WMSE）信源编码问题，利用经典的反向水填充（reverse waterfilling）解进行非均匀比特分配。分析了仅使用标量INT量化器的WaterSIC方案的高码率性能，并与GPTQ进行对比。

Result: WaterSIC的高码率性能：(a) 基向量无关，仅由Σ_X的行列式决定，对随机旋转免疫；(b) 距信息论失真极限仅差一个2πe/12的乘性因子（约0.25 bit/entry）。GPTQ在随机旋转下与WaterSIC相差约0.1 bit（取决于层类型），表明其在高码率下也接近最优。

Conclusion: 利用协方差信息的非均匀比特分配（水填充）可提升LLM权重量化性能；在随机旋转下，GPTQ实际上也接近最优，但WaterSIC具有基向量无关的理论优势。

Abstract: This is the second part of the work investigating quantized matrix multiplication (MatMul). In part I we considered the case of calibration-free quantization, whereas here we discuss the setting where covariance matrix $Σ_X$ of the columns of the second factor is available. This setting arises in the ubiquitous task of weight-only post-training quantization of LLMs.
  Weight-only quantization is related to the problem of weighted mean squared error (WMSE) source coding, whose classical (reverse) waterfilling solution dictates how one should distribute rate between coordinates of the vector. We show how waterfilling can be used to improve practical LLM quantization algorithms (GPTQ), which at present allocate rate equally. A recent scheme (known as ``WaterSIC'') that only uses scalar INT quantizers is analyzed and its high-rate performance is shown to be (a) basis free (i.e., characterized by the determinant of $Σ_X$ and, thus, unlike existing schemes, is immune to applying random rotations); and (b) within a multiplicative factor of $\frac{2πe}{12}$ (or 0.25 bit/entry) of the information-theoretic distortion limit. GPTQ's performance, in turn, is affected by the choice of basis, but for a random rotation and actual $Σ_X$ from Llama-3-8B we find it to be within 0.1 bit (depending on the layer type) of WaterSIC, suggesting that GPTQ with random rotation is also near optimal, at least in the high-rate regime.

</details>


### [760] [Margin-Adaptive Confidence Ranking for Reliable LLM Judgement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15416)
*Gaojie Jin,Yong Tao,Lijia Yu,Tianjin Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出用专门学习的置信度估计器替代启发式置信度信号，通过模拟标注者多样性和基于间隔的排序公式来更好地建模LLM输出与人类判断的一致性，并提供了该估计器的泛化保证，在固定序列测试中显著提高了排序准确性和目标一致水平的达成率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有假设检验框架依赖"模型估计置信度与人类分歧风险单调"这一假设，但该假设在实践中可能被违反，且置信度估计器的泛化行为未被充分分析。

Method: 学习专用置信度估计器，利用模拟标注者多样性和基于间隔的排序公式显式建模LLM区分人类一致与分歧案例的能力，并推导泛化保证以指导自适应训练过程。

Result: 在多个数据集和评估模型上，学习到的置信度估计器在固定序列测试中改善了排序准确性，增强了置信度与分歧风险之间的单调关系，并提高了达到目标一致水平的成功率。

Conclusion: 通过学习专用置信度估计器替代启发式信号，并利用间隔相关权衡指导自适应训练，能有效解决原假设检验框架中单调性假设被违反的问题，显著提升LLM与人类判断的一致性保证效果。

Abstract: Jung et al. (2025) introduce a hypothesis testing framework for guaranteeing agreement between large language models (LLMs) and human judgments, relying on the assumption that the model's estimated confidence is monotonic with respect to human-disagreement risk. In practice, however, this assumption may be violated, and the generalization behavior of the confidence estimator is not explicitly analyzed. We mitigate these issues by learning a dedicated confidence estimator instead of relying on heuristic confidence signals. Our approach leverages simulated annotator diversity and a margin-based ranking formulation to explicitly model how confidently an LLM distinguishes between human-agreement and human-disagreement cases. We further derive generalization guarantees for this estimator, revealing a margin-dependent trade-off that informs the design of an adaptive estimator training procedure. When integrated into fixed-sequence testing, the learned confidence estimator yields improved ranking accuracy and empirically strengthens the monotonic relationship between confidence and disagreement risk, leading to higher success rates in satisfying target agreement levels across multiple datasets and judge models.

</details>


### [761] [Ghosted Layers: Unconstrained Activation Alignment for Recovering Layer-Pruned LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15491)
*Vincent-Daniel Yun,Junhyuk Jo,Sai Praneeth Karimireddy,Sunwoo Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Ghosted Layers模块，通过闭式最优线性算子解决层剪枝后隐藏状态分布不匹配问题，无需训练即可恢复模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 层剪枝会移除Transformer解码器块，导致后续存活层接收的隐藏状态与训练时的分布不匹配，造成显著性能下降。现有训练无关方法受限于有限算子子空间的约束解。

Method: 提出Ghosted Layers恢复模块，将问题形式化为边界激活对齐问题，通过少量校准集推导闭式最优线性算子来重建被剪枝层引入的激活差异。

Result: 在多种LLM主干网络和剪枝策略上，该方法在准确率和困惑度上一致优于现有训练无关基线方法，同时保持了层剪枝的效率优势。

Conclusion: 所提闭式解对应于对齐目标的无约束最优解，而现有方法受限于有限子空间上的约束解，证明了该方法在理论和实践上的优势。

Abstract: Layer pruning removes entire Transformer decoder blocks from large language models, but introduces a mismatch between the hidden state received by the next surviving layer and the distribution it was trained to process, leading to significant performance degradation. We propose Ghosted Layers, a training-free recovery module that addresses this issue by solving a boundary activation alignment problem. Our method derives a closed-form optimal linear operator from a small calibration set to reconstruct the activation discrepancy introduced by the pruned layers. We show that this solution corresponds to the unconstrained optimum of the alignment objective, whereas existing methods are restricted to constrained solutions over limited operator subspaces. Experiments across multiple LLM backbones and pruning strategies demonstrate that our method consistently improves accuracy and perplexity over prior training-free baselines, while preserving the efficiency gains of layer pruning. Official code repository: https://github.com/daniel-eai/ghosted_layers_official_repository/.

</details>


### [762] [FRWKV+: Periodic-Aware Adaptive Gating for Frequency-Space Linear Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15690)
*Qingyuan Yang,Dongyue Chen,Da Teng,Junhua Xiao,Jiaji Pan,Shizhuo Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FRWKV-Plus是一种轻量级周期感知频率空间多元时间序列预测模型，通过交叉分支谱门控和信任门控残差修正机制，在保持高效推理的同时提升预测性能，在7个标准基准上表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有频率空间模型将实部和虚部频谱分量作为弱耦合流处理，且将周期性线索视为普通输入特征，未能充分利用周期结构信息，尤其在周期模式不可靠时表现不佳。

Method: 基于高效FRWKV骨干网络，提出交叉分支谱门控（利用兄弟分支摘要重加权各谱分支）和信任门控残差修正（将周期内上下文转换为有界、符号灵活的门控调整），修正项在初始化时保持恒等映射且有界约束。

Result: 在7个标准基准上与强线性、频域、递归风格和Transformer预测器竞争，保持轻量级特性；消融实验证实各组件均有贡献，在Exchange和ILI数据集上提升显著，周期内上下文是最具影响力的单一组件。

Conclusion: FRWKV-Plus通过精巧的门控机制实现了周期感知与轻量高效的平衡，验证了在周期性线索不可靠时通过有界残差修正提升鲁棒性的有效性。

Abstract: Accurate and efficient long-term multivariate time series forecasting requires capturing recurring temporal structure while keeping inference cheap across many variables and horizons. Frequency-space models represent long-range and periodic variation compactly, but they typically process the real and imaginary spectral components as weakly coupled streams and treat periodic cues as ordinary input features, even when such cues are unreliable. This paper proposes FRWKV-Plus, a lightweight periodic-aware frequency-space forecasting model built on the efficient FRWKV backbone. FRWKV-Plus introduces a cross-branch spectral gate that reweights each spectral branch using a summary of its sibling branch, and a trust-gated residual correction that converts compact within-period context into a bounded, sign-flexible adjustment of these gates under a learned, data-dependent trust score. By construction, the correction is identity-preserving at initialization and strictly bounded, so periodic evidence can refine but never dominate or invert the base interaction. On seven standard benchmarks, FRWKV-Plus is consistently competitive with strong linear, frequency-domain, recurrent-style, and Transformer-based forecasters while preserving the lightweight profile of the backbone. Controlled three-seed ablations show that each component contributes, that the benefit is modest on strongly periodic data and pronounced on the harder Exchange and ILI datasets, and that the within-period context is the most influential single component. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/yangqingyuan-byte/FRWKV-plus.

</details>


### [763] [VQ-Atom: Semantic Discretization of Local Atomic Environments for Molecular Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16823)
*Takayuki Kimura*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: VQ-Atom提出了一种基于向量量化的原子级语义分词框架，将分子的局部化学环境编码为离散token。在KIBA数据集的药物-靶标相互作用预测任务上，AUROC达0.79，优于SMILES和连续分子表征，且下游训练速度提升约3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分子机器学习中广泛使用的SMILES token主要是一种线性化格式，缺乏化学语义分解。作者希望设计一种能编码化学语义的分子tokenization方法，从而减轻下游学习负担。

Method: 提出VQ-Atom框架，通过向量量化（vector quantization）将原子的局部化学环境映射为离散token，每个token编码原子周围的图局部化学上下文，与分子结构对齐。

Result: 在KIBA数据集的蛋白质-药物靶标相互作用预测任务上，AUROC达0.79，大幅优于基于SMILES和连续分子表征的方法；下游训练速度比连续原子表征快约3倍。

Conclusion: 分子tokenization不仅是预处理步骤，更是核心设计选择。结构良好的token能编码充分的化学语义，减轻下游学习负担。token设计可成为继架构、目标和优化之外的又一机器学习研究维度。

Abstract: Large language models succeed by combining large-scale pretraining with meaningful discrete tokens. In molecular machine learning, SMILES is widely used as a token representation, but it is primarily a linearization format for molecular graphs rather than a semantic decomposition of chemistry. We propose VQ-Atom, a semantic tokenization framework that assigns discrete atom-level tokens based on local chemical environments via vector quantization. Unlike SMILES tokens, VQ-Atom tokens encode graph-local chemical context and are aligned with molecular structure. On protein-cold drug--target interaction prediction using the KIBA dataset, VQ-Atom substantially improves global ranking performance, achieving AUROC of 0.79 while substantially outperforming both SMILES-based and continuous molecular representations under an identical downstream architecture. Furthermore, VQ-Atom enables approximately 3 times faster downstream training than continuous atom-level representations by replacing per-atom continuous features with reusable discrete tokens. These results suggest that molecular tokenization is not merely a preprocessing step, but a central design choice. In particular, well-structured tokens can encode substantial chemical semantics, reducing the burden on downstream learning. VQ-Atom can be interpreted as defining a molecular language, where tokens correspond to chemically meaningful atomic environments, suggesting that token design may constitute an additional axis of machine learning research alongside architecture, objectives, and optimization.

</details>


### [764] [LEAP: Learnable End-to-End Adaptive Pruning of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17289)
*Mohammad Mozaffari,Younes Hourri,Mohammad Rastegari,Mahyar Najibi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LEAP提出基于Gumbel-sigmoid的每权重伯努利松弛方法，实现端到端非结构化掩码学习，在0.5B-8B参数量的LLM上相比ADMM平均提升2.59个百分点的零样本准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有非结构化LLM剪枝方法（如基于最优脑外科医生的逐层代理）在激进稀疏率下牺牲端到端准确性，而端到端方法（如MaskLLM、PATCH）的可学习掩码在非结构化设置下因类别-模式参数化导致不可扩展。

Method: 用每权重的伯努利分布通过Gumbel-sigmoid松弛替代不可行的类别-模式参数化，使端到端非结构化掩码学习变得可行。

Result: 在5个LLM系列（0.5B-8B参数）、50%和60%稀疏率下，六任务平均零样本准确率相比最优逐层基线ADMM提升2.59个百分点。

Conclusion: LEAP通过可微的伯努利松弛实现了端到端非结构化剪枝，在保持推理加速的同时显著提升准确性。

Abstract: Unstructured sparsity is now natively accelerated by recent GPU kernels and dataflow hardware, shifting the bottleneck from inference execution to the pruning algorithm. State-of-the-art methods for unstructured LLM pruning are layer-wise surrogates derived from the Optimal Brain Surgeon principle, and they sacrifice end-to-end accuracy, especially under aggressive sparsity. End-to-end alternatives such as MaskLLM and PATCH show that learnable masks can close this gap, but their categorical-over-patterns parameterization scales with the number of valid masks per row and does not port to the unstructured setting. We introduce LEAP, which replaces this intractable parameterization with a per-weight Bernoulli-via-Gumbel-sigmoid relaxation that makes end-to-end unstructured mask learning tractable. Across five LLM families from 0.5B to 8B parameters at 50% and 60% sparsity, LEAP improves six-task average zero-shot accuracy by +2.59 points on average over ADMM, the best layer-wise baseline in our sweep.

</details>


### [765] [Adaptive Generate-Rank-Verify: Inference-Time Search with Costly Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17609)
*Shaddin Dughmi,Mahdi Haghifam,Yusuf Hakan Kalayci*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文形式化了推理时语言模型管线中的"生成式主动搜索"问题，提出了一种自适应生成-排序-验证算法ADAP，在理论保证下实现接近最优的期望成本，并在数学推理和编程竞赛中验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实应用中使用廉价奖励信号+昂贵验证器（如数学推理中的答案检查、代码生成中的隐藏测试执行）的管线缺乏理论形式化，需要解决成本敏感的首个正例搜索问题。

Method: ①形式化生成式主动搜索为代价敏感的首个正例搜索问题；②在已知分布下用动态规划刻画最优策略；③在未知分布下提出ADAP算法（自适应增加采样数和top-ranked验证数）；④基于中心星数给出学习理论下界。

Result: ADAP在单调性假设下达到分布感知最优策略的常数倍期望成本；实验证明在数学推理和竞赛编程任务中优于固定非自适应策略和难度自适应基线。

Conclusion: 理论分析和实验共同表明，自适应生成-排序-验证策略能有效平衡采样成本和验证成本，结构假设（单调性）对问题的可学习性是必要的。

Abstract: Many inference-time language-model pipelines combine a cheap reward signal with an expensive verifier, such as exact answer checking in mathematical reasoning or hidden-test execution in code generation. We formalize this setting using a learning-theoretic lens as generative active search: a cost-sensitive first-positive search problem in which a policy adaptively samples candidates from an unknown distribution, observes cheap scores, and pays for verifier labels until it finds a positive example. For a fixed prompt, the generator and reward model induce two unknown objects: a distribution over reward scores and a score-conditioned success function. When these quantities are known, we characterize the distribution-aware optimal policy using a dynamic programming approach. In the realistic and practical setting where both the score distribution and success function are unknown, we propose ADAP, a shellwise adaptive generate-rank-verify algorithm that progressively increases the number of sampled responses and top-ranked verifications. Under the monotonicity assumption that higher reward scores are no less likely to pass verification, we show that ADAP achieves expected cost within a constant factor of the distribution-aware optimum. We complement this result with learning-theoretic lower bounds, based on a centered star number, showing that structural assumptions on the score--label relationship are necessary. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and competitive programming validate the predicted advantage over both fixed non-adaptive policies and difficulty-adaptive baselines.

</details>


### [766] [Post-Trained MoE Can Skip Half Experts via Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18643)
*Xingtai Lv,Li Sheng,Kaiyan Zhang,Yichen You,Siyan Gao,Xueheng Luo,Yuxin Zuo,Yuchen Fan,Junlin Yang,Ganqu Cui,Bingning Wang,Fan Yang,Youbang Sun,Ning Ding,Bowen Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ZEDA是一种低成本框架，通过注入零输出专家和两阶段自蒸馏，将已训练好的静态MoE模型转换为动态MoE，在Qwen3-30B-A3B和GLM-4.7-Flash上消除超过50%的专家FLOPs，准确率损失微小，推理加速约1.20倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态MoE方法通常依赖从头预训练或任务特定适配，缺乏将已训练好的静态MoE模型高效转换为动态MoE的实用方案，导致推理时无法根据输入难度动态跳过不必要的专家计算。

Method: ZEDA通过两个关键设计实现静态到动态MoE的转换：(1) 在每个MoE层注入无参数的零输出专家（zero-output experts）；(2) 采用两阶段自蒸馏，以原始MoE为冻结教师，并应用组级平衡损失来稳定架构转换。

Result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B和GLM-4.7-Flash两个模型上，覆盖数学、代码和指令跟随等11个基准，ZEDA消除超过50%的专家FLOPs，仅带来边际准确率损失。相比最强动态MoE基线分别提升6.1和4.0个点，端到端推理加速约1.20倍。

Conclusion: ZEDA提供了一种实用且高效的静态MoE转动态MoE方案，能够在不显著损失性能的前提下大幅降低推理计算成本，为已部署的MoE模型提供即时的推理加速收益。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) scales language models efficiently through sparse expert activation, and its dynamic variant further reduces computation by adjusting the activated experts in an input-dependent manner. Existing dynamic MoE methods usually rely on pre-training from scratch or task-specific adaptation, leaving the practical conversion of fully trained MoE underexplored. Enabling such adaptation would directly alleviate the inference costs by allowing easy tokens to bypass unnecessary expert during serving. This paper introduces Zero-Expert Self-Distillation Adaptation (ZEDA), a low-cost framework that transforms post-trained static MoE models into efficient dynamic ones. To stabilize this architectural conversion, ZEDA injects parameter-free zero-output experts into each MoE layer and adapts the augmented model through two-stage self-distillation, utilizing the original MoE as a frozen teacher and applying a group-level balancing loss. On Qwen3-30B-A3B and GLM-4.7-Flash across 11 benchmarks spanning math, code, and instruction following, ZEDA eliminates over 50% of expert FLOPs at marginal accuracy loss. It outperforms the strongest dynamic MoE baseline by 6.1 and 4.0 points on the two models, and delivers ~1.20$\times$ end-to-end inference speedup.

</details>


### [767] [SPHERICAL KV: Angle-Domain Attention and Rate-Distortion Retention for Efficient Long-Context Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18856)
*Anay Chauhan,Gurucharan Marthi Krishna Kumar,Arion Das,Amit Dhanda,Vinija Jain,Aman Chadha,Amitava Das*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Spherical KV 提出了一种基于注意力几何的球面参数化方法，通过角度域注意力（ADA）和率失真保留（RDR）两个组件，在长上下文推理中降低 KV 缓存占用并保持解码效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文推理中 KV 缓存随着上下文增长而膨胀，解码过程受限于 HBM 带宽而非计算能力。现有方法（如驱逐、窗口、量化、卸载）虽减少了缓存占用，但未充分解决关键路径瓶颈——压缩后的状态仍需在解码时恢复为稠密向量。

Method: 提出 Spherical KV 方法，包含两个核心组件：(1) 角度域注意力（ADA）：将键存储为球面参数化（标量半径 + 紧凑角度编码），直接从角度码计算注意力 logits，无需重建稠密键向量；(2) 率失真保留（RDR）：在固定预算下联合选择每个 token 和每个头的保留/丢弃决策及精度层级，生成层级均匀的页面，辅以轻量元数据和合并读取。

Result: ADA 保留了分页、块局部、融合友好的解码路径，直接减少实际服务场景中的 HBM 流量；RDR 在固定内存预算下实现了 KV 驻留的降低，同时保持了解码效率。

Conclusion: Spherical KV 将 KV 分配建模为率失真问题，基于注意力几何优化，提供了一种面向部署的长上下文推理机制，有效平衡了 KV 内存占用与解码效率。

Abstract: Long-context inference is increasingly constrained by the KV cache: resident memory grows with context length, and decoding becomes limited by repeated High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) streaming rather than arithmetic. Existing methods such as eviction, windowing, quantization, and offloading reduce footprint, but often leave the critical-path bottleneck only partially addressed, especially when compressed states must still be reconstructed into dense vectors during decoding.
  We present Spherical KV, a long-context inference method that treats KV allocation as a rate-distortion problem grounded in attention geometry for efficient decoding. The method is built on two ideas: (i) represent directional information cheaply in the decode hot loop, and (ii) allocate retention and precision according to estimated future utility. Its first component, Angle-Domain Attention (ADA), stores keys in a spherical parameterization consisting of a scalar radius and compact angle codes, and computes attention logits directly from these codes without reconstructing dense keys. This preserves a paged, block-local, fusion-friendly decode path and directly targets HBM traffic in realistic serving settings. Its second component, Rate-Distortion Retention (RDR), jointly chooses keep/drop decisions and precision tiers per token and head under a fixed budget, producing tier-homogeneous pages with lightweight metadata and coalesced reads. Together, ADA and RDR provide a deployment-oriented mechanism for reducing KV residency while preserving decode efficiency.

</details>


### [768] [Causal Unlearning in Collaborative Optimization: Exact and Approximate Influence Reversal under Adversarial Contributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20341)
*Ali Mahdavi,Azadeh Zamanifar,Amirfarhad Farhadi,Omid Kashefi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HF-KCU通过Krylov子空间共轭梯度迭代近似影响函数，高效实现联邦学习中客户端数据删除，速度提升47.75倍，精度损失仅0.60%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习系统为满足隐私法规必须支持数据删除请求，但每次删除后从头训练模型计算成本过高。

Method: 利用Krylov子空间中共轭梯度迭代近似影响函数，复杂度从O(d³)降至O(kd)；引入因果加权机制确保仅更新持有被删除数据的客户端参数。

Result: 在CIFAR-10上比重新训练快47.75倍，测试精度仅下降0.60%（71.16% vs 71.76%）；成员推理攻击成功率为0.499，与重训练模型一致；支持有界对抗扰动。

Conclusion: HF-KCU在效率、精度和隐私保护之间取得良好平衡，适用于异步删除请求和计算预算受限的生产环境，且具有可解释性。

Abstract: Federated learning systems must support data deletion requests to comply with privacy regulations, yet retraining from scratch after each deletion is computationally prohibitive. We present HF-KCU, a method that removes a client's contribution by approximating the influence function through conjugate gradient iterations in Krylov subspaces, reducing complexity from O(d^3) to O(kd) where k<<d.A causal weighting mechanism ensures that only clients holding the deleted data receive parameter updates, preventing spurious changes to unaffected clients. Our method is designed to handle bounded adversarial perturbations to the Hessian and gradient, providing graceful degradation under realistic threat models. We validate HF-KCU across convolutional (ResNet-18, SimpleCNN) and transformer (ViT-Lite) architectures on CIFAR-10, MNIST, and Fashion-MNIST. On CIFAR-10 under Dirichlet (alpha=0.5) partitioning, HF-KCU achieves 47.75 times speedup over retraining while maintaining test accuracy within 0.60% of the rational baseline(71.16 vs 71.76 %). Membership inference attacks on the forget set yield success rates of 0.499 matching the retrained model and confirming effective privacy restoration. We provide convergence guarantees showing that the Krylov approximation error decreases as O((k ^1/2-1)/(k^1/2+1)) where k is the Hessian condition number. The causal weighting mechanism ensures surgical updates, where only clients holding deleted data are modified, preserving model quality for unaffected participants and avoiding the instability of gradient-based approaches in asynchronous federated settings. This design provides interpretability as each update is directly traceable to the influence of the deleted data. The method's efficiency and precision make it suitable for production federated systems where deletion requests arrive asynchronously and computational budgets are constrained.

</details>


### [769] [Latent Cache Flow: Model-to-Model Communication Without Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22863)
*Maximillian Rossi,Prajwal Raghunath,Eugene Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Latent Cache Flow (LCF)，通过联合翻译和压缩KV缓存实现更高效、更准确的LLM间通信，适配器大小仅为C2C的4%，支持不同上下文场景，速度提升8.5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体间文本通信延迟高、信息损失大，C2C方法适配器庞大且训练昂贵，且要求目标上下文完全一致，不适用于智能体间上下文不同的通信场景。

Method: 联合翻译和压缩键值对，将适配器规模缩减至C2C的约4%；设计适配器仅传输目标模型不具备的新信息摘要，而非逐token翻译。

Result: 剪枝后的13 MB LCF适配器在共享上下文设置中比956 MB的C2C更准确；在不同上下文场景中，F1提升7.5%，Exact Match提升23%，速度比文本通信快8.5倍。

Conclusion: LCF通过更小的适配器实现了更高效率和准确性，并解决了C2C无法处理的不同上下文通信问题，更适合LLM智能体间通信。

Abstract: LLM agents today communicate via text, which incurs considerable latency and information loss due to the need to autoregressively decode the sharer model's state and encode at the receiver model. Recent work such as Cache-to-Cache (C2C; Fu et al., 2026) seeks to exchange KV caches by learning adapters that translate sharer KV matrices to the receiver model. However, the adapters are large and expensive to train, and translate individual tokens, which requires the target context to be identical. This is unsuitable for agent communication, where the LLMs have differing context. We introduce Latent Cache Flow (LCF). To address efficiency, we observe that keys and values can be jointly translated and compressed, reducing the adapter to about 4% of C2C's size. To address differing context, we design the adapter to transmit a summary of new information that the target model does not have. Our early experiments show that a pruned 13 MB LCF adapter can be more accurate than C2C at 956 MB in shared-context settings; for different contexts, LCF improves F1 by 7.5% and Exact Match by 23% while 8.5 times faster than text-based communication.

</details>


### [770] [Accelerating Divisible Load Processing Through Machine Learning: A Practical Framework for Large-Scale Workloads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23247)
*Bharadwaj Veeravalli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出首个基于机器学习（前馈神经网络）的框架，用于预测单层树网络架构中可分负载理论的最优处理时间，模型在100,000个合成配置上训练，实现了97-99%的R²精度和1-5%的MAPE，推理时间小于1毫秒，可作为传统DLT计算的高效替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统DLT范式下的最优处理时间计算需要显式求解复杂的负载分配方程，计算开销大，难以满足实时调度、设计空间探索和云资源分配等场景的低延迟需求。本文旨在探索用机器学习替代传统解析方法的可行性。

Method: 采用16个工程特征的前馈神经网络（FNN），在100,000个合成生成的系统配置上进行训练，预测SLTN架构下的最优处理时间，无需显式求解DLT方程。

Result: 模型达到97-99%的R²精度，平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）为1-5%，推理时间低于1毫秒。特征重要性分析显示模型隐式捕获了DLT的数学结构（负载守恒和同步完成约束）。在节点数3-20、负载大小1-100 GB的配置下泛化良好，但在极大或高度异构系统中性能略有下降。

Conclusion: 本文证明了利用机器学习加速分布式计算优化的可行性，在保持近最优精度的同时大幅提升计算效率，为实时调度和资源分配等应用提供了有效替代方案。

Abstract: In this paper, we introduce the first machine learning framework for predicting optimal processing times in Single-Level Tree Network (SLTN) architectures for the Divisible Load Theory (DLT) paradigm. Using a feedforward neural network(FNN) with 16 engineered features, we train a model on 100,000 synthetically generated configurations to predict optimal processing times without explicit formulation of DLT equations. The model achieves 97-99% accuracy (R-square factor) with mean absolute percentage error of 1-5%, demonstrating that neural networks can effectively learn complex load distribution relationships. Feature importance analysis reveals that the model implicitly captures DLT mathematical structure, including load conservation and simultaneous finishing constraints. With inference times under 1 millisecond, the approach serves as a viable option over traditional DLT computation, enabling applications in real-time scheduling, design space exploration, and cloud resource allocation. The method generalizes well across diverse system configurations (n=3 to 20, load size =1 to 100 GB) with consistent accuracy, though performance degrades slightly for very large or highly heterogeneous systems. This work demonstrates the feasibility of using machine learning to accelerate distributed computing optimization while maintaining near-optimal accuracy.

</details>


### [771] [Riemannian-Manifold Steering: Geometry-Aware Generative Autoencoders for Label-Free Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24942)
*Narmeen Oozeer,Shivam Raval,Philip Quirke,Manikandan Ravikiran,Jeff Phillips,Shriyash Upadhyay,Amirali Abdullah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将语言模型流形操控重铸为黎曼测地线计算问题，通过输出空间Hellinger距离拉回到激活空间并利用概念-令牌模式学习编码器，实现了无需标签、无需拓扑先验、无需任务特定曲线拟合的统一框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流形操控方法需要带标签的类别质心和预设的循环/序列结构，限制了其应用范围。作者希望消除这些约束，建立更通用的框架。

Method: 将流形操控定义为黎曼测地线计算，以输出空间Hellinger距离拉回作为度量，通过学习编码器近似该度量，编码器基于概念-令牌模式在输出距离上训练。

Result: 在标准四任务语言模型算术基准上，该方法能可靠地将模型驱动到目标类别，在较小输出空间上比基线方法遵循更自然的轨迹。

Conclusion: 提供了一个统一的黎曼流形操控框架，并实现了无需标签质心和预设边界条件的实践方法。

Abstract: Steering a language model - intervening on its internal activations to change downstream behaviour - has recently expanded beyond linear interpolation to nonlinear methods such as angular and kernelized steering, which define intervention transformations without learning an explicit geometry over paths in activation space. Freshly introduced geometry-aware manifold methods do learn such a geometry, but require labelled class centroids together with prescribed cyclic or sequential structure. These assumptions restrict where manifold steering can be applied, since existing constructions require labelled centroids and compatible boundary conditions. We recast manifold steering more broadly as \textbf{Riemannian geodesic computation} on activation space, recovering linear and labelled-spline steering as geodesics under particular choices of metric. A principled metric within this framework is the output-space Hellinger distance pulled back to activations; we approximate this with a learned encoder trained on output distances over a small concept-token schema - no per-prompt labels, no topology prior, and no per-task curve fitting. Empirically, the method reliably drives the model onto the target class across all tasks in a standard four-task language-model arithmetic benchmark, while following more behaviourally natural trajectories than baselines on smaller output spaces. We thereby provide a unified Riemannian framework for manifold steering together with a schema-supervised, label-free instantiation that operates without labelled centroids or prescribed boundary conditions.

</details>


### [772] [Global Convergence of Wasserstein Policy Gradient for Entropy-Regularized Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26078)
*Zhaoyu Zhu,Rui Gao,Shuang Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为Wasserstein策略梯度（WPG）方法建立了全局收敛性理论，通过利用熵正则化强化学习中的Bellman结构，证明了软Bellman残差与Gibbs策略之间的状态级KL表示、Bellman收缩与全局最优间隙的关系，以及Bellman预解恒等式连接值改进与相对Fisher信息。结合均匀log-Sobolev不等式，推导出分布Polyak–Łojasiewicz条件，并控制了离散化误差，最终实现了几何收缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WPG方法在连续控制问题中表现出色，但其全局收敛性质尚不明确。标准Langevin分析方法无法直接应用，因为RL目标通过Bellman递归依赖于策略（而非静态凸泛函），且Langevin漂移由软Q函数决定，其正则性必须在策略迭代过程中加以控制。

Method: 1. 利用软Bellman残差的状态级KL表示（相对于Gibbs策略）；2. 通过Bellman收缩将残差与全局最优间隙关联；3. 引入Bellman预解恒等式连接值改进与相对Fisher信息；4. 结合均匀log-Sobolev不等式（LSI）推导分布Polyak–Łojasiewicz条件；5. 建立正则性和均匀界以控制离散化误差。

Result: 得到了几何收缩率（至离散化偏差为止），证明了熵正则化RL虽然不具有通常的凸性，但Bellman递归诱导了有利于全局收敛的Polyak–Łojasiewicz型几何结构。

Conclusion: 熵正则化RL通过Bellman结构隐式地赋予问题PL几何性质，使得WPG方法能够实现全局收敛，这为WPG在连续控制中的成功提供了理论支撑。

Abstract: Wasserstein policy gradient (WPG) is a policy optimization method for reinforcement learning (RL) that exploits the optimal-transport geometry of action distributions. For the entropy-regularized RL objective, WPG evolves each state-conditional policy by transporting it along the action gradient of the soft Q-function together with a Langevin-type diffusion. Despite its appeal for continuous-control problems, its global convergence properties remain poorly understood. Standard Langevin analyses do not directly apply, because the RL objective depends on the policy through the Bellman recursion rather than through a static convex functional, and the Langevin drift is determined by the soft Q-function, whose regularity must be controlled along the policy iterates.
  In this paper, we develop a global convergence theory for WPG by exploiting the Bellman structure of entropy-regularized RL. We show that the role usually played by convexity can be replaced by a Bellman-based argument: the soft Bellman residual admits a statewise KL representation with respect to a Gibbs policy; Bellman contraction relates this residual to the global optimality gap; and a Bellman resolvent identity connects value improvement to relative Fisher information. Combined with a uniform log-Sobolev inequality (LSI) for the evolving Gibbs family, these ingredients yield a distributional Polyak--Łojasiewicz condition. We further establish the regularity and uniform bounds needed to control the discretization error, thereby obtaining geometric contraction up to a discretization bias. Conceptually, our analysis shows that although entropy-regularized RL is not convex in the usual flat sense, the Bellman recursion induces a favorable Polyak--Lojasiewicz-type (PL) geometry that supports global convergence of WPG.

</details>


### [773] [The Strongest Teacher Is Not Always the Best Teacher: Student-Centric Answer Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26872)
*Zhengyu Hu,Zheyuan Xiao,Linxin Song,Fengqing Jiang,Yuetai Li,Zhengyu Chen,Zhihan Xiong,Yue Liu,Junhao Lin,Yao Su,Lijie Hu,Kaize Ding,Teng Xiao,Radha Poovendran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 当前LLM训练普遍使用最强教师模型生成训练数据，但本文发现最强教师的答案未必是对学生最优的监督信号。为此提出SCAS框架，根据学生端学习成本从多个验证正确的教师答案中选择最优监督，实验表明该方法持续优于传统做法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 揭示并解决现有LLM训练中"教师测试性能等价于教学质量"这一隐含假设的缺陷，即最强教师提供的答案不一定是对特定学生最优的监督信号。

Method: 提出Student-Centric Answer Sampling (SCAS)框架：基于token级梯度分解推导出仅需前向传播的学生端学习成本代理指标，据此从多个已验证正确的教师答案中选择对学生最有利的答案进行训练。

Result: 在30个教师模型、6个学生基座模型、6个任务上的实验表明，SCAS一致性地提升了学生模型性能。

Conclusion: 有效的知识蒸馏应优先选择与学生当前状态匹配的监督信号，而非单纯依赖教师模型的强度；以学生为中心的数据选择策略优于传统的最强教师策略。

Abstract: LLM training increasingly relies on teacher-generated supervision, from synthetic responses to reasoning traces and tool-use demonstrations. Current practice often chooses the highest-performing teacher to generate student training data, implicitly treating teacher test performance as a proxy for teaching quality. We show that this assumption can fail: even when multiple teachers provide correct answers to the same question, the answer from the strongest teacher is not necessarily the best supervision for a given student. To address this gap, we propose Student-Centric Answer Sampling (SCAS), a framework that selects from verified teacher-generated answers according to their estimated student-centric learning cost. Motivated by a token-wise gradient decomposition, we derive an efficient forward-only proxy for this cost and use it to guide answer selection during training. Experiments across 30 teacher models, 6 student base models, and 6 tasks show that SCAS consistently improves student performance, suggesting that effective distillation should prioritize supervision matched to the current student rather than teacher strength alone.

</details>


### [774] [Locality-Aware Redundancy Pruning for LLM Depth Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27786)
*Vincent-Daniel Yun,Youngrae Kim,Woosang Lim,YoungJin Heo,Minkyu Kim,Sunwoo Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为LoRP的无训练、一次性深度剪枝框架，通过表示局部性（Representation Locality）引导层剪枝，利用表示局部性分数（RLS）量化层间冗余，并在多种LLM上提升了困惑度和下游任务准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有一次性剪枝方法依赖局部层重要性或固定的冗余假设，忽略了不同LLM架构中层间冗余的分布差异（局部化或全局分布），需要一种更普适的剪枝策略。

Method: LoRP框架：1）利用小校准集计算全局层间隐藏状态相似性，导出表示局部性分数（RLS）；2）计算逐层相似性并对层进行聚类；3）根据聚类内残差冗余分配剪枝比例，实现无训练的一次性深度剪枝。

Result: 在多种LLM家族上的实验表明，LoRP在困惑度和下游任务准确率上均优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 层间冗余的局部性因架构而异，LoRP通过感知局部性的冗余度量实现了更有效的深度剪枝，且无需额外训练。

Abstract: Large language models are known to contain representational redundancy across network depth, making depth pruning an effective approach for improving inference efficiency. Existing one-shot pruning methods rely on local layer importance or fixed redundancy assumptions across architectures. We propose Locality-Aware Redundancy Pruning (LoRP), a training-free one-shot depth pruning framework guided by representation locality. We show that inter-layer redundancy can be either localized or globally distributed depending on the LLM architecture. To characterize this phenomenon, we introduce Representation Locality Score (RLS), derived from global inter-layer hidden-state similarity. Using a small calibration set, LoRP computes pairwise layer similarity, clusters layers by representational similarity, and allocates pruning according to residual intra-cluster redundancy. Experiments across diverse LLM families show improvements in both perplexity and downstream task accuracy. Official github repository: https://github.com/daniel-eai/LoRP-Locality-Aware-Redundancy-Pruning/

</details>


### [775] [Mechanistic origins of catastrophic forgetting: why RL preserves circuits better than SFT?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28860)
*Jeanmely Rojas Nunez,Viraj Sawant,Nathan Allen,Nomgondalai Amgalanbaatar,Yannis Zongo,Vasu Sharma,Maheep Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出差异电路脆弱性（differential circuit vulnerability）指标，从机制层面比较RL和SFT在微调LLM时对内部计算电路的保留程度，发现RL能更好地保留基础电路从而缓解灾难性遗忘，但任务适应速度较慢。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前期工作从行为层面发现RL比SFT更能缓解灾难性遗忘，但缺乏对内部机制的理解。本文希望从电路层面探究RL优势的根源。

Method: 提出差异电路脆弱性（differential circuit vulnerability）指标，以注意力头为单位衡量微调对电路的影响程度；在Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct上对比RL和SFT在科学问答任务中的表现。

Result: SFT任务适应更快但电路破坏和灾难性遗忘更严重；RL保留更多基础电路但任务适应较慢。

Conclusion: 电路保留程度可能是RL比SFT更抗灾难性遗忘的机制原因。

Abstract: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) frequently induces catastrophic forgetting of prior capabilities. Recent work has shown that reinforcement learning (RL) retains prior capabilities more effectively than supervised fine-tuning (SFT), attributing this to policy-gradient updates remaining closer to the base policy \cite{shenfeld2025rl}. We extend this behavioral account to the mechanistic level and ask whether RL's advantage is mirrored by stronger preservation of internal computational circuits. We introduce differential circuit vulnerability, a head-level measure of how much a circuit degrades under fine-tuning, and use it to compare RL and SFT on Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct adapted to scientific question-answering. We find a clear mechanistic trade-off: SFT adapts more rapidly to the target task but produces substantially greater circuit disruption and forgetting of prior capabilities, whereas RL preserves a larger fraction of the base circuit at the cost of slower task adaptation. These findings suggest that circuit preservation may help explain why RL is more robust to catastrophic forgetting. We released our code here: https://github.com/rl-sft-circuit-research/differential-circuit-vulnerability.

</details>


### [776] [Cycle-Space Informed Detection of Autoencoded Blind False Data Injection Attacks on Power Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28912)
*Xin Li,Chenhan Xiao,Jonathan Cohen,Aviad Elyashar,Yang Weng,Rami Puzis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于拓扑Cycle-Space的检测器（CSD），用于防御利用自编码器雅可比零空间进行盲攻击的假数据注入攻击（FDIA），通过最小循环基（MCB）实现最优泛化误差，并在多个IEEE标准系统上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于统计或数据驱动的检测方法容易受到利用相同数据结构构造的隐蔽扰动攻击，特别是自编码器学习的零空间攻击可以避开残差检测器和时间序列异常检测器。

Method: 提出拓扑信息驱动的Cycle-Space检测器（CSD），利用网络的Cycle-Space施加结构约束以增强零空间估计，并使用最小循环基（MCB）实现最优泛化误差，不依赖精确线路参数。

Result: 在IEEE 14、30、57、118节点系统上的仿真结果表明，所提方法在真实测量噪声下能有效检测数据驱动的FDIA。

Conclusion: 通过利用拓扑导出的循环约束而非仅依赖数值零空间估计，所提方法改善了正常测量与攻击测量之间的分离度，且不需要精确的线路参数。

Abstract: The rapid growth of AI-driven data centers and large-scale energy storage systems is increasing the reliance of power system operation on real-time measurement data and automated decision-making. However, many existing detection methods rely on statistical or data-driven analysis of measurements and can fail when attackers exploit the same data structure to craft stealthy perturbations. To illustrate this limitation, we demonstrate a blind False Data Injection Attack (FDIA) in which an Autoencoder learns the measurement manifold and generates perturbations aligned with the Jacobian null space, thereby allowing the attack to evade both residual-based baddata detectors and time-series anomaly detectors. To mitigate data-driven FDIAs which exploit the null space, we propose a topology-informed Cycle-Space Detector (CSD) that leverages the Cycle-Space of the network to impose structural constraints that enhance null space estimation. In addition, we prove that by using the Minimum Cycle Basis (MCB), the proposed CSD achieves the optimal generalization error for attack detection. By exploiting topology-derived cycle constraints rather than relying solely on numerical null space estimation, the proposed method does not require precise line parameters and improves the separation between normal and attacked measurements. Simulation results on IEEE 14-, 30-, 57-, and 118-bus systems demonstrate that the proposed method effectively detects data-driven FDIAs under realistic measurement noise.

</details>


### [777] [Midpoint Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29920)
*Daniil Shlenskii,Nikita Gushchin,Lev Novitskiy,Dmitry V. Dylov,Alexander Korotin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出中点生成模型（MGM），利用流匹配中线性插值的对称性，推导出中点散度作为分布差异度量，并通过随机翻转插值和对称随机插值进行推广，最终得到一个可计算的目标函数用于训练一步生成模型，在性能上达到与现有方法竞争的水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有一步生成模型在训练效率和理论保证上仍有不足，本文旨在利用流匹配中线性插值的对称性，推导出新的分布差异度量（中点散度），从而为训练一步生成模型提供更原则性和理论驱动的框架。

Method: 1）利用流匹配线性插值的对称性，发现当端点分布相同时，中点时间t=1/2处的漂移场为零，其范数定义为中点散度；2）引入随机翻转插值将中点散度扩展到整个时间域；3）用对称随机插值替代确定性线性插值，得到广义中点散度；4）推导广义散度的变分形式，得到可计算的目标函数用于训练一步生成器。

Result: MGM算法在理论上具有坚实的理论基础，在实践中达到与现有一步生成建模方法竞争的性能水平。

Conclusion: 中点生成模型提供了一种有效且理论扎实的一步生成建模方法，利用流匹配的对称性构造了新的分布差异度量，为一步生成模型的训练提供了新的原则性框架。

Abstract: We introduce Midpoint Generative Models (MGM), a principled framework for training one-step generative models. MGM is based on a simple symmetry of Flow Matching with linear interpolation: when the two endpoint distributions coincide, the corresponding drift field vanishes at the midpoint time, $t=1/2$. We show that the norm of this field defines a valid discrepancy between distributions, which we call the Midpoint Divergence. We extend this discrepancy beyond the midpoint by introducing randomly flipped interpolations and further generalize it by replacing deterministic linear Flow Matching interpolations with symmetric stochastic interpolants, yielding a generalized Midpoint Divergence. Finally, we derive a variational formulation of our generalized divergence, yielding a tractable objective for training a one-step generator. The resulting MGM algorithm offers an effective and theoretically grounded approach to generative modeling, achieving competitive performance against existing one-step generative modeling methods.

</details>


### [778] [Can AI Weather Models Predict Beyond Two Weeks? A Quantitative Benchmark and Analysis of Long Rollouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30184)
*Fanny Lehmann,Firat Ozdemir,Yun Cheng,Torsten Hoefler,Sebastian Schemm,Benedikt Soja,Siddhartha Mishra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对AI天气预报模型在长期（超过15天）滚动预报中出现的“不稳定性”问题，提出了一个正式的分类体系，将失败模式归纳为三种：爆发（blow-up）、漂移（drift）和季节性丧失（loss of seasonality）。通过对九种最先进AI天气模型进行一年的滚动预报分析，发现稳定性取决于对小尺度时空变化的处理方式：不稳定模型会放大高频能量，而稳定模型则充当去噪器。此外，稳定模型能生成取决于初始状态的独特天气轨迹，并非简单的“随机鹦鹉”。基于Vision Transformer架构的消融实验验证了这些发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI天气模型在短中期（15天内）表现优异，但在更长的滚动预报周期中常出现定义不清的“不稳定性”问题，缺乏正式的分类体系来系统描述和诊断这些失败模式。

Method: 对九种最先进的AI天气模型进行长达一年的滚动预报，将失败模式分类为爆发、漂移和季节性丧失三种类型；通过添加噪声测试模型的稳定性；基于Vision Transformer架构进行消融实验，研究不同设计选择对稳定性的影响。

Result: 不稳定模型会放大高频能量，而稳定模型在输入中加入噪声时能起到去噪作用；稳定模型能生成依赖初始状态的独特天气轨迹，而非简单的模式复制。

Conclusion: AI天气模型的长期稳定性关键在于对小尺度时空变化的正确处理，稳定模型并非随机鹦鹉，而是能够基于初始条件生成独特且合理的长期天气演化轨迹。

Abstract: While AI weather models excel at short-to-medium range forecasts (up to 15 days), they frequently suffer from ill-defined "instabilities" when rolled out over longer horizons. This work addresses the lack of a formal taxonomy by categorizing these failures into three distinct regimes: blow-up, drift, and loss of seasonality, through year-long rollouts of nine state-of-the-art AI weather models. Our analysis reveals that stability hinges on the treatment of small spatio-temporal scales: unstable models amplify high-frequency energy, while stable models act as denoisers when noise is added to their inputs. Far from reducing these models to mere stochastic parrots, our findings highlight that stable models generate unique weather trajectories, conditioned on the initial state. We verify our findings through ablation studies on architectural design choices, conducted using state-of-the-art Vision Transformer (ViT) AI weather model architectures.

</details>


### [779] [Cross-Layer Subspace Coupling for LLM Compression: A Unifying Framework and Its Empirical Limits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30836)
*Snigdha Chandan Khilar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了一种统一的SVD压缩框架虽能降低权重重建误差（最多46%），但在实践中导致困惑度与准确率严重下降。作者通过机制分析发现，尽管数学上耦合了相邻层，但Transformer残差流在前向传播中实际解耦了这些层，因此逐层最优性比跨层联合优化更重要。结论是权重空间重建不适合跨层压缩，未来应聚焦逐层激活重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SVD LLM和Basis Sharing等基于SVD的压缩方法可统一为同一优化问题，但此前缺乏对该统一框架有效性的严格检验。作者旨在从理论和实践层面验证该统一方法的优劣，并解释其失效的根本原因。

Method: 将SVD LLM和Basis Sharing统一为联合交叉层优化问题，在Pythia模型上进行数学证明与测试，并通过机制分析探究残差流对层间耦合的实际影响。

Result: 统一方法将权重重建误差降低最多46%，但下游任务中困惑度和准确率严重劣于标准的逐层SVD LLM。机制分析表明，残差流在前向传播中解耦了数学上耦合的相邻层。

Conclusion: 权重空间重建是跨层压缩的有缺陷目标，逐层最优性（尤其是激活重建）比跨层联合优化更关键，未来方法应转向逐层激活重建。

Abstract: Recent SVD based compression methods for large language models like SVD LLM and Basis Sharing can be unified under one optimization problem. While mathematical proofs and tests on Pythia models show this unified approach improves weight reconstruction error by up to 46% percent it fails in practical tasks. Downstream metrics like perplexity and accuracy severely degrade compared to standard per layer SVD LLM. The authors explain this failure mechanistically. Although the bundle method mathematically couples adjacent layers the transformer residual stream actually decouples them during forward passes. Thus per layer optimality matters more than joint cross layer optimization. The paper concludes that weight space reconstruction is a flawed objective for cross layer compression and future methods must focus on per layer activation reconstruction instead.

</details>


### [780] [SDM-Q: Cost-Aware Staged Decision-Making for Multi-Omics Classification with Deep Q-Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31014)
*Nan Mu,Yangfan Xiao,Ling Wang,Xiaoning Li,Yue Kang,Chen Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SDM-Q，一个基于强化学习的自适应、成本感知的多组学分类框架，将多组学诊断建模为有限时域序贯决策问题，通过后向阶段优化策略在保持分类性能的同时有效减少冗余模态获取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法在推理时假设所有模态均可用，导致大量冗余且临床实用性有限，而获取完整多组学数据昂贵且耗时。

Method: 将多组学诊断建模为有限时域序贯决策问题，当前已获取的组学模态定义诊断状态；使用动作价值函数决定是否获取额外模态或终止决策；终端奖励由分类正确性和累积获取成本共同决定；采用后向阶段优化策略提升策略一致性和训练稳定性。

Result: 在ROSMAP、LGG、BRCA、KIPAN四个数据集上，SDM-Q在保持竞争力的分类性能同时显著减少冗余模态获取。BRCA和KIPAN中超过99%和95%受试者仅用单一模态即可准确分类，ROSMAP和LGG中平均获取模态数低于2个。

Conclusion: 成本感知的序贯决策为提升精准医疗工作流的效率提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Multi-omics data provide complementary molecular characterizations of disease phenotypes and play an important role in disease diagnosis and subtype classification in precision medicine. However, acquiring complete multi-omics profiles is expensive and time-consuming, while most existing deep learning methods assume full modality availability during inference, resulting in substantial redundancy and limited practicality in clinical settings. To address this issue, we propose SDM-Q, a reinforcement learning framework for adaptive and cost-aware multi-omics classification. Specifically, multi-omics diagnosis is reformulated as a finite-horizon sequential decision problem, where the currently acquired omics modalities define the diagnostic state at each stage. An action--value function determines whether to acquire an additional modality or terminate the decision process and output the final prediction. To balance diagnostic utility and acquisition cost, the reward is defined only at the terminal stage and jointly determined by classification correctness and cumulative modality acquisition cost. A backward stage-wise optimization strategy is introduced to improve policy consistency and training stability. Experiments on four public multi-omics datasets, including ROSMAP, LGG, BRCA, and KIPAN, demonstrate that SDM-Q effectively reduces redundant modality acquisition while maintaining competitive classification performance compared with methods using complete multi-omics inputs. In the BRCA and KIPAN datasets, more than 99\% and 95\% of subjects, respectively, achieve accurate classification using only a single omics modality, while the average number of acquired modalities remains below two for ROSMAP and LGG. These results suggest that cost-aware sequential decision-making provides an effective paradigm for improving the efficiency of precision medicine workflows.

</details>


### [781] [Scalable Inference-Time Annealing with Surrogate Likelihood Estimators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31498)
*Daniel Peñaherrera,Rishal Aggarwal,David Ryan Koes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SITA方法，通过基于流的生成模型结合能量模型进行推理时退火，避免昂贵的散度计算，实现对分子玻尔兹曼分布的高效采样，在丙氨酸二肽和三肽上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算化学中传统玻尔兹曼分布采样方法计算成本高，而现有基于扩散模型的退火方法需要计算分数场的散度来估计重要性权重，对于大体系难以实现。

Method: SITA方法：沿温度阶梯迭代微调基于流的生成模型，利用能量模型实现快速代理似然，避免昂贵的散度项计算，在推理时退火过程中通过重要性采样生成训练数据。

Result: 在丙氨酸二肽和丙氨酸三肽体系上取得了最先进的采样性能，同时避免了代价高昂的散度项计算。

Conclusion: SITA为大规模分子体系的玻尔兹曼分布采样提供了一种可扩展且计算高效的解决方案。

Abstract: A long standing challenge in computational chemistry and biophysics is efficiently sampling the Boltzmann distribution of molecules. Advances in generative modeling have been proposed to address the limitations of conventional sampling techniques by eliminating the computational cost of simulation. A promising direction is iteratively finetuning diffusion models along a temperature ladder whereby training data is generated via importance sampling during inference-time annealing. Unfortunately, these methods require computing a divergence over the score field to estimate importance weights, rendering them intractable for larger systems. Here we present scalable inference-time annealing (SITA), which retrains flow-based models to generate samples at progressively lower temperatures using an energy-based model to facilitate fast surrogate likelihoods. We demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on both Alanine Dipeptide and Alanine Tripeptide while avoiding costly divergence terms. Our code is available at https://github.com/countrsignal/sita.git

</details>


### [782] [On the Recoverability of Causal Relations from Bulk Gene Expression Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00568)
*Gongxu Luo,Boyang Sun,Kun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从理论和实证两方面证明，只有在线性聚合（如求和/均值）结合仿射结构方程的条件下，基因间的因果关系才能从bulk表达数据中可恢复地推断；而实际数据中基因调控关系偏离线性，因此从聚合数据恢复因果关系需谨慎。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管bulk基因表达数据在单细胞时代仍被广泛使用且有许多因果推断方法，但聚合是一种有损的、不可逆的过程，因果关系能否以及何种条件下能从聚合数据中恢复尚不明确，本文旨在回答这一基础问题。

Method: 通过形式化两种一致性概念（函数形式一致性和条件独立一致性）来定义聚合下的可恢复性，推导出可恢复的充要条件；并在4个bulk和4个单细胞基因表达数据集上实证分析基因调控函数的线性程度。

Result: 因果关系的可恢复性仅在"线性聚合（如求和/均值）+ 仿射结构方程"的组合下成立；实际数据中基因间的成对调控函数在两种数据类型下均偏离线性，缺乏支持线性假设的实证依据。

Conclusion: 在缺乏强额外假设的情况下，从聚合的bulk表达数据中恢复因果关系应持谨慎态度。

Abstract: Bulk gene expression profiling, which aggregates pooled RNA across cells within a biological sample, remains important in the single-cell era because it is typically less noisy, more sensitive, and more cost-effective than single-cell assays. Accordingly, a growing body of computational methods seeks to recover causal relations among genes from bulk expression data. However, aggregation is a lossy, non-invertible coarsening of the underlying cellular system, and it remains unclear whether and under what conditions causal relations are recoverable from aggregated bulk gene expression data. To answer this, we formalize recoverability under aggregation through two notions of consistency: functional-form consistency and conditional-independence consistency. We then derive necessary and sufficient conditions for recoverability, showing that these properties are preserved only under linear aggregations (e.g., sum/mean) coupled with affine structural equations. To assess the practical plausibility of these conditions, analyses of four bulk and four single-cell gene expression datasets further reveal that the estimated pairwise regulatory functions among genes deviate from linearity in both data types, providing limited empirical support for the linearity assumptions required for recoverability. Together, these results caution against recovering causal relations from aggregated bulk expression data without strong additional assumptions.

</details>


### [783] [Beyond Independent Manipulation: Individual Fairness-aware Strategic Classification with Peer Imitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00827)
*Xinpeng Lv,Chunyuan Zheng,Yunxin Mao,Renzhe Xu,Jinxuan Yang,Yuanlong Chen,Wangrong Huang,Shaowu Yang,Wenjing Yang,Xinwang Liu,Peng Cui,Haotian Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出个体公平感知的策略分类（IFSC）框架，解决现有公平策略分类中忽视个体公平导致的同伴驱动操纵问题，通过模拟基于相似性的模仿行为并引入鲁棒学习过程，在合成和真实数据集上提升了个体公平一致性并减轻了模仿导致的分布扭曲。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公平感知的策略分类工作主要关注群体公平，且假设代理独立响应。然而个体公平要求相似个体获得相似结果，这导致代理的操纵行为相互依赖（模仿被正面决策的同伴），与经典策略分类中独立模型的假设不匹配。

Method: 提出IFSC框架，将策略操纵建模为基于相似性向可见的已接受同伴的模仿行为，学习后操纵分布下的分类器；并采用鲁棒学习过程，在操纵模拟中引入随机扰动以处理同伴可观测性的不确定性。

Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，IFSC提升了个体公平一致性，减轻了模仿诱导的分布扭曲。

Conclusion: IFSC通过建模同伴驱动的模仿操纵行为并引入鲁棒学习，有效解决了个体公平场景下策略分类的相互依赖问题，改善了个体公平性。

Abstract: Strategic classification (SC) investigates scenarios where agents manipulate their features to obtain favorable decisions from predictive models. Existing fairness-aware SC approaches primarily focus on group fairness and typically assume that agents respond independently. However, when individual fairness is required, ensuring similar individuals receive similar outcomes, agents' manipulation becomes interdependent: an agent's preferred manipulation depends on the neighborhoods' outcomes. This induces a mismatch between classical SC formulations and fairness-aware decision settings, where independent models no longer accurately characterize strategic manipulations. To address this issue, we introduce individual fairness-aware strategic classification (IFSC), a framework that models peer-driven manipulation arising from individual fairness, where agents imitate nearby positively decided peers to obtain favorable outcomes. IFSC characterizes strategic manipulation as similarity-based imitation toward visible accepted peers and learns classifiers under the resulting post-manipulation distributions. To account for uncertainty in peer observability, IFSC employs a robust learning process that introduces stochastic perturbations during manipulation simulation. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that IFSC improves individual-fairness consistency and mitigates imitation-induced distortions.

</details>


### [784] [When Hard Negatives Hurt: Bridging the Generative-Discriminative Gap in Hard Negative Synthesis for Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01304)
*Zhicheng Zhang,Jiwei Tang,Kuicai Dong,Xiaopeng Li,Jieming Zhu,Jingyu Li,Qianhui Zhu,Fengyuan Lu,Wang Jiaheng,Gang Wang,Hai-Tao Zheng,Zhaocheng Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出LLM生成的负样本直接用于对比学习会损害检索性能，并分析了生成-判别差距的根因：两个复合失败模式（判别无关生成和来源依赖捷径）。为解决该问题，提出CausalNeg框架，包含CoT引导的反事实扰动构造负样本和查询视角熵最大化两个模块。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 硬负样本挖掘是训练检索器的主流策略，但受限于语料库可用性、基于检索器分数而非诊断性选择、以及随检索器提升而日益严重的假阳性污染。LLM合成负样本虽提供了一种不受约束、有针对性且无假阳性风险的替代方案，但直接将其纳入对比学习反而会降低检索性能。

Method: 提出CausalNeg框架，包括：(1) CoT引导的反事实扰动：将文档满足查询的原因分解为显式信息需求，然后精确违反单个需求来构造具有可控、可解释硬度的负样本；(2) 查询视角熵最大化训练：分散生成的负样本在相似度谱上的分布，最小化来源身份与相似度分数之间的互信息，抑制捷径利用。

Result: 分析了两个关键失败模式：判别无关生成（LLM缺乏查询信息需求的显式模型，生成通用或主题漂移文本，无法提供对比信号）和来源依赖捷径（分布性伪影使模型通过来源而非相关性区分负样本，导致梯度漂移并破坏优化）。CausalNeg通过针对性设计弥合了生成-判别差距。

Conclusion: LLM生成的负样本不能直接用于对比学习，需要弥合生成-判别差距。CausalNeg通过反事实构造和熵最大化有效解决了该问题，代码已开源。

Abstract: Hard negative mining has become the dominant strategy for training retrievers, yet it faces intrinsic limitations: negatives are bounded by corpus availability, selected by retriever score rather than diagnostic value, and increasingly contaminated by false positives as the retriever improves. LLM-based synthesis offers a principled alternative, where negatives that are unconstrained, targeted, and free from false positive risk. But we show that naively incorporating generated negatives into contrastive learning often degrades retrieval performance. We identify and formalize the root cause as a generative-discriminative gap: LLM generation optimizes for fluent, plausible text, while contrastive learning demands strategic violations of relevance at the decision boundary. Our analysis reveals two compounding failure modes: discriminative-agnostic generation, where the LLM lacks an explicit model of query information needs and defaults to generic or topic-drifted text that provides no contrastive signal; and source-dependent shortcuts, where distributional artifacts enable the model to distinguish negatives by origin rather than relevance, causing gradient drift that actively corrupts optimization. To close this gap, we propose CausalNeg consisting of two main modules: (1) CoT-guided counterfactual perturbation for data construction: decomposes why a document satisfies a query into explicit information requirements, then surgically violates individual requirements to construct negatives with controlled, interpretable hardness. (2) Query-view entropy maximization during training: disperses generated negatives across the similarity spectrum, minimizing the mutual information between source identity and similarity scores to suppress shortcut exploitation. We make our code publicly available at https://github.com/mzhangzhicheng/CausalNeg.

</details>


### [785] [Turning Back Without Forgetting: Selective Backward Refinement for Parameter-Efficient Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01379)
*Anushka Tiwari,Kaiyi Ji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SABER是一个免回放的提示基参数高效持续学习框架，通过选择性后向细化实现正向后向知识迁移，利用提示梯度几何和损失分布相似性判断何时进行后向细化，并限制更新为非干扰方向，在多个基准和预训练骨干上持续取得正向后向迁移并保持良好平均性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于提示的参数高效持续学习方法虽然通过隔离任务特定提示缓解了灾难性遗忘，但同时也限制了后向任务改进前向任务的能力，后向知识迁移问题尚未得到充分探索。

Method: SABER提出选择性后向细化机制：1) 利用提示梯度几何和损失分布相似性两种互补的任务相关性准则判断何时进行后向细化有益；2) 通过限制参数更新至提示参数空间中的非干扰方向，实现安全的后向细化。

Result: 在多个持续学习基准和不同预训练骨干（T5-Large、LLaMA、Qwen）上的大量实验表明，SABER持续实现正向后向迁移，同时保持强大的整体平均性能。

Conclusion: SABER成功弥补了提示基持续学习中后向知识迁移的空白，实现了受控的后向迁移，为提示基持续学习提供了新的范式。
