*Cornelius Schröder,Žygimantas Marcinkus,Markus Lienkamp*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种部署友好的方法，通过为3D目标检测器增加偶然不确定性估计，并结合短时间窗口上的双样本z检验，区分真实运动与检测抖动，从而减少自动驾驶中因抖动导致的静态物体误检为动态的问题，在实际道路测试中显著降低了错误动态预测和不必要的刹车。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶中，静态物体的检测抖动会导致跟踪中的速度估计偏差和误预测轨迹，进而引发规划器不必要的干预（如误刹车）。现有速度阈值方法在噪声较大的真实场景中无法区分真实运动与抖动。

Method: 在3D目标检测器中引入偶然不确定性估计，对短时间窗口内的检测结果应用双样本z检验，利用已有的数据关联实现最小计算开销，集成到Autoware自动驾驶框架中。

Result: 在nuScenes数据集上与速度阈值方法性能相当，但在真实道路测试中显著减少错误动态预测和不必要的停车。实验发现真实数据中存在一个中间抖动带，纯速度规则会误分类该区域。

Conclusion: 不确定性感知检测结合轻量级统计检验，能够在噪声更大的真实场景中为自动驾驶带来实用性能提升。

Abstract: Reliable motion classification is critical for autonomous driving, as false dynamic predictions of static objects can cascade into unnecessary planner interventions. Unstable bounding box predictions can lead to spurious velocity estimates in tracking and falsely predicted trajectories. We present a deployment-friendly mitigation strategy that augments a 3D object detector with aleatoric uncertainty estimates and applies a two-sample z-test over short observation windows to separate true motion from jitter. Integrated into Autoware with minimal changes, the approach reuses existing data association for minimal compute overhead. Empirical results show parity with velocity thresholding on nuScenes, but substantially fewer false dynamic predictions and unnecessary stops in real-world test drives, explained by the presence of an intermediate jitter band in the recorded data that speed-only rules misclassify. This demonstrates that uncertainty-aware detection and lightweight statistical testing can deliver practical performance gains for autonomous driving in noisier real-world settings.

</details>


### [896] [MosaicIMU: Composing Carrier Experts for Generalizable Neural Inertial Odometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09355)
*Junye Zou,Huiyi Yan,Xinning Xu,Xiaolei Li,Pengkun Zhou,Jinhui Zhang,Ziyang Meng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MosaicIMU提出了一种基于载体条件混合专家（MoE）的预训练与自适应框架，用于泛化性神经惯性里程计。通过原型路由器组合载体特定专家特征，结合历史感知EKF进行速度与不确定性解码。针对未见领域冻住基模型并学习轻量级专家残差分支，边缘部署时利用路由器选择在线样本进行高效增量更新。实验显示平均ATE和RTE-10s分别降低40%和34%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于学习的惯性里程计方法通常绑定特定载体，难以在异构平台上泛化。需要一种能够跨载体泛化的鲁棒惯性里程计方法，以应对外部感知不可靠的场景。

Method: 提出MosaicIMU框架，包含：(1) 基于原型路由器的载体条件混合专家（MoE）架构，组合载体特定专家特征；(2) 局部速度与不确定性约束解码，结合历史感知EKF进行积分；(3) 未见领域自适应：冻结预训练基模型，学习轻量级专家残差分支；(4) 边缘部署：复用路由器选择信息量大的在线样本进行高效增量更新。

Result: MosaicIMU在多个载体平台上一致优于基于学习的基线方法，平均绝对轨迹误差（ATE）降低40%，10秒相对轨迹误差（RTE-10s）降低34%。

Conclusion: MosaicIMU提供了一种从预训练到部署的可扩展范式，实现了可泛化且自适应的神经惯性里程计，有效解决了跨载体泛化问题和实际部署中的自适应需求。

Abstract: Robust inertial odometry is essential for various carriers when external sensing is unreliable. Learning-based methods reduce integration drift by capturing local motion priors, but these methods often remain tied to a particular carrier, limiting generalization across heterogeneous platforms. We present MosaicIMU, a carrier-conditioned Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) pretraining-and-adaptation framework for generalizable neural inertial odometry. MosaicIMU uses a prototype-based router to compose carrier-specific expert features, decodes local velocity and uncertainty constraints, and integrates them with a history-aware EKF. For unseen domain adaptation, it freezes the pretrained base model and learns a new lightweight expert residual branch. For edge-deployment, it further reuses the router to select informative online samples for efficient incremental updates. Experiments show that MosaicIMU consistently outperforms learning-based baselines, reducing average ATE and RTE-10s by 40% and 34%, respectively. These results highlight that MosaicIMU provides a scalable pretraining-to-deployment paradigm for generalizable and adaptive neural inertial odometry.

</details>


### [897] [ReGIL: Retrieval-Guided Imitation Learning from a Single Demonstration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09381)
*Yuying Zhang,Francesco Verdoja,Wenyan Yang,Ville Kyrki*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ReGIL是一种检索引导的模仿学习框架，将单次示教作为外部记忆，通过检索对齐提供奖励和引导探索，在LIBERO和Meta-World基准及真实机器人任务上取得优于基线方法的成功率和训练效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单次示教下深度神经网络机器人操作策略的学习极具挑战性，因为微小偏差会迅速累积导致失败，而大量在线交互数据收集成本高昂。

Method: 提出了ReGIL框架，将单次示教视为静态外部记忆，在训练过程中反复查询该记忆以同时引导探索、生成正则化缓冲区和构建奖励；通过当前轨迹与检索片段之间的局部时间对齐计算奖励，提供逐步且信息丰富的反馈。

Result: 在LIBERO和Meta-World基准的单次示教设置下，ReGIL在成功率和训练效率上均优于先前基线方法；真实机器人实验中，仅使用一次示教和不到一小时的在线训练，在三个操作任务上实现超过75%的成功率，且初始机器人姿态和目标位置均存在随机性。

Conclusion: 单次示教作为可重用记忆不仅能提供静态监督，还能实现更高效的机器人学习。

Abstract: Learning robot manipulation policies with deep neural networks from a single demonstration remains highly challenging, as even small deviations from the demonstrated trajectory can quickly compound into failure, while collecting substantial online interaction data is costly. We propose ReGIL, a retrieval-guided imitation learning framework that treats a single demonstration as an external memory. ReGIL repeatedly queries this static memory throughout training to simultaneously guide exploration, generate the regularization buffer, and construct rewards. Specifically, it computes rewards through local temporal alignment between the current trajectory and the retrieved segment, providing step-wise and informative feedback for policy improvement. We evaluate ReGIL on robotic manipulation tasks from the LIBERO and Meta-World benchmarks under the single demonstration setting. ReGIL outperforms prior baselines in both success rate and training efficiency. In real-robot experiments, using only one demonstration and less than one hour of online training, ReGIL achieves over 75% success rate across three manipulation tasks with randomness in both initial robot pose and target position. These results demonstrate that leveraging the single demonstration as reusable memory can provide more than static supervision for efficient robot learning. More details can be found on our website: https://regil2026.github.io/

</details>


### [898] [Harness Engineering for Physical AI: Robot Middleware Is the Harness Layer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09416)
*Sanghoon Lee,Jiyeong Chae,Kyung-Joon Park*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出在物理AI时代，机器人中间件应承担“约束系统”（harness）的新角色，在控制、计算和通信三个维度上对AI模型的输出进行投影（Projection）、隔离（Isolation）和回退（Transfer）约束，并以ROS 2 Harness Profile作为实现蓝图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着学习型策略、规划器和VLA模型作为因果参与者进入机器人控制路径，现有中间件缺乏对AI模型在时序、调度和网络层面的约束机制。语言智能体领域已将这一层命名为"harness"，但机器人社区尚未采用此框架。

Method: 定义物理AI约束系统（Physical AI Harness）的三个核心功能：Projection（在发射时门控每个输出）、Isolation（隔离模型的执行和传输时隙）、Transfer（检查失败时回退到经过验证的基线）。提出将这些功能嵌入机器人中间件，而非作为应用层手写代码，并以ROS 2 Harness Profile作为具体实现载体。

Result: 识别出现有机器人中间件已提供大部分约束系统所需的基础设施，但缺少针对AI模型的三项强制功能。这些功能目前以手写应用代码形式存在于部署系统中，本应作为中间件的第一公民。

Conclusion: 机器人中间件应成为控制、计算、通信三个维度的合成强制执行层，而非单一轴的最佳执行器。ROS 2 Harness Profile可作为承载AI模型声明（输出区域、推理预算、运行模式）并由中间件强制执行的部署构件。

Abstract: Robot middleware faces a new role in the era of Physical AI. Learned policies, planners, and vision-language-action (VLA) models now enter deployed robots as causal participants on the control path, but the layer that integrates them with timing, scheduling, and network has not been named. Recent language-agent work names this layer the harness, the external system that mediates tools, manages state, bounds resources, and records execution. The robotics community has not yet adopted this framing, and we propose that robot middleware is that harness. A Physical AI harness differs from a software harness in where it intervenes. A software harness mediates at tool-call boundaries. A Physical AI harness must mediate at control, computing, and communication simultaneously, because a learned policy's output crosses all three: its commands shift the trajectory, its inference time shifts the schedule, and its payload shifts the bandwidth. Robot middleware is the lowest robot-stack layer with mediating abstractions over all three, so it is best positioned to compose their enforcement. It already provides most of what a harness needs but lacks the enforcement for an AI model. We name this missing enforcement as three functions: Projection gates each output at emission, Isolation bounds the model's execution and transmission slot, and Transfer falls back to a verified baseline when checks fail. Each appears today as hand-built application code in deployed robot systems, built on surfaces robot middleware already provides. Robot middleware should host them not as the best single-axis enforcer but as the layer that composes all three. We sketch this as a ROS 2 Harness Profile, a deployment artifact that carries an AI model's declared output region, inference budget, and operating regime while the middleware enforces them across ROS 2, DDS, and Zenoh.

</details>


### [899] [Dense Force Estimation with an Event-based Optical Tactile Sensor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09451)
*Agis Politis,René Zurbrügg,Valentina Cavinato*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个基于事件触觉传感器进行稠密3D力场重建的框架，通过事件数据估计表面位移，并利用逆有限元方法将其映射为力，在100Hz下实现了(0.14N, 0.10N, 0.93N)的平均绝对误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉触觉传感器受限于帧率、运动模糊和数据带宽，而事件触觉传感器虽具有微秒级时间分辨率和低运动模糊，但现有方法仅能预测合力，无法提供稠密力场信息，这限制了机器人灵巧操作中的高频力反馈能力。

Method: 提出基于事件触觉传感器的稠密3D力场重建框架：1) 通过事件流追踪标记点恢复剪切位移；2) 利用CNN从事件数据预测法向位移；3) 将3D位移场通过逆有限元方法(iFEM)映射为力场。

Result: 在(4N, 4N, 20N)的力范围内，平均绝对误差为(0.14N, 0.10N, 0.93N)，系统平均运行频率为100Hz。

Conclusion: 该工作是实现高频稠密力反馈的第一步，可用于机器人抓取和灵巧操作中的高频控制。

Abstract: Humans rely on spatially dense, geometry and force-aware tactile feedback at high temporal resolution for dexterous manipulation. While vision-based tactile sensors enable dense force estimation, they are limited by camera frame rates, motion blur, and data bandwidth. Event-based optical tactile sensors offer an attractive alternative with microsecond temporal resolution and low motion blur, but existing methods are restricted to predicting only net forces. We introduce the first framework for dense 3D force field reconstruction using event-based optical tactile sensors. Our approach estimates 3D surface displacements from event data and maps them to forces via the inverse Finite Elements Method (iFEM). Shear displacements are recovered through the proposed event-based marker tracking algorithm, while normal displacements are predicted by a convolutional neural network trained on a collected dataset of synchronized force-displacement-event data. Experiments demonstrate accurate reconstruction of physically grounded forces, achieving a mean absolute error of (0.14 N, 0.10 N, 0.93 N) over force ranges up to (4 N, 4 N, 20 N), while operating at an average of 100 Hz. This work constitutes a first step toward enabling dense force feedback for high-frequency control in robotic grasping and dexterous manipulation.

</details>


### [900] [$ω$-EVA: Envision, Verify, and Act with Latent Interactive World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09457)
*Zhenguo Sun,Yu Sun,Hande Huang,Alois Knoll*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ω-EVA提出了一种潜空间交互式世界模型，通过“设想-验证-执行”三阶段框架实现具身动作生成。该模型学习动作条件潜动力学，训练语言条件流策略，并通过三分支精化器联合推理当前状态、动作条件未来和提议动作，将世界模型从被动预测器转变为主动动作反馈模块。在约1.2B参数且无额外机器人数据预训练下，在多种仿真设置中表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身策略通常直接映射当前观测到动作，隐含了候选动作的后果；世界模型虽提供预测性监督或外部模拟，但很少让策略在执行前审视其自身提议的想象后果。ω-EVA旨在让世界模型成为主动的动作反馈模块而非被动预测器。

Method: 提出ω-EVA，包含三阶段框架：1) 学习动作条件潜动力学；2) 在动力学感知的视觉表示上训练语言条件流策略；3) 将策略的提议反馈给世界模型。创新点在于三分支精化器，联合推理当前状态、提议条件未来和提议动作以生成最终动作块，且推理过程在潜特征空间中进行，避免生成未来视频。

Result: 在单臂、双臂、长时域和扰动仿真等多种设置下，完整的交互流水线一致地改进了提议策略；潜空间诊断显示有意义的动作条件未来结构。约1.2B参数且无额外机器人数据预训练，实现了竞争性的性能-规模-数据权衡。

Conclusion: ω-EVA展示了将世界模型作为主动动作反馈模块的有效性，在紧凑参数规模下实现了优异的性能-数据权衡，验证了潜空间设想-验证-执行范式的实用价值。

Abstract: Embodied policies typically map current observations directly to actions, leaving candidate-action consequences implicit. World models provide predictive supervision, representations, or external simulation, but rarely let a policy inspect the imagined consequence of its own proposal before acting. We introduce $ω$-EVA, a latent interactive world model that realizes an Envision--Verify--Act loop for embodied action generation. Its three-stage framework learns action-conditioned latent dynamics, trains a language-conditioned flow policy on dynamics-aware visual representations, and feeds the policy's proposal back through the world model. A tri-branch refiner jointly reasons over the current state, proposal-conditioned future, and proposed action to produce the final action chunk. Because consequence reasoning remains in latent feature space, $ω$-EVA avoids generating future videos at inference. Evaluations across diverse single-arm, bimanual, long-horizon, and perturbed simulation settings show that the complete interaction pipeline consistently improves the proposal policy, while latent diagnostics indicate meaningful action-conditioned future structure. With approximately 1.2B parameters and no additional robot-data pretraining, $ω$-EVA demonstrates a compact and competitive performance--scale--data trade-off, making the world model an active action-feedback module rather than a passive predictor.

</details>


### [901] [Goal Sets, Not Goal States: Queryable Robot Goals through Goal-Set Hindsight Relabeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09476)
*Carlos Vélez García,Miguel Cazorla,Jorge Pomares*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出目标集事后重标记（GS-HER），将事后重标记从单点目标泛化为谓词级目标集，通过二进制查询定义成功变量，使离线GCRL算法无需重训即可适应多种目标谓词。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准事后重标记将已到达的未来状态视为精确目标，当任务成功仅取决于状态子集时，这会过度约束离线机器人学习，尤其是在存在无关状态维度（nuisance dimensions）的情况下。

Method: GS-HER将已到达状态认证为查询定义的目标集而非单点目标；通过二进制查询指定哪些变量决定成功，使目标谓词成为推理时输入，底层离线GCRL算法无需改动。

Result: 在OGBench任务和五种离线目标条件学习器上，GS-HER在完整状态目标受无关维度瓶颈时提升性能；单个检查点可回答多种机器人目标谓词而无需重训。

Conclusion: GS-HER将事后重标记转变为可重用的目标接口，缓解了离线学习中对无关状态维度的过约束问题，提升了泛化性和效率。

Abstract: Hindsight relabeling usually turns achieved future states into exact goals, which can overconstrain offline robot learning when task success depends only on a subset of the state. We propose Goal-Set Hindsight Relabeling (GS-HER), a predicate-level generalization of HER in which achieved states certify query-defined goal sets rather than singleton goal states. A binary query specifies which variables define success, making the goal predicate an inference-time input while leaving the underlying offline GCRL algorithm unchanged. Across OGBench tasks and five offline goal-conditioned learners, GS-HER improves performance when full-state goals are bottlenecked by nuisance dimensions and turns hindsight relabeling into a reusable goal interface: one checkpoint can answer multiple robot goal predicates without retraining.

</details>


### [902] [Targeting World Models to Compromise Robot Learning Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09499)
*Ethan Rathbun,Ahmed Agha,Saaduddin Mahmud,Christopher Amato,Alina Oprea,Eugene Bagdasarian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文揭示了世界模型在机器人学习供应链中存在的隐蔽数据投毒隐患：攻击者可将恶意提示或过渡动力学注入看似安全的遥操作数据中，这些数据在被世界模型处理时才会激活，生成危险的合成训练轨迹，最终导致下游机器人策略被后门攻击。实验在动作条件与文本条件世界模型上验证了攻击有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型在机器人学习中的应用日益广泛，但其引入的供应链安全问题尚未被充分认识。传统数据投毒直接污染公开数据集，而世界模型的"二次处理"特性创造了一种全新的、更隐蔽的攻击面——攻击者无需直接篡改训练数据即可植入后门。

Method: 提出两种新型攻击方式：(1) 恶意提示注入——在遥操作数据中嵌入特定触发条件，世界模型处理时生成异常轨迹；(2) 过渡动力学妥协——修改数据中的状态转移模式，使世界模型在特定条件下产生危险的合成轨迹。攻击不需要直接修改地面真实训练数据。

Result: 在动作条件世界模型和文本条件世界模型上均验证了攻击有效性：实现了对下游深度强化学习策略的端到端后门攻击，并在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）设置中完成了概念验证。

Conclusion: 世界模型在机器人学习供应链中的安全脆弱性不可忽视，亟需研究更安全的世界模型构建方法，并重新评估其在机器人学习流水线中的位置。

Abstract: World models have recently seen a rapid growth in both their popularity and capability as more data efficient tools for generating robot training data or simulating real world environments, with many works proposing their integration into the robot learning pipeline. While highly practical, in this work we demonstrate that world models introduce a uniquely stealthy and effective data poisoning entry point into the robot learning supply chain that can result in the deployment of unsafe or otherwise compromised robotic policies despite training on seemingly safe ground truth training data. In contrast to traditional data poisoning techniques which directly implant dangerous trajectories into sold or uploaded datasets, our novel attack methods inject malicious prompts or compromising transition dynamics into visibly safe teleoperated datasets which are only activated once fed through a world model as input. This can result in the generation of synthetic, dangerous robot training trajectories and subsequently unsafe or compromised robot policies. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our attacks against both state of the art action conditioned and text conditioned world models, showing a full end-to-end backdoor on a downstream DRL policy and a proof-of-concept for the VLA setting. Overall these findings necessitate research into more secure world models and reevaluating their position within the robot learning supply chain.

</details>


### [903] [Efficient Minimal Solvers for Relative Pose Estimation in Autonomous Driving Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09569)
*Tao Li,Liang Liu,Jianli Han,Weimin Lv*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于新颖平移参数化和一阶旋转近似的统一框架，用于多相机系统的相对位姿估计。在该框架下设计了三个面向自动驾驶车辆的高效最小求解器：集成IMU垂直方向先验、利用转向时的旋转轴方向先验以及针对平面运动。这些方法通过减少点对应数量和代数复杂度，在RANSAC管线中实现更快的假设生成。在合成数据集和KITTI基准上的实验表明，该方法在速度和精度之间取得了良好的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有相对位姿估计方法计算成本高、高度依赖丰富的特征匹配，难以满足自动驾驶场景中对实时性和鲁棒性的需求。

Method: 提出统一框架，基于新颖平移参数化和一阶旋转近似；设计了三个最小求解器（IMU垂直方向先验、转向旋转轴方向先验、平面运动假设），减少最小点对应数量和代数复杂度。

Result: 在合成数据集和KITTI自动驾驶基准上的实验表明，所提求解器在速度和精度之间取得了优于现有方法的平衡。

Conclusion: 该方法通过降低计算复杂度和点对应需求，提升了在实时系统（如自动驾驶、机器人导航）中的适用性，实现了高效且鲁棒的相对位姿估计。

Abstract: With the advancement of visual sensing systems, computer vision is playing an increasingly important role in autonomous driving and robot navigation. Relative pose estimation in multi-camera systems is essential for accurate vehicle localization and environment perception, demanding high real-time performance and robustness. Existing methods, however, often involve high computational costs and rely heavily on abundant feature matches, limiting their applicability in time-sensitive driving scenarios. To address these limitations, this paper introduces a unified framework for efficient relative pose estimation, built upon a novel translation parameterization and first-order rotation approximation. Within this framework, we propose three efficient minimal solvers specifically designed for autonomous vehicles. The first solver integrates the vertical direction prior from Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs), the second utilizes the rotation axis direction prior during steering maneuvers, and the third is designed for planar motion - a realistic assumption for ground vehicles operating on structured roads. By reducing both the minimal number of point correspondences and the algebraic complexity, our methods enable faster hypothesis generation within RANSAC-based pipelines, improving suitability for real-time systems. Extensive experiments on synthetic datasets and the KITTI autonomous driving benchmark demonstrate that the proposed solvers achieve a favorable balance between speed and accuracy compared to existing state-of-the-art algorithms.

</details>


### [904] [CT-VAM: A Cerebello-Thalamic-Inspired Vision-Action Model for Efficient Visuomotor Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09572)
*Jiacheng Li,Yize Guo,Jiabin Guo,Qingchen Liu,Jiahu Qin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种小脑-丘脑启发的视觉-动作模型（CT-VAM），仅用68M参数即可实现与大模型竞争的机器人操作性能，通过TARS条件注意力解码器分离处理异构输入，并支持云端-边缘协同的高频实时控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中依赖语言描述任务意图，但在高频低层执行中反复处理语言是不必要的。作者希望将高层语义推理与低层闭环控制解耦，实现轻量级本地执行策略，同时支持云端大模型与边缘设备的高效协作。

Method: 1) 提出CT-VAM架构，包含TARS（丘脑动作路由流）条件注意力解码器，独立路由动作、视觉和任务三个流，防止密集视觉token淹没任务条件。2) 采用流一致修复（flow-consistent inpainting）实现异步块执行，支持高频控制。3) 模型仅68M参数，输入为双目视觉观测、本体感知和轻量级任务条件。

Result: 在LIBERO基准上达到与更大规模VLA模型可比的成功率，同时降低推理延迟。在实际资源受限的机器人平台上展示了鲁棒的部署性能。

Conclusion: CT-VAM验证了分离高层语义推理与低层运动控制的可行性，为云端-边缘协同的机器人操作提供了高效实用的轻量级方案。

Abstract: Vision-language-action models have shown strong promise for robot manipulation, yet raw language is primarily needed to specify task intent rather than to be repeatedly processed during high-frequency low-level execution. Motivated by this separation, we propose a cerebello-thalamic-inspired vision-action model (CT-VAM) for efficient task-conditioned visuomotor control. CT-VAM acts as a compact local execution policy that predicts action chunks from dualview visual observations, proprioception, and a lightweight task condition, potentially enabling a practical cloud-edge paradigm in which high-level semantic reasoning can be handled by large models while fast closed-loop control runs on local hardware. To fuse heterogeneous inputs effectively, CT-VAM introduces TARS (Thalamic Action Routing Stream), a stream-separated conditional attention decoder that independently routes action, visual and task streams, preventing dense sensory tokens from overwhelming compact task-relevant conditions. With only 68M parameters, CT-VAM achieves LIBERO success rates competitive with substantially larger VLA models, while reducing inference latency. Together with flow-consistent inpainting for asynchronous chunk execution, CT-VAM supports high-frequency control and demonstrates robust realworld deployment on resource-constrained robotic platforms.

</details>


### [905] [Shape Formation for the Cooperative Transportation of Arbitrary Objects Using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09610)
*Mohamed Sayed,Wolfram Burgard,Tanja Katharina Kaiser*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于多智能体强化学习的方法，使多机器人系统能够自主定位到任意形状、质量分布不均的物体下方形成稳定支撑构型，并在过程中避障，适用于工业到家庭服务中的协同物体运输。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实世界中的物体可能具有任意形状和非均匀质量分布，传统方法难以使机器人形成安全支撑物体的构型，亟需一种能自适应复杂几何与质量分布的自主构型控制方法。

Method: 采用多智能体强化学习（MARL），让多机器人系统自主决策定位到物体下方，形成平衡支撑构型，同时避开障碍物。

Result: 在多种环境和不同机器人数量下，该方法能可靠生成平衡构型，并泛化到杂乱场景及具有复杂几何与非均匀质量分布的物体。

Conclusion: 所提方法有效解决了真实世界物体运输中的构型控制难题，具备良好的泛化能力。

Abstract: Cooperative object transportation is essential in numerous domains, including industrial to domestic services. A popular transportation strategy is to carry objects on top of multi-robot systems. The corresponding task is typically solved by decomposing it into three interconnected subproblems: formation control, cooperative navigation, and collision avoidance. A particular challenge posed by real-world objects is their potentially arbitrary shape and non-uniform mass distribution, necessitating robot formations that securely support the object. In this work, we address the challenge of pattern formation control for transporting such real-world objects by proposing a novel multi-agent reinforcement learning approach. Our approach enables a multi-robot system to autonomously position itself underneath an object to support its weight while avoiding obstacles during the formation process. Our evaluations with diverse environments and varying numbers of robots show that our approach leads to policies that reliably produce balanced formations and generalize to cluttered scenes and objects with complex geometry and non-uniform mass distribution.

</details>


### [906] [DexPIE: Stable Dexterous Policy Improvement from Real-World Experience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09615)
*Ruizhe Liao,Wenrui Chen,Liangji Zeng,Haoran Lin,Fan Yang,Kailun Yang,Yaonan Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DexPIE是一个后训练框架，通过真实世界部署中收集的经验来改进灵巧操作策略，在三个真实任务上相比演示基线策略实现了37%的成功率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧操作因高维动作空间和复杂接触动力学而面临挑战，纯演示学习的策略在部署时存在复合误差，且需要大量专家数据才能达到可靠性能。为突破演示数据的局限性，提出利用部署经验进行策略改进。

Method: 提出DexPIE后训练框架，包含三个关键组件：(1) 适应灵巧手的干预系统和多阶段DAgger式数据收集，实现有效探索覆盖；(2) 在相对动作空间中引入异步推理，降低后训练 rollout 与演示数据之间的时序噪声；(3) 通过连续最优性指标对策略进行条件化，以更细粒度方式利用数据质量。

Result: 在三个挑战性的真实世界灵巧操作任务上，DexPIE相比基于演示的参考策略实现了37%的成功率提升，优于所有基线方法，展现出更强的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: DexPIE通过利用真实部署经验有效改进了灵巧操作策略，超越了纯演示学习的性能上限，为灵巧操作的后训练提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Dexterous manipulation presents substantial challenges for imitation learning due to its high-dimensional action space and complex contact-rich dynamics. Policies trained purely from demonstrations often suffer from compounding errors during deployment and require large amounts of expert data to achieve reliable performance. To move beyond the limitations of demonstration data, in this work, we propose DexPIE, a post-training framework for dexterous policy improvement from experience collected through real-world deployment. First, DexPIE enables effective exploration coverage through a dexterous-hand-adapted intervention system and multi-stage DAgger-style data collection across initial and intermediate task stages, providing reliable supervision for accurate policy evaluation. To reduce temporal noise between post-training rollouts and demonstration data, we introduce asynchronous inference in the relative action space, which better aligns rollout data with demonstrated behavior and allows the critic to learn a value function induced by a more consistent underlying policy. Finally, DexPIE improves the policy through conditioning on a continuous optimality indicator, allowing the policy to leverage the quality of data in a more fine-grained manner. Across three challenging real-world dexterous manipulation tasks, DexPIE achieves a 37% improvement in success rate over the demonstration-based reference policy, outperforming all baseline methods and demonstrating stronger robustness. The source code and dataset will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [907] [Motion planning for hundreds of floating robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09620)
*Jan Kamm,Antonio Terpin,Raffaello D'Andrea,Aswin Ramachandran*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 针对大规模浮动机器人编队的碰撞避免运动规划问题，提出了一种可扩展的流水线方法：从初始化构建碰撞图，分解为独立交互簇并行求解，并引入鲁棒机制处理分解病理。在最高500台机器人仿真及两次真实世界演示（苏黎世湖24台、威尼斯双年展）中验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模机器人编队中碰撞避免导致强耦合，且编队规模增大时耦合复杂度快速上升，现有方法难以在短时间内生成跨越数千时间步的轨迹。

Method: 提出可扩展流水线：(1) 从初始轨迹构建碰撞图；(2) 将耦合问题分解为交互簇；(3) 独立并行求解各簇，并设计鲁棒机制处理常见分解病理。

Result: 在500台机器人仿真中验证了可扩展性，并在两次真实世界演示中成功部署：苏黎世湖24台Water Way机器人、威尼斯建筑双年展。

Conclusion: 所提方法能在稀疏关键帧约束下，数秒内生成分钟级时长、数千时间步的大规模编队避碰轨迹，兼具可扩展性和实际部署可行性。

Abstract: Planning collision-free motion for large robot fleets is difficult because collision avoidance induces strong inter-agent coupling that grows rapidly with team size. We consider omnidirectional floating robots on water, where choreographies are specified by sparse keyframes and an interactive tool must generate trajectories within seconds, even when transitions span minutes and thousands of time steps. We propose a scalable pipeline that builds a collision graph from an initialization, decomposes the coupled problem into interaction clusters, and solves clusters independently (and in parallel) with robustness mechanisms for common decomposition pathologies. We validate the approach in simulations up to 500 robots. The synthesized trajectories have also been deployed in two real-world demonstrations, on Lake Zürich with a fleet of 24 Way of Water crafts and at the Time Space Existence 2025 Venice Biennale.

</details>


### [908] [ReCoVLA: VLM-Guided Reward Compilation for Failure Recovery in Vision-Language-Action Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09630)
*Haodi Hu,Chung-Ta Huang,Jing Liu,Ye Wang,Kei Suzuki,Matthew Brand,Toshiaki Koike-Akino*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ReCoVLA提出了一种基于故障条件的残差恢复框架，通过冻结预训练的VLA策略，利用外部VLM推断故障模式和恢复阶段，并构建结构化奖励进行残差策略训练，最终在仿真和真实实验中显著提升了操作任务的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的VLA策略在语言条件操作任务中表现良好，但在遇到非标称状态（如故障或异常情况）时缺乏鲁棒性，难以进行有针对性的恢复。作者希望在不重新训练或微调昂贵VLA模型的前提下，赋予其故障恢复能力。

Method: ReCoVLA保持预训练VLA策略冻结，使用外部VLM作为语义奖励选择器，预测恢复描述符和奖励掩码；基于这些信息在仿真中训练残差恢复策略，然后零样本迁移到真实世界。该方法将高层故障理解与低层纠错控制解耦，支持不同的VLA模型。

Result: 在仿真中，ReCoVLA将微调基线$π_{0.5}$的平均成功率从36.7%提升至66.7%；在真实零样本仿真到现实迁移实验中，ReCoVLA取得了最佳平均性能，成功率为61.7%。

Conclusion: ReCoVLA通过解耦故障理解与纠错控制，在不修改VLA策略的前提下有效提升了其在故障状态下的恢复能力，在短时域、长时域和接触丰富的操作任务中均优于基线方法。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies provide strong priors for language-conditioned manipulation, but remain brittle in off-nominal states requiring targeted recovery. We propose ReCoVLA -- a failure-conditioned residual recovery framework that keeps a pretrained VLA policy frozen, uses an external vision-language model (VLM) to infer the failure mode and recovery stage, and compiles a structured reward from task-relevant components. Rather than using the VLM to generate actions or rewards directly, ReCoVLA uses it as a semantic reward selector: it predicts a recovery descriptor and reward mask for in-simulation residual-policy training, followed by zero-shot sim-to-real deployment of the trained recovery policies. This decouples high-level failure understanding from low-level corrective control to support different VLAs. Experiments across short-horizon, long-horizon, and contact-rich manipulation tasks show that ReCoVLA outperforms the tested baselines on average. In simulation, our reward compiler improves average success from 36.7% for the fine-tuned $π_{0.5}$ baseline to 66.7%. In physical zero-shot sim-to-real experiments, ReCoVLA achieves the best average performance, with 61.7% success.

</details>


### [909] [Physics-Aware Sparse Learning and Selective Online Adaptation for Euler-Lagrange Robot Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09640)
*Rishabh Dev Yadav,Samaksh Ujjawal,Sihao Sun,Spandan Roy,Wei Pan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种保结构的残差学习框架，将动力学模型误差分解为惯性修正、相应的科里奥利项和广义力残差，机械部分在物理约束下学习，干扰敏感部分通过稀疏历史依赖的潜变量交互模型并结合贝叶斯线性回归在线自适应，在多种机器人平台上提升了动力学预测和轨迹跟踪性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标称欧拉-拉格朗日模型在载荷变化、未建模耦合、摩擦、气动效应等条件下往往不准确，现有基于学习的修正方法通过添加单一加性残差虽提高了预测精度，但未能保留欧拉-拉格朗日系统的内部机械结构，导致模型不保持对称性、正定性以及惯性与速度相关项之间的耦合，进而产生物理不一致的预测，降低了模型预测控制器中的可靠性。

Method: 提出保结构残差学习框架，将模型失配分解为三个部分：惯性修正矩阵、对应的诱导科里奥利项以及广义力残差。机械部分在物理约束下学习（保证对称性、正定性等），干扰敏感部分通过稀疏历史依赖的潜变量交互模型表示，并利用贝叶斯线性回归进行在线自适应。该分离机制保留关键机械结构，同时将自适应限制在最受变化条件影响的动力学部分。

Result: 在多种机器人平台（移动机器人、空中机器人、机械臂系统）上的实验表明，所提方法在耦合和时变动力学条件下改善了动力学预测精度和轨迹跟踪性能。

Conclusion: 将结构化残差建模、紧凑潜变量交互选择与选择性在线自适应相结合，对于实际场景下的基于模型的控制具有重要价值。

Abstract: Accurate dynamics models are essential for model-based robotic control, yet nominal Euler--Lagrange models often become inaccurate in the presence of payload variation, unmodeled coupling, friction, aerodynamic effects, and changing operating conditions. Most learning-based correction methods improve prediction accuracy by introducing a single additive residual, but do not preserve the internal mechanical structure of Euler--Lagrange systems. This leads to models that do not preserve symmetry, positive-definiteness, or the coupling between inertia and velocity-dependent terms, which can result in physically inconsistent predictions and reduced reliability when embedded in model-based controllers. We propose a structure-preserving residual learning framework that decomposes model mismatch into an inertia correction, the corresponding induced Coriolis term, and a generalized-force residual. The mechanical component is learned under physical constraints, while the disturbance-sensitive component is represented through a sparse history-dependent latent interaction model and adapted online using Bayesian linear regression. This separation preserves key mechanical structure while restricting adaptation to the part of the dynamics most affected by changing conditions. Experiments across multiple robotic platforms, including mobile, aerial, and manipulator systems, show that the proposed method improves dynamics prediction and trajectory tracking under coupled and time-varying dynamics. These results highlight the value of combining structured residual modeling, compact latent interaction selection, and selective online adaptation for real-world model-based control.

</details>


### [910] [Modeling Components and Connections in Cyber-Physical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09645)
*Kate Sanborn,Tanuj Kenchannavar,Vakul Nath,Jonathan Sprinkle*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了ROSLaunchVisual，一个基于WebGME的模型集成环境，通过图形化界面设计和管理ROS启动文件，支持元模型驱动验证、自动导入/导出和可视化通信映射，提高了开发效率和系统理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于文本的ROS启动文件（XML）虽然能展示模块层次结构，但隐藏了模块间的连接和接口细节，导致开发时难以捕捉系统整体信息，尤其在大型或协作机器人项目中容易出错。

Method: 在WebGME平台上构建模型集成环境，采用图形化界面表示节点、发布者、订阅者和参数等互联组件，支持元模型驱动的验证、启动文件的自动导入/导出、可视化通信映射，并通过插件实现库更新、语义错误检查和重映射管理。

Result: 实现了启动文件的动态系统分析，可在静态开发和现有/新启动文件分析中使用，使启动文件创建更直观且不易出错。

Conclusion: ROSLaunchVisual通过提升抽象层次，改善了协作和大型机器人项目中启动文件的开发效率与系统理解，降低了出错率。

Abstract: Text based configuration files for cyber-physical systems show the hierarchy of component modules well but often hide the details of connections and interfaces between modules. A model-based visual approach to these configuration files can better capture this information. The XML structure of Robot Operating System (ROS) launch files can be improved using a modeling approach. This paper presents ROSLaunchVisual, a model-integrated environment built on WebGME for designing, visualizing, and managing ROS launch files. The tool raises the level of abstraction by allowing developers to create and modify launch files using a graphical interface that represents nodes, publishers, subscribers, and arguments as interconnected components. The tool provides a dynamic system analysis that can then be used in the static development and analysis of new and existing launch files. ROSLaunchVisual incorporates features such as metamodel-driven validation, automatic import/export of launch files, and visual communication mapping. Plugins further enhance functionality by updating libraries, checking for semantic errors, and managing remaps. By making launch file creation more intuitive and less error-prone, ROSLaunchVisual improves development efficiency and system understanding, especially in collaborative or large-scale robotics projects.

</details>


### [911] [Safe Polytope-in-Polytope Motion Planning and Control with Control Barrier Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09719)
*Alejandro Gonzalez-Garcia,Dries Dirckx,Jan Swevers,Wilm Decré*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于模型预测控制的安全局部运动规划方法，通过离散时间控制障碍函数约束，保证多面体机器人足迹始终保持在连续更新的凸自由空间区域内。该方法不依赖障碍物检测或分割，计算复杂度与局部自由空间几何和机器人形状相关，而非障碍物数量。实验表明，相比传统多面体避障方法，计算时间最多可降低91倍，并在无人地面车辆和非完整移动机器人上实现了10Hz的实时安全控制，包括动态障碍物的反应式避碰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将机器人简化为点或圆形过于保守，丢弃了成功和安全通过狭窄通道所需的信息，需要一种考虑机器人实际物理足迹的安全运动规划方法。

Method: 将机器人足迹表示为多面体，在模型预测控制器中引入离散时间控制障碍函数约束，保证多面体始终位于连续更新的凸自由空间区域内。自由空间公式化无需障碍物检测或分割，约束数量取决于局部自由空间几何和机器人形状的复杂度。

Result: 与多面体避障方法相比，计算时间最多降低91倍；在无人地面车辆和非完整移动机器人上验证，实现了10Hz的实时运动规划与控制，包括反应式动态避障。

Conclusion: 所提方法能够在复杂环境中实现安全、实时的运动规划与控制，有效解决了机器人物理足迹约束问题，且计算效率随障碍物数量增加而显著优于传统方法。

Abstract: Autonomous mobile robots operating in tight environments require motion planning frameworks that account for the physical footprint of the robot. Simplifying the geometry to a point or a circle is conservative and discards information needed to successfully and safely traverse narrow passages. This work proposes a safe local motion planning and control method that guarantees that a polytopic robot footprint stays inside a continuously updated convex free-space region. The containment condition is formulated as a set of discrete-time control barrier function constraints within a model predictive controller. The number of safety constraints depends on the complexity of the local free-space geometry and the robot shape, instead of the number of obstacles. The proposed free-space formulation does not need any obstacle detection or segmentation. A comparative analysis against a polytope-based obstacle avoidance formulation confirms favorable scaling up to a reduction of 91$\times$ in computation time as the number of obstacles increases. The approach is validated in simulation with an autonomous surface vehicle and on hardware with a non-holonomic mobile robot, using both occupancy grids and LiDAR sensing. The experiments demonstrate safe real-time motion planning and control at 10~Hz on an onboard embedded computer, including reactive avoidance of dynamic obstacles.

</details>


### [912] [ProbeAct: Probe-Guided Training-Free Failure Recovery in Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09740)
*Fan Zhang,Seongbin Park,Baharan Mirzasoleiman,Shariar Talebi,Nader Sehatbakhsh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PROBEACT是一种无需训练、即插即用的运行时干预框架，通过轻量级隐藏状态探针、运动学状态机和分层控制障碍函数滤波器，检测并恢复预训练VLA模型在抓取和放置任务中的失败，在LIBERO-plus基准上将OpenVLA-OFT模型的成功率从69.6%提升至74.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的VLA模型在训练分布内表现良好，但泛化能力有限，难以应对光照变化、视角改变、初始状态变化等扰动，缺乏鲁棒性。

Method: PROBEACT由三个组件组成：(i) 轻量级多目标隐藏状态探针，从中间VLA特征预测任务相关物体的3D位置，并使用匈牙利匹配身份追踪处理多目标场景；(ii) 与物体无关的运动学状态机，仅利用夹爪内部信号和末端执行器运动学检测抓取、运输和放置失败；(iii) 分层控制障碍函数滤波器，将重复失败位置编码为软安全集约束，最小化修正VLA动作的同时保留基线行为。

Result: 在LIBERO-plus基准上，PROBEACT将OpenVLA-OFT模型的成功率从69.6%提升至74.1%，并且对基础和微调后的VLA策略均具有广泛适用性。

Conclusion: PROBEACT作为一种无需训练、即插即用的干预框架，可作为VLA策略的通用安全网，有效提升其鲁棒性和成功率，且与现有训练流程正交。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models demonstrate strong perfor-1 mance on language-conditioned robotic manipulation within their training dis-2 tribution, yet their generalization capabilities remain fundamentally limited. They3 lack the robustness required to handle perturbations, frequently failing when con-4 fronted with lighting changes, altered camera viewpoints, or small initial-state5 variations. We propose PROBEACT, a training-free runtime intervention frame-6 work that detects and recovers from grasping and placement failures in pre-7 trained VLA policies without modifying their weights or requiring additional8 demonstrations. PROBEACT combines three components: (i) a lightweight multi-9 target hidden-state probe that predicts the 3D positions of task-relevant objects10 from intermediate VLA features, with Hungarian-matched identity tracking for11 multi-object scenes; (ii) an object-agnostic kinematic state machine that detects12 grasp, transport, and placement failures using only gripper-internal signals and13 end-effector kinematics; and (iii) a hierarchical Control Barrier Function (CBF)14 filter that encodes repeated-failure locations as soft safe-set constraints, mini-15 mally correcting VLA actions while preserving baseline behavior. As a plug-and-16 play, training-free intervention loop, PROBEACT is orthogonal to existing train-17 ing pipelines. Evaluated on the LIBERO-plus benchmark, our framework acts as18 a universal safety net, improving the success rate of the OpenVLA-OFT model19 from 69.6% to 74.1%, while demonstrating broad applicability to both base and20 fine-tuned VLA policies.

</details>


### [913] [Your Model Already Knows: Attention-Guided Safety Filter for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09749)
*Seongbin Park,Fan Zhang,Baharan Mirzasoleiman,Shahriar Talebi,Nader Sehatbakhsh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文发现VLA模型中的少量注意力头能够可靠地定位策略意图接近的目标物体，利用这些注意力头构建了一个无需训练的安全框架，结合控制障碍函数过滤器和轻量级实时目标跟踪器，实现了对动态障碍物的碰撞规避。在SafeLIBERO动态基准测试中，该方法比依赖初始时刻VLM识别的oracle方法平均提升43%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型缺乏对任务无关物体的碰撞避免保证；现有的基于VLM的安全过滤器速度太慢，无法在控制循环中运行，只能在回合初始化时调用一次，因此无法跟踪移动障碍物。

Method: 发现VLA模型中少量注意力头能可靠定位策略意图接近的目标；利用这些注意力头构建无训练安全框架，每步获取活动目标并将场景其余部分视为障碍物；将信息输入控制障碍函数(CBF)过滤器；结合轻量级实时目标跟踪器处理非静态障碍物。

Result: 在原始静态SafeLIBERO基准测试中，该方法与使用特权模拟器状态识别目标的oracle方法性能相当；在动态变体中，该方法平均超越oracle方法43%。

Conclusion: VLA策略内部已经包含实时安全过滤所需的感知信号，无需额外训练或繁重的辅助模型即可利用这些信号实现安全控制。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated impressive end-to-end performance across a variety of robotic manipulation tasks. However, these policies offer no guarantees against collisions with task-irrelevant objects in the scene. Existing safety filters sidestep this problem by querying a vision-language model (VLM) to identify obstacles and their locations. This, however, is too slow to run in the control loop and can only be invoked at episode initialization, leaving the filter unable to track moving obstacles. We discover that a small number of attention heads within a VLA model reliably localize the object the policy intends to approach. These heads can be exploited within a training-free safety framework that obtains the active target from the attention heads at every step, treats the remainder of the scene as obstacles, and feeds these into a Control Barrier Function (CBF) filter. Together with a lightweight real-time object tracker, this allows for collision avoidance for non-static obstacles. We evaluate our framework on SafeLIBERO, which we extend with moving obstacles. On the original static benchmark, our method performs comparably to an oracle that uses privileged simulator state to identify the target, emulating a VLM-based identification step run once at episode initialization. On the dynamic variant, where the oracle's init-time target assignment becomes stale, our method substantially outperforms it by 43%, on average. Our findings suggest that the perceptual signals needed for real-time safety filtering are already present within VLA policies and can be exploited without additional training or heavy auxiliary models.

</details>


### [914] [Difference-Aware Retrieval Policies for Imitation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09758)
*Quinn Pfeifer,Ethan Pronovost,Paarth Shah,Khimya Khetarpal,Siddhartha Srinivasa,Abhishek Gupta*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DARP是一种半参数检索式模仿学习方法，通过在推理时重用训练数据，基于k近邻结构重新参数化模仿学习问题，在连续控制和机器人操作等任务中相比标准行为克隆提升15-46%的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准行为克隆（Behavior Cloning）在部署时会因复合误差导致对分布外状态泛化能力差，这是因为学习的是全局的从状态到动作的直接映射，无法有效应对训练数据分布之外的场景。

Method: 提出DARP方法，将模仿学习问题重新参数化为局部邻域结构的形式：不学习全局策略，而是训练模型基于专家演示中的k近邻样本、对应动作以及邻域状态与查询状态之间的相对距离向量来预测动作。这是一种半参数检索式方法，推理时复用训练数据。

Result: 在连续控制和机器人操作等多个领域，以及包括高维视觉特征在内的不同表示上，DARP相比标准行为克隆实现了15-46%的一致性能提升。该方法不需要额外数据收集、在线专家反馈或任务特定知识。

Conclusion: DARP通过半参数检索式方法有效缓解了行为克隆的分布外泛化问题，且无需额外假设或数据，是一种简洁而有效的改进方案。

Abstract: Parametric imitation learning via behavior cloning can suffer from poor generalization to out-of-distribution states due to compounding errors during deployment. We show that reusing the training data during inference via a semi-parametric retrieval-based imitation learning approach can alleviate this challenge. We present Difference-Aware Retrieval Policies for Imitation Learning (DARP), a semi-parametric retrieval-based imitation learning approach that addresses this limitation by reparameterizing the imitation learning problem in terms of local neighborhood structure rather than direct state-to-action mappings. Instead of learning a global policy, DARP trains a model to predict actions based on $k$-nearest neighbors from expert demonstrations, their corresponding actions, and the relative distance vectors between neighbor states and query states. DARP requires no additional assumptions beyond those made for standard behavior cloning -- it does not require additional data collection, online expert feedback, or task-specific knowledge. We demonstrate consistent performance improvements of 15-46% over standard behavior cloning across diverse domains, including continuous control and robotic manipulation, and across different representations, including high-dimensional visual features. Code and demos are available at https://weirdlabuw.github.io/darp-site/.

</details>


### [915] [AetheRock: An Arm-Worn Robot Teaching System for Force-Guided Vision-Tactile Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09777)
*Hong Li,Yue Xu,Yihan Tang,Yankang Dong,Chenyuan Liu,Chenyang Yu,Xuyang Li,Siyuan Huang,Yujun Shen,Nan Xue,Yong-Lu Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出AetheRock可穿戴设备与ForceVT表征学习框架，解决力-视觉-触觉协同学习中的传感器不兼容问题，通过指尖触觉传感器、压力传感器及力引导的触觉学习，提升数据效率并克服制造不一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 力觉和触觉传感在接触丰富的操作中不可或缺，但现有手持或可穿戴设备中力与触觉传感器的不兼容装配严重制约了力感知机器人学习的发展。

Method: 设计AetheRock臂戴设备，集成模块化触觉传感器GelSlim-MiniFab、电阻式压力传感器、定制PCB模块及可穿戴套件；提出ForceVT表征学习框架，利用力与视觉引导与保真度无关的触觉学习。

Result: AetheRock实现了合格的数据效率；ForceVT有效缓解了视触觉传感器在制造和使用不一致时的效率低下问题。

Conclusion: 通过创新的硬件设计与算法，缓解了夹爪力-视觉-触觉机器人学习中的局限性。

Abstract: Force and tactile sensing are indispensable in contact-rich manipulation. However, force-aware robot learning faces critical challenges due to the incompatible assembly of tactile and force sensors in handheld or wearable devices. To address these limitations, we first introduce AetheRock for gripper-force, vision, and tactile data collection, which is an arm-worn device featuring a modular and easily manufactured visuo-tactile sensor, GelSlim-MiniFab, at the fingertip, a resistive pressure sensor at the human finger contact region, a customized PCB module, and a wearable kit for comfortable and robust collection. Building on this, we propose ForceVT, a representation learning framework that uses force and vision to guide fidelity-agnostic tactile learning, enabling robust inference in any tactile situation. Real-world experiments show that AetheRock achieves qualified data efficiency and that ForceVT effectively alleviates inefficiencies when visuo-tactile sensors exhibit manufacturing and utilization inconsistencies. Overall, our work mitigates the limitations of gripper-force vision-tactile robot learning through innovative hardware design and algorithms.

</details>


### [916] [SynManDex: Synthesizing Human-like Dexterous Grasps from Synthetic Human Pre-Grasps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09798)
*Yanming Shao,Zanxin Chen,Wenwei Lin,Mingjie Zhou,Tianxing Chen,Xiaokang Yang,Yichen Chi,Yao Mu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SynManDex是一个合成管线，通过生成人类预抓取作为感知意图的提议，再通过机器人原生优化解决最终接触，将人类手-物交互的功能意图转移到灵巧机器人手上，实现了高抓取质量和类人自然度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类手-物交互蕴含功能意图，但直接迁移到机器人手常因形态、接触和可达性约束而失败。现有方法缺乏有效的途径将人类交互的语义信息与机器人物理约束相结合。

Method: SynManDex首先采样基于物体的数字化人类预抓取，将其重定向到灵巧机器人手部姿态，然后在目标实体上优化力闭合接触，最后输出通过各步骤检查的轨迹关键帧。生成的关键帧支持多种操作任务，如抓取提起、倒茶、拍照和吹笛子，这些任务通过VLM智能体设计。

Result: 抓取稳定性86.4%，类人自然度评分4.67/5（93.4%）；仿真成功率80.7%；在36自由度双臂灵巧机器人平台上的真实机器人成功率为25/30（83.3%）。

Conclusion: SynManDex有效结合了人类功能意图与机器人物理约束，在抓取质量、类人自然度和实际部署成功率上均表现出色，验证了从人类预抓取到机器人原生优化的合成管线在灵巧操作任务中的有效性。

Abstract: Human hand-object interactions encode functional intent, but direct transfer to robotic hands often fails under morphology, contact, and reachability constraints. We present SynManDex, a synthetic pipeline that uses generated human pre-grasps as affordance-aware proposals and resolves the final contacts with robot-native optimization. SynManDex samples object-conditioned digital human pre-grasps, retargets them to dexterous robotic hand poses, optimizes force-closure contacts on the target embodiment, and admits trajectories that pass checks from each step. The resulting keyframes support both grasp-and-lift demonstrations and various prehensile manipulation tasks such as tea pouring, photo taking, and flute playing, designed via VLM agents. As a result, SynManDex combines high grasp quality (86.4\% grasp stability) with 4.67/5 human-likeness (93.4\%). It achieves 80.7\% successes in simulation and 25/30 (83.3\%) real-robot successes when applied to a 36-DOF bimanual dexterous robotic platform.

</details>


### [917] [AHA-WAM:Asynchronous Horizon-Adaptive World-Action Modeling with Observation-Guided Context Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09811)
*Jisong Cai,Long Ling,Shiwei Chu,Zhongshan Liu,Jiayue Kang,Zhixuan Liang,Wenjie Xu,Yinan Mao,Weinan Zhang,Xiaokang Yang,Ru Ying,Ran Zheng,Yao Mu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出AHA-WAM，一种异步自适应时域世界-动作模型，通过解耦视频DiT（低频世界规划器）和动作DiT（高频执行器）的时序分辨率，利用滚动KV记忆和层间联合注意力实现高效机器人操控，在RoboTwin和真实任务中达到SOTA性能（92.80%和78.3%成功率），速度提升4.59倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界-动作模型将世界预测和动作执行绑定在相同时间分辨率下，导致世界分支被迫建模冗余且信息量低的近端帧变化，未能充分发挥视频分支在具身控制中的潜力。

Method: 提出AHA-WAM，基于双DiT架构：1) 低频视频DiT作为世界规划器，维护滚动的KV记忆以编码长时程场景演化；2) 高频动作DiT通过层间联合注意力查询上下文，闭环执行短动作片段；3) 引入自适应时域偏移训练和观测引导视频上下文路由(OVCR)，无需重新运行视频DiT即可实现异步执行。

Result: 在RoboTwin上达到92.80%平均成功率，4个真实世界任务上达到78.3%成功率，实现24.17Hz闭环控制，速度是Fast-WAM的4.59倍，且无需机器人数据预训练。

Conclusion: 通过解耦世界预测和动作执行的时序分辨率，AHA-WAM有效提升了世界-动作模型的效率与性能，证明异步时序设计是具身控制中利用长程视频上下文的关键。

Abstract: World-action models have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot manipulation, jointly modeling visual scene dynamics and actions to inject physical priors into policy learning. However, existing world-action models couple world prediction and action execution at the same temporal resolution, forcing the world branch to model near-term frame variations that are redundant and weakly informative. We posit that strictly binding world prediction and action execution to the same temporal rhythm may underutilize the potential of the video branch for embodied control. Therefore, we propose AHA-WAM, an Asynchronous Horizon-Adaptive World-Action Model built on a dual Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture that reorganizes world-action modeling around this temporal asymmetry. AHA-WAM instantiates the video DiT as a low-frequency world planner that maintains rolling key-value memory over past observations and exposes reusable layerwise latent context encoding long-horizon scene evolution, while a high-frequency action DiT executes short action chunks in closed loop by querying this context through layerwise joint attention. To support asynchronous execution, we introduce horizon-adaptive offset training and Observation-Guided Video-Context Routing (OVCR), which together let the action expert exploit long-horizon world context while remaining responsive to real-time execution state without rerunning the video DiT. Experiments on RoboTwin and real-world manipulation tasks show that AHA-WAM achieves state-of-the-art performance without any robot-data pretraining, attaining 92.80% average success on RoboTwin and 78.3% success across 4 real-world tasks, while reaching 24.17 Hz closed-loop control with a 4.59x speedup over Fast-WAM.

</details>


### [918] [iMaC: Translating Actions into Motion and Contact Images for Embodied World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09813)
*Zhenyu Wu,Xiuwei Xu,Yukun Zhou,Yifan Li,Qiuping Deng,Xiaofeng Wang,Zheng Zhu,Bingyao Yu,Ziwei Wang,Jiwen Lu,Haibin Yan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出iMac（Image as Action Control）范式，将原始视觉图像作为具身世界模型的原生动作表示，通过双分支架构（图像-动作编码器+动态世界预测器）实现高保真未来状态预测和闭环控制，在公共基准和真实机器人场景中超越传统基于向量的动作控制方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统具身框架依赖低维结构化动作向量（如关节角度、末端执行器位姿），存在表达能力有限、跨本体泛化差、复杂物理交互动态建模不自然等问题，亟需一种更具表现力且通用的动作表示范式。

Method: 提出iMac范式：1）将连续视觉操控表示为基于图像的动作token，隐式编码空间运动意图、交互几何约束和物理动态；2）构建双分支架构——图像-动作编码器将目标驱动视觉图像压缩为紧凑动作嵌入，动态世界预测器以图像动作为条件学习环境转移规则，实现闭环控制。

Result: 在公开具身操控基准和真实机器人场景中，iMac在预测精度、任务成功率及跨场景泛化能力上均优于基于向量的动作控制基线，并消除了对人工定义动作空间的依赖。

Conclusion: 本文提供了一种创新的视觉-动作视角，为具身世界模型提供了简单有效的可扩展范式，实现了异构具身智能体的灵活通用控制。

Abstract: Embodied world models have emerged as a pivotal paradigm for visual robotic decision-making and interactive environment simulation. However, conventional embodied frameworks rely on low-dimensional structured action vectors (e.g., joint angles and end-effector poses), which suffer from limited expressive capacity, poor generalization across diverse embodiments, and unnatural dynamic modeling for complex physical interactions. To address these limitations, this paper proposesiMac (Image as Action Control), a novel unified control paradigm that treats raw visual images as native action representations for embodied world models. Departing from traditional explicit kinematic action encoding, iMac formulates continuous visual manipulation as image-based action tokens, which inherently encapsulate spatial motion intentions, interactive geometric constraints and subtle physical dynamics. We construct a dual-branch embodied architecture consisting of an image-action encoder and a dynamic world predictor: the encoder compresses target-driven visual images into compact action embeddings, while the predictor learns environment transition rules conditioned on image actions to achieve high-fidelity future state prediction and closed-loop embodied control. Extensive experiments are conducted on public embodied manipulation benchmarks and real-world robotic scenarios. The results demonstrate that iMac outperforms vector-based action control baselines in prediction accuracy, task success rate and cross-scene generalization ability. Moreover, our image-action design eliminates the reliance on manually defined action spaces, realizing flexible and universal control for heterogeneous embodied agents. This work provides an innovative visual-action perspective for embodied world models, offering a simple yet effective paradigm for scalable robotic perception and manipulation.

</details>


### [919] [MemoryVLA++: Temporal Modeling via Memory and Imagination in Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09827)
*Hao Shi,Weiye Li,Bin Xie,Yulin Wang,Renping Zhou,Tiancai Wang,Xiangyu Zhang,Ping Luo,Gao Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出MemoryVLA++，一种受认知科学启发的完整时间建模框架，通过工作记忆、感知-认知记忆库和世界模型，为VLA模型赋予记忆与想象能力，在多项仿真和真实机器人任务上取得显著性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型主要依赖当前观测，在长时序、时间依赖任务中表现不佳。受认知科学中工作记忆、海马体系统（情景记忆）和内部模型（未来状态想象）的启发，作者旨在为VLA模型构建完整的记忆与想象时间建模框架。

Method: 1) 预训练VLM编码当前观测为感知和认知Token，形成工作记忆；2) 这些Token查询感知-认知记忆库以检索相关历史上下文，该记忆库存储低层细节和高层语义，并通过冗余感知合并更新；3) 世界模型在去噪潜空间中想象未来状态，并在记忆引导下整合为完整的时序感知Token；4) 最终Token条件化扩散动作专家，预测时序一致的动作序列。

Result: 在5个仿真基准（Libero, SimplerEnv, Mikasa-Robo, Calvin, Libero-Plus）和3类真实机器人任务（涵盖3种机器人）上取得强性能。真实机器人实验中，在通用任务、记忆依赖任务和想象依赖任务上分别获得+9%、+26%、+28%的提升。

Conclusion: 完整的记忆与想象时间建模能显著提升VLA模型在机器人操作任务上的表现，尤其是在长时序、强时间依赖的场景中效果更为突出。

Abstract: Temporal modeling is essential for robotic manipulation, as effective control requires both memory of past interactions and imagination of future states. However, most VLA models rely primarily on the current observation and therefore struggle with long-horizon, temporally dependent tasks. Cognitive science suggests that humans rely on working memory to buffer short-lived context, the hippocampal system to preserve episodic memory of past experience, and internal models to imagine possible future state evolution. Inspired by these mechanisms, we propose MemoryVLA++, a full temporal modeling framework that equips VLA models with memory and imagination for robotic manipulation. A pretrained VLM encodes the current observation into perceptual and cognitive tokens, forming working memory. These tokens query a Perceptual-Cognitive Memory Bank to retrieve relevant historical context. This bank stores low-level details and high-level semantics from past interactions, and is updated through redundancy-aware consolidation. A world model imagines future states in a denoising latent space, and the imagined latents are integrated under memory guidance to form full temporal-aware tokens. The resulting tokens condition a diffusion action expert to predict temporally consistent action sequences. We conduct extensive experiments on 5 simulation benchmarks and 3 categories of real-robot tasks across 3 robots, covering general manipulation, long-horizon temporal tasks, robustness, and generalization. Our method achieves strong performance across Libero, SimplerEnv, Mikasa-Robo, Calvin, Libero-Plus, and diverse real-robot tasks, validating the effectiveness of full temporal modeling with memory and imagination. For example, on real robots, it achieves +9%, +26%, +28% gains on general, memory-dependent, and imagination-dependent tasks. Project Page: https://shihao1895.github.io/MemoryVLA-PP-Web

</details>


### [920] [An Interval Branch-and-Bound-Based Inverse Kinemetics Algorithm Towards Global Optimal Redundancy Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.12183)
*Yajue Yang,Zeqing Zhang,Yuanqing Wu,Jia Pan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于区间分支定界法、并结合快速数值逆运动学求解器搜索启发式的通用逆运动学求解方法，能够生成连续解片（而非孤立采样点），揭示自运动流形的内在几何结构，支持任意时间模式和次优分辨率求解，并在冗余与非冗余机械臂上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机械臂的通用逆运动学问题（获取所有可行关节角的自运动流形）对机器人建模、规划与控制至关重要，现有采样法只能生成独立解，缺乏对解空间几何结构的连续描述。

Method: 采用区间分支定界法作为主框架，并融入快速数值逆运动学求解器启发的搜索启发式策略，以高效生成相邻解的解片（patches），而非孤立采样点。

Result: 在非冗余和冗余机械臂上的数值实验验证了该方法相比采样法的优越性，能够提供更丰富的自运动流形几何信息，并支持任意时间模式下的次优分辨率求解。

Conclusion: 该方法为通用逆运动学求解提供了一种新的连续解片生成范式，可服务于最优规划等应用，且具备灵活的计算时间适应性。

Abstract: The general inverse kinematics (IK) problem of a manipulator, namely that of acquiring the self-motion manifold (SMM) of all admissible joint angles for a desired end-effector pose, plays a vital role in robotics modeling, planning and control. To efficiently solve the generalized IK, this paper proposes an interval branch-and-bound-based approach, which is augmented with a fast numerical IK-solver-enabled search heuristics. In comparison to independent solutions generated by sampling based methods, our approach generates patches of neighboring solutions to provide richer information of the inherent geometry of the SMM for optimal planning and other applications. It can also be utilized in an anytime fashion to obtain solutions with sub-optimal resolution for applications within a limited period. The performance of our approach is verified by numerical experiments on both non-redundant and redundant manipulators.

</details>


### [921] [Integrated Hierarchical Decision-Making in Inverse Kinematic Planning and Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.01324)
*Kai Pfeiffer,Quan Zhang,Yuqing Chen,Gordon Boateng,Yuquan Wang,Vincent Bonnet,Aberrahmane Kheddar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种高效的非线性规划框架，将分层决策与全身逆运动学规划和控制紧密结合，利用ℓ0范数和稀疏分层结构，解决了机器人领域中复杂的非线性分层决策问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法要么依赖计算繁重的混合整数非线性规划，要么将决策与逆运动学分离（常用可达性方法近似），或者使用高效但通用性较差的ℓ1范数线性稀疏规划，无法解决底层非线性问题。亟需一种高效、通用且精确的非线性分层决策求解方法。

Method: 提出稀疏分层非线性规划求解器，通过利用稀疏分层结构并引入机器人领域极少使用的ℓ0范数，将分层决策与全身逆运动学规划和控制紧密集成，而非分离处理。

Result: 该求解器高效解决了此前文献中未涉及的复杂非线性分层决策问题，包括：从大量候选点中同时进行优先级排序的末端执行器位置选择的逆运动学规划，以及在随机旋转的盒子上同时选择双臂抓取位置的逆运动学控制。

Conclusion: 所提出的稀疏分层非线性规划框架兼具高效性、通用性和精确性，能够处理传统方法难以应对的复杂非线性分层决策问题，为机器人逆运动学规划与控制提供了新的有效途径。

Abstract: This work presents a novel and efficient nonlinear programming framework that tightly integrates hierarchical decision-making with whole-body inverse kinematic planning and control. Decision-making plays a central role in many aspects of robotics, from sparse inverse kinematic control with a minimal number of joints, to inverse kinematic planning while simultaneously selecting a discrete end-effector location from multiple candidates. Current approaches often rely on heavy computations using mixed-integer nonlinear programming, separate decision-making from inverse kinematics (some times approximated by reachability methods), or employ efficient but less versatile $\ell_1$-norm formulations of linear sparse programming, without addressing the underlying nonlinear problem formulations. In contrast, the proposed sparse hierarchical nonlinear programming solver is efficient, versatile, and accurate by exploiting sparse hierarchical structure and leveraging the $\ell_0$-norm which is rarely used in robotics. The solver efficiently tackles complex nonlinear hierarchical decision-making problems previously unaddressed in the literature, such as inverse kinematic planning with simultaneous prioritized selection of end-effector locations from a large set of candidates, or inverse kinematic control with simultaneous selection of bi-manual grasp locations on a randomly rotated box.

</details>


### [922] [TACO: General Acrobatic Flight Control via Target-and-Command-Oriented Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.01125)
*Zikang Yin,Canlun Zheng,Shiliang Guo,Zhikun Wang,Shiyu Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种面向目标和指令的强化学习框架(TACO)，通过谱归一化和输入输出重缩放方法，能够统一处理多种特技飞行任务并允许在线参数调整，在高速圆周飞行和连续多翻转等任务中验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有特技飞行控制方法通常局限于特定的机动任务，无法在线更改飞行模式参数，缺乏统一处理多种机动任务的通用框架。

Method: 提出TACO框架（面向目标和指令的强化学习），统一处理不同机动任务并支持在线参数变化；提出带输入输出重缩放的谱归一化方法，增强策略的时空平滑性、独立性和对称性，克服仿真到现实的差距。

Result: 通过大量仿真和真实世界实验验证，实现了高速圆周飞行和连续多翻转等特技动作。

Conclusion: TACO框架能够统一处理多种特技飞行任务，支持在线参数调整，并通过谱归一化方法有效克服sim-to-real差距。

Abstract: Although acrobatic flight control has been studied extensively, one key limitation of the existing methods is that they are usually restricted to specific maneuver tasks and cannot change flight pattern parameters online. In this work, we propose a target-and-command-oriented reinforcement learning (TACO) framework, which can handle different maneuver tasks in a unified way and allows online parameter changes. Additionally, we propose a spectral normalization method with input-output rescaling to enhance the policy's temporal and spatial smoothness, independence, and symmetry, thereby overcoming the sim-to-real gap. We validate the TACO approach through extensive simulation and real-world experiments, demonstrating its capability to achieve high-speed circular flights and continuous multi-flips.

</details>


### [923] [Follow Everything: A Leader-Following and Obstacle Avoidance Framework with Goal-Aware Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.19399)
*Qianyi Zhang,Shijian Ma,Boyi Liu,Jianhao Jiao,Dimitrios Kanoulas*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一个统一框架，用分割模型替代检测模型以支持任意形态领航者，结合距离帧缓冲器增强识别鲁棒性，并设计目标感知适应机制与基于图的规划器，实现机器人在领航者短暂离开视野时的稳健跟随。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有领导者跟随方法难以泛化到任意形态的领航者，且当领航者暂时离开机器人视野时容易失败，需要一种统一的解决方案。

Method: 1) 用分割模型替代传统检测模型，使领航者可以是任意物体；2) 距离帧缓冲器存储多距离下的领航者嵌入以增强鲁棒性；3) 目标感知适应机制根据领航者可视性与运动状态控制机器人规划状态；4) 基于图的规划器为每种状态生成候选轨迹，实现高效跟随与避障。

Result: 仿真和真实实验（以腿式机器人为跟随者，领航者包括人类、地面机器人、无人机、腿式机器人、停车标志）显示在室内外环境下，跟随成功率提升，视觉丢失时长减少，碰撞率降低，领航者-跟随者距离减小。

Conclusion: 提出的统一框架能够有效处理任意形态领航者的跟随任务，并在领航者短暂离视野时仍保持鲁棒性，性能优于现有方法。

Abstract: Robust and flexible leader-following is a critical capability for robots to integrate into human society. While existing methods struggle to generalize to leaders of arbitrary form and often fail when the leader temporarily leaves the robot's field of view, this work introduces a unified framework addressing both challenges. First, traditional detection models are replaced with a segmentation model, allowing the leader to be anything. To enhance recognition robustness, a distance frame buffer is implemented that stores leader embeddings at multiple distances, accounting for the unique characteristics of leader-following tasks. Second, a goal-aware adaptation mechanism is designed to govern robot planning states based on the leader's visibility and motion, complemented by a graph-based planner that generates candidate trajectories for each state, ensuring efficient following with obstacle avoidance. Simulations and real-world experiments with a legged robot follower and various leaders (human, ground robot, UAV, legged robot, stop sign) in both indoor and outdoor environments show competitive improvements in follow success rate, reduced visual loss duration, lower collision rate, and decreased leader-follower distance.

</details>


### [924] [A Survey on Deep Multi-Task Learning in Connected Autonomous Vehicles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.00917)
*Jiayuan Wang,Farhad Pourpanah,Q. M. Jonathan Wu,Ning Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文首次全面综述了深度多任务学习（MTL）在网联自动驾驶汽车（CAVs）中的应用，涵盖感知、预测、规划、控制以及V2X通信与无线资源管理（RRM）等关键功能域，并按单车/多车协作范式进行分类讨论，最后指出了现有方法的优势与局限及未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统上CAV的多个任务（感知、预测、规划、控制）由独立模型分别处理，导致部署成本高、计算开销大、实时性差；同时V2X通信带来严格的时延、可靠性和带宽约束。MTL通过统一模型联合学习多个任务，有望提升效率和资源利用率，但目前缺乏对该领域的系统性综述。

Method: 本文采用系统性综述方法，首先概述CAV和MTL基础知识，然后按感知、预测、规划、控制及V2X通信与RRM五大功能域对现有深度MTL工作进行分类梳理，每个域内进一步区分为单车（仅车载）和V2X增强协作（多智能体）两种范式。

Result: 发现深度MTL在CAV各功能域中均有应用尝试，但多数工作集中在感知和预测任务，规划和控制的MTL研究相对较少；V2X场景下的多智能体协作MTL尚处于早期阶段，现有方法在任务间负迁移、动态任务权重分配、通信与计算联合优化等方面仍存在显著不足。

Conclusion: 深度MTL为CAV系统提供了提升计算效率和资源利用率的有前景路径，但当前研究在任务相关性建模、多智能体协作机制、通信-计算联合优化以及实际部署验证等方面仍存在关键空白，需要进一步探索。

Abstract: Connected autonomous vehicles (CAVs) must simultaneously perform multiple tasks, such as perception, prediction, planning, and control, to ensure safe and reliable navigation in complex environments. Moreover, through vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication, cooperative perception and driving among CAVs can be enabled, thereby mitigating the limitations of individual vehicles, while it also introduces stringent latency, reliability, and bandwidth constraints. Traditionally, tasks are addressed using separate models, which leads to high deployment costs, increased computational overhead, and challenges in achieving real-time performance. Multi-task learning (MTL) has recently emerged as a promising solution that enables the joint learning of multiple tasks within a unified model. This offers improved efficiency and resource utilization. To the best of our knowledge, this survey is the first comprehensive review focusing on deep MTL in CAVs. We begin with an overview of CAVs and MTL to provide foundational background. Then, we review MTL approaches across key functional domains in CAVs, including perception, prediction, planning, control, as well as V2X communications and radio resource management (RRM). For the first four domains, we categorize existing works under ego vehicle-only (onboard-only) and V2X-enhanced cooperative (multi-agent) paradigms. We further discuss V2X communications and RRM as communication-centric MTL problems. Finally, we discuss the strengths and limitations of existing methods, identify key research gaps, and provide future research directions aimed at advancing MTL methodologies for CAV systems.

</details>


### [925] [Reward Evolution with Graph-of-Thoughts: A Bi-Level Language Model Framework for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.16136)
*Changwei Yao,Xinzi Liu,Chen Li,Marios Savvides*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出RE-GoT框架，通过图结构推理结合LLM和VLM，实现无需人工干预的强化学习奖励函数自动设计与演化，在RoboGen和ManiSkill2任务上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习中奖励函数设计依赖大量人工经验和迭代调试，现有LLM自动奖励设计方法存在幻觉、依赖人类反馈、难以处理复杂多步任务等问题，亟需可扩展且无需人工干预的自动化奖励设计方法。

Method: 提出RE-GoT双层框架：1）上层将任务分解为文本属性图（Graph-of-Thoughts），利用图结构推理进行综合分析并生成奖励函数；2）下层通过视觉语言模型（VLM）自动评估 rollout 结果，迭代优化奖励函数，全程无需人类干预。

Result: 在10个RoboGen任务上平均成功率提升32.25%，复杂多步任务提升显著；在4个ManiSkill2任务上平均成功率达93.73%，超越现有LLM方法甚至专家设计的奖励函数。

Conclusion: 将LLM和VLM与图结构推理相结合，为强化学习中奖励函数的自主演化提供了可扩展且有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Designing effective reward functions remains a major challenge in reinforcement learning (RL), often requiring considerable human expertise and iterative refinement. Recent advances leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) for automated reward design, but these approaches are limited by hallucinations, reliance on human feedback, and challenges with handling complex, multi-step tasks. In this work, we introduce Reward Evolution with Graph-of-Thoughts (RE-GoT), a novel bi-level framework that enhances LLMs with structured graph-based reasoning and integrates Visual Language Models (VLMs) for automated rollout evaluation. RE-GoT first decomposes tasks into text-attributed graphs, enabling comprehensive analysis and reward function generation, and then iteratively refines rewards using visual feedback from VLMs without human intervention. Extensive experiments on 10 RoboGen and 4 ManiSkill2 tasks demonstrate that RE-GoT consistently outperforms existing LLM-based baselines. On RoboGen, our method improves average task success rates by 32.25%, with notable gains on complex multi-step tasks. On ManiSkill2, RE-GoT achieves an average success rate of 93.73% across four diverse manipulation tasks, significantly surpassing prior LLM-based approaches and even exceeding expert-designed rewards. Our results indicate that combining LLMs and VLMs with graph-of-thoughts reasoning provides a scalable and effective solution for autonomous reward evolution in RL.

</details>


### [926] [Symskill: Symbol and Skill Co-Invention for Data-Efficient and Reactive Long-Horizon Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.01661)
*Yifei Simon Shao,Yuchen Zheng,Sunan Sun,Pratik Chaudhari,Vijay Kumar,Nadia Figueroa*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SymSkill是一个统一框架，能够从未标记、未分割的演示中联合学习谓词、操作符和技能，结合了组合泛化与实时故障恢复，在动态环境下实现多步操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法中，模仿学习（IL）虽具反应性但缺乏组合泛化能力，无法在场景变化时决定复用哪些技能；而经典任务与运动规划（TAMP）虽具组合性，但规划延迟高，无法实现实时故障恢复。因此需要一种兼具两者优势的统一框架。

Method: 离线阶段，SymSkill从演示中学习符号抽象和目标导向技能；在线阶段，利用学习到的谓词合取，通过符号规划器组合和重排技能以实现符号目标，并在运动层和符号层进行实时故障恢复，配合柔顺控制器支持安全执行。

Result: 在RoboCasa仿真中，SymSkill执行12个单步任务成功率达85%，并能将这些任务组合成多步计划而无需额外数据。在真实Franka机器人上，仅需5分钟游戏数据即可学习并执行12步任务。

Conclusion: SymSkill成功结合了组合泛化与实时恢复能力，在仿真和真实机器人上都展示了高效的多步操作性能，代码和更多分析已开源。

Abstract: Multi-step manipulation in dynamic environments remains challenging. Imitation learning (IL) is reactive but lacks compositional generalization, since monolithic policies do not decide which skill to reuse when scenes change. Classical task-and-motion planning (TAMP) offers compositionality, but its high planning latency prevents real-time failure recovery. We introduce SymSkill, a unified framework that jointly learns predicates, operators, and skills from unlabeled, unsegmented demonstrations, combining compositional generalization with real-time recovery. Offline, SymSkill learns symbolic abstractions and goal-oriented skills directly from demonstrations. Online, given a conjunction of learned predicates, it uses a symbolic planner to compose and reorder skills to achieve symbolic goals while recovering from failures at both the motion and symbolic levels in real time. Coupled with a compliant controller, SymSkill supports safe execution under human and environmental disturbances. In RoboCasa simulation, SymSkill executes 12 single-step tasks with 85% success and composes them into multi-step plans without additional data. On a real Franka robot, it learns from 5 minutes of play data and performs 12-step tasks from goal specifications. Code and additional analysis are available at https://symskill.github.io/ .

</details>


### [927] [How Well Do Latent World Models Understand Partially Observable Safety Constraints?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.06492)
*Matthew Kim,Kensuke Nakamura,Andrea Bajcsy*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究了在部分可观测条件下，潜空间世界模型的安全控制问题，识别了两种失败模式（估计缺口和预测缺口），提出了相应的诊断指标和缓解策略，并通过机器人烹饪任务验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜世界模型虽能从高维观测中学习状态表示和动力学，但在部分可观测环境下，若潜状态未能编码安全相关信息，会导致控制失败。现有工作缺乏对这类安全失败模式的系统分析和诊断。

Method: 1) 识别两种失败模式：估计缺口（当前观测无法揭示安全关键量）和预测缺口（失败可观测但无法可靠预测）；2) 提出两种诊断指标：基于互信息的安全可观测性度量和基于滚动的未来安全可预测性度量；3) 提出缓解策略：针对估计缺口使用特权多模态监督，针对预测缺口使用共形风险校准。

Result: 在Franka Research 3机械臂的烹饪任务上，分别使用单模态RGB和多模态（RGB+触觉、RGB+热感）世界模型进行验证，所提缓解策略在部分可观测条件下提高了安全性，但增加了保守性。

Conclusion: 潜世界模型的状态表示是否足以支持可靠的机器人控制是一个关键问题，本研究为安全关键场景下潜空间控制的可靠性提供了诊断工具和缓解方法。

Abstract: Latent world models are a promising approach for learning state representations and dynamics directly from high-dimensional observations, enabling robot control in hard-to-model settings. However, control performance ultimately depends on the latent representation encoding the required information for the task. In this work, we study latent-space safe control problems and show how partial observability can induce control failures when safety-relevant information is not preserved in the latent state. Specifically, we identify two world model failure modes: estimation gaps, where current observations do not reveal safety-critical quantities (e.g., temperature in a cooking task), and prediction gaps, where failures are observable once they occur but cannot be reliably anticipated from available observations. We introduce two diagnostics for these gaps: a mutual-information-based measure of safety observability and a rollout-based measure of future safety predictability. Finally, we present mitigation strategies for each failure mode: privileged multimodal supervision for estimation gaps and conformal risk calibration for prediction gaps. Across two hardware case studies -- using unimodal RGB world models and multimodal RGB+Tactile and RGB+Thermal variants -- we show that these mitigation strategies improve the safety of a Franka Research 3 manipulator on challenging cooking tasks under partial observability, albeit with increased conservativeness. More broadly, our work raises the question of when world model state representations are sufficient for reliable robot control

</details>


### [928] [DIJIT: A Robotic Head for an Active Observer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.07998)
*Mostafa Kamali Tabrizi,Mingshi Chi,Bir Bikram Dey,Kelly Yuan,Markus D. Solbach,Yiqian Liu,Michael Jenkin,John K. Tsotsos*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一款名为DIJIT的双目机器人头，专为移动主动观察者设计，具有9个机械自由度和4个光学自由度，性能接近人类，如达到人类峰值扫视速度的85%，并提出了一种基于相机方向与电机值直接关系的扫视运动方法，左右相机平均误差分别为1.17°和1.14°。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了在移动机器人平台上实现主动视觉研究，探索类人眼-头颈运动及其相互关系，并比较人类视觉中眼/头运动与当前计算机视觉方法的差异。

Method: 设计了具有9个机械自由度和4个光学自由度的双目机器人头DIJIT，涵盖会聚、版本和扭转运动范围；提出了一种利用相机方向与电机值直接关系的扫视运动控制方法。

Result: DIJIT达到人类峰值扫视速度的85%；提出的扫视方法左右相机平均误差分别为1.17°和1.14°，精度接近人类水平。

Conclusion: DIJIT作为主动观察机器人平台，在运动范围和速度上接近人类性能，其扫视控制方法实现了高精度的类人运动，有助于推动主动视觉和人类视觉机制的研究。

Abstract: We present DIJIT, a novel binocular robotic head expressly designed for mobile agents that behave as active observers. DIJIT's unique breadth of functionality enables active vision research and the study of human-like eye and head-neck motions, their interrelationships, and how each contributes to visual ability. DIJIT is also being used to explore the differences between how human vision employs eye/head movements to solve visual tasks and current computer vision methods. DIJIT's design features nine mechanical degrees of freedom, while the cameras and lenses provide an additional four optical degrees of freedom. The ranges and speeds of the mechanical design are comparable to human performance. DIJIT attains 85\% of the peak human saccade speed. Our design includes the ranges of motion required for convergent stereo, namely, vergence, version, and cyclotorsion. Here, we present DIJIT and some aspects of its performance. We also present a novel method for saccadic camera movements, using a direct relationship between camera orientation and motor values. The resulting saccadic camera movements are close to human movements in terms of their accuracy, with 1.17$^\circ$ and 1.14$^\circ$ mean error for the left and right cameras, respectively.

</details>


### [929] [Programmable Deformation Design of Porous Soft Actuator through Volumetric-Pattern-Induced Anisotropy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.12320)
*Canqi Meng,Weibang Bai*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种通过在泡沫多孔材料中刻入特定图案来实现软体执行器可编程变形的新设计方法，通过横向（弯曲）、纵向（倾斜）和斜向（扭转）三种基本图案，结合有限元分析与实验验证，实现了最高80°弯曲、18°倾斜和115°扭转的可控变形，并展示了图案可迁移性、可扩展性和无模快速成型能力，最终通过仿人手折痕图案设计出具有自适应抓取能力的软体机械手。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于空心弹性腔的软体气动执行器存在结构支撑力小、多模态功能需昂贵几何重构设计等局限；虽然可通过在多孔腔体内填充泡沫等材料提供结构稳定性，但如何通过定制多孔体本身实现可编程变形的方法仍未被充分探索。

Method: 在多孔泡沫圆柱基底上刻入特定图案以引入局部结构各向异性，在全局真空输入下引导材料变形；设计了三种基本图案（横向→弯曲、纵向→倾斜、斜向→扭转）；采用有限元分析（FEA）建立计算模型研究刻痕图案机理；通过实验优化图案阵列数N。

Result: 通过优化图案阵列数N，实现了最大80°弯曲（N=2）、18°倾斜（N=1）和115°扭转（N=8）；验证了图案可迁移性、可扩展性和无模快速成型能力；基于人手折痕图设计的仿生软体手实现了类人自适应抓取。

Conclusion: 该工作为多功能软体多孔机器人的设计提供了一种高效、可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: Conventional soft pneumatic actuators, typically based on hollow elastomeric chambers, often suffer from small structural support and require costly geometry-specific redesigns for multimodal functionality. Porous materials such as foam, filled into chambers, can provide structural stability for the actuators. However, methods to achieve programmable deformation by tailoring the porous body itself remain underexplored. In this paper, a novel design method is presented to realize soft porous actuators with programmable deformation by incising specific patterns into the porous foam body. This approach introduces localized structural anisotropy of the foam guiding the material's deformation under a global vacuum input. Furthermore, three fundamental patterns on a cylindrical foam substrate are discussed: transverse for bending, longitudinal for tilting, and diagonal for twisting. A computational model is built with Finite Element Analysis (FEA), to investigate the mechanism of the incision-patterning method. Experiments demonstrate that with a potential optimal design of the pattern array number N, actuators can achieve bending up to $80^{\circ}$ (N=2), tilting of $18^{\circ}$ (N=1), and twisting of $115^{\circ}$ (N=8). The versatility of our approach is demonstrated via pattern transferability, scalability, and mold-less rapid prototyping of complex designs. As a comprehensive application, we translate the human hand crease map into a functional incision pattern, creating a bio-inspired soft robot hand capable of human-like adaptive grasping. Our work provides a new, efficient, and scalable paradigm for the design of multi-functional soft porous robots.

</details>


### [930] [LightTact: A Visual-Tactile Fingertip Sensor for Deformation-Independent Contact Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.20591)
*Changyi Lin,Boda Huo,Mingyang Yu,Emily Ruppel,Bingqing Chen,Jonathan Francis,Ding Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: LightTact是一种基于光学原理的视觉-触觉指尖传感器，通过环境光阻断设计实现仅传输接触点散射光，从而在不依赖宏观形变的情况下检测极轻接触，实现高对比度接触分割，并支持水扩散、面霜蘸取等新型机器人操作行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有触觉传感器大多依赖宏观表面形变来推断接触，但在与液体、半液体或超软材料交互时，形变极小甚至不发生，导致难以鲁棒地感知此类轻接触。

Method: 设计了一种环境光阻断光学结构，抑制外部光和内部照明在非接触区域的传播，仅传输真实接触点产生的散射光，从而在原始图像中实现非接触像素近黑（灰度均值<3）、接触像素保留表面自然外观的高对比度成像。

Result: 实现了对材料属性、接触力、表面外观和环境光照鲁棒的像素级接触分割；解锁了水扩散、面霜蘸取、软薄膜交互等新型轻接触机器人操作行为；其空间对齐的视觉-触觉图像可直接被视觉语言模型理解。

Conclusion: LightTact通过不依赖形变的直接光学接触感知原理，有效解决了轻接触难以检测的问题，并为机器人精细操作和视觉-触觉多模态感知开辟了新可能。

Abstract: Contact often occurs without macroscopic surface deformation, such as during interaction with liquids, semi-liquids, or ultra-soft materials. However, most existing tactile sensors rely on deformation to infer contact, making such light-contact interactions difficult to perceive robustly. To address this, we present LightTact, a visual-tactile fingertip sensor that makes contact directly visible via a deformation-independent principle. LightTact features an ambient-blocking optical configuration that suppresses both external light and internal illumination at non-contact regions, while transmitting only the scattered light generated at true contacts. As a result, LightTact produces high-contrast raw images in which non-contact pixels remain near-black (mean gray value < 3) and contact pixels preserve the natural appearance of the contacting surface. Built on this, LightTact achieves accurate pixel-level contact segmentation that is robust to material properties, contact force, surface appearance, and environmental lighting. We further demonstrate that LightTact unlocks new robotic manipulation behaviors that require detection of extremely light contact, including water spreading, facial-cream dipping, and soft thin-film interaction. In addition, we show that LightTact's spatially aligned visual-tactile images can be directly interpreted by vision-language models.

</details>


### [931] [Vision-Based Early Fault Diagnosis and Self-Recovery for Strawberry Harvesting Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.02085)
*Meili Sun,Chunjiang Zhao,Lichao Yang,Hao Liu,Shimin Hu,Ya Xiong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种针对草莓采摘机器人的视觉故障诊断与自恢复框架，通过SRR-Net实现统一感知与故障诊断，结合相对误差补偿、微型相机反馈抓取调整及LSTM滑动预测，有效解决了抓取偏移、空抓/误抓和滑落问题，显著提升了采摘稳定性和效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 草莓采摘机器人面临视觉感知差、夹爪对位不准、空抓/误抓和滑落等问题，导致采摘稳定性和效率低下，亟需一种能够自主诊断和恢复的解决方案。

Method: 提出端到端SRR-Net实现果实与夹爪的联合检测、分割和成熟度回归；基于目标-夹爪同时检测的相对误差补偿方法校正位置偏差；末端集成微型光学相机提供实时视觉反馈，采用MobileNet V3-Small分类器在放气阶段进行抓取调整；在折断阶段使用时序LSTM分类器预测草莓滑落，并据此执行二次充气与再抓取或终止循环。

Result: 夹爪与采摘点之间沿x轴和y轴的平均绝对误差从11.50 mm和5.25 mm分别降低到3.12 mm和4.06 mm，时间增加0.64±0.24 s；抓取调整模块减少约0.5 s抓取阶段；滑落预测对已滑落案例处理成功率为88.89%，每个失败循环节省约4.00 s，对正在滑落草莓的恢复率达81.25%，额外需要0.63 s重新抓取。

Conclusion: 所提出的视觉故障诊断与自恢复框架有效解决了草莓采摘机器人常见的视觉感知与抓取故障问题，在可接受的时间成本内显著提升了采摘精度、成功率和效率。

Abstract: Strawberry-harvesting robots faced challenges such as poor visual perception, gripper misalignment, empty grasp/misgrasp, and slippage, which reduced harvesting stability and efficiency.To overcome these issues, this paper proposes a visual fault diagnosis and self-recovery framework. An end-to-end SRR-Net achieved unified perception and fault diagnosis through joint detection, segmentation, and ripeness regression of the fruit and gripper.
