Leveraging this integrated perception, a relative error compensation method driven by simultaneous target-gripper detection was designed to correct positional misalignments exceeding the tolerance threshold. A micro-optical camera integrated within the end-effector delivered real-time visual feedback. Based on the micro-optical camera, a MobileNet V3-Small classifier was utilized for grasp adjustment during the deflating stage, enabling the early abort of the harvesting cycle in cases of empty grasp/misgrasps. Furthermore, a time-series LSTM classifier was applied during the snap-off stage to predict strawberry slippage. Based on these predictions, the system executed re-inflation and a secondary snap-off attempt for slipping strawberries, or aborted the cycle for slipped strawberries. Experiments demonstrated that the mean absolute errors between the end-effector and the picking point were reduced to 3.12 mm and 4.06 mm from 11.50 mm and 5.25 mm along the x- and y-axes, respectively, at the cost of a time increment of 0.64 $pm$ 0.24 s. The grasp adjustment module reduced the grasping phase by approximately 0.5 s and avoided empty-placement for failure cases. The strawberry slip prediction module handled slipped cases with an 88.89% success rate, saving approximately 4.00 s per harvesting cycle for failure cases. Also, it achieved an 81.25% recovery rate for slipping strawberries, requiring additional 0.63 s for re-grasping.

</details>


### [932] [On-the-fly hand-eye calibration for the da Vinci surgical robot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.14871)
*Zejian Cui,Ferdinando Rodriguez y Baena*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种在机器人辅助微创手术中实时计算手眼变换矩阵的校准框架，通过特征关联和手眼校准两个模块实现无预训练的鲁棒工具定位，在公开数据集上验证了其高精度和高效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在机器人辅助微创手术中，线缆驱动机器人（如达芬奇手术机器人）的编码器读数误差导致工具定位不准确，影响患者安全和手术执行效果，亟需一种能够实时校正的校准方法。

Method: 提出一个校准框架，包含两个相互关联的算法模块：特征关联模块（为单目图像上检测到的关键点提供鲁棒对应关系，无需预训练）和手眼校准模块（采用多种滤波方法以适应不同手术场景）。通过实时计算手眼变换矩阵实现工具定位。

Result: 在多种公开视频数据集上（涵盖体外和离体场景、不同光照条件和关键点测量精度）进行测试，工具定位误差显著降低，精度与其他最先进方法相当，同时具有更高的时间效率。

Conclusion: 提出的校准框架能够有效降低RMIS中工具定位误差，在保持精度的同时提升计算效率，具有较好的鲁棒性和场景适应性。

Abstract: In Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive Surgery (RMIS), accurate tool localization is crucial to ensure patient safety and successful task execution. However, this remains challenging for cable-driven robots, such as the da Vinci robot, because erroneous encoder readings lead to pose estimation errors. In this study, we propose a calibration framework to produce accurate tool localization results through computing the hand-eye transformation matrix on-the-fly. The framework consists of two interrelated algorithms: the feature association block and the hand-eye calibration block, which provide robust correspondences for key points detected on monocular images without pre-training, and offer the versatility to accommodate various surgical scenarios by adopting an array of filter approaches, respectively. To validate its efficacy, we test the framework extensively on publicly available video datasets that feature multiple surgical instruments conducting tasks in both in vitro and ex vivo scenarios, under varying illumination conditions and with different levels of key point measurement accuracy. The results show a significant reduction in tool localization errors under the proposed calibration framework, with accuracies comparable to other state-of-the-art methods while being more time-efficient.

</details>


### [933] [Robot-DIFT: Correspondence-Sensitive Diffusion Features for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11934)
*Yu Deng,Yufeng Jin,Xiaogang Jia,Jiahong Xue,Gerhard Neumann,Georgia Chalvatzaki*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Robot-DIFT，通过流形蒸馏将扩散特征转化为确定性单次前馈骨干，结合空间-语义特征金字塔网络(S2-FPN)向策略暴露细粒度对应线索，解决了接触丰富操作任务中语义不变性抑制闭环控制对应线索的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操作常在最后毫米级失败，因为语义不变性抑制了闭环控制所需的对应线索（位姿偏移、边界、预接触对齐），而现有视觉编码器虽提供强语义抽象但缺乏对应敏感性。

Method: 通过流形蒸馏将噪声条件扩散教师模型转化为确定性单次前馈学生网络，保留特征流形；设计S2-FPN融合由粗到细的解码器特征，生成同时暴露语义上下文和精细接触细节的视觉token。

Result: 在RoboCasa、LIBERO-10和真实机器人上，Robot-DIFT在接触敏感任务上优于视觉-语言、自监督、几何导向和扩散基线方法。控制实验表明S2-FPN解锁而非替代扩散对应先验。

Conclusion: 扩散特征蕴含的密集对应先验可以通过蒸馏和合适特征金字塔结构有效服务于实时控制，弥合语义理解与精细操作之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: Robot manipulation often fails in the final millimeters: a policy may recognize the right object yet miss the pose offsets, boundaries, or pre-contact alignments needed for action. We argue that such failures arise when semantic invariance suppresses correspondence cues for closed-loop control, or when these cues are not exposed to the policy in a usable form. Modern visual encoders provide strong semantic abstractions, but contact-rich manipulation requires correspondence sensitivity: discriminative feature responses to action-relevant changes in pose, boundary, and contact geometry. Diffusion features provide a strong prior for dense correspondence, but direct use is impractical due to stochasticity, latency, and representation drift. We introduce Robot-DIFT, a deterministic diffusion-derived backbone for real-time control. Through Manifold Distillation, Robot-DIFT converts a noise-conditioned diffusion Teacher into a clean-input, single-pass Student while preserving the teacher's feature manifold. A Spatial--Semantic Feature Pyramid Network (S2-FPN) fuses coarse-to-fine Student decoder features into visual tokens that expose semantic context and fine contact detail to the policy. Across RoboCasa, LIBERO-10, and real robots, Robot-DIFT outperforms vision--language, self-supervised, geometry-oriented, and diffusion baselines on contact-sensitive tasks. Controlled backbone/readout swaps show that S2-FPN unlocks, rather than replaces, the diffusion correspondence prior.

</details>


### [934] [SODA-CitrON: Static Object Data Association by Clustering Multi-Modal Sensor Detections Online](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.22243)
*Jan Nausner,Kilian Wohlleben,Michael Hubner*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为SODA-CitrON的在线静态目标数据关联与融合方法，通过无监督聚类处理异构传感器检测，在loglinear复杂度下实现了优于JPDA、DBSTREAM等方法的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典数据关联方法（如JPDA）针对动态目标设计，不适用于静态目标——静态目标被间歇性观测且具有异构不确定性，运动模型在区分目标和杂波时提供极少的判别信息。

Method: 提出SODA-CitrON方法，采用在线无监督机器学习聚类多模态传感器检测，同时估计位置并维持未知数量目标的持久轨迹。算法完全在线运行，处理时序不相关和多传感器测量，具有最坏情况loglinear复杂度，并提供完全可解释的输出。

Result: 在多种蒙特卡洛仿真场景中，与POM滤波、DBSTREAM聚类和JPDA等方法相比，SODA-CitrON在F1分数、位置RMSE、MOTP和MOTA等指标上 consistently 优于对比方法。

Conclusion: SODA-CitrON有效解决了静态目标数据关联难题，兼顾了在线性、计算效率和可解释性，在静态目标建图场景中表现优越。

Abstract: The online fusion and tracking of static objects from heterogeneous sensor detections is a fundamental problem in robotics, autonomous systems, and environmental mapping. Although classical data association approaches such as JPDA are well suited for dynamic targets, they are less effective for static objects observed intermittently and with heterogeneous uncertainties, where motion models provide minimal discriminative power with respect to clutter. In this paper, we propose a novel method for static object data association by clustering multi-modal sensor detections online (SODA-CitrON), while simultaneously estimating positions and maintaining persistent tracks for an unknown number of objects. The proposed unsupervised machine learning approach operates in a fully online manner and handles temporally uncorrelated and multi-sensor measurements. Additionally, it has a worst-case loglinear complexity in the number of sensor detections while providing full output explainability. We evaluate the proposed approach in different Monte Carlo simulation scenarios and compare it against state-of-the-art methods, including POM-based filtering, DBSTREAM clustering, and JPDA. The results demonstrate that SODA-CitrON consistently outperforms the compared methods in terms of F1 score, position RMSE, MOTP, and MOTA in the static object mapping scenarios studied.

</details>


### [935] [Sparse Autoencoders Reveal Interpretable and Steerable Features in VLA Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19183)
*Aiden Swann,Lachlain McGranahan,Hugo Buurmeijer,Monroe Kennedy,Mac Schwager*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文通过稀疏自编码器（SAEs）分析VLA模型的内部表征，发现可解释且可因果操控的通用特征（如运动基元和语义概念），并通过引导实验验证这些特征对行为控制的作用，揭示了VLA泛化的机制基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型在机器人操作中表现优异，但对其在对象、场景和指令间泛化的内部机制（何时及为何泛化）缺乏深入研究。

Method: 在VLA隐藏层激活上训练稀疏自编码器（SAEs），学习稀疏字典并发现可解释特征；提出指标区分通用可迁移基元与回合特定的记忆化特征；通过LIBERO仿真和DROID真实硬件上的引导实验验证特征的可因果操控性。

Result: 识别出对应运动基元和语义概念的SAE特征，部分特征在回合间通用且可因果引导；放大通用/语义特征可诱导一致行为，消融则破坏模型性能；引导可用于控制无提示方向的行为。

Conclusion: VLA模型能够学习可重复使用的内部特征，连接感知、语言和动作，跨任务和场景实现泛化，为理解VLA泛化机制提供了机械论证据。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising approach for general-purpose robot manipulation. However, little research has mechanistically explored when and why they generalize across objects, scenes, and instructions. To probe internal representations, we train Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) on the VLA's hidden-layer activations. SAEs learn sparse dictionaries over model activations, often revealing features that correspond to interpretable directions in the model's representation space. We identify SAE features corresponding to motion primitives and semantic concepts, including features that are general across episodes and causally steerable. We propose a metric to categorize features as general transferable primitives or episode-specific memorizations, offering a promising glimpse towards VLA generalization. We validate these findings through steering experiments on both the LIBERO simulation benchmark and on real-world DROID hardware. We find that amplifying general and semantic features induces behaviors consistent with their meanings, whereas ablating them destroys model performance. Furthermore, we demonstrate steering as a way to control behavior in unpromptable directions. Together, these results provide mechanistic evidence that VLAs can learn reusable internal features linking perception, language, and action across tasks and scenes. Our project page is located at https://drvla.github.io

</details>


### [936] [Decentralized End-to-End Multi-AAV Pursuit Using Predictive Spatio-Temporal Observation via Deep Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.24238)
*Yude Li,Zhexuan Zhou,Huizhe Li,Yanke Sun,Yenan Wu,Yichen Lai,Yiming Wang,Youmin Gong,Jie Mei*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于端到端多智能体强化学习的去中心化协同追捕框架，利用预测性时空观测（PSTO）将原始LiDAR观测直接映射为连续控制指令，在杂波环境中实现静态障碍避让、动态目标拦截和协同包围，仿真和实物实验均验证了其高效性和可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖抽象几何特征或特权地面真值状态，规避了现实环境中部分和噪声感知带来的不确定性，缺乏能够处理真实感知不确定性的去中心化协同追捕方案。

Method: 提出去中心化端到端MARL框架，核心是预测性时空观测（PSTO）——一种自我中心网格表示，在统一固定分辨率投影中对齐障碍物几何、预测性对手意图和队友运动；基于PSTO训练单一去中心化策略，直接处理原始LiDAR观测并输出连续控制指令。

Result: 仿真中相比依赖特权障碍物信息的SOTA学习方法，捕获效率更优且成功率具有竞争力；统一策略无需重新训练即可无缝扩展到不同团队规模；完全自主的室外四旋翼机群实物实验验证了仅依赖机载感知与计算的可行性。

Conclusion: 去中心化端到端MARL结合PSTO表示能够有效解决杂波环境下的协同追捕问题，兼顾感知不确定性、可扩展性与实物部署可行性。

Abstract: Decentralized cooperative pursuit in cluttered environments is challenging for autonomous aerial swarms, especially under partial and noisy perception. Existing methods often rely on abstracted geometric features or privileged ground-truth states, and therefore sidestep perceptual uncertainty in real-world settings. We propose a decentralized end-to-end multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework that maps raw LiDAR observations directly to continuous control commands. Central to the framework is the Predictive Spatio-Temporal Observation (PSTO), an egocentric grid representation that aligns obstacle geometry with predictive adversarial intent and teammate motion in a unified, fixed-resolution projection. Built on PSTO, a single decentralized policy enables agents to navigate static obstacles, intercept dynamic targets, and maintain cooperative encirclement. Simulations demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior capture efficiency and competitive success rates compared to state-of-the-art learning-based approaches relying on privileged obstacle information. Furthermore, the unified policy scales seamlessly across different team sizes without retraining. Finally, fully autonomous outdoor experiments validate the framework on a quadrotor swarm relying on only onboard sensing and computing.

</details>


### [937] [FingerEye: Learning Dexterous Manipulation with Continuous Vision-Tactile Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.20689)
*Zhixuan Xu,Yichen Li,Xuanye Wu,Tianyu Qiu,Lin Shao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FingerEye是一种融合双目视觉与触觉的感知与学习框架，通过在 fingertips 集成RGB摄像头和可变形接触接口，实现从接近前、接触中到接触后的连续视觉-触觉反馈，从而提升灵巧机器人操作能力。通过分组结构化模态融合策略，在7个接触敏感任务中相比仅手腕视觉策略提升超过30个百分点的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧机器人操作需要从接触前到接触后始终保持信息丰富的感知，但现有方法在接触前后感知的连续性上存在不足，缺乏同时支持接近定位和接触力感知的集成传感方案。

Method: 传感层面：在指尖集成双目RGB摄像头（接触前提供近距离视觉和立体信息）与带标记点的可变形圆环（接触后通过标记点形变推断接触力）。学习层面：构建虚实结合的数据采集与评估系统，提出FingerEye Policy，采用分组结构化模态融合策略减少模态捷径（modality shortcut），充分利用分布式指尖反馈。

Result: 在7个接触敏感任务上，FingerEye在仿真和真实环境中均比仅手腕视觉的策略平均成功率提升超过30个百分点。

Conclusion: FingerEye通过连续视觉-触觉反馈和分组模态融合策略，显著提升了灵巧机器人在接触敏感任务中的操作性能，验证了分布式指尖传感与融合学习的有效性。

Abstract: Dexterous robotic manipulation requires perception that remains informative from pre-contact approach to contact initiation and post-contact control. We introduce FingerEye, a sensing and learning framework that strengthens robotic dexterity through continuous vision-tactile feedback throughout interaction. On the sensing side, FingerEye integrates binocular RGB cameras with a compliant contact interface to support perception both before and after contact. Before contact, the fingertip cameras provide close-range visual cues and implicit stereo for precise approach and object localization. After contact, marker-tracked deformation of the compliant ring provides a proxy for contact wrench sensing. On the learning side, we build real-and-sim infrastructure for data collection and evaluation, systematically study policy-interface designs for learning with multiple FingerEye sensors, and develop FingerEye Policy, which applies group-structured modality fusion to reduce modality shortcuts and better exploit distributed fingertip feedback. Across seven contact-sensitive task settings, FingerEye improves wrist-only policy by over 30 percentage points in mean success rate in both simulation and the real world.

</details>


### [938] [CodeGraphVLP: Code-as-Planner Meets Semantic-Graph State for Non-Markovian Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.22238)
*Khoa Vo,Sieu Tran,Taisei Hanyu,Yuki Ikebe,Duy Nguyen,Nghi D. Q. Bui,Minh Vu,Anthony Gunderman,Chase Rainwater,Anh Nguyen,Ngan Le*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CodeGraphVLP是一个层级框架，通过持久化语义图状态、可执行代码规划器和进度引导的视觉语言提示，解决了VLA模型在非马尔可夫长程操作任务中因部分可观测性和视觉干扰导致的失败问题，显著提升了任务完成率并降低了规划延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的VLA模型通常假设最新观测足以进行动作推理，但这在非马尔可夫长程任务中不成立——任务相关信息可能被遮挡或仅出现在早期轨迹中，且杂乱环境和干扰物使细粒度视觉定位变得脆弱。

Method: 提出CodeGraphVLP层级框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 持久化语义图状态，在部分可观测条件下维护任务相关实体和关系；(2) 基于可执行代码的规划器，在语义图上执行高效的进度检查并输出子任务指令及相关对象；(3) 进度引导的视觉语言提示，利用规划器输出构建抑制杂乱的观测，聚焦VLA执行器于关键证据。

Result: 在真实世界的非马尔可夫任务上，CodeGraphVLP相较于强VLA基线和历史增强变体提升了任务完成率，同时相比VLM-in-the-loop规划大幅降低了规划延迟。消融实验验证了各组件的贡献。

Conclusion: 通过语义图状态与代码规划器的结合，可以有效克服VLA模型在长程非马尔可夫任务中的部分可观测性和视觉干扰问题，实现更可靠的机器人操作。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models promise generalist robot manipulation, but are typically trained and deployed as short-horizon policies that assume the latest observation is sufficient for action reasoning. This assumption breaks in non-Markovian long-horizon tasks, where task-relevant evidence can be occluded or appear only earlier in the trajectory, and where clutter and distractors make fine-grained visual grounding brittle. We present CodeGraphVLP, a hierarchical framework that enables reliable long-horizon manipulation by combining a persistent semantic-graph state with an executable code-based planner and progress-guided visual-language prompting. The semantic-graph maintains task-relevant entities and relations under partial observability. The synthesized planner executes over this semantic-graph to perform efficient progress checks and outputs a subtask instruction together with subtask-relevant objects. We use these outputs to construct clutter-suppressed observations that focus the VLA executor on critical evidence. On real-world non-Markovian tasks, CodeGraphVLP improves task completion over strong VLA baselines and history-enabled variants while substantially lowering planning latency compared to VLM-in-the-loop planning. We also conduct extensive ablation studies to confirm the contributions of each component.

</details>


### [939] [Robust Koopman Control Barrier Filters for Safe Actor-Critic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26452)
*Dhruv S. Kushwaha,Zoleikha A. Biron*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Robust Koopman-CBF SAC框架，通过数据驱动的Koopman预测器构建CBF安全滤波器，并利用投影残差边界处理近似误差，在安全强化学习任务中实现零约束违反，同时揭示了线性EDMD模型和速度势垒在高维任务中的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 控制障碍函数(CBF)在安全强化学习中能提供最小干预的安全滤波，但现有方法依赖精确动力学和手工设计的屏障证书，限制了其在无模型RL中的应用。

Method: 1) 从数据中学习有限维Koopman预测器；2) 在提升空间中构造仿射CBF约束；3) 通过二次规划安全层强制执行约束；4) 利用保留轨迹的投影残差边界收紧CBF条件，补偿有限维近似误差；5) 评论家在执行的Safe Action上训练，演员正则化向CBF可行域靠近。

Result: 在CartPole稳定与跟踪任务中实现零约束违反，回报匹配或超越无约束SAC；在Safety Gymnasium高维运动任务中部分场景减少违规，但揭示了一阶速度势垒和线性EDMD模型的局限性。

Conclusion: 鲁棒Koopman-CBF滤波器是无模型RL与可证明安全性之间的有前景桥梁，但需高阶CBF和多步Koopman扩展以处理复杂系统。

Abstract: Safe reinforcement learning (RL) for robotic systems requires policies that improve task performance while satisfying state and input constraints during both training and deployment. Control barrier functions (CBFs) provide a principled mechanism for enforcing forward invariance through minimally invasive safety filters, but their use in model-free RL is limited by the need for accurate dynamics and hand-designed barrier certificates. We propose Robust Koopman-CBF SAC, a safety-filtered actor--critic framework that learns a finite-dimensional Koopman predictor from data, constructs affine CBF constraints in the lifted space, and enforces them through a quadratic-program safety layer. To account for finite-dimensional Koopman approximation error, the CBF condition is tightened using a projected residual margin estimated from held-out rollout data. The critic is trained on the executed safe action, while the actor is regularized toward the Koopman-CBF feasible set, reducing dependence on the filter over training. Across safe-control benchmarks, the method achieves zero constraint violations on CartPole stabilization and tracking while matching or exceeding unconstrained SAC returns. On high-dimensional Safety Gymnasium locomotion tasks, the method reduces violations in some settings but also exposes important limitations of first-order velocity barriers and linear EDMD models, motivating high-order and multi-step Koopman-CBF extensions. These results suggest that robust Koopman-CBF filters are a promising bridge between model-free RL and certifiable safety, while clarifying the structural conditions under which such filters remain effective.

</details>


### [940] [BORA: Bridging Offline Reinforcement Learning and Online Residual Adaptation for Real-World Dexterous VLA Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30226)
*Zhongxi Chen,Yifan Han,Yanming Shao,Huanming Liu,Congsheng Xu,Xiaoyu Chen,Yao Mu,Wenzhao Lian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: BORA是一个面向真实世界灵巧操作VLA模型的离线到在线RL后训练框架，通过离线阶段构建动作条件价值引导的评论家，以及在线阶段引入冻结VLA基础+轻量级人类在环分块残差适应机制，显著提升了灵巧操作的成功率和泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型在灵巧操作中面临高维手部控制和执行误差累积两大挑战，真实世界RL后训练虽能弥合差距，但高维灵巧探索会导致时间不一致性、样本低效和硬件风险。

Method: BORA框架包含两个阶段：离线阶段构建同时接收VLM认知token和动作块的评论家，实现动作条件价值引导；在线阶段冻结VLA基础模型，引入人类在环的分块残差适应机制，利用离线评论家和干预驱动奖励来纠正执行误差并适应真实世界物理变化。

Result: 在五个复杂真实世界灵巧操作任务中，BORA相比纯模仿学习和传统解耦RL基线，标准设置下平均成功率提升33%，未见物体泛化场景下提升43%。

Conclusion: BORA通过离线到在线的RL后训练框架，有效弥合了VLA模型在灵巧操作中的视觉动作生成与物理可靠执行之间的差距，为真实世界灵巧操作提供了一种高效可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for grounding visual-language understanding into real-world robotic manipulation. However, dexterous manipulation remains challenging for VLA policies due to high-dimensional hand control and compounding execution errors, which makes real-world RL post-training essential for bridging the gap between visually grounded action generation and physically reliable dexterous execution. However, high-dimensional dexterous exploration often triggers temporal inconsistency, sample inefficiency and hardware risks in the real world. To address these challenges, we propose BORA, an offline-to-online RL post-training framework designed for real-world dexterous VLA models. In the offline phase, BORA constructs a critic that takes both the VLM's cognition tokens and action chunks as inputs. This design enables action-conditioned value guidance, allowing the critic to evaluate dexterous hand motions beyond visual context alone. During the subsequent online phase, BORA freezes the VLA base and introduces a lightweight, Human-in-the-Loop (HiL) chunk-wise residual adaptation mechanism to mitigate real-world execution errors and further correct the offline-learned intents within the actual physical environment. By inheriting the offline critic and employing intervention-driven rewards, BORA effectively corrects execution discrepancies and adapts to real-world physical variances while preserving the pretrained policy as a stable prior. Extensive evaluations across five complex real-world dexterous tasks demonstrate that BORA significantly outperforms pure imitation learning and traditional decoupled RL baselines, achieving a 33% absolute increase in average success rate under standard settings and up to a 43% improvement in unseen object generalization.

</details>


### [941] [Continuous Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00229)
*Yueh-Hua Wu,Tatsuya Matsushima,Kei Ota*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Continuous Reasoning方法，用共享的高斯潜变量替代自然语言作为VLA的推理媒介，并通过自验证目标确保其可共享和可验证，在LIBERO-PRO和真实机器人上显著提升了任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言在连续控制任务中与动作的细粒度不匹配：文本和显式子目标在任务级粒度运作，而VLA策略需要在更细的时间尺度上选择动作，导致推理步骤与当前所需动作之间耦合松散。因此需要重新思考VLA中“语言”的角色——一个有用的推理媒介应当可跨实例共享、可通过下游动作改进验证、并与时间扩展的控制结构对齐。

Method: 提出Continuous Reasoning模型：1）首先预测连续推理，形式为结构化连续思维集（共享高斯潜变量接口）；2）将其复用为块结构动作生成的共享上下文。训练采用自验证目标：指数移动平均教师模型必须成功消费学生的推理来预测目标动作，确保推理媒介可共享且可验证，避免成为模型私有的捷径。

Result: 在LIBERO-PRO上提升了鲁棒性；在真实机器人上，相比于π0.5，在TX-G2（AgiBot G2兼容变体）上平均子任务成功率提升40.4%，在HSR上提升26.3%。

Conclusion: VLA中的推理不在于增加额外的token数量，而在于构建一个可共享、可验证的面向动作的内部语言。

Abstract: Natural language is a powerful reasoning medium for language and vision-language models, but it is mismatched to the granularity of continuous control. Text and explicit subgoals operate at task-level granularity, whereas vision-language-action (VLA) policies must choose actions at a much finer temporal scale; a single reasoning step can therefore span many action chunks while remaining only weakly coupled to the action needed now. This suggests a different question for VLA: what should play the role of language? We argue that a useful VLA reasoning medium must be shareable across model instances, verifiable through downstream action improvement, and aligned with temporally extended control structure.
  Based on this view, we propose Continuous Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action. Our model first predicts continuous reasoning in the form of a structured set of continuous thoughts, then reuses them as shared context for chunk-structured action generation. Better action prediction alone does not certify good reasoning: if the same internal medium cannot be shared across model instances and independently verified through improved downstream control, the added latent may simply become a model-private shortcut that helps on seen behaviors without supporting generalizable control. We therefore instantiate continuous reasoning as a shared Gaussian latent interface and train it with a self-verification objective in which an exponential-moving-average teacher must successfully consume the student's reasoning when predicting target actions.
  Empirically, Continuous Reasoning improves LIBERO-PRO robustness and performs strongly on real robots, raising mean subtask success over π0.5 by 40.4% on TX-G2, an AgiBot G2-compatible variant, and 26.3% on HSR. This suggests that reasoning in VLA is less about extra tokens than about a shareable, verifiable internal language for action.

</details>


### [942] [ImagineUAV: Aerial Vision-Language Navigation via World-Action Modeling and Kinodynamic Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01205)
*Xuchen Liu,Jiawei Huang,Shihao Xia,Bingxi Liu,Jinqiang Cui,Jiankun Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ImagineUAV提出了一种基于级联世界-动作建模的想象力驱动框架，通过潜在视频扩散模型生成指令条件下的未来观测，再由动作提取器和运动动力学规划器推导出6-DoF无碰撞轨迹，仅1.3B参数即在VLN基准和真实飞行中超越此前方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型在无人机VLN任务中因几何不一致和动力学不匹配而表现脆弱，亟需一种能显式建模环境演变并保证轨迹安全可行的方法。

Method: 采用级联世界-动作建模：首先用潜在视频扩散模型生成指令条件下的未来观测（想象环境演化），然后通过动作提取器推断6-DoF运动，再经运动动力学规划器优化为无碰撞轨迹，并使用步骤蒸馏推理管线实现实时执行。

Result: 仅1.3B参数，在标准VLN基准和真实世界飞行中均优于此前VLN和VLA基线方法。

Conclusion: 验证了想象力驱动的空中导航的实用性和有效性，表明通过显式想象环境演变可以克服直接回归方法的脆弱性。

Abstract: Vision-language navigation (VLN) for UAVs demands grounding free-form instructions into 6-DoF flight under partial observability. While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel at semantic reasoning, they suffer from brittleness due to geometric inconsistency and dynamics mismatch. To address this, we propose ImagineUAV, an imagination-driven framework leveraging cascaded world-action modeling. Instead of direct regression, ImagineUAV employs a latent video diffusion model to generate instruction-conditioned future observations, explicitly imagining environmental evolution, from which 6-DoF motions are inferred via an action extractor. A kinodynamic planner then refines these estimates into collision-free trajectories. Additionally, a step-distilled inference pipeline ensures real-time execution. With only 1.3B parameters, ImagineUAV outperforms prior VLN and VLA baselines on benchmarks and real-world flights, validating the practicality of imagination-driven aerial navigation.

</details>


### [943] [Crazyflow: An Accurate, GPU-Accelerated, Differentiable Drone Simulator in JAX](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01478)
*Martin Schuck,Marcel P. Rath,Yufei Hua,Abhishek Goudar,SiQi Zhou,Angela P. Schoellig*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Crazyflow是一个面向空中机器人的仿真平台，在速度上比现有SOTA快一个数量级以上（单机），可并行模拟数千个含4000架无人机的集群。它同时支持基于解析梯度的策略学习（亚厘米级轨迹跟踪精度）和基于采样的避障（每秒超5亿步），并首次实现了飞行中强化学习（0.38秒内从零训练恢复策略）。该平台兼容多种仿真抽象层级和所有开源Crazyflie模型，提供轻量级系统辨识流水线，打破了传统"训练-部署"范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空中机器人仿真器各自独立支持保真度、可微分性和集群等特性，缺少一个能同时涵盖所有这些领域的统一平台。

Method: 设计了Crazyflow仿真器，在速度、精度和可微分性三个维度同时优化，支持从单智能体到多智能体、从基于模型到数据驱动、从基于梯度到基于采样的多种算法范式。

Result: 单机速度比现有SOTA快一个数量级以上；支持大规模集群模拟（数千个含4000架无人机的集群）；亚厘米级轨迹跟踪精度；避障速度超5亿步/秒；0.38秒内完成飞行中强化学习训练。

Conclusion: Crazyflow作为开源资源，通过同时推动精度、速度和可微分性，支持大规模并行化的在线执行学习和优化，为新型算法开发开辟了新方向。

Abstract: High-quality, large-scale synthetic data from simulations is becoming a cornerstone for pushing the capabilities of robot algorithms. While aerial robotics simulators have evolved to support specialized needs such as fidelity, differentiability, and swarms independently, a unified platform that can synthesize data across all these domains is missing. In this work, we propose Crazyflow, a simulator designed to push the limits of aerial-robotics algorithm development, from model-based to data-driven methods, gradient-based to sampling-based approaches, and single-agent to multi-agent systems. Compared to existing state-of-the-art drone simulators, it achieves speeds more than an order of magnitude faster for a single drone and can simulate thousands of swarms of 4000 drones each. Real-world experiments show Crazyflow supports both analytical-gradient-based policy learning, achieving sub-centimeter trajectory tracking accuracy without domain randomization, and sampling-based obstacle avoidance at speeds exceeding half a billion steps per second. Breaking the traditional train-then-deploy paradigm, we show that its unprecedented speed even enables in-flight reinforcement learning; we demonstrate this by throwing a physical drone into the air and training a recovery policy from scratch in 0.38 seconds, successfully stabilizing the drone. Crazyflow supports multiple levels of simulation abstraction, is directly compatible with all open-source Crazyflie models, and enables rapid reconfiguration across custom drone platforms and applications by providing a light-weight system identification pipeline. By pushing accuracy, speed, and differentiability simultaneously, Crazyflow serves as an open-source resource for synthetic data generation, with emerging capabilities for large-scale parallelization for online, in-execution learning and optimization, opening the door to novel algorithm development.

</details>


### [944] [Dexterity-BEV: Aligning 3D World and Actions for Generalizable Robot Policies Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02274)
*Huayi Zhou,Wei Gao,Dekun Lu,Ruiji Liu,Zhanqi Zhang,Ziyang Zhang,Jian Chen,Wenlve Zhou,Sheng Xu,Shumin Li,Kangyi Guo,Shichen Xu,Zixin Huang,Yongyi Su,Kui Jia*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Dex-BEV框架，通过引入对齐顶点图和顶点频谱作为3D表示，并结合规范鸟瞰图（BEV）对齐框架，解决端到端操纵策略中存在的2D视觉输入忽略3D本质、以及输入输出空间对齐不足的问题，提升了操纵策略的泛化性和一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端操纵策略结合大规模预训练VLM虽具潜力，但存在两大局限：1）依赖2D RGB输入，忽略操纵任务固有的3D特性；2）缺乏输入输出空间以及不同机器人、相机设置和轨迹数据集之间的3D空间对齐。

Method: 1）提出对齐顶点图（aligned vertex map）和顶点频谱（vertex spectrum）作为逐像素3D表示，将2D视觉输入提升至3D；2）通过将每像素3D信息和机器人动作表达至共享坐标，实现输入输出对齐；3）设计规范BEV对齐框架，构建BEV图像以获得视角不变表示；4）开发数据处理流水线，包括新颖的跨机器人、人类操作者和数据集的轨迹时间对齐方案。

Result: 所提贡献共同缓解了输入输出的时空错位问题，提升了真实世界操纵任务的一致性和泛化能力。

Conclusion: 通过3D对齐表示和BEV规范框架，有效克服了2D基础模型在机器人操纵中的固有缺陷，为大规模、跨平台、跨设置的泛化操纵提供了可行方案。

Abstract: End-to-end manipulation policies, combined with web-scale pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs), show the promise for generalizable and dexterous robotic manipulation. However, they inherit two key limitations from 2D foundation models: 1) the reliance on 2D RGB inputs that ignores the intrinsically 3D nature of manipulation; and 2) the lack of spatial 3D alignment between input-output spaces as well as across diverse robot embodiments, camera setups, and trajectory datasets. In this paper, we present a series of contributions to address these issues. First, we introduce aligned vertex map and vertex spectrum -- a pixel-wise 3D representation that elevates 2D visual inputs to 3D, using camera calibration and optional depth. This novel input representation marries 3D awareness with the generalization of 2D large VLMs. Then, we propose to align the inputs and outputs of manipulation policies by expressing per-pixel 3D information of each camera view and robot actions to a shared coordinate. Based on this, we designate a canonical Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) alignment frame and innovatively propose to construct BEV images, producing a view-invariant representation robust to camera pose variations. To enable training and evaluation at scale, we develop a comprehensive data processing pipeline to perform such alignments; we also introduce a novel temporal alignment scheme for trajectories across diverse robots, human operators, and datasets. These contributions collectively mitigate input and output spatial-temporal misalignments, improving the consistency and generalization for real-world manipulation. Pretrained checkpoint, source code and data processing pipeline are available in https://hnuzhy.github.io/projects/Dex-BEV.

</details>


### [945] [IMAC-AgriVLN: Can Agricultural Vision-and-Language Navigation Agents be Aware of Instruction Mistakes?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02519)
*Xiaobei Zhao,Xingqi Lyu,Xin Chen,Xiang Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 针对农业VLN中指令可能包含错误这一现实问题，提出A2A-MI基准和IMAC模块，通过在指令中插入三类错误并设计纠错机制，显著提升了机器人在指令错误场景下的导航性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有农业VLN方法均假设给定指令是正确的，但这与现实场景不符——任何人都有可能说出带错误的指令。需要填补这一研究空白。

Method: 1) 构建A2A-MI基准，包含半自动数据标注器，将三类错误更高效、多样化地插入原始指令；2) 提出IMAC模块，通过分析指令与当前前方图像，判断指令是否有误并在必要时尝试纠正；3) 将IMAC集成到基线模型中。

Result: 现有SOTA农业VLN代理在A2A-MI上出现显著性能下降：SR下降57%，NE下降9%。而集成IMAC后性能大幅提升，缩小了与无错误指令场景的差距。

Conclusion: 农业VLN代理需要具备对指令错误的怀疑意识，IMAC模块能有效建立这种意识，纠正指令错误。

Abstract: Agricultural robots are serving as powerful assistants across a wide range of agricultural tasks, nevertheless, still heavily relying on manual operations or railway systems for movement. The AgriVLN method and the A2A benchmark pioneeringly extended Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) to the agricultural domain, enabling a robot to navigate to a target position following a natural language instruction. However, almost all the prior methods adopt an ideal assumption that the given instructions themselves are correct, which does not align with the realistic scenarios, because anybody may say an instruction with mistakes. To bridge this gap, we propose the A2A-MI benchmark, in which we build a semi-automatic data annotator to insert three mistake classifications into each original instruction in a more diversified and efficient way. We test several state-of-the-art agricultural VLN agents on it and observe a sufficient drop with -57% on SR and -9% on NE, from which we suggest that an agricultural VLN agent tends to assume that the given instruction is correct, so does not have the awareness to doubt it when the scenes it sees do not align with the instruction it receives. To build the awareness on instruction mistake, we propose the IMAC module analyzing the instruction and the current front-facing image, to judge whether the instruction has mistakes and attempt to correct it when needed. We integrate IMAC into the baseline model, and observe a noteworthy improvement, sufficiently narrowing the gap to the performance on instructions without mistakes. Project: https://github.com/AlexTraveling/IMAC-AgriVLN.

</details>


### [946] [See Less, Specify More: Visual Evidence Budgets for Generalizable VLAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02735)
*Yueh-Hua Wu,Tatsuya Matsushima,Kei Ota*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: S2 (See Less, Specify More) 框架通过细化指令（Specify More）和限制视觉证据预算（See Less）来提升VLA模型的泛化能力，在8个真实机器人任务上将平均子任务成功率从54.2%提升至79.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型在干扰物、外观变化和语义相似任务下泛化能力差，根本原因在于粗粒度指令导致监督别称（supervision aliasing），且模型需要从不加约束的视觉上下文中自行解决歧义。

Method: Specify More：保留原始指令作为高层目标，同时为每条轨迹重新标注细粒度的轨迹级和子任务级语言描述以消除执行歧义。See Less：引入显式视觉证据预算机制，训练执行器仅基于任务充分的视觉证据行动，无需区域或掩码标注。

Result: 在TX-G2（AgiBot G2兼容变体）和HSR上的8个真实机器人任务中，S2将平均子任务成功率从pi0.5基线的54.2%提升至79.0%。

Conclusion: 训练执行器使用信息丰富的局部引导和任务充分的视觉证据，而非从弱监督中自行恢复这两者，能够显著提升VLA模型的泛化能力。

Abstract: Generalization remains a central bottleneck for vision-language-action (VLA) models: under distractors, appearance shifts, and semantically similar tasks, the policy must often infer local execution details from coarse instructions while also deciding which parts of the image matter for control. We present S2 (See Less, Specify More), a framework for improving VLA generalization by training the executor under a cleaner interface.
  Specify More preserves the original instruction as a stable high-level goal while relabeling each trajectory into refined trajectory- and subtask-level language that disambiguates the current execution mode. Unlike native attention, See Less imposes an explicit visual evidence budget, training the executor to act from task-sufficient evidence rather than unconstrained visual context, without any region or mask annotation.
  This interface lets the executor follow detailed guidance without relying on distracting visual patches or resolving avoidable ambiguity on its own, and it remains compatible with off-the-shelf VLM planners through in-context learning. Across our main evaluation settings, S2 improves overall generalization metrics by changing the executor's learning problem: coarse instructions induce avoidable supervision aliasing, goal-preserving local guidance outperforms instruction replacement in our main ablations, and explicit evidence budgeting reduces dependence on broad visual context beyond efficiency considerations.
  Across eight real-robot tasks on TX-G2 (an AgiBot G2-compatible variant) and HSR, S2 raises mean subtask success from 54.2% to 79.0% over pi0.5. Together, these results suggest that VLA generalization improves when the executor is trained to act from informative local guidance and task-sufficient visual evidence, rather than recovering both from weak supervision.

</details>


### [947] [Worth Remembering: Surprise-Gated Robot Episodic Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03787)
*Nicolas Gorlo,Derek K. Wise,Alberto Speranzon,Luca Carlone*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出基于贝叶斯惊奇（Bayesian surprise）的门控机制，用于机器人长期记忆中的选择性存储，通过V-JEPA-2语义潜空间计算惊奇度，结合4D场景图空间记忆，在机器人问答任务上相比先前方法提升≥12%，并在事件分割任务中以无监督因果方法超越有监督方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用机器人需要将指令与过去经验关联，但存储所有历史事件不可行（内存限制），且未来任务不可先验预知，因此需要一种通用的选择性记忆机制，保留对未来任务高价值的事件。

Method: 提出贝叶斯惊奇作为记忆形成的门控机制，在V-JEPA-2提供的语义丰富、部署无关的潜空间中计算惊奇度，以选择性地存储高惊奇（信息量大）的事件，并将其与4D场景图空间记忆结合。

Result: 在机器人问答任务中，对于时间、空间和二元问题，相比先前机器人记忆方法提升≥12%；在事件分割任务中，使用无监督因果方法超越有监督方法和非因果方法。

Conclusion: 贝叶斯惊奇是一种有效的无监督选择性记忆机制，能显著提升机器人对历史事件的推理能力，并在事件分割中展现出因果建模的优势。

Abstract: Robots solving generalist tasks need to be able to ground instructions in their past experience, since humans may refer to notable past events when giving a task (e.g., ``Take me to where the chemical spill happened yesterday''). Since memory limits make storing all past events infeasible, long-term robot memory must be selective, ideally retaining only those episodes with high utility for future tasks. However, future tasks are not typically given a priori for generalist robots. To select generically useful memories, we propose Bayesian surprise as a gating mechanism for memory formation. We present an approach to compute surprise in a semantically rich deployment-agnostic latent space provided by V-JEPA-2. Using our gated episodic memory to augment 4D scene graph-based spatial memory, we show a consistent improvement over state-of-the-art benchmarks in robot question answering, outperforming prior robot memory methods by $\geq12\%$ for temporal, spatial, and binary questions, and surpassing the performance of supervised and non-causal methods with an unsupervised causal method in event segmentation tasks.

</details>


### [948] [RealDexUMI: A Wearable Universal Manipulation Interface for Dexterous Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06033)
*Chaoyi Xu,Yixuan Jiang,Jiahui Huan,Yuhui Fu,Haoyu Zhou,Weitian Yuan,Jiayi Yu,Wanpeng Zhang,Haoqi Yuan,Zongqing Lu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出RealDexUMI，一种基于可穿戴通用操作接口的灵巧操控数据采集系统，通过共享末端执行器模块（轻量级灵巧手+手内视觉+指尖触觉）和掌侧同构遥操作手套，实现零重定向、零差距的灵巧操控数据采集，在8个真实机器人任务上达到88.75%的平均成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有灵巧操控数据采集方法要么通过重定向或具身转换损失了可部署的灵巧性，要么依赖机器人专属遥操作，成本高、难以扩展且缺乏直观的接触感知控制能力。

Method: 设计了一个共享灵巧末端执行器模块（轻量级灵巧手、手内视觉、指尖触觉），配合掌侧同构遥操作手套，实现从人手到机器人手的实时、免重定向、直观精准映射，确保采集与部署阶段的手内观测、触觉信号、接触信息和手部动作完全一致。

Result: 在8个真实机器人任务（涵盖精细操作、接触丰富、长程和双臂操控）上，策略平均成功率达88.75%，能泛化到未见过的初始位姿，并可在三种不同具身形态间迁移。

Conclusion: RealDexUMI通过同构遥操作和共享末端执行器设计，有效解决了灵巧操控数据采集中的可部署性与数据质量之间的权衡问题，为灵巧操控学习提供了一种可扩展、低成本的高质量数据采集方案。

Abstract: Learning dexterous manipulation requires demonstrations that preserve fine hand-object interactions while remaining executable at deployment. Existing pipelines either lose deployable dexterity through retargeting or embodiment conversion, or rely on robot-specific teleoperation that is costly to scale and often lacks intuitive, contact-aware control for dexterous data collection. We present RealDexUMI, a wearable universal manipulation interface built around a shared dexterous end-effector module that integrates a lightweight dexterous hand, in-hand vision, and fingertip tactile sensing. A palm-side isomorphic teleoperation glove maps human finger inputs to robot-hand joint commands, enabling real-time, retargeting-free, intuitive, and precise hand control. The shared hand and sensing modules yield zero-gap end-effector data, with matched in-hand observations, tactile signals, contacts, and hand actions between collection and deployment. Across eight real-robot tasks spanning fine-grained, contact-rich, long-horizon, and bimanual manipulation, policies trained on RealDexUMI data achieve an average success rate of 88.75%, generalize to unseen initial poses, and transfer across three embodiments. Website: https://research.beingbeyond.com/realdexumi

</details>


### [949] [HANDOFF: Humanoid Agentic Task-Space Whole-Body Control via Distilled Complementary Teachers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06493)
*Lizhi Yang,Junheng Li,Nehar Poddar,Yiling Hou,Gio Huh,Robert Griffin,Georgia Gkioxari,Aaron Ames*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出HANDOFF，一种基于紧凑显式接口的人形机器人全身控制器，通过多专家知识蒸馏和上下文条件混合门控机制，在Unitree G1平台上实现了全地形运动、操作与跌倒恢复，并支持自然语言驱动的任务规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全身控制器通常需要密集的运动学或空间参考信号，而任务规划器难以从高层语义中合成这些信号。作者希望设计一种更紧凑、直观且表达能力足够的接口，弥合任务规划与全身控制之间的鸿沟。

Method: 提出HANDOFF控制器：(1)设计紧凑显式的命令空间接口；(2)通过多教师KL散度蒸馏，将三个互补专家（全身运动跟踪（安全过滤数据）、 locomotion、跌倒恢复）的知识蒸馏到一个混合专家（MoE）学生网络中；(3)采用上下文条件门控机制动态选择专家输出。

Result: 在Unitree G1平台，HANDOFF在速度跟踪上达到SOTA水平，提供了最大的鲁棒操作工作空间之一；通过VLM驱动的智能体规划器，实现了多自然语言指令驱动的任务执行，无需任务特定数据或控制器微调。

Conclusion: 紧凑显式的接口结合多专家知识蒸馏和条件门控机制，能有效实现人形机器人全地形运动与操作控制，且具有良好的泛化性和硬件可行性。

Abstract: For a humanoid robot to be deployed in the real world, the choice of command space (i.e., the interface between task planning and whole-body control) is crucial. Existing whole-body controllers typically demand dense kinematic or spatial references that planners struggle to synthesize from task semantics. We instead propose a compact, explicit interface that is intuitive, general, modular, and expressive enough for diverse loco-manipulation skills. To this end, we introduce HANDOFF, a single humanoid whole-body controller that follows this interface and is distilled via multi-teacher KL distillation under a context-conditioned gating scheme into a mixture-of-experts student from three complementary specialists: whole-body motion tracking with safety-filtered data, locomotion, and fall-recovery. On the Unitree G1, HANDOFF matches state-of-the-art velocity tracking and offers one of the largest robust manipulation workspaces. We further demonstrate hardware feasibility through multiple natural-language-driven task roll-outs, powered by a VLM-driven agentic planner with no task-specific data or controller fine-tuning.

</details>


### [950] [QuadVerse: An Integrated Framework Aligning Visual-Physical Reality for Quadruped Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07118)
*Yuxiang Chen,Yuanhao Wang,Ziheng Zhang,Meng Zhang,Yu Liu,Yufei Jia,Tiancai Wang,Erjin Zhou,Jin Xie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: QuadVerse是一个利用重建场景作为校准基底的集成框架，通过几何约束的3D高斯泼溅、接触校准和残差动力学补偿，对齐视觉感知、物理交互和执行器动态，实现零样本视觉导航策略部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有sim-to-real方法通常分别处理视觉或动态差异，忽略了这些个体不匹配在机器人状态演化中积累和传播的问题。

Method: 1) 从RGB视频重建几何约束的3DGS场景，支持批量逼真渲染和碰撞感知语义网格提取；2) 网格用于接触校准，初始化空间变化的摩擦先验并通过轨迹后验搜索精炼；3) 通过在接触校准的地形上重放真实轨迹训练残差动力学补偿器，减少地形接触误差与执行器非理想性的纠缠。

Result: 在重建质量和 locomotion 跟踪上超过相关基线，实现了无需任务特定真实世界rollouts的零样本视觉导航策略部署。

Conclusion: 通过统一校准视觉、接触和动力学差异，QuadVerse有效缩小了sim-to-real差距，为机器人策略的零样本迁移提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Simulation is central to robot learning, yet the sim-to-real gap remains a major bottleneck. Existing approaches often tackle visual or dynamic gaps separately, overlooking how these individual mismatches accumulate and propagate throughout the robot's state evolution. In this paper, we introduce QuadVerse, an integrated framework that uses reconstructed scenes as a calibration substrate for aligning visual perception, physical interaction, and actuator dynamics. From captured RGB videos, we reconstruct geometry-constrained 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes that support batched photorealistic ego-view rendering and collision-ready semantic mesh extraction. The meshes further enable contact calibration by initializing spatially varying friction priors and refining them through trajectory-based posterior search. To address remaining actuator discrepancies, QuadVerse trains a residual dynamics compensator by replaying real-world trajectories on the contact-calibrated terrain, reducing the entanglement between terrain-induced contact errors and actuator non-idealities. Experiments show that QuadVerse improves reconstruction quality and locomotion tracking over relevant baselines. Leveraging this foundation, we demonstrate robust zero-shot visual-navigation policy deployment without task-specific real-world rollouts.

</details>
